10.1002/hec.1648.abstractZh: 成本效益分析通常基于从全因死亡率估算出的生命年收益。当一项干预措施仅影响少数死亡原因，且这些原因占所有死亡的比例很小时，这种方法可能不够精确。我们开发了一种新的成本效益分析技术，该技术能够基于特定原因的死亡率来估算生命年收益，从而考虑各种竞争性的死亡原因。在随机试验数据的背景下，我们调整了随机组间其他原因的死亡率。这种方法比基于总死亡率的分析具有更高的精确度，我们展示了其适用于生命年收益、质量调整生命年收益、增量成本以及成本效益分析。然而，在多状态健康经济模型中，来自竞争性原因的死亡率通常来源于国家统计数据，并假设在干预组之间是相同的。在这种模型中，基于特定原因的死亡率的方法与使用总死亡率的标准方法得出的估计结果和精确度基本相同。这些方法被应用于一项随机试验和一个健康经济模型，这两个模型都是针对腹部主动脉瘤的筛查。对于成本效益分析来说，精确度的提升显然有助于决策，但重要的是要确保“特定原因的死亡率”的定义能够涵盖所有可能受到干预影响的死亡原因。

abstract.text: Medicare Part B pays outpatient physicians according to the billed Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) codes, which differ in procedure and intensity. Since many performed services merely differ by intensity, physicians have an incentive to upcode services to increase profitability of a visit. Using nationally representative data from the 2001 to 2003 Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey, this paper explores the effect of Medicare Part B fee differentials on the upcoding of general office visits (i.e. for established patient visits with CPT codes of 99212-99215). It finds strong evidence that these fee differentials influence physician's coding choice for billing purposes across a variety of specialties. For general office visits, Medicare outlays attributable to upcoding may sum to as much as 15% of total expenditures for such visits. Medicare has much to gain financially by clarifying its classification rules. Until the distinctions between types of Medicare visits are redefined in a way that eliminates ambiguity, upcoding under Medicare Part B is likely to continue.

10.1002/hec.1649.abstractZh: Medicare Part B根据所开具的Current Procedural Terminology（CPT）代码向门诊医生支付费用，这些代码在手术方式和强度上有所不同。由于许多服务的差异仅体现在强度上，医生因此有动机提高服务的编码等级，以增加每次就诊的盈利能力。本文利用2001至2003年Medicare当前受益人调查中的全国代表性数据，探讨了Medicare Part B的费用差异对一般门诊就诊（即使用CPT代码99212-99215的常规患者就诊）的过度编码行为的影响。研究发现，这些费用差异确实会影响医生在计费时的编码选择，且这种影响涉及多种专科。对于一般门诊就诊，因过度编码而产生的Medicare支出可能占总支出的15%。Medicare通过明确其分类规则，可以在财务上获得更多收益。在Medicare各类就诊之间的区别被重新定义以消除歧义之前，Medicare Part B下的过度编码行为很可能会持续下去。

abstract.text: By polling individual responses to hypothetical scenarios, valuation studies estimate population preferences toward health on a quality-adjusted life year (QALY) scale. The scenarios typically involve trade-offs in time (time trade-off (TTO)), risk (standard gamble (SG)), or number of persons affected (person trade-off (PTO)). This paper revisits the QALY assumptions and provides a coherent health econometric approach that unites TTO, SG, and PTO techniques under a common estimator. The proposed approach avoids the use of ratio statistics in QALY estimation and the common convention of arbitrarily changing trade-off responses. As an example, 34% of the TTO responses from the seminal Measurement and Valuation of Health study were changed in the original UK analysis, which led to substantially lower QALY estimates. As a general rule, if the original estimate is less than 0.5 QALYs, add 0.25 QALYs to get the new estimates.

10.1002/hec.1650.abstractZh: 通过调查个体对假设情景的回应，估值研究以质量调整生命年（QALY）为单位来估算人们对健康的偏好。这些情景通常涉及时间（时间权衡）、风险（标准赌博）或受影响人数（人数权衡）之间的权衡。本文重新审视了QALY假设，并提出了一种连贯的健康计量经济学方法，将时间权衡、风险权衡和人数权衡技术统一在一个共同的估计器中。该方法避免了在QALY估计中使用比率统计，并避免了随意改变权衡响应的常见做法。例如，在最初的英国分析中，有34%的时间权衡响应被修改，这导致QALY估计值显著降低。一般而言，如果原始估计值低于0.5 QALY，则需加上0.25 QALY以获得新的估计值。

abstract.text: Aim To explore what happens to the expected value of perfect information (EVPI) as an increasingly large number of decision options is considered. Methods A stylised model of screening for a hypothetical cancer. The model was used to test different possible ages for 'once in a lifetime' screening under a variety of assumptions about model parameter uncertainty. Initial model runs only considered screening at ages which are multiples of 16 years, then multiples of 8 years were allowed, then 4 years, etc. Results Effects of more refined choice sets on the cost-effectiveness acceptability frontier (CEAF) and EVPI are shown. The CEAF collapses to zero for threshold incremental cost-effectiveness ratios at which screening at some age is preferred to no screening, while the EVPI stabilises at a non-zero figure. Conclusions The CEAF is likely to be highly dependent on the choice of options when these are a selection from a very large set of possible options. In contrast, the EVPI can be reasonably approximated by a model with a slightly limited choice set.

10.1002/hec.1651.abstractZh: 目的：探讨在考虑越来越多的决策选项时，完全信息期望价值（EVPI）的变化情况。方法：建立了一个针对假设性癌症的筛选模型。该模型用于测试在不同模型参数不确定性假设下，“一生一次”筛查的不同可能年龄。最初的模型运行仅考虑了年龄为16年的倍数，随后允许考虑8年的倍数，然后是4年的倍数等。结果：更精细的选择集对成本效益可接受性边界（CEAF）和EVPI的影响得到了体现。当阈值增量成本效益比率使得在某个年龄进行筛查优于不筛查时，CEAF会降为零，而EVPI则稳定在非零数值。结论：当选项来自非常庞大的选择集时，CEAF很可能高度依赖于选项的选择。相比之下，使用选择范围稍小的模型可以较为合理地近似EVPI。

abstract.text: We review statistical methods for analysing healthcare resource use and costs, their ability to address skewness, excess zeros, multimodality and heavy right tails, and their ease for general use. We aim to provide guidance on analysing resource use and costs focusing on randomised trials, although methods often have wider applicability. Twelve broad categories of methods were identified: (I) methods based on the normal distribution, (II) methods following transformation of data, (III) single-distribution generalized linear models (GLMs), (IV) parametric models based on skewed distributions outside the GLM family, (V) models based on mixtures of parametric distributions, (VI) two (or multi)-part and Tobit models, (VII) survival methods, (VIII) non-parametric methods, (IX) methods based on truncation or trimming of data, (X) data components models, (XI) methods based on averaging across models, and (XII) Markov chain methods. Based on this review, our recommendations are that, first, simple methods are preferred in large samples where the near-normality of sample means is assured. Second, in somewhat smaller samples, relatively simple methods, able to deal with one or two of above data characteristics, may be preferable but checking sensitivity to assumptions is necessary. Finally, some more complex methods hold promise, but are relatively untried; their implementation requires substantial expertise and they are not currently recommended for wider applied work.

10.1002/hec.1653.abstractZh: 我们回顾了用于分析医疗资源使用与成本的统计方法，这些方法能够应对数据分布的不对称性、多余的零值、多模态性以及右尾现象，并且易于广泛使用。我们的目标是在分析资源使用与成本方面提供指导，重点针对随机试验，尽管这些方法通常具有更广泛的适用性。我们确定了十二大类的方法：(I)基于正态分布的方法，(II)对数据进行转换后的方法，(III)单分布广义线性模型，(IV)基于非GLM家族的偏态分布的参数模型，(V)基于参数分布混合的模型，(VI)两部分或多部分的Tobit模型，(VII)生存分析方法，(VIII)非参数方法，(IX)基于数据截断或修剪的方法，(X)数据成分模型，(XI)基于模型平均的方法，以及(XII)马尔可夫链方法。基于这一回顾，我们的建议是：首先，在样本量较大且样本均值接近正态分布的情况下，应优先选择简单的方法。其次，在样本量稍小的情況下，能够处理上述数据特征中的一种或两种的简单方法可能更为合适，但需检查其对假设的有效性。最后，一些更复杂的方法具有潜力，但相对未经充分试验；它们的实施需要大量的专业知识，目前不建议将其用于更广泛的应用工作。

abstract.text: Education has been shown to be the most important correlate of health. However, the mechanism through which education influences health has been largely unexplained. Grossman argued that education improves health production efficiency. In contrast, Fuchs argued that the association between health and education is not primarily causal but reflects unobserved causes of both outcomes. Instead of education causing better health, some 'third' variables may be related to both education and health. The 'third' variable most frequently mentioned is time preference. The aim of this paper is to investigate the role of time preference in the relationship between education and health. The role of risk attitude is also investigated. The paper exploits a unique data set of households that incorporated stated preference questions eliciting individuals' time preferences. The results show that the effect of education reduces but does not disappear when controlling for individuals' time preferences.

10.1002/hec.1655.abstractZh: 教育已被证明是健康最重要的相关因素。然而，教育如何影响健康的机制在很大程度上尚未得到解释。格罗斯曼认为，教育提高了健康生产的效率。相比之下，福克斯认为，健康与教育之间的关联并非主要出于因果关系，而是反映了两种结果中未观察到的因素。并非教育导致了更好的健康，可能存在一些“第三变量”与教育和健康都有关联。最常提到的“第三变量”是时间偏好。本文旨在研究时间偏好在教育与健康关系中的作用，同时也探讨了风险态度的作用。本文利用了一个独特的家庭数据集，该数据集包含了表明个人时间偏好的问题。研究结果表明，在控制个体时间偏好的情况下，教育的效应虽然有所减少，但并未消失。

abstract.text: While informal care is a significant part of non-market economic activity, its value is rarely acknowledged, perhaps reflecting a lack of market data. Traditional methods to value such care include opportunity and replacement cost. This study is the first to employ the discrete choice experiment methodology to value informal care tasks. A monetary value is estimated for three tasks (personal care, supervising and household tasks). The relationship between time spent on formal and informal care is also modelled and preference heterogeneity investigated using the Latent Class Model. Complementarity between supervising tasks and formal care is observed. Monetary compensation is important, with willingness to accept per hour values ranging from £0.38 to £0.83 for personal care, £0.75 for supervising and £0.31 to £0.6 for household tasks. Heterogeneity in preferences is observed, with monetary compensation being important for younger people, but insignificant for older individuals. Such heterogeneity is important at the policy level. Values are lower than those generated by opportunity cost and replacement cost methods, perhaps because of the limited ability of revealed preference methods to capture broader aspect of utility. Differences with contingent valuation methods are also observed, suggesting future research should investigate the external validity of the different methods.

10.1002/hec.1656.abstractZh: 非正式照顾是非市场经济活动中不可或缺的一部分，但其价值却很少被认可，这或许反映了缺乏相关的市场数据。传统上，评估此类照顾的价值通常采用机会成本和替代成本的方法。本研究首次采用离散选择实验方法来评估非正式照顾任务的价值。对三项任务（个人照顾、监督和家庭事务）进行了货币价值估算。研究还建模分析了正式照顾与非正式照顾之间的时间分配关系，并使用潜在类别模型探讨了偏好差异。研究发现，监督任务与正式照顾之间存在互补性。货币补偿非常重要，个人照顾的每小时接受意愿在0.38英镑至0.83英镑之间，监督任务的意愿在0.75英镑之间，而家庭事务的意愿则在0.31英镑至0.6英镑之间。偏好存在差异，对于年轻人来说，货币补偿非常重要，但对于老年人来说则无关紧要。这种偏好差异在政策层面具有重要意义。这些价值低于机会成本和替代成本方法得出的结果，这可能是因为揭示性偏好方法在捕捉效用的更广泛方面存在局限性。与条件价值评估方法相比，本研究也发现了差异，这表明未来的研究应探讨不同方法的外部有效性。

abstract.text: This paper presents a new way to monitor priority settings in public health-care systems. We take departure in medical guidelines prescribing acceptable waiting times for different medical descriptions. Allocating ICD10 codes to the medical descriptions, we are able to compare actual waiting times to the recommended maximum waiting times. This way we use the medical guidelines as a tool for monitoring prioritisation in the health sector. In an application, using data from the Norwegian Patient Register, we test statistically for compliance with the guidelines. The results indicate that patients suffering from the most severe conditions are receiving too low priority in the Norwegian health-care sector relative to patients of lower priority.

10.1002/hec.1659.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种监测公共卫生系统中优先级设置的新方法。我们基于医学指南，这些指南规定了不同医疗状况的可接受等待时间。通过将ICD10编码与医疗状况相对应，我们可以比较实际等待时间与推荐的最大等待时间。通过这种方式，我们将医学指南作为监测卫生领域优先级的一个工具。在一项应用中，我们使用了挪威患者登记数据，从统计上验证了这些指南的遵守情况。结果表明，在挪威的医疗保健系统中，病情最严重的患者相对于优先级较低的患者，受到的重视程度过低。

abstract.text: A small number of studies have provided suggestive evidence that the general public rejects the idea of giving higher priority to low-cost patients, in the context of a limited budget, in order to maximise health benefits. The study reported here used semi-structured group discussions to investigate the normative bases of such views among the Australian public. Discussion groups help participants reflect critically upon their own reasoning processes and go some way towards revealing underlying values rather than unreflective preferences. As a part of the exercise, participants were asked to allocate a hospital budget. After discussion and deliberation only three out of 41 chose to allocate all of the money to the low-cost patients. Reasons were not based on conceptual confusion or lack of insight into the implications of the different strategies, but rather on views about fairness, including the importance of giving all groups a 'chance' of being treated and of not removing 'hope' from high-cost patients. The results suggest that as costs rise people are willing to pay more than the minimum cost of a quality-adjusted life year for equity reasons, indicating that caution must be exercised in estimating a single monetary value for a QALY.

10.1002/hec.1660.abstractZh: 少数研究提供了一些线索，表明在预算有限的情况下，公众普遍不赞成优先考虑低成本患者，以最大化健康收益。本文报道的研究采用半结构化小组讨论的方式，探讨了澳大利亚公众持有这种观点的规范基础。讨论小组有助于参与者批判性地反思自己的推理过程，从而揭示潜在的价值观，而非无意识的偏好。作为活动的一部分，参与者被要求分配一笔医院预算。经过讨论和审议后，只有41名参与者中的3人选择将所有资金分配给低成本患者。这些选择并非基于概念上的困惑或对不同策略影响的缺乏理解，而是基于关于公平性的观点，包括给予所有群体“接受治疗的机会”的重要性，以及不剥夺高成本患者的“希望”。研究结果表明，随着成本上升，人们愿意为公平原则支付超过质量调整生命年的最低成本，这表明在估算质量调整生命年的单一货币价值时必须谨慎行事。

abstract.text: Expansion of private long-term care insurance (LTCI) is often posited as a potential mechanism to finance long-term care (LTC) for a growing elderly population in the US. One largely ignored issue is lapse or cancellation of policies. Individuals who let a LTCI policy lapse face resumed risk of LTC expenditures while suffering the financial loss of premiums paid. The motivation for lapse has been poorly understood, though some have hypothesized that improvements in health risk may be responsible. We use 1996-2006 Health and Retirement Study data from 3974 respondents who report having private LTCI to estimate baseline and dynamic predictors of lapse and test for ex post adverse selection. Individuals who lapse are generally poorer, less educated, less healthy, and more likely to be racial and ethnic minorities than those who retain their policies. Changes in health status play a relatively small role in lapse, and we find little evidence for adverse selection associated with lapse. We conclude that lapse of LTCI is more an issue of finances and alternatives than a reassessment of health risk. Because lapse rates are highest among the least healthy individuals, lapse should be considered explicitly in efforts to expand the LTCI market.

10.1002/hec.1661.abstractZh: 私人长期护理保险（LTCI）的扩展通常被视为为美国日益增长的老年人口提供长期护理的潜在机制。但一个被严重忽视的问题是保险政策的失效或取消。让LTCI政策失效的个体将面临重新承担长期护理支出的风险，同时还会遭受已支付的保费损失。导致政策失效的原因尚未得到充分理解，尽管有人假设健康风险的变化可能是原因之一。我们使用了1996-2006年“健康与退休研究”的数据，该数据来自3974名报告拥有私人LTCI的受访者，以估计政策失效的基线和动态预测因素，并检验事后逆向选择的影响。与保持保险政策的个体相比，失效的个体通常经济状况较差、教育程度较低、健康状况较差，且更可能是少数族裔。健康状况的变化在政策失效中作用相对较小，我们也没有发现与政策失效相关的逆向选择的证据。我们得出结论，LTCI政策的失效更多是由于财务和替代方案的问题，而非对健康风险的重新评估。由于最不健康的个体其失效率最高，因此在扩大LTCI市场的努力中，应明确考虑政策失效的问题。

abstract.text: This paper uses repeated cross-section data from Norway to estimate the demand for fruits and vegetables (FV) and physical activity (PA) with a particular focus on the role of socioeconomic status. Conventional econometric count data models produce results that are commonly found in empirical work; the effect of higher socioeconomic status on healthy behavior is positive and generally statistically significant, but the average partial effects are in some cases small and imprecisely estimated. For both behaviors, subsequent latent class models identify two subpopulations - or groups of people - with different sets of preferences; one group has low latent demands, but for these individuals, average partial effects of socioeconomic status are generally stronger than those predicted by the conventional models. The other smaller group consists of individuals who have high latent demands, but whose variability in behavior is poorly explained by socioeconomic status. Posterior analysis shows that individuals with higher socioeconomic status are more likely to belong to the healthier of these two groups. Proxies for time preferences, risk, self-control, and time constraints are also found to be important in characterizing high latent demand groups for PA and FV.

10.1002/hec.1662.abstractZh: 本文利用挪威的重复横截面数据，估计了水果和蔬菜以及身体活动需求，特别关注社会经济地位的作用。传统的计量经济计数数据模型得出的结果在实证研究中较为常见：较高的社会经济地位对健康行为的积极影响是积极的，并且通常在统计上显著，但平均部分效应在某些情况下较小且估计不够精确。对于这两种行为，后续的潜在类别模型识别出两个具有不同偏好集的子群体；其中一个群体的潜在需求较低，但对于这些个体来说，社会经济地位的平均部分效应通常比传统模型预测的更为显著。另一个较小的群体则由潜在需求较高的个体组成，但其行为的变异性无法由社会经济地位很好地解释。后续分析表明，社会经济地位较高的个体更有可能属于这两个群体中较健康的那一个。时间偏好、风险、自我控制和时间限制等代理变量在描述身体活动和水果蔬菜的高潜在需求群体方面也起着重要作用。

abstract.text: Empirical evidence from US studies suggests that female physicians earn less than their male counterparts, on average. The earnings gap does not disappear when individual and market characteristics are controlled for. This paper investigates whether a gender earnings difference can also be observed in a health-care system predominantly financed by public insurance companies. Using a unique data set of physicians' earnings recorded by a public social security agency in an Austrian province between 2000 and 2004, we find a gender gap in average earnings of about 32%. A substantial share of this gap (20-47%) cannot be explained by individual and market characteristics, leaving labor market discrimination as one possible explanation for the observed gender earnings difference of physicians.

10.1002/hec.1663.abstractZh: 来自美国研究的实证证据表明，女性医生的收入平均低于男性医生。即使控制了个体和市场特征后，这种收入差距仍然存在。本文研究在主要由公共保险公司资助的医疗保健系统中，是否也能观察到性别收入差异。通过利用奥地利一个省份的公共社会保障机构记录的医生收入数据（时间跨度为2000年至2004年），我们发现平均收入方面的性别差距约为32%。其中，有相当一部分差距（20-47%）无法用个体和市场特征来解释，因此劳动力市场中的歧视可能是导致医生性别收入差异的一个可能原因。

abstract.text: In this paper, we investigate the relationship between baseline health and costs of hospital use over a period of eight years. We combine cross-sectional survey data with information from the Dutch national hospital register. Four different indicators of health (self-perceived health, long-term impairments, ADL limitations and comorbidity) are considered. We find that for ages 50 to 70, differences in hospital costs between good health and bad health are substantial and persist during the whole time period. However, for higher ages expected hospital costs for individuals in bad health decline rapidly and become lower than those for people in good health after about six to seven years. The higher mortality rate among people in bad health is the primary cause here. Our results are confirmed for all four health indicators. We conclude that relying on better health to contain healthcare expenditures is too optimistic, and the interaction between health and mortality should be taken into account when projecting healthcare costs. Healthy ageing is important, but more for health gains than for cost savings.

10.1002/hec.1664.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了八年期间基础健康状况与医院使用成本之间的关系。我们结合了横断面调查数据与荷兰国家医院登记信息。考虑了四个不同的健康指标：自我感知的健康状况、长期损伤、日常生活活动限制以及合并症。研究发现，在50至70岁年龄段，健康状况良好与健康状况不佳的人在医院成本上存在显著差异，且这种差异在整个研究期间都持续存在。然而，对于更高年龄段的人来说，健康状况不佳的个体预期医院成本在大约六到七年后会迅速下降，并低于健康状况良好的人的成本。健康状况不佳的人群更高的死亡率是这一现象的主要原因。我们的研究结果适用于所有四个健康指标。我们得出结论，认为依靠更好的健康状况来控制医疗支出过于乐观，在预测医疗成本时应该考虑健康与死亡率之间的相互作用。健康老龄化固然重要，但更多是为了健康收益而非成本节约。

abstract.text: This study investigates the extent to which family income is associated with an extensive range of child cognitive and behavioural outcomes in a cohort of almost 19 000 British children born between 2000 and 2001. Merging the economists' and developmental psychologists' approaches, it also attempts to identify the main mechanisms through which family economic resources translate into better developmental outcomes for children. The relative and joint relevance of three groups of mediating factors (parental stress, parental investment and other family-related pathways), identified from the recent economic and psychological literature, are examined both in a cross-sectional ('mopping-up' approach) and in a panel data (fixed effects models) context. Results indicate a weak or absent direct effect of family economic resources on child development after controlling for potential mediating mechanisms. The study also identifies key mediating factors (e.g. maternal depression, a cognitively stimulating home environment, parenting practices and length of breastfeeding) that could be targeted by government initiatives in order to effectively improve children's intellectual development and behaviour beyond what income redistribution can achieve.

10.1002/hec.1665.abstractZh: 本研究调查了家庭收入与近19,000名出生于2000至2001年的英国儿童在认知和行为方面的多种结果之间的关联程度。通过结合经济学家和发展心理学家的研究方法，本研究还试图确定家庭经济资源如何转化为儿童更好的发展成果的主要机制。从最新的经济和心理文献中确定的三组中介因素（父母压力、父母投入以及其他与家庭相关的途径）的相对和联合重要性，在横断面研究和面板数据（固定效应模型）背景下都得到了考察。结果表明，在控制潜在的中介机制后，家庭经济资源对儿童发展的直接影响较弱或不存在。研究还确定了一些关键的中介因素（如母亲抑郁、具有认知刺激性的家庭环境、育儿方式以及母乳喂养的时间），这些因素可以作为政府政策的目标，以有效改善儿童的智力发展和行为，超越收入再分配所能达到的效果。

abstract.text: Previous studies have shown that adolescent religious participation is negatively associated with risky health behaviors such as cigarette smoking, alcohol consumption, and illicit drug use. One explanation for these findings is that religion directly reduces risky behaviors because churches provide youths with moral guidance or with strong social networks that reinforce social norms. An alternative explanation is that both religious participation and risky health behaviors are driven by some common unobserved individual trait. We use data from the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent Health and implement an instrumental variables approach to identify the effect of religious participation on smoking, binge drinking, and marijuana use. Following Gruber (2005), we use a county-level measure of religious market density as an instrument. We find that religious market density has a strong positive association with adolescent religious participation, but not with secular measures of social capital. Upon accounting for unobserved heterogeneity, we find that religious participation continues to have a significant negative effect on illicit drug use. On the contrary, the estimated effects of attendance in instrumental variables models of binge drinking and smoking are statistically imprecise.

10.1002/hec.1666.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，青少年宗教参与与吸烟、饮酒和非法药物使用等危险健康行为之间存在负相关关系。其中一种解释是，宗教能够直接减少危险行为，因为教堂为青少年提供道德指导或强大的社交网络，从而强化社会规范。另一种解释是，宗教参与和危险健康行为都是由某些共同的、未被观察到的个体特质所驱动的。我们采用了《全国青少年健康纵向研究》的数据，并采用工具变量方法来分析宗教参与对吸烟、酗酒和大麻使用的影响。根据Gruber（2005）的方法，我们使用县级的宗教市场密度作为工具变量。研究发现，宗教市场密度与青少年宗教参与之间存在强烈的正相关关系，但与世俗意义上的社会资本无关。在考虑未观察到的异质性后，我们发现宗教参与仍然对非法药物使用有显著的负面影响。相反，在酗酒和吸烟的工具变量模型中，宗教参与的估计效应在统计上并不精确。

abstract.text: Studies show a relationship between oral inflammatory processes and cardiovascular risk factors, suggesting that dental care may reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease (CVD) events. However, due to the differences between men and women in the development and presentation of CVD, such effects may vary by sex. We use a valid set of instrumental variables to evaluate these issues and include a test of essential heterogeneity. CVD events include new occurrences of heart attack (including death from heart attack), stroke (including death from stroke), angina, and congestive heart failure. Controls include age, race, education, marital status, foreign birthplace, and cardiovascular risk factors (health status, body mass index, alcohol use, smoking status, diabetes status, high-blood-pressure status, physical activity, and depression). Our analysis finds no evidence of essential heterogeneity. We find the minimum average treatment effect for women to be -0.01, but find no treatment effect for men. This suggests that women who receive dental care may reduce their risk of future CVD events by at least one-third. The findings may only apply to married middle-aged and older individuals as the data set is only representative for this group.

10.1002/hec.1667.abstractZh: 研究表明，口腔炎症过程与心血管风险因素之间存在关联，这表明口腔护理可能有助于降低心血管疾病的发生风险。然而，由于男性和女性在心血管疾病的发展和表现上存在差异，这种效果可能因性别而异。我们使用一组有效的工具变量来评估这些问题，并进行了本质异质性检验。心血管疾病包括新发的心肌梗死（包括因心肌梗死导致的死亡）、中风（包括因中风导致的死亡）、心绞痛以及充血性心力衰竭。控制变量包括年龄、种族、教育程度、婚姻状况、出生地以及心血管风险因素（健康状况、体重指数、酒精使用、吸烟状况、糖尿病状况、高血压状况、体力活动以及抑郁情况）。我们的分析未发现本质异质性的证据。我们发现女性的平均治疗效果为-0.01，而男性则没有治疗效果。这表明接受口腔护理的女性可能将未来心血管疾病的发生风险降低至少三分之一。这些发现可能仅适用于已婚的中年及岁以上人群，因为数据集仅代表这一群体。

abstract.text: This paper aims to estimate empirically the efficiency of a Swiss telemedicine service introduced in 2003. We used claims' data gathered by a major Swiss health insurer, over a period of 6 years and involving 160 000 insured adults. In Switzerland, health insurance is mandatory, but everyone has the option of choosing between a managed care plan and a fee-for-service plan. This paper focuses on a conventional fee-for-service plan including a mandatory access to a telemedicine service; the insured are obliged to phone this medical call centre before visiting a physician. This type of plan generates much lower average health expenditures than a conventional insurance plan. Reasons for this may include selection, incentive effects or efficiency. In our sample, about 90% of the difference in health expenditure can be explained by selection and incentive effects. The remaining 10% of savings due to the efficiency of the telemedicine service amount to about SFr 150 per year per insured, of which approximately 60% is saved by the insurer and 40% by the insured. Although the efficiency effect is greater than the cost of the plan, the big winners are the insured who not only save monetary and non-monetary costs but also benefit from reduced premiums.

10.1002/hec.1668.abstractZh: 本文旨在实证评估2003年引入的瑞士远程医疗服务效率。我们使用了瑞士一家主要健康保险公司收集的6年数据，涉及160,000名参保成年人。在瑞士，健康保险是强制性的，但人们可以选择管理式护理计划或按服务收费的计划。本文重点关注一种传统的按服务收费计划，该计划要求参保人在就医前必须拨打远程医疗服务中心电话。这种类型的计划平均医疗支出远低于传统保险计划。造成这种差异的原因可能包括选择效应、激励效应或效率因素。在我们的样本中，约90%的医疗支出差异可以通过选择效应和激励效应来解释。剩余10%的节省来自远程医疗服务的效率，每年每位参保人可节省约150瑞士法郎，其中约60%由保险公司节省，40%由参保人节省。尽管效率效应大于计划成本，但最大的受益者是参保人，他们不仅节省了货币和非货币成本，还因保费降低而受益。

abstract.text: In a dynamic Two-Part Model (2 PM), we find the effect of previous smoking on the participation decision to be decreasing with education among Swedish women, i.e. more educated are less state dependent. However, we do not find an analogous effect of education on the conditional intensity of consumption.

10.1002/hec.1669.abstractZh: 在动态的两部分模型中，我们发现，在瑞典女性中，以往吸烟经历对参与决策的影响随着教育水平的提高而减弱，即受教育程度较高的女性对政府的依赖程度较低。然而，我们没有发现教育水平对消费强度有类似的积极影响。

abstract.text: For most insurers, traditional methods of controlling health-care demand include deductibles, co-payments, stop-losses, and insurance ceilings. This paper examines the effect of the patient reimbursement method of health insurance (immediate reimbursement or later reimbursement) on individuals' health-care utilization decisions. We find that immediate reimbursement significantly increases the likelihood of patients seeking outpatient treatment in China. We also empirically explore the channels through which immediate reimbursement affects individual's incentives on health-care demand.

10.1002/hec.1670.abstractZh: 对于大多数保险公司而言，控制医疗需求的传统方法包括免赔额、共付额、止损机制以及保险上限。本文探讨了医疗保险中患者报销方式（即时报销或延迟报销）对个体医疗使用决策的影响。研究发现，即时报销显著增加了患者在中国的门诊治疗需求。我们还通过实证分析，探讨了即时报销如何影响个体对医疗需求的激励行为。

abstract.text: We analyze deaths among prime-aged men and women during a 13-year period in a high AIDS mortality setting and examine the distribution of deaths by the economic status of these individuals at baseline using the 1991-2004 Kagera Health and Development Survey (KHDS). We investigate whether the distribution of subsequent prime-age adult deaths as measured by concentration indices depends on the measure of living standards used. We compare the performance of three measures: (1) per capita expenditure; (2) a modern wealth asset index replicating the asset index included in the 2004 Tanzanian AIDS Indicator Survey data file; and (3) a traditional wealth asset index, which includes only measures of traditional wealth. We find no evidence that economic status is linked to prime-age adult deaths, for both men and women, regardless of the measure of economic status used. This finding suggests both that more generally the measure of economic status used does not appear to be crucial, and specifically that relationships using traditional measures of wealth do not seem to differ from those using conventional measures.

10.1002/hec.1671.abstractZh: 我们分析了在艾滋病高死亡率环境下，13年间成年男女的死亡情况，并利用1991-2004年的卡格拉健康与发展调查数据，研究了这些个体在基线时的经济状况与死亡分布之间的关系。我们探讨了后续成年死亡的分布情况，以及这种分布是否取决于所使用的生活水平衡量标准。我们比较了三种衡量标准：(1)人均支出；(2)一个复制2004年坦桑尼亚艾滋病指标调查数据文件中包含的资产指数的现代财富资产指数；以及(3)一个仅包含传统财富衡量标准的传统财富资产指数。我们发现，无论使用何种经济状况衡量标准，经济地位与成年死亡之间均无明显关联。这一发现表明，总体而言，所使用的经济状况衡量标准似乎并不重要，并且使用传统财富衡量标准与使用传统衡量标准之间的关系似乎并无差异。

abstract.text: We analyse the determinants of influenza vaccination take-up of Europeans above the age of 50 years using the first two waves of the Survey of Health, Ageing, and Retirement (SHARE). Using quality-of-care indicators, special emphasis is put on the measurement and the impact of physician quality. We find that age, health status, lifestyle, labour-force status, and the family structure are important determinants of the decision to get a flu shot. Physician quality, as measured by four indicators, also positively affects the probability of getting a flu shot.

10.1002/hec.1672.abstractZh: 我们利用“健康、老龄化与退休调查”的前两波数据，分析了50岁以上欧洲人接种流感疫苗的决定因素。通过关注医疗服务质量指标，我们特别强调了医生质量对接种意愿的影响。研究发现，年龄、健康状况、生活方式、劳动力状况以及家庭结构都是决定是否接种流感疫苗的重要因素。此外，通过四个指标衡量医生质量，也显著提升了接种流感疫苗的概率。

abstract.text: Improving access to health care and financial protection of the poor is a key concern for policymakers in low- and middle-income countries, but there have been few rigorous program evaluations. The Medical Insurance Program for the Poor in the republic of Georgia provides a free and extensive benefit package and operates through a publicly funded voucher program, enabling beneficiaries to choose their own private insurance company. Eligibility is determined by a proxy means test administered to applicant households. The objective of this study is to evaluate the program's impact on key outcomes including utilization, financial risk protection, and health behavior and management. A dedicated survey of approximately 3500 households around the thresholds was designed to minimize unobserved heterogeneity by sampling clusters with both beneficiary and non-beneficiary households. The research design exploits the sharp discontinuities at two regional eligibility thresholds to estimate local average treatment effects. Results suggest that the program did not affect utilization of health services but decreased mean out-of-pocket expenditures for some groups and reduced the risk of high inpatient expenditures. There are no systematic impacts on health behavior, management of chronic illnesses, and patient satisfaction.

10.1002/hec.1673.abstractZh: 改善贫困人口的医疗获取和财务保障是低收入和中等收入国家政策制定者关注的关键问题，但针对此类项目的严格评估却很少。格鲁吉亚的贫困人群医疗保险计划提供免费且全面的福利包，并通过由公共资金支持的代金券计划运作，使受益人能够自行选择私人保险公司。资格评定依据申请家庭进行的代理手段测试。本研究旨在评估该计划对关键指标的影响，包括医疗服务利用情况、财务风险保护以及健康行为和管理。为了最小化未观测到的异质性，研究团队对约3500户家庭进行了调查，这些家庭位于两个区域性的资格门槛附近。研究设计利用两个区域性资格门槛处的显著差异来估算局部平均处理效应。研究结果表明，该计划并未影响医疗服务的利用，但降低了某些群体的平均自付费用，并减少了高住院费用的风险。该计划对健康行为、慢性病管理以及患者满意度没有系统性影响。

abstract.text: Recent research suggests that overweight females suffer penalties in the labor and marriage markets, while overweight males do not. This study explores whether similar gender differences in the effect of body weight exist in what Cawley et al. (2006) labeled 'the adolescent sex market'. Drawing on data from the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent Health, we use fixed effects and instrumental variables identification strategies to estimate the relationship between body weight and sexual activity. We find evidence that increased body weight lowers the probability that female adolescents become sexually active. In contrast, there is little evidence of a causal relationship between body weight and sexual activity for male adolescents.

10.1002/hec.1674.abstractZh: 近期研究表明，超重的女性在劳动市场和婚姻市场上面临不利条件，而超重的男性则不会如此。本研究探讨了在Cawley等人（2006年）所称的“青少年性市场”中，体重是否也存在类似的性别差异。基于《全国青少年健康纵向研究》的数据，我们采用固定效应和工具变量识别策略来估计体重与性活动之间的关系。研究发现，体重增加会降低女性青少年发生性活动的概率。相比之下，对于男性青少年而言，体重与性活动之间几乎没有因果关系。

abstract.text: This paper re-examines the effects of breastfeeding on long-term educational outcomes using longitudinal data on siblings. While family-fixed effects allow controls for all shared family factors, these estimators are sensitive to compensating or reinforcing behaviors by parents. These biases may be particularly important for estimating the effects of parental investment such as breast feeding, where sibling discordance may be difficult to treat as a random outcome and may result in persistence in differential investments between siblings. This paper uses a unique question asked to adolescent siblings about parental favoritism to adjust for potential reinforcing behavior by parents. Standard fixed effects estimates suggest important long-term educational effects of breastfeeding; however, these effects are uniformly eliminated after focusing on families who treat siblings equally. These findings shed light on the mechanisms linking associations between breastfeeding and longer term outcomes.

10.1002/hec.1675.abstractZh: 本文重新探讨了母乳喂养对长期教育成果的影响，使用了关于兄弟姐妹的纵向数据。虽然家庭固定效应能够控制所有共同的家庭因素，但这些估计量对父母可能产生的补偿或强化行为非常敏感。这些偏差在估计诸如母乳喂养这样的父母投资效果时尤为重要，因为兄弟姐妹之间的不一致性可能难以被视为随机现象，这可能导致兄弟姐妹之间持续存在不同的投资行为。本文通过向青少年兄弟姐妹询问父母是否偏爱某个孩子的问题，来调整父母可能的强化行为。标准的固定效应估计表明母乳喂养对长期教育有显著影响；然而，在关注那些平等对待兄弟姐妹的家庭后，这些效应被完全消除了。这些发现揭示了母乳喂养与长期结果之间的关联机制。

abstract.text: There is no consistent evidence of the relationship between market competition and hospital efficiency. Some studies indicated that more competition led to a faster patient turnover rate, higher hospital costs, and lower hospital efficiency. Since the 1980s some studies found market competition could increase the efficiency of inpatient services. However, there were few studies testing the market competition during a hospital's earlier stages on its efficiency during later stages, or the dynamic of efficiency. In this study, we examined the effect of early-stage market competition on later-stage hospital efficiency in Taiwan, and we determine the efficiency change using longitudinal study design. The data for the analysis came from the annual national hospital survey of 1996 and 2001 provided by the Department of Health. There were 102 teaching hospital be analysed. The results show that no evidence supports the proposition that higher market competition would improve the efficiency of hospitals in delivering inpatient services in Taiwan. Importantly, neither was the inefficiency score nor the Malmquist productivity index of inpatient services associated with the level of hospital market competition, regardless of the adjustment for hospital characteristics. However, the results may be related with the hospital increasing beds investment behavior.

10.1002/hec.1676.abstractZh: 目前尚无一致的证据表明市场竞争与医院效率之间存在关联。一些研究表明，市场竞争加剧会导致患者流动率加快、医院成本上升以及医院效率下降。自20世纪80年代以来，部分研究指出市场竞争能够提升住院服务的效率。然而，针对医院早期阶段的市场竞争对其后期效率的影响，以及效率的动态变化，相关研究相对较少。本研究考察了台湾早期市场竞争对后期医院效率的影响，并采用纵向研究设计来确定效率的变化。数据来源于卫生部提供的1996年和2001年度全国医院调查。共有102家教学医院被纳入分析范围。研究结果表明，没有证据表明市场竞争加剧会提升台湾医院在提供住院服务方面的效率。值得注意的是，无论是否考虑医院特征的影响，住院服务的效率得分和Malmquist生产率指数均未显示出与市场竞争水平的关联。不过，研究结果可能与医院增加床位投资的行为有关。

abstract.text: Economic analysis is increasingly being employed in formal resource allocation decision-making processes in health care. As a consequence, the methods employed by economic analysts are increasingly subject to close scrutiny. One such area of methodology concerns the instruments used to elicit preferences for various health states for use in the construction of quality-adjusted life years. There are a number of techniques which may be used to elicit preferences and different techniques produce different results. The objective of this study was to explore the test-retest reliability of two techniques: Time Trade Off (TTO) and Person Trade Off (PTO) valuations were collected by a general population postal survey. A total of 798 respondents returned questionnaires. The intra class correlation coefficients ranged from 0.40 to 0.88 for TTO and, -0.17 to 0.82 for PTO, with the majority of coefficients being >0.50. The reliability coefficients varied between techniques and health states, with the TTO technique tending to produce higher coefficients. While the reliability results for TTO were generally positive, the reliability results for PTO are less clear.

10.1002/hec.1677.abstractZh: 在医疗保健领域的正式资源分配决策过程中，经济分析的应用日益广泛。因此，经济分析师所采用的方法越来越容易受到严格的审查。其中一个方法论领域涉及用于收集人们对不同健康状态的偏好数据，这些数据被用于构建质量调整生命年。有多种技术可以用来收集偏好信息，不同的技术会产生不同的结果。本研究的目的是探讨两种技术的重测信度：时间权衡（TTO）和人物权衡（PTO）评估。通过一项针对普通人群的邮政调查收集了数据，共有798名受访者返回了问卷。TTO的组内相关系数范围为0.40至0.88，PTO的组内相关系数范围为-0.17至0.82，其中大多数系数的数值大于0.50。不同技术和健康状态的信度系数有所不同，TTO技术的系数通常较高。虽然TTO的信度结果总体上是积极的，但PTO的信度结果则不太明确。

abstract.text: Objective To compare direct and indirect willingness to pay (WTP) elicitation methods in terms of feasibility, reliability, and comparability. The application is obstetrics, where always both a mother's and a child's health are at stake. Methods An open-ended contingent valuation method (CVM) as a direct WTP elicitation method, and the discrete choice experiment (DCE) as an indirect WTP elicitation method. Vignettes to be valued were based on clinical patient data. Participants were 88 laypersons who received their questionnaires by postal mail. Results The DCE task was completed faster (p=0.006) and was regarded easier (p<0.001) than the CVM task. Test-retest for CVM was substantial (ICC=0.76), and for DCE moderate (k=0.49). Female sex (p<0.001), age≥50 years (p=0.013), higher income (p<0.001), and higher education (p<0.001) were associated with higher WTP. Correlation between CVM and DCE was 0.79 (Kendall's Tau-b; p<0.001). The implied WTP as derived with DCE was between 2.3 and 10.2 times higher than with CVM. The relationship between the WTPs was linear. Conclusion It is yet unclear what lies behind the numbers of DCE. DCE has no methodological benefits over the conventional CVM when eliciting WTP for complex health outcomes in obstetrics.

10.1002/hec.1678.abstractZh:
目的：比较直接法和间接法在可行性、可靠性和可比性方面的差异。本研究以产科领域为应用对象，因为在此领域中，母亲和孩子的健康都至关重要。  
方法：采用开放式条件估值法作为直接法，离散选择实验作为间接法。评估对象的样本基于临床患者数据。参与者为88名普通民众，问卷通过邮政方式发送。  
结果：离散选择实验的完成速度更快（p=0.006），且被认为更容易实施（p<0.001）。条件估值法的重测信度较高（ICC=0.76），而离散选择实验的重测信度适中（k=0.49）。女性（p<0.001）、年龄≥50岁（p=0.013）、较高收入（p<0.001）以及较高教育水平（p<0.001）与较高的支付意愿相关。条件估值法与离散选择实验之间的相关性为0.79（Kendall's Tau-b；p<0.001）。通过离散选择实验得出的支付意愿是条件估值法的2.3至10.2倍。支付意愿之间的关系呈线性。  
结论：目前尚不清楚离散选择实验背后的机制。在产科领域评估复杂健康结果的支付意愿时，离散选择实验在方法上并不优于传统的条件估值法。

abstract.text: When valuing health states (e.g., for use in the assessment of health technologies), health economists often ask respondents how many years of life in poor health they would be willing to trade-off in order to live in full health. Problems with preferences of this kind have led to calls for the use of more direct measures of the utility associated with experiencing a health state. The fact remains, however, that individuals are often willing to make large sacrifices in life expectancy to alleviate conditions for which there appears to be a considerable degree of hedonic adaptation. The purpose of this study is to investigate this important discrepancy in more detail. Data from 1173 internet and telephone surveys in the United States suggest that time trade-off responses are related to the frequency and intensity of negative thoughts about health in ways that may not be very well captured by any of the proposed valuation methods.

10.1002/hec.1679.abstractZh: 在评估健康状态（例如，用于评估健康技术）时，健康经济学家通常会询问受访者愿意为完全健康而牺牲多少年健康状况不佳的生活。这类偏好问题导致人们呼吁使用更直接的指标来衡量与处于某种健康状态相关的效用。然而，事实是，个体往往愿意在预期寿命上做出较大牺牲，以缓解那些似乎存在相当程度享乐性适应的情况。本研究的目的是更详细地探讨这一重要差异。来自美国1173项互联网和电话调查的数据表明，时间权衡反应与关于健康的负面想法的频率和强度有关，而这些因素可能无法通过任何现有的评估方法得到很好的反映。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the excess cost of hospital inpatient care due to adverse safety events in the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) hospitals during fiscal year 2007. We measured adverse events according to the Patient Safety Indicator (PSI) algorithms of the Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality. Patient level cost regression analyses were performed using generalized linear modeling techniques. Accounting for the heavily skewed distribution of costs among patients having adverse safety events, results suggested that the excess cost of nine different PSIs for VA patients are much higher than previously estimated. We tested sensitivity of results to whether costs were measured by VA's Decision Support System (DSS) that uses local costs of specific inputs, or by the average costing system developed by VA's Health Economics Resource Center. DSS costing appeared to better characterize the high cost patients.

10.1002/hec.1680.abstractZh: 本文估算了2007财年美国退伍军人事务部医院因不良安全事件而产生的额外住院费用。我们根据医疗保健研究与质量局的患者安全指标算法来衡量不良事件。通过广义线性建模技术进行了患者层面成本回归分析。考虑到出现不良安全事件的患者成本分布严重偏斜，研究结果表明，退伍军人事务部患者九种不同安全事件的额外成本远高于先前估计的数值。我们还测试了结果对成本计量方式的敏感性，即成本是通过退伍军人事务部决策支持系统使用特定输入的本地成本来计量的，还是通过退伍军人事务部健康经济资源中心开发的平均成本系统来计量的。结果显示，决策支持系统的成本计量方式似乎更能准确反映高成本患者的实际情况。

abstract.text: This paper assesses the effects of different health conditions on happiness. Based on new data for Latin America, we examine the effects of different conditions across age, gender, and income cohorts. Anxiety and pain have stronger effects than physical problems, likely because people adapt better to one-time shocks than to constant uncertainty. The negative effects of health conditions are very large when compared with the effects of income on happiness. And, while higher peer income typically elicits envy, better peer health provides positive signals for life and health satisfaction. Health norms vary widely across countries.

10.1002/hec.1682.abstractZh: 本文评估了不同健康状况对幸福感的影响。基于拉丁美洲的新数据，我们研究了不同年龄、性别和收入群体在不同健康状况下的影响。焦虑和疼痛的影响比身体问题更为显著，这可能是因为人们更能适应一次性冲击，而不是持续的不确定性。与收入对幸福感的影响相比，健康状况的负面影响非常大。此外，虽然较高的同龄人收入通常会引发嫉妒，但更好的同龄人健康状况则能为生活和健康满意度带来积极信号。不同国家的健康观念存在很大差异。

abstract.text: The time trade-off (TTO) is widely used in population-based surveys to estimate health-state valuations. Typically, respondents may characterize states as being better than or worse than dead. However, worse-than-dead responses can produce strongly negative mean values, so various analytic transformations of these responses have been suggested. The episodic random utility model (eRUM), operationalized using a linear regression estimator, was proposed as an alternative to these transformations, in part because of its theoretical appeal. We analyzed the eRUM estimator's mathematical properties and found that it violates monotonicity under certain patterns of survey responses, such that improvement in some individual valuations would imply a lower overall valuation for a given health state. Consequently, it is possible that orderings of alternative strategies based on eRUM valuations could lead a decision-maker to choose a strictly dominated strategy. Re-analyzing data from a large population-based EQ-5D valuation survey in the United Kingdom, we found 27% of all TTO responses (63% of all worse-than-dead responses) met the conditions for violation of monotonicity, and 74% of all respondents had at least one such response. These results present some challenge to the use of the eRUM estimator in generating health-state valuations for population health measurement and economic evaluation.

10.1002/hec.1683.abstractZh: 时间权衡（TTO）在基于人口的调查中被广泛用于估算健康状态的估值。通常，受访者会将各种状态描述为比死亡状态更好或更差。然而，比死亡状态更差的反应可能会导致平均值出现强烈的负面结果，因此人们提出了多种对这些反应的解析转换方法。其中，基于线性回归估计器的偶发随机效用模型（eRUM）被提出作为这些转换方法的替代方案，部分原因是其理论上的吸引力。我们分析了eRUM估计器的数学特性，发现在某些调查反应模式下，它违反了单调性原则，即某些个体估值的改善意味着给定健康状态的整体估值会降低。因此，基于eRUM估值的策略排序可能会导致决策者选择一种严格被支配的策略。通过对英国一项大型基于人口的EQ-5D估值调查的数据重新分析，我们发现27%的TTO反应（占所有比死亡状态更差反应的63%）符合单调性违反的条件，而74%的受访者至少有一个这样的反应。这些结果对使用eRUM估计器进行人口健康测量和经济评估提出了挑战。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effect of diabetes on labor-force participation, hours worked, days-out-of-work due to illness, and earnings using data from the National Health Interview Survey. Findings indicate that diabetes, estimated wholly, is significantly detrimental to most labor market outcomes. However, separation of type I and II diabetes shows that much of the negative effect is due to type II diabetes. On average a female with type II diabetes can experience a wage penalty of almost 50% relative to a healthy individual. Additionally, estimates of specifically type II diabetes may be subject to endogeneity bias. To account for this, I utilize whether an individual's biological mother has been diagnosed with diabetes as an instrumental variable. This instrument provides both theoretical and statistical explanatory power to separate the causal effect of type II diabetes on labor-force decisions.

10.1002/hec.1685.abstractZh: 本文利用全国健康访谈调查的数据，估计了糖尿病对劳动力参与率、工作小时数、因病缺勤天数以及收入的影响。研究结果表明，总体而言，糖尿病对大多数劳动力市场结果具有显著的负面影响。然而，将糖尿病分为1型和2型后可以发现，大部分负面影响是由2型糖尿病引起的。平均而言，患有2型糖尿病的女性相比健康个体，其工资损失接近50%。此外，对2型糖尿病的具体估计可能存在内生性偏差。为了克服这一问题，我采用了个体生物学母亲的糖尿病诊断情况作为工具变量。这一工具变量在理论及统计上都具有解释力，有助于区分2型糖尿病对劳动力决策的实际影响。

abstract.text: New contraceptive methods provide greater choice in terms of effectiveness, management of side-effects, convenience and frequency of administration and flexibility, but make the decisions about contraception more complex. There are limited data on the factors that determine women's choices among these alternatives, to inform providers about the factors which are most important to women, or to predict uptake of new products. This paper reports on a choice experiment designed to elicit women's preferences in relation to prescribed contraception and to forecast the impact of the introduction of two new products into the Australian market. A generalised multinomial logit model is estimated and used in the simulation exercise. The model forecasts that the hormonal patch would be well received among women, achieving a greater market share than current non-pill products, but the vaginal ring would have limited appeal.

10.1002/hec.1686.abstractZh: 新的避孕方法在有效性、副作用管理、使用便利性、用药频率以及灵活性方面提供了更多的选择，但同时也使得避孕决策变得更加复杂。关于哪些因素会影响女性对多种避孕方法的选择，目前的数据非常有限，这些数据有助于为医疗服务提供者提供有关对女性来说最重要的因素的信息，或者预测新产品的市场接受度。本文报道了一项选择实验，旨在了解女性对处方避孕方法的偏好，并预测两种新产品在澳大利亚市场的引入所带来的影响。实验中采用了一种广义多项式逻辑模型，该模型预测激素贴片会受到女性的广泛欢迎，市场份额将超过现有的非口服避孕产品，而阴道环则可能会受到有限的欢迎。

abstract.text: In economic evaluation of health care, main stream practice is to discount benefits at the same rate as costs. But main papers in which this practice is advocated have missed a distinction between two quite different evaluation problems: (1) How much does the time of program occurrence matter for value and (2) how much do delays in health benefits from programs implemented at a given time matter? The papers have furthermore focused on logical and arithmetic arguments rather than on real value considerations. These 'consistency arguments' are at best trivial, at worst logically flawed. At the end of the day, there is a sensible argument for equal discounting of costs and benefits rooted in microeconomic theory of rational, utility maximising consumers' saving behaviour. But even this argument is problematic, first because the model is not clearly supported by empirical observations of individuals' time preferences for health, second because it relates only to evaluation in terms of overall individual utility. It does not provide grounds for claiming that decision makers with a wider societal perspective, which may include concerns for fair distribution, need to discount

10.1002/hec.1687.abstractZh: 在医疗服务的经济评估中，主流做法是以与成本相同的比率来折现收益。但那些提倡这种做法的主要论文忽略了两个截然不同的评估问题之间的区别：（1）项目实施的时间对价值有多重要？（2）在某一特定时间实施项目所带来的健康收益延迟有多严重？这些论文还侧重于逻辑和算术上的论证，而非实际价值考量。这些“一致性论证”充其量只是微不足道，最坏的情况下则存在逻辑上的缺陷。归根结底，基于理性效用最大化消费者的储蓄行为的微观经济理论，有合理的理由对成本和收益进行同等折现。但即便这一论点也存在问题，首先是因为该模型并未得到关于个人对健康时间偏好行为的实证观察的明确支持；其次，因为它仅涉及从整体个人效用的角度进行评估。它无法作为依据，来证明那些具有更广泛社会视角的决策者——这些决策者可能还包含对公平分配的关注——需要折现。

abstract.text: A growing body of work suggests that health may be transferred across generations. The aim of this paper is to examine the mechanisms that might account for observed intergenerational associations in health outcomes. Using data from Vietnam, this study analyzes intergenerational correlations in height, a measure of long-run health status, between parents and their children. Insights from biology and economics are used to motivate several strategies that collectively provide insight on the role and importance of different mechanisms. The results illustrate strong intergenerational associations in height, which remain stable with the inclusion of controls for parent and household characteristics. Maternal height is more strongly associated with the heights of boys than girls, while the associations with paternal height are similar across genders. The use of conditions faced by parents early in life as instruments for their height yields significantly larger estimates of the mother-child height association relative to OLS, while the estimated father-child associations move to zero. These results, in conjunction with those from several other tests, illustrate that non-genetic factors are important in determining parent-child associations in height, and more speculatively, that epigenetic mechanisms may play an important role. These findings illustrate the value of investments in early childhood, as these may confer intergenerational benefits.

10.1002/hec.1688.abstractZh: 越来越多的研究表明，健康状况可能在不同代际之间传递。本文旨在探讨可能导致代际间健康结果关联的机制。本研究以越南的数据为基础，分析了父母与子女之间的身高代际相关性，其中身高是长期健康状况的一个衡量指标。通过结合生物学和经济学的研究方法，本文提出了几种策略，以进一步了解不同机制的作用和重要性。研究结果表明，身高在代际间存在显著的相关性，这一相关性在纳入父母和家庭特征的控制变量后仍然保持稳定。母亲身高与男孩的身高相关性更强，而父亲身高的相关性在性别间相似。将父母早年所面临的条件作为身高变化的指标，得出的母子身高关联估计值比普通最小二乘法得出的估计值要大得多；而父子身高关联则接近于零。这些结果与其他多项研究的结果一致，表明非遗传因素在决定父母与子女身高关联方面起着重要作用，并且，从推测的角度来看，表观遗传机制也可能发挥重要作用。这些发现强调了早期儿童投资的价值，因为这些投资可能会带来代际间的益处。

abstract.text: Objective To test the performance tilting hypothesis using information asymmetry (IA) within the community oriented activities of prospective payment system (PPS) hospitals. Data sources American Hospital Association (AHA) Annual Survey Database and Medicare Cost Report from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services both in fiscal year 2000; Health maintenance organization (HMO) penetration from the Area Resource File. Study design A cross-sectional analysis was performed, using a national sample of 3162 PPS hospitals merged from the AHA data set and Medicare profit data. The individual hospital serves as the unit of empirical analysis. General linear model, multiple and logistic regressions are utilized to examine the association between IA and hospital performance indicators. Principal findings A positive relationship between IA and Medicare profit margins was found. Higher IA was associated with decreased likelihood that the hospital would report having a long-term plan for the health of its host community, and with increased likelihood of performance tilting. Conclusion Information asymmetry offers hospitals an advantageous position in achieving profit maximization. The study also documented the presence of performance tilting by health-care management. Whether increased information demands from a society accustomed to significant disclosure will reduce this agency problem is not yet clear.

10.1002/hec.1689.abstractZh: 目的  利用信息不对称（IA）来检验倾斜假设在面向社区的活动中的预期付费系统（PPS）医院中的表现。  数据来源：美国医院协会（AHA）年度调查数据库和医疗保险与医疗补助服务局在2000财年的医疗保险成本报告；健康维护组织（HMO）的渗透率数据来自地区资源文件。  研究设计  采用横断面分析，使用从AHA数据和医疗保险利润数据中合并的3162家PPS医院的样本。以单个医院为实证分析单位。利用一般线性模型、多元回归和逻辑回归来探讨IA与医院绩效指标之间的关联。  主要发现  发现IA与医疗保险利润边际之间存在正相关关系。较高的IA与医院报告没有长期计划改善所在社区的健康状况的可能性降低，以及绩效倾斜的可能性增加有关。  结论  信息不对称为医院在利润最大化方面提供了有利地位。研究还记录了医疗管理中的绩效倾斜现象。对于习惯于大量信息披露的社会而言，增加信息需求是否会减少这一代理问题，目前尚不清楚。

abstract.text: This paper evaluates relationships between healthcare employees' perceptions of three hospital organizational constructs (Leadership, Support and Resources), and their assessment of two employee-related outcomes (employee satisfaction and retention) and two patient-related outcomes (patient satisfaction and quality of care). Using four all-employee surveys conducted by the Veterans Health Administration in the United States between 1997 and 2006, we examine the strength of these relationships and their changes over time. Exposure and outcome measures are employee-assessed in all the surveys. Because it can accommodate both latent and measured variables into the model, Structural Equation Modelling (SEM) is used to capture and quantify the relationship structure. The aim of the project is to identify possible intervention foci. The analyses revealed that employee-related outcomes are improved by increases in Leadership and Support, and, not surprisingly, the outcome variable of employee satisfaction reduced turnover intention. The employee assessed patient-related outcomes of satisfaction and quality of care were most improved by increases in Resources. Results also indicate that the three organizational constructs and the web of associations characterized by SEM underwent changes over the study period, perhaps in relation to changes in VHA policy emphases, changes in survey wording and other possible unmeasured factors.

10.1002/hec.1692.abstractZh: 本文评估了医疗员工对医院三个组织结构要素（领导力、支持与资源）的认知与其对两个员工相关结果（员工满意度和留任率）以及两个患者相关结果（患者满意度和护理质量）的评估之间的关系。通过美国退伍军人健康管理局在1997至2006年间进行的四次全员工调查，我们研究了这些关系的强度及其随时间的变化。所有调查中都采用了员工评估的结果作为暴露和结果指标。由于结构方程模型能够同时纳入潜变量和测量变量，因此采用该模型来捕捉和量化这些关系结构。该项目的目标是确定可能的干预重点。分析结果显示，通过提升领导力与支持水平，员工相关结果有所改善；不出所料，员工满意度这一结果变量降低了员工离职意愿。而员工评估的患者相关结果——满意度与护理质量——则主要通过增加资源得到改善。研究结果还表明，这三个组织结构要素及其通过结构方程模型所描绘的关联网络在研究期间发生了变化，这可能与VHA政策重点的变化、调查措辞的修改以及其他未测量因素有关。

abstract.text: More than 45% of Australians buy health insurance for private treatment in hospital. This is despite having access to universal and free public hospital treatment. Anecdotal evidence suggests that avoidance of long waits for public treatment is one possible explanation for the high rate of insurance coverage. In this study, we investigate the effect of waiting on individual decisions to buy private health insurance. Individuals are assumed to form an expectation of their own waiting time as a function of their demographics and health status. We model waiting times using administrative data on the population hospitalised for elective procedures in public hospitals and use the parameter estimates to impute the expected waiting time and the probability of a long wait for a representative sample of the population. We find that expected waiting time does not increase the probability of buying insurance but a high probability of experiencing a long wait does. On average, waiting time has no significant impact on insurance. In addition, we find that favourable selection into private insurance, measured by self-assessed health, is no longer significant once waiting time variables are included. This result suggests that a source of favourable selection may be aversion to waiting among healthier people.

10.1002/hec.1707.abstractZh: 超过45%的澳大利亚人购买私人医疗保险，以便在医院接受治疗。尽管他们可以免费享受公共医院的医疗服务。一些传闻表明，避免长时间等待公共医疗服务可能是保险覆盖率较高的一个原因。在这项研究中，我们探讨了等待时间对个人购买私人健康保险决策的影响。假设个人会根据其人口统计信息和健康状况来预测自己的等待时间。我们使用公共医院中因手术而住院的行政数据来建模等待时间，并利用参数估计值来估算预期等待时间和长时间等待的概率。我们发现，预期等待时间并不会增加购买保险的概率，但长时间等待的概率确实会增加。平均而言，等待时间对保险购买决策没有显著影响。此外，我们发现，一旦纳入等待时间变量，根据自我评估的健康状况来选择私人保险的情况就不再显著了。这一结果表明，健康人群选择私人保险的一个原因可能是对等待时间的厌恶。

abstract.text: Informal filial care plays an important role for elderly parents facing health challenges. Ageing, however, exacerbates the burden of filial care because the ratio of older to younger individuals is higher and disabled parents live longer. The well-being of elderly parents is even more insecure in Asian developing countries that are undergoing unprecedented ageing and drastic changes in social norms and values, whereas old-age support systems have yet to be developed. In this paper, we investigate factors that influence cohabitation decision by elderly parents and their adult children using the longitudinal Indonesian Family Life Survey (IFLS). Focusing on new cohabitation in which a parent who lives independently starts to cohabitate with a child, we conduct transition analysis to make a more convincing causal interpretation than the standard cross-sectional approach. We find that, while parental needs are important, cohabitation is influenced to a larger extent by the costs and gains of children. The elderly facing health and economic challenges are at higher risk of not receiving filial support than other elderly individuals.

10.1002/hec.1708.abstractZh: 非正式的家庭照料对于面临健康挑战的老年父母来说起着重要作用。然而，人口老龄化加剧了照料负担，因为老年人与年轻人的比例更高，且残疾父母的寿命更长。在亚洲发展中国家，由于人口迅速老龄化以及社会规范和价值观发生剧烈变化，老年父母的福祉更加不稳定，而养老支持体系尚未得到充分发展。本文利用印度尼西亚家庭生活调查数据，研究了影响老年父母与其子女同居决策的因素。重点关注父母独立生活后开始与子女同居的新情况，我们通过过渡分析来得出比传统横断面研究更可靠的因果解释。研究发现，尽管父母的需求很重要，但同居的决定更多受到子女带来的成本和收益的影响。面临健康和经济挑战的老年父母，无法获得家庭照料的几率比其他老年个体更高。

abstract.text: We investigate whether overweight or obese individuals utilize more medical care than normal weight individuals by estimating a finite mixture model which splits the population into frequent and non-frequent users of primary care physician (GP) services. Based on a survey sample aged 25-60 years from the National Health Interview (NHI) 2000 merged to Danish register data, we compare differences in the impact of being overweight and obese relative to being normal weight on the utilization of GP services. Estimated bodyweight effects vary across latent classes and show that being obese or overweight does not increase the utilization of GP services among infrequent users but does so among frequent users. Obese (and to a lesser extent, overweight) infrequent users are observed 5 years later to substantially increase their health-care usage as measured by doctor visits, hospitalizations, and number of bed days.

10.1002/hec.1711.abstractZh: 我们研究了超重或肥胖人群是否比正常体重人群更频繁地利用医疗服务，通过构建一个有限混合模型来划分人群为经常使用初级保健医生服务的人群和不太常使用的人群。基于2000年全国健康访谈中25-60岁年龄段的调查样本，并将其与丹麦登记数据合并，我们比较了超重和肥胖与正常体重相比，对使用初级保健医生服务的影响差异。估计出的体重效应在不同潜在类别中有所不同，结果显示，对于不太常使用初级保健医生服务的人群来说，肥胖或超重并不会增加他们的服务使用频率，但对于经常使用的人群来说，肥胖或超重确实会增加服务使用频率。研究发现，5年后，肥胖（以及超重）的不常使用初级保健医生服务的人群，其医疗服务使用频率显著增加，表现为就诊次数、住院次数和住院天数都有所上升。

abstract.text: Whereas National Health authorities recommend a decrease in the consumption of 'added' sugar, a reform on the sugar market will lead to a 36% decrease of the sugar price in the EU. Using French data on soft drinks purchases, this paper investigates the anticipated impact of this reform on the consumption of sugar-sweetened beverages. The reform of the EU sugar policy leads to a decrease in regular soft drink prices by 3% and varies across brands. To assess substitution within this food category, we use a random-coefficients logit model that takes into account a large number of differentiated products and heterogeneity in consumers' behavior. Results suggest that price changes would lead to an increase in market shares of regular products by 7.5% and to substitutions between brands to the benefit of products with the highest sugar content. On the whole, it would raise consumption of regular soft drinks by more than 1 litre per person per year and consumption of added sugar by 124 g per person per year, this increase being larger in households composed of overweight and obese individuals.

10.1002/hec.1721.abstractZh: 鉴于国家卫生当局建议减少“添加”糖的摄入，对糖市场的改革将导致欧盟糖价下降36%。本文利用法国关于软饮料购买的数据，研究了这一改革对含糖饮料消费的预期影响。欧盟糖政策的改革使普通软饮料的价格下降3%，但不同品牌之间的价格差异较大。为了评估这一食品类别内的替代行为，我们采用了一种随机系数逻辑模型，该模型考虑了大量差异化的产品以及消费者行为的异质性。研究结果表明，价格变动将使普通产品的市场份额增加7.5%，并且品牌之间的替代行为会增加含糖量最高的产品的消费。总体而言，这将使每人每年的普通软饮料消费量增加超过1升，同时每人每年的添加糖摄入量增加124克，这一增长在由超重和肥胖人群组成的家庭中更为明显。

abstract.text: The binary variable is one of the most common types of variables in the analysis of income-related health inequalities. I argue that while the binary variable has some unusual properties, it shares many of the properties of the ratio-scale variable and hence lends itself to both relative and absolute inequality analyses, albeit with some qualifications. I argue that criticisms of the normalization I proposed in an earlier paper, and of the use of the binary variable for inequality analysis, stem from a misrepresentation of the properties of the binary variable, as well as a switch of focus away from relative inequality to absolute inequality. I concede that my normalization is not uncontentious, but, in a way, that has not previously been noted.

10.1002/hec.1752.abstractZh: 二元变量是分析收入相关健康不平等时最常见的变量类型之一。我认为，尽管二元变量具有一些特殊性质，但它与比率尺度变量有许多共同之处，因此既适用于相对不平等分析，也适用于绝对不平等分析，不过需要一些限制条件。我认为，对我在早期论文中提出的归一化方法的批评，以及对于使用二元变量进行不平等分析的批评，都是因为对二元变量性质的误解，以及关注点从相对不平等转向了绝对不平等。我承认我的归一化方法并非没有争议，但以前并没有人注意到这一点。

abstract.text: High deductible health plans (HDHPs) have become an increasingly common form of benefit design used by employers to manage health-care costs. Numerous studies have evaluated the uptake and impact of HDHPs on health-care utilization. Most studies have employed the standard difference-in-differences (DID) methodology. In this paper, we employ three alternative methodologies to evaluate a natural experiment in which a traditional health plan was fully replaced by a HDHP. We implement the standard DID and the quantile difference-in-differences (QDID) estimators to evaluate the impact of the HDHP on following six outcomes: overall cost, medical cost, pharmacy cost, outpatient visit count, inpatient visit count and emergency room visit count. We compare these results to a changes-in-changes (CIC) estimator, a generalized version of the standard (DID) estimator. We find that both the DID and CIC models yielded similar results, while the QDID model provided additional insights on the HDHP impact across different parts of the outcome distributions. Overall, introduction of HDHP had no impact on health-care costs, positive impact on the number of outpatient visits and mixed impacts on the inpatient and emergency room visit counts. The QDID estimates suggest HDHP introduction generally impacted subjects in upper percentiles (50th, 75th and 90th).

10.1002/hec.1757.abstractZh: 高免赔额健康计划已成为雇主用于管理医疗成本的一种常见福利设计形式。许多研究评估了高免赔额健康计划在医疗利用方面的接受度和影响。大多数研究采用了标准差异-差异法（DID）。在本文中，我们采用了三种替代方法，以评估一个自然实验的结果，该实验中传统健康计划被高免赔额健康计划完全取代。我们采用标准DID和分位数差异-差异法（QDID）估计器来评估高免赔额健康计划对以下六个结果的影响：总体成本、医疗费用、药房费用、门诊就诊次数、住院就诊次数和急诊室就诊次数。我们将这些结果与变化-变化法（CIC）估计器进行了比较，后者是标准DID估计器的一种广义版本。我们发现，DID和CIC模型得出的结果相似，而QDID模型提供了关于高免赔额健康计划在不同结果分布部分影响的额外见解。总体而言，引入高免赔额健康计划对医疗成本没有影响，但对门诊就诊次数有积极影响，对住院和急诊室就诊次数则产生了混合影响。QDID估计表明，高免赔额健康计划的引入通常对较高百分位数（第50、75和90位）的受试者产生了影响。

abstract.text: The prenatal diagnosis of Down syndrome (amniocentesis) presents parents with a complex dilemma which requires comparing the risk of giving birth to an affected child and the risk of losing an unaffected child through amniocentesis-related miscarriage. Building on the specific features of the French Health insurance system, this paper shows that variation in the monetary costs of the diagnosis procedure may have a very significant impact on how parents solve this ethical dilemma. The French institutions make it possible to compare otherwise similar women facing very different reimbursement schemes and we find that eligibility to full reimbursement has a largely positive effect on the probability of taking an amniocentesis test. By contrast, the sole fact of being labelled 'high-risk' by the Health system seems to have, as such, only a modest effect on subsequent choices. Finally, building on available information on post-amniocentesis outcomes, we report new evidence suggesting that amniocentesis increases the risk of premature birth and low weight at birth.

10.1002/hec.1762.abstractZh: 唐氏综合征的产前诊断（羊膜穿刺术）给父母带来了复杂的抉择，需要权衡生育患病孩子的风险与因羊膜穿刺术导致的流产而失去健康孩子的风险。基于法国健康保险系统的具体特点，本文指出诊断程序的货币成本差异可能对父母如何解决这一伦理困境产生重大影响。法国的相关机构允许面临不同报销方案的相似女性进行比较，我们发现完全报销资格对选择进行羊膜穿刺术的概率有显著的正面影响。相比之下，被健康系统标记为“高风险”这一事实似乎对后续选择的影响较为有限。最后，基于现有的羊膜穿刺术后结果信息，我们发现了新的证据，表明羊膜穿刺术会增加早产和低出生体重的风险。

abstract.text: Economists usually draw a distinction between smokers. They distinguish 'happy addicts' à la Becker-Murphy from 'unhappy addicts' who state that smoking is a mistake and call for some help to quit. When evaluating tobacco control policies, it might be important to distinguish their effects on those two types of population. Indeed, such policies are welfare improving only if they help unhappy addicts to quit. We investigate the effect of the French workplace smoking ban on a sample of presumably 'unhappy addicts', smokers who consult tobacco cessation services. We show that the ban caused an increase in the demand for such services, and that this increase was larger in cold and rainy areas. It also induced an increase in the percentage of successful attempts to quit. Workplace smoking bans might be welfare improving since they seem to help 'unhappy addicts' to reconcile their behavior with their preferences.

10.1002/hec.1763.abstractZh: 经济学家通常区分吸烟者的类型。他们区分了像贝克尔-墨菲所描述的“快乐的瘾君子”和那些认为吸烟是一种错误并寻求帮助戒烟的“不快乐的瘾君子”。在评估烟草控制政策时，区分这两种人群的影响可能非常重要。事实上，只有当这些政策能够帮助不快乐的瘾君子戒烟时，它们才能真正改善福利。我们研究了法国工作场所禁烟令对那些可能属于“不快乐的瘾君子”的群体的影响，这些人是寻求戒烟服务的吸烟者。我们发现，禁烟令导致了对这些服务的需求增加，而在寒冷和雨天地区，这种需求增加更为明显。此外，它还提高了成功戒烟尝试的比例。工作场所禁烟令可能有助于改善福利，因为它们似乎能够帮助“不快乐的瘾君子”调整自己的行为以符合他们的偏好。

abstract.text: In this paper, we propose an estimator for models in which an endogenous dichotomous treatment affects a count outcome in the presence of either sample selection or endogenous participation using maximum simulated likelihood. We allow for the treatment to have an effect on the participation or the sample selection rule and on the main outcome. Applications of this model are frequent in-but no limited to-health economics. We show an application of the model using data from Kenkel and Terza (2001), who investigate the effect of physician advice on the amount of alcohol consumption. Our estimates suggest that in these data (i) neglecting treatment endogeneity leads to a wrongly signed effect of physician advice on drinking intensity, (ii) accounting for treatment endogeneity but neglecting endogenous participation leads to an upward biased estimate of the treatment effect and (iii) advice affects only the drinking intensive margin but not drinking prevalence.

10.1002/hec.1764.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种估计方法，用于那些存在内生二分处理因素影响计数结果的情况，无论是否存在样本选择或内生参与现象，均可通过最大模拟似然法进行处理。我们允许处理因素对参与行为或样本选择规则以及主要结果产生影响。该模型的应用广泛，不仅限于健康经济学领域。我们以Kenkel和Terza（2001年）的研究数据为例，展示了该模型的应用效果。他们的研究探讨了医生建议对酒精消费量的影响。我们的估计结果表明：（i）忽略处理因素的内生性会导致医生建议对饮酒强度的效应符号错误；（ii）考虑处理因素的内生性但忽略内生参与行为会导致处理效应的估计值出现向上偏差；（iii）医生建议仅影响饮酒强度较高的群体，而不会影响饮酒的普遍水平。

abstract.text: The paper explores the link between managerial performance and cost efficiency of 617 Japanese general local public hospitals in 1999-2007. Treating managerial performance as unobservable heterogeneity, the paper employs a panel data stochastic cost frontier model with latent classes. Financial parameters associated with better managerial performance are found to be positively significant in explaining the probability of belonging to the more efficient latent class. The analysis of latent class membership was consistent with the conjecture that unobservable technological heterogeneity reflected in the existence of the latent classes is related to managerial performance. The findings may support the cause for raising efficiency of Japanese local public hospitals by enhancing the quality of management.

10.1002/hec.1769.abstractZh: 本文探讨了1999年至2007年间617家日本地方公立医院的管理绩效与成本效率之间的关系。将管理绩效视为不可观测的异质性因素，本文采用带有潜在类别的面板数据随机成本前沿模型进行分析。研究发现，与更好的管理绩效相关的财务参数在解释属于更高效潜在类别的概率方面具有显著的正向影响。潜在类别成员身份的分析结果与这一猜想一致，即反映在潜在类别存在中的不可观测技术异质性与管理绩效之间存在关联。这些发现可能有助于通过提升管理质量来提高日本地方公立医院的效率。

abstract.text: In France, a significant number of General Practitioners (GPs) earn less than 1.5 times the French minimum salary. Using a representative panel of self-employed GPs over the years 1993-2004, this paper tests whether these low-income GPs choose to work less than all other GPs or whether they are constrained to do so. The test is based on measuring reactions to positive and negative demand shocks. As low-income GPs do not increase activity in response to a positive demand shock but decrease activity in response to a negative demand shock, it appears that their low-income status is attributable to a strong preference for leisure.

10.1002/hec.1770.abstractZh: 在法国，相当数量的全科医生收入不到法国最低工资的一倍半。本文以1993年至2004年间的一组代表性自雇全科医生为样本，研究这些低收入全科医生是否选择减少工作时间，或者他们是否被迫如此行事。研究通过测量对正面和负面需求冲击的反应来进行分析。结果显示，低收入全科医生在面临正面需求冲击时不会增加工作活动，而在面临负面需求冲击时则会减少工作活动。这表明，他们低收入的状态可能是由于他们对休闲活动的强烈偏好所致。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the causal effect of Oportunidades, a conditional cash-transfer program in Mexico, on overweight and obesity of adolescents living in poor rural areas. Affecting youth weight was not a goal of this program. However, health economics research suggests that the provision of schooling, health information sessions and sizable cash transfers to Oportunidades participants could have substantially changed their overweight and obesity rates. Exploiting an exogenous jump in program participation by means of a fuzzy Regression Discontinuity (RD) design, the evidence of this paper suggests that Oportunidades decreased obesity among participant women. The identified local average treatment effect (LATE) at the threshold for program eligibility suggests that female obesity would decrease if the program was expanded to cover slightly better-off households. The design of the program does not allow disentangling the causal pathways that contributed to the lower prevalence of obesity among women, but the effect likely resulted from increased access to information and schooling, improved dietary quality, increased monitoring of health outcomes and (possibly) increased physical activity. Suggestive evidence shows that teen pregnancy rates were higher among non-participants. Therefore, weight gain after childbirth might also explain higher obesity rates among non-participant females.

10.1002/hec.1773.abstractZh: 本文研究了墨西哥的一项条件性现金转移计划“Oportunidades”对贫困农村地区的青少年超重和肥胖问题的因果效应。该计划的目标并非直接针对青少年的体重问题。然而，健康经济学研究表明，通过提供教育、健康信息以及向“Oportunidades”计划参与者提供大量现金转移，可以显著改变他们的超重和肥胖率。本文利用模糊回归不连续设计，通过分析计划参与人数的变化，发现“Oportunidades”计划有助于降低女性成员的肥胖率。在计划资格门槛处确定的局部平均处理效应表明，如果计划扩展到稍微条件较好的家庭，女性成员的肥胖率将会下降。该计划的设计方式无法明确区分导致女性肥胖率降低的具体因果路径，但这一效果可能源于信息获取的增加、教育水平的提高、饮食质量的改善、健康结果的监测加强，以及可能的体力活动增加。有证据表明，非参与者中的青少年怀孕率较高，因此，分娩后的体重增加也可能解释了非参与者女性较高的肥胖率。

abstract.text: This paper develops a smooth mixture of Tobits (SMTobit) model for healthcare expenditure. The model is a generalization of the smoothly mixing regressions framework of Geweke and Keane (J Econometrics 2007; 138: 257-290) to the case of a Tobit-type limited dependent variable. A Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithm with data augmentation is developed to obtain the posterior distribution of model parameters. The model is applied to the US Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey data on total medical expenditure. The results suggest that the model can capture the overall shape of the expenditure distribution very well, and also provide a good fit to a number of characteristics of the conditional (on covariates) distribution of expenditure, such as the conditional mean, variance and probability of extreme outcomes, as well as the 50th, 90th, and 95th, percentiles. We find that healthier individuals face an expenditure distribution with lower mean, variance and probability of extreme outcomes, compared with their counterparts in a worse state of health. Males have an expenditure distribution with higher mean, variance and probability of an extreme outcome, compared with their female counterparts. The results also suggest that heart and cardiovascular diseases affect the expenditure of males more than that of females.

10.1002/hec.1777.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种用于医疗支出的平滑混合Tobit模型。该模型是Geweke和Keane提出的平滑混合回归框架的推广，适用于Tobit型有限因变量的情况。文中开发了一种基于马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛算法并结合数据增强的方法，用于获取模型参数的后验分布。该模型被应用于美国Medicare当前受益人调查中关于总医疗支出的数据。研究结果表明，该模型能够很好地捕捉支出分布的整体形态，并且能够很好地拟合条件分布（基于协变量）的多个特征，如条件均值、方差、极端结果的概率，以及第50%、90%和95%的分位数。研究发现，健康状况较好的个体面临的是具有较低均值、较低方差和较低极端结果概率的支出分布，而健康状况较差的个体则相反。男性在支出分布上表现出更高的均值、更高的方差以及更高的极端结果概率。研究结果还表明，心脏病和心血管疾病对男性的支出影响大于对女性。

abstract.text: This paper extends the ex ante moral hazard model to allow healthy lifestyles to reduce the probability of illness in future periods, so that current preventive behaviour may be affected by anticipated changes in future insurance coverage. In the United States, Medicare is offered to almost all the population at the age of 65. We use nine waves of the US Health and Retirement Study to compare lifestyles before and after 65 of those insured and not insured pre 65. The double-robust approach, which combines propensity score and regression, is used to compare trends in lifestyle (physical activity, smoking, drinking) of the two groups before and after receiving Medicare, using both difference-in-differences and difference-in-differences-in-differences. There is no clear effect of the receipt of Medicare or its anticipation on alcohol consumption nor smoking behaviour, but the previously uninsured do reduce physical activity just before receiving Medicare.

10.1002/hec.1778.abstractZh: 本文将事前道德风险模型扩展为允许健康生活方式降低未来时期的疾病发生概率，从而使当前的预防行为受到未来保险覆盖变化的预期影响。在美国，几乎所有65岁及以上的人口都享有医疗保险。我们利用美国健康与退休研究中的九波数据，比较了65岁之前和之后有保险与没有保险的人群的生活方式。采用结合倾向评分和回归分析的双稳健方法，通过比较两组在获得医疗保险前后的生活方式（如体力活动、吸烟、饮酒）变化，使用差异中的差异和差异中的差异中的差异方法进行分析。结果显示，获得医疗保险或其预期对酒精消费和吸烟行为没有明显影响，但之前没有保险的人在获得医疗保险之前确实减少了体力活动。

abstract.text: In 1996, the Washington Panel recommended that the productivity costs that are not directly related to obtaining care be captured in the quality‐of‐life weights used to construct the quality‐adjusted life years (QALYs) in American cost–utility analyses. This paper revisits the original justification of the Panel and the critiques that appeared in the literature at the time. It then analyzes how productivity costs would be viewed from a cost–benefit analysis perspective to identify their welfare implications and then translates these implications into what they mean for how to express productivity costs in a cost–utility analysis. Next, three consistency issues are identified: (i) consistency between the welfare implications and the health status questionnaires used to construct the QALYs; (ii) consistency between the productivity costs from morbidity and mortality; and (iii) consistency between the measurement of productivity costs and the societal perspective. Finally, after reviewing the productivity costs policies of other countries, the paper makes a modest proposal for a new US policy.

10.1002/hec.1795.abstractZh: 1996年，华盛顿小组建议，那些与获得护理直接无关的生产力成本应被纳入用于构建美国成本-效用分析中的质量调整生命年（QALYs）的生活质量权重中。本文重新审视了小组最初的理由以及当时文献中出现的批评意见。接着，文章分析了从成本-效益分析的角度如何看待生产力成本，以确定其福利影响，并将这些影响转化为如何在成本-效用分析中表达生产力成本。随后，文章指出了三个一致性问题：(i) 福利影响与用于构建QALYs的健康状况问卷之间的一致性；(ii) 由发病率和死亡率产生的生产力成本之间的一致性；以及(iii) 生产力成本衡量方法与社会视角之间的一致性。最后，在回顾了其他国家的生产力成本政策后，文章提出了一个新的美国政策建议。

abstract.text: In the United States, two patients with the same medical condition can receive drastically different treatments. In addition, the same patient can walk into two physicians’ offices and receive equally disparate treatments. This chapter attempts to understand why. It focuses on three areas: the patient, the physician, and the clinical situation. Specifically, the chapter surveys patient or demand-side factors such as price, income, and preferences; physician or supply-side factors such as specialization, financial incentives, and professionalism; and situational factors including behavioral influences and systems-level factors that play a role in clinical decision making. This chapter reviews theory and evidence, borrowing heavily from the clinical literature.

10.1016/b978-0-444-53592-4.00006-2.abstractZh: 在美国，两名患有相同疾病的患者可能会接受截然不同的治疗。此外，同一位患者可能会走进两家不同的医生诊所，并受到截然不同的治疗。本章试图解释这一现象的原因。它重点关注三个方面：患者、医生以及临床情况。具体而言，本章探讨了患者的需求因素，如价格、收入和偏好；医生的供给因素，如专业分工、经济激励和职业素养；以及影响临床决策的情境因素，包括行为影响和系统层面的因素。本章通过大量参考临床文献，对理论和证据进行了回顾。

abstract.text: This paper uses data on real and perceived cancer risks and cancer screening behavior to test the allocative efficiency theory. Specifically, it explores whether the educated make better-informed health decisions. I propose that (1) when educated individuals are better informed, they are more likely to incorporate variation in risk factors when they report their personal cancer risk, and (2) as risk varies, the better educated will react more strongly by adopting preventive behaviors such as cancer screening. The results support for both predictions. Further, using data on attitudes toward breast health, I explore a possible mechanism: educated women are more receptive to scientific evidence and hold fewer nonscientific beliefs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.08.008.abstractZh: 本文利用实际和感知的癌症风险以及癌症筛查行为的数据来检验配置效率理论。具体而言，本文探讨了受过教育的人群是否能够做出更明智的健康决策。我提出以下观点：(1)当受过教育的人拥有更充分的信息时，他们在报告个人癌症风险时会更考虑风险因素的变化；(2)随着风险的变化，受教育程度较高的人会采取更积极的预防行为，如进行癌症筛查。研究结果支持这两个预测。此外，通过收集关于乳腺癌健康态度的数据，本文还探讨了一种可能的机制：受过教育的女性更易于接受科学证据，并且持有较少的非科学信念。

abstract.text: We analyse the properties of optimal price adjustment to hospitals when no lump-sum transfers are allowed and when prices differ to reflect observable exogenous differences in costs. We find that: (a) when the marginal benefit from treatment is decreasing and the cost function is the power function, price adjustment for hospitals with higher costs is positive but partial; if the marginal benefit is constant, the price is identical across providers; (b) if the cost function is exponential or it is separable in monetary and non-monetary costs (and linear in monetary costs), price adjustment is positive even when the marginal benefit is constant; (c) higher inequality aversion of the purchaser increases concentration in prices and lowers concentration in quantities; (d) if some dimensions of costs are private information, a higher correlation between the observable and unobservable cost component increases the optimal price for providers whose observable costs are above the average.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.09.001.abstractZh: 我们分析了在不允许一次性转移支付且价格差异反映可观测的外生成本变化情况下，医院最优价格调整的特性。研究发现：(a)当治疗的边际效益递减且成本函数为幂函数时，成本较高的医院的价格调整是积极的但有限的；如果边际效益保持不变，不同供应商之间的价格则相同；(b)如果成本函数为指数型，或者成本可以分离为货币成本和非货币成本（并且货币成本呈线性），即使边际效益保持不变，价格调整也是积极的；(c)购买者的不平等厌恶程度越高，价格集中度越高，而数量集中度则越低；(d)如果某些成本维度是私人信息，可观测成本与不可观测成本之间的相关性越高，那些可观测成本高于平均水平的供应商的最优价格也会相应提高。

abstract.text: I estimate models of endogenous social interactions in body weight at the county and state levels. The results show that dispersion in body weight across time and space in the U.S. is not clearly excessive, and that much of this variation can be attributed to observable individual and regional characteristics. Models exploiting variants of methods proposed by Glaeser et al. (2003), fixed effects, instrumental variable and split-sample instrumental variable methods to address endogeneity suggest that there are not large social multipliers on body weight outcomes. The evidence suggests there may be small multipliers on BMI, obesity, and morbid obesity. There is no evidence that underweight is subject to a social multiplier. The results are sensitive to specification.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.09.002.abstractZh: 我估算了县级和州级层面体重内生互动的模型。研究结果表明，美国体重在时间和空间上的差异并不明显，这种差异很大程度上可以归因于可观察到的个体和地区特征。利用Glaeser等人（2003年）提出的各种方法、固定效应模型、工具变量模型以及分割样本工具变量模型来分析内生性问题的结果表明，体重变化并没有显著的社会放大效应。证据表明，BMI、肥胖和病态肥胖可能具有较小的社会放大效应。没有证据表明体重过轻会受到社会放大效应的影响。这些结果对模型设定非常敏感。

abstract.text: The focus on employer-provided health insurance in the United States may restrict business creation. We address the limited research on the topic of "entrepreneurship lock" by using recent panel data from matched Current Population Surveys. We use difference-in-difference models to estimate the interaction between having a spouse with employer-based health insurance and potential demand for health care. We find evidence of a larger negative effect of health insurance demand on business creation for those without spousal coverage than for those with spousal coverage. We also take a new approach in the literature to examine the question of whether employer-based health insurance discourages business creation by exploiting the discontinuity created at age 65 through the qualification for Medicare. Using a novel procedure of identifying age in months from matched monthly CPS data, we compare the probability of business ownership among male workers in the months just before turning age 65 and in the months just after turning age 65. We find that business ownership rates increase from just under age 65 to just over age 65, whereas we find no change in business ownership rates from just before to just after for other ages 55-75. We also do not find evidence from the previous literature and additional estimates that other confounding factors such as retirement, partial retirement, social security and pension eligibility are responsible for the increase in business ownership in the month individuals turn 65.
