Our estimates provide some evidence that "entrepreneurship lock" exists, which raises concerns that the bundling of health insurance and employment may create an inefficient level of business creation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.09.003.abstractZh: 在美国，对雇主提供健康保险的关注可能会限制商业创收。我们利用最近的匹配当前人口调查面板数据，对关于“创业锁”这一话题的有限研究进行了探讨。我们使用差异-差异模型来估计拥有雇主提供健康保险的配偶与对医疗保健潜在需求之间的相互作用。我们发现，对于没有配偶健康保险的人来说，健康保险需求对商业创收的负面影响比有配偶健康保险的人更大。我们还采用了一种新的方法来研究雇主提供健康保险是否通过利用65岁时的资格限制来阻碍商业创收的问题。通过一种新颖的方法，从匹配的月度CPS数据中识别出年龄以月为单位的数值，我们比较了65岁前几个月和65岁后几个月男性工人拥有企业的概率。我们发现，在65岁之前，拥有企业的比例有所上升，而在65岁之后则没有变化。对于55-75岁之间的其他年龄段，我们也没有发现其他混杂因素如退休、部分退休、社会保障和养老金资格对65岁前后拥有企业比例的影响。我们的估计结果表明，“创业锁”确实存在，这引发了关于将健康保险与就业捆绑可能导致商业创收效率低下问题的担忧。

abstract.text: This purpose of this paper is to investigate the impact of Paragraph IV patent infringement decisions on brand drug pharmaceutical firms. Paragraph IV decisions determine whether a generic firm can enter before the period of exclusivity ends. I construct a novel dataset of all Paragraph IV decisions and find that they disproportionately involve the highest revenue drugs, significant periods of patent protection, and a non-trivial portion of all brand drugs facing generic entry. I also estimate the impact of Paragraph IV decisions on brand firm profitability and find they have large value consequences.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.09.004.abstractZh: 本文旨在研究第四款专利侵权判决对品牌制药公司的影响。第四款判决决定了仿制药公司是否可以在专利独占期结束前进入市场。我构建了一个包含所有第四款判决的新颖数据集，发现这些判决主要涉及收入最高的药品、专利保护时间较长的药品，以及相当一部分面临仿制药进入市场的品牌药品。我还估算了第四款判决对品牌制药公司盈利能力的影响，发现其具有较大的价值效应。

abstract.text: This paper addresses the question of whether the effect of parental drinking on children's later consumption of alcohol - which is frequently found to be of positive sign - exhibits a certain pattern of heterogeneity. In particular, if this effect is more prominent in the upper tail than elsewhere in the distribution of children's alcohol consumption, conventional regression analyses that focus on the mean effect may substantially underrate parental drinking as a risk factor for children's later alcohol abuse. In our empirical application, we address this issue by applying censored quantile regression methods to German survey data. The supposed pattern of heterogeneity is indeed found in the data, at least for daily parental drinking. In addition, the intergenerational transmission of alcohol consumption exhibits gender-specific heterogeneity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.09.005.abstractZh: 本文探讨了父母饮酒对孩子日后饮酒行为的影响——这一影响通常被认为是积极的——是否存在某种异质性模式。具体而言，如果这种影响在儿童饮酒分布的尾部更为显著，那么传统的回归分析可能会严重低估父母饮酒作为孩子日后饮酒滥用的风险因素的重要性。在我们的实证研究中，我们通过应用截尾分位数回归方法来处理德国调查数据，发现数据中确实存在这种异质性模式，至少对于日常父母饮酒行为而言是如此。此外，饮酒行为的代际传递也表现出性别特定的异质性。

abstract.text: We use data from the Irish census and exploit regional and temporal variation in infant mortality rates over the 20th century to examine effects of early life conditions on later life health. The urban mortality penalty collapsed in Ireland in the years right after World War II. Our main identification is public health interventions centered on improved sanitation and food safety, which we believed played a leading role in eliminating the Irish urban infant mortality penalty. Our estimates suggest that a unit decrease in mortality rates at time of birth reduces the probability of being disabled as an adult by about 12-18%.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.10.002.abstractZh: 我们利用爱尔兰人口普查的数据，并分析20世纪婴儿死亡率的区域性和时间变化，以研究早期生活条件对后期健康的影响。在第二次世界大战后的几年里，爱尔兰的城市死亡率惩罚现象消失了。我们的主要发现是，以改善卫生条件和食品安全为中心的公共卫生干预措施在消除爱尔兰城市婴儿死亡率惩罚方面发挥了重要作用。我们的估计表明，出生时死亡率每降低一个单位，成年后成为残疾的概率就会减少约12-18%。

abstract.text: This paper applies the analytical tools of optimal taxation theory to the design of the optimal subsidy on preventive behaviours, in an economy where longevity varies across agents, and depends on preventive expenditures and on longevity genes. Public intervention can be here justified on three grounds: corrections for misperceptions of the survival process and for externalities related to individual preventive behaviour, and redistribution across both earnings and genetic dimensions. The optimal subsidy on preventive expenditures is shown to depend on the combined impacts of misperception, externalities and self-selection. It is generally optimal to subsidize preventive efforts to an extent depending on the degree of individual myopia, on how productivity and genes are correlated, and on the complementarity of genes and preventive efforts in the survival function.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.10.003.abstractZh: 本文运用最优税收理论的分析工具，研究在寿命因个体而异、且受预防性支出和寿命基因影响的经济体系中，如何设计最优的预防性行为补贴。公共干预的合理性基于三个方面：纠正对生存过程的误解以及与个体预防性行为相关的外部性，以及通过收入与基因维度进行再分配。研究表明，预防性支出的最优补贴取决于误解、外部性以及自我选择的综合影响。一般来说，补贴预防性努力的程度应取决于个体的近视程度、生产力和基因之间的关联程度，以及基因与预防性努力在生存功能中的互补性。

abstract.text: We address models that can explain why expert patients (obstetricians, midwives and doctors) are treated better than non-experts (mainly non-medical training). Models of statistical discrimination show that benevolent doctors treat expert patients better, since experts are better at communicating with the doctor. Agency theory suggests that doctors have an incentive to limit hospital costs by distorting information to non-expert patients, but not to expert patients. The hypotheses were tested on a large set of data, which contained information about the highest education of the parents, and detailed medical information about all births in Norway during the period 1967-2005 (Medical Birth Registry). The empirical analyses show that expert parents have a higher rate of Caesarean section than non-expert parents. The educational disparities were considerable 40 years ago, but have become markedly less over time. The analyses provide support for statistical discrimination theory, though agency theory cannot be totally excluded.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.10.004.abstractZh: 我们研究了能够解释为何专家型患者（如产科医生、助产士和医生）比非专家型患者（主要是非医学专业培训的人员）受到更好治疗的模型。统计歧视模型表明，仁慈的医生会更好地对待专家型患者，因为专家型患者更擅长与医生沟通。代理理论则认为，医生有动机通过向非专家型患者传递错误信息来降低医院成本，但不会对专家型患者这样做。这些假设在大量数据上进行了验证，这些数据包含了父母的最高教育水平信息，以及1967年至2005年间挪威所有分娩的详细医疗信息（Medical Birth Registry）。实证分析显示，专家型父母比非专家型父母更倾向于选择剖宫产。40年前，教育水平的差异相当明显，但随着时间的推移，这一差异已经显著缩小。这些分析支持了统计歧视理论，尽管不能完全排除代理理论的影响。

abstract.text: We study an enhanced fee-for-service model for primary care physicians in the Family Health Groups (FHG) in Ontario, Canada. In contrast to the traditional fee-for-service (FFS) model, the FHG model includes targeted fee increases, extended hours, performance-based initiatives, and patient enrolment. Using a long panel of claims data, we find that the FHG model significantly increases physician productivity relative to the FFS model, as measured by the number of services, patient visits, and distinct patients seen. We also find that the FHG physicians have lower referral rates and treat slightly more complex patients than the comparable FFS physicians. These results suggest that the FHG model offers a promising alternative to the FFS model for increasing physician productivity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.10.005.abstractZh: 我们研究了加拿大安大略省家庭健康小组中初级保健医生的增强式按服务收费模式。与传统的按服务收费模式相比，家庭健康小组模式包括有针对性的费用增加、延长的工作时间、基于绩效的举措以及患者登记制度。通过长期索赔数据分析，我们发现与按服务收费模式相比，家庭健康小组模式显著提高了医生的生产效率，主要体现在服务数量、患者访问次数以及接诊的不同患者数量上。我们还发现，家庭健康小组中的医生转诊率较低，且治疗的复杂患者数量略多于相应的按服务收费模式的医生。这些结果表明，家庭健康小组模式为提高医生生产效率提供了一个有前景的替代方案。

abstract.text: We provide an ex-post assessment of the UK 5-a-day information campaign, where the positive effects of information are disentangled from potentially conflicting price dynamics. Using 4 years of data from the Expenditure and Food Survey between 2002 and 2006, we estimate that the 5-a-day program has lifted fruit and vegetable consumption by 0.3 portions, on average. We also provide quantitative evidence of a differentiated impact by income group, ranging from 0.2 to 0.7 portions. All impacts are larger than those observed by simply comparing pre-policy and post-policy intakes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.10.006.abstractZh: 我们对英国的“每日5份蔬果”信息宣传活动进行了事后评估，旨在将信息带来的积极影响与可能相互冲突的价格动态区分开来。通过利用2002年至2006年间的《支出与食品调查》数据，我们估计“每日5份蔬果”计划平均使蔬果摄入量增加了0.3份。我们还提供了关于不同收入群体所受影响的定量证据，其影响范围从0.2到0.7份不等。所有这些影响都比单纯比较政策实施前后的摄入量所观察到的效果更为显著。

abstract.text: Using data from the Canadian National Longitudinal Survey of Children and Youth (NLSCY), this study examines how and why health outcomes exhibit persistence during the period from childhood to adolescence. We examine the distribution of health outcomes and health transitions using descriptive analysis and explore the determinants of these distributions by estimating the contributions of family SES, unobserved heterogeneity and state dependence and also allowing for heterogeneity of state dependence parameters across categories of neighborhood status. Our analysis indicates that children living in poorer neighborhoods, in neighborhoods with lower education levels and in neighborhoods with more families headed by lone-parents tend to experience poor health status for longer after a transition to it, while children tend to experience multiple health drops living in poorer neighborhoods, in neighborhoods with less educated people, in neighborhoods with more families headed by lone-parents and in neighborhoods with more families living in rental accommodation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.10.007.abstractZh: 本研究利用加拿大儿童和青少年纵向调查的数据，探讨了儿童时期到青少年时期期间健康结果为何会持续出现。我们通过描述性分析来研究健康结果的分布和健康状况的变迁，并通过估计家庭社会经济地位、未观察到的异质性以及状态依赖性等因素的影响，同时考虑不同社区状况下状态依赖性参数的异质性。分析结果表明，生活在较贫困的社区、教育水平较低的社区以及由单亲抚养的家庭中长大的儿童，在健康状况出现变迁后，健康状况持续不佳的时间更长。此外，生活在较贫困的社区、教育水平较低的地区、由单亲抚养的家庭较多的社区以及居住在租赁房屋中的家庭，儿童的健康状况更容易出现多次下降。

abstract.text: In measuring inequality of a bounded variable such as health status, one can focus on attainments or shortfalls. However, rankings of social states by attainment and shortfall inequality do not necessarily mirror one another. We propose a requirement, that attainment inequality and shortfall inequality be measured consistently, and we examine the performance of partial orderings and indices of inequality in this respect. For relative inequality and all currently documented intermediate inequality concepts, the orderings fail our consistency requirement, as do all indices which respect these orderings. However, the absolute inequality partial ordering satisfies consistency. We identify two classes of indices of absolute inequality, one containing rank-independent and the other rank-dependent indices, which measure attainment and shortfall inequality consistently (in fact identically). The only subgroup decomposable inequality index, of any type, which measures attainment and shortfall inequality consistently is the variance. We discuss implications for the study of pure health inequality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.10.008.abstractZh: 在衡量诸如健康状况这样的有限变量的不平等时，可以关注成就或不足。然而，根据成就和不足不平等来排序的社会状态并不一定相互对应。我们提出了一个要求，即成就不平等和不足不平等必须得到一致性的衡量。我们研究了在这方面部分排序和不平等指数的表现。对于相对不平等以及所有目前记录的中间不平等概念，这些排序未能满足我们的一致性要求，所有遵循这些排序的指数也未能满足这一要求。然而，绝对不平等的部分排序则满足了一致性要求。我们识别出两类绝对不平等指数：一类包含与排名无关的指标，另一类包含与排名相关的指标，这两类指数都能一致地衡量成就和不足不平等（实际上两者是完全相同的）。在任何类型的可分解不平等指数中，唯一能一致衡量成就和不足不平等的是方差指数。我们讨论了这对纯健康不平等研究的影响。

abstract.text: We argue that reluctance to invest in drug treatments to fight the AIDS epidemics in developing countries is largely motivated by severe losses occurring from the future albeit uncertain appearance of a curative vaccine. We design a set of securities generating full insurance coverage against such losses, while achieving full risk-sharing with vaccine development agencies. In a General Equilibrium framework, we show that those securities are demanded to improve social welfare in developing countries, to increase current investment in treatments and the provision of public goods. Even though designed for AIDS, those securities can also be applied to other epidemics such as malaria and tuberculosis, as well as any innovative treatment to fight orphan diseases.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.11.001.abstractZh: 我们认为，发展中国家在对抗艾滋病疫情的投资意愿不足，主要源于未来可能出现的严重损失，尽管治愈疫苗的出现尚不确定。我们设计了一组能够完全覆盖这些损失的证券，同时实现与疫苗研发机构的风险共担。在一般均衡框架下，我们表明这些证券的需求有助于改善发展中国家的社会福利，增加当前对治疗方法和公共产品供应的投资。尽管这些证券是为艾滋病设计的，但它们也可以应用于疟疾、结核病等其他传染病，以及任何用于对抗孤儿病的创新治疗方法。

abstract.text: What are the health impacts of retirement? As talk of raising retirement ages in pensions and social security schemes continues around the world, it is important to know both the costs and benefits for the individual, as well as the governments' budgets. In this paper we use the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe (SHARE) dataset to address this question in a multi-country setting. We use country-specific early and full retirement ages as instruments for retirement behavior. These statutory retirement ages clearly induce retirement, but are not related to an individual's health. Exploiting the discontinuities in retirement behavior across countries, we find significant evidence that retirement has a health-preserving effect on overall general health. Our estimates indicate that retirement leads to a 35 percent decrease in the probability of reporting to be in fair, bad, or very bad health, and an almost one standard deviation improvement in the health index. While the self-reported health seems to be a temporary impact, the health index indicates there are long-lasting health differences.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.11.002.abstractZh: 退休对健康有何影响？随着全球范围内关于提高养老金和社会保障计划退休年龄的讨论不断，了解这对个人的成本和收益，以及政府的预算情况非常重要。在本文中，我们使用欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查（SHARE）数据集来探讨这一问题，并采用各国特定的提前退休和完全退休年龄作为退休行为的指标。这些法定退休年龄确实促使人们退休，但它们与个人健康并无直接关系。通过分析各国退休行为的差异，我们发现退休对整体健康具有保护作用。我们的估计表明，退休可使报告处于良好、较差或非常糟糕健康状况的概率降低35%，并使健康指数提高近一个标准差。虽然自我报告的健康状况似乎只是暂时的影响，但健康指数显示存在长期的健康差异。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the relationship between health shocks and labour market outcomes in 9 European countries using the European Community Household Panel. Matching techniques are used to control for the non-experimental nature of the data. The results suggest that there is a significant causal effect from health on the probability of employment: individuals who incur a health shock are significantly more likely to leave employment and transit into disability. The estimates differ across countries, with the largest employment effects being found in The Netherlands, Denmark, Spain and Ireland, and the smallest in France and Italy. Differences in social security arrangements help to explain these cross-country differences.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.11.003.abstractZh: 本文利用欧洲共同体家庭面板数据，研究了9个欧洲国家中健康冲击与劳动力市场结果之间的关系。通过匹配技术来控制数据的非实验性质。研究结果表明，健康状况对就业概率有显著的因果影响：遭受健康冲击的个体更有可能离职并转为残疾状态。不同国家的估计结果存在差异，荷兰、丹麦、西班牙和爱尔兰的就业影响最大，而法国和意大利的影响最小。社会保障制度的差异有助于解释这些国家间的差异。

abstract.text: This paper explores the consequences of the expiration of charity care requirements imposed on private hospitals by the Hill-Burton Act. We examine delivery care and the health of newborns using the universe of Florida births from 1989 to 2003 combined with hospital data from the American Hospital Association. We find that charity care requirements were binding on hospitals, but that private hospitals under obligation "cream skimmed" the least risky maternity patients. Conditional on patient characteristics, they provided less intensive maternity services but without compromising patient health. When obligations expired, private hospitals quickly reduced their charity caseloads, shifting maternity patients to public hospitals. The results in this paper suggest, perhaps surprisingly, that requiring private providers to serve the underinsured can be effective.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.11.004.abstractZh: 本文探讨了《希尔-伯顿法案》对私立医院实施的慈善护理要求到期后的影响。我们通过1989年至2003年间佛罗里达州的出生数据以及美国医院协会提供的医院数据，来研究护理服务的提供情况以及新生儿的健康状况。研究发现，慈善护理要求确实对医院产生了约束力，但负有义务的私立医院在分配产妇患者时，最不倾向于选择风险较低的产妇。根据患者特征，这些私立医院提供了较为低强度的产妇服务，但并未损害患者的健康。当这些要求到期时，私立医院迅速减少了慈善护理的承担量，并将产妇患者转交给公立医院。本文的结果或许令人惊讶地表明，要求私立医疗服务提供者为保险不足的患者提供服务，可能是有效的做法。

abstract.text: Awareness campaigns are often used to encourage medical screening that allows for early detection of health problems, but much remains unknown about the effectiveness of these programs. This paper evaluates whether National Breast Cancer Awareness Month (NBCAM) has led to increased diagnosis of breast cancer. The analysis examines the number of diagnoses made in November (1 month after NBCAM) during years before and after NBCAM was initiated. We find that from 1993 to 1995, the period when breast cancer advocacy was expanding rapidly into a nationwide movement, NBCAM led to an increase in the number of November diagnoses. During earlier periods (from the mid-1980s to the early-1990s), when breast cancer advocacy was still a nascent grassroots movement, and in later periods, when breast cancer advocacy had become a well-established nationwide cause, there is little evidence that October NBCAM events had an effect on November diagnoses.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.11.005.abstractZh: 意识提升活动常被用来鼓励医学筛查，以便早期发现健康问题，但这些项目的有效性仍有很多未知之处。本文评估了全国乳腺癌宣传月是否导致了乳腺癌诊断数量的增加。分析考察了在宣传月启动前后，11月（宣传月后的一个月）的诊断数量。研究发现，在1993年至1995年期间，当乳腺癌宣传活动迅速扩展为全国性运动时，全国乳腺癌宣传月确实增加了11月的诊断数量。而在更早的时期（从20世纪80年代中期到90年代初），乳腺癌宣传活动仍是一个新兴的基层运动，以及后来，当乳腺癌宣传活动已成为一个成熟的全国性事业时，10月的全国乳腺癌宣传月活动对11月的诊断数量几乎没有影响。

abstract.text: Since 1992, the Pennsylvania Health Care Cost Containment Council (PHC4) has published cardiac care report cards for coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery providers. We examine the impact of CABG report cards on a provider's aggregate volume and volume by patient severity and then employ a mixed logit model to investigate the matching between patients and providers. We find a reduction in volume of poor performing and unrated surgeons' volume but no effect on more highly rated surgeons or hospitals of any rating. We also find that the probability that patients, regardless of severity of illness, receive CABG surgery from low-performing surgeons is significantly lower.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.11.006.abstractZh: 自1992年以来，宾夕法尼亚州医疗保健成本控制委员会（PHC4）一直向冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）手术提供者发布心脏护理报告卡。我们研究了这些报告卡对提供者手术总量以及按患者病情严重程度划分的手术量的影响，并采用混合逻辑模型来研究患者与提供者之间的匹配关系。研究发现，表现不佳且未获得评级的医生的手术量有所减少，但这对评级较高的医生或任何评级的医院都没有影响。此外，我们还发现，无论患者的病情严重程度如何，患者接受低水平医生实施的CABG手术的概率显著较低。

abstract.text: Little is known about the ability of incentives to influence decisions by physicians regarding choices of settings for care delivery. In the context of outpatient procedural care, the emergence of freestanding ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) as alternatives to hospital-based outpatient departments (HOPDs) creates a unique opportunity to study this question. We advance a model where physicians' division of labor between ASCs and HOPDs affects the medical complexity of patients treated in low-acuity settings (i.e. ASCs). Analyses of outpatient surgical procedure data show that physicians working exclusively in low-acuity settings (i.e. ASCs) treat patients of significantly higher medical complexity in these settings than do physicians who also practice in higher-acuity settings (i.e. HOPDs). This discrepancy shrinks with increasing procedural risk and with increasing distance between ASCs and acute care hospitals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.11.007.abstractZh: 关于激励措施对医生在选择护理场所时决策的影响，目前了解甚少。在门诊手术护理的背景下，独立设置的门诊手术中心作为医院门诊部门的替代方案，为研究这一问题提供了独特的机会。我们提出了一个模型，该模型认为医生在门诊手术中心与医院门诊部门之间的分工会影响患者在低风险场所（即门诊手术中心）接受的医疗复杂性。对门诊手术数据的分析表明，仅在低风险场所工作的医生所治疗的患者的医疗复杂性明显高于那些同时在高风险场所工作的医生所治疗的患者。这种差异随着手术风险的增加以及门诊手术中心与急性护理医院之间的距离的加大而缩小。

abstract.text: We propose a two-stage model to study the impact of different hospitals' governance frameworks on the optimal contracts designed by third-party payers when patients' disease severity is the private information of the hospital. In the second stage, doctors and managers interact within either a bargaining or a contracting scenario. In the contracting scenario, managers offer a contract that determines the payment to doctors, and doctors decide how many patients to treat. In the bargaining scenario, doctors and managers strategically negotiate on both the payment to doctors and the number of patients to treat. We derive the equilibrium doctors' payments and number of treated patients under both scenarios. We then derive the optimal contract offered by the government to the hospital in the first stage. Results show that when the cost of capital is sufficiently low, the informational rent is lower, and the social welfare is higher, in the contracting scenario.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.12.001.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个两阶段模型，用于研究不同医院治理框架对第三方支付方设计的最优合同的影响，其中患者疾病的严重程度是医院的私有信息。在第二阶段，医生和管理者在谈判或契约场景中互动。在契约场景中，管理者提出一个决定医生薪酬的合同，而医生则决定要治疗多少患者。在谈判场景中，医生和管理者会就医生薪酬和治疗患者数量进行策略性谈判。我们推导出了两种场景下医生支付和接受治疗患者数量的最优解。然后，我们推导出政府在第一阶段向医院提供的最优合同。结果表明，当资本成本足够低时，在契约场景中，信息租金较低，社会福利更高。

abstract.text: This paper uses sequential stochastic dominance procedures to compare the joint distribution of health and income across space and time. It is the first application of which we are aware of methods to compare multidimensional distributions of income and health using procedures that are robust to aggregation techniques. The paper's approach is more general than comparisons of health gradients and does not require the estimation of health equivalent incomes. We illustrate the approach by contrasting Canada and the US using comparable data. Canada dominates the US over the bottom part of the bi-dimensional distribution of health and income, though not generally over the uni-dimensional distributions of health or income. The paper also finds that welfare for both Canadians and Americans has not unambiguously improved during the last decade over the joint distribution of income and health, in spite of the fact that the uni-dimensional distributions of income have clearly improved during that period.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.12.002.abstractZh: 本文采用序贯随机优势方法，比较了健康与收入在时空上的联合分布。据我们所知，这是首次使用对聚合技术具有鲁棒性的方法，来比较收入和健康的多维分布。本文的方法比单纯比较健康梯度更为通用，且无需估算健康等价收入。我们通过使用可比较的数据对比加拿大和美国来说明这种方法。在健康与收入的二维分布中，加拿大在较低水平时优于美国，但在健康或收入的单维分布上则并非如此。此外，尽管收入在单维分布上明显有所改善，但加拿大人和美国人的福利在收入与健康的联合分布方面并未得到明确改善。

abstract.text: Based on comprehensive administrative register data from Norway, we examine the determinants of sickness absence behavior; in terms of employee characteristics, workplace characteristics, panel doctor characteristics, and economic conditions. The analysis is based on a novel concept of a worker's steady state sickness absence propensity, computed from a multivariate hazard rate model designed to predict the incidence and duration of sickness absence for all workers. Key conclusions are that (i) most of the cross-sectional variation in absenteeism is caused by genuine employee heterogeneity; (ii) the identity of a person's panel doctor has a significant impact on absence propensity; (iii) sickness absence insurance is frequently certified for reasons other than sickness; and (iv) the recovery rate rises enormously just prior to the exhaustion of sickness insurance benefits.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.12.003.abstractZh: 基于挪威的综合性行政登记数据，我们研究了影响员工缺勤行为的因素，包括员工特征、工作场所特征、医生团队特征以及经济条件。分析基于一种新颖的工人稳态缺勤倾向概念，该概念是通过一个多变量风险率模型计算得出的，该模型旨在预测所有工人的缺勤发生率和持续时间。主要结论是：(i) 大多数横截面上的缺勤差异是由真实的员工异质性引起的；(ii) 个人医生团队的身份对缺勤倾向有显著影响；(iii) 缺勤保险常常因非疾病原因而获得认证；(iv) 缺勤保险福利耗尽之前，康复率会急剧上升。

abstract.text: We use panel data from local authorities in England between 1998 and 2004 to examine the differential impact of increased access for teenagers to emergency birth control (EBC) at pharmacies on teenage pregnancies and sexually transmitted infections (STIs). We estimate both difference-in-difference (DD) and the more robust difference-in-difference-in-differences (DDD) models. The DD estimates provide some evidence that pharmacy EBC schemes are associated with higher teenage conception rates, but this result is not upheld in the DDD models. In contrast both the DD and DDD models provide consistent evidence that pharmacy EBC schemes are associated with higher teenage STI rates.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.12.004.abstractZh: 我们使用1998至2004年间英格兰地方政府的面板数据，来研究青少年在药店获得紧急避孕服务机会增加对青少年怀孕和性传播感染的影响差异。我们采用了差异分解模型（DD）以及更为严谨的差异分解差异模型（DDD）进行估计。差异分解模型的估计结果表明，药店紧急避孕服务计划与较高的青少年受孕率有关，但这一结果在差异分解差异模型中并未得到支持。相反，无论是差异分解模型还是差异分解差异模型，都一致表明药店紧急避孕服务计划与较高的青少年性传播感染率相关。

abstract.text: Employability strongly moderates the effects of unemployment and of job insecurity on life satisfaction and mental health. Using nationally representative panel data from Australia, I find that an increase in employability from zero to 100% cancels around three quarters, in some cases more, of the detrimental effect of unemployment. Employability also matters for employees: an increase in men's employability from zero to 100% reduces the detrimental effect of job insecurity by more than half. The effects of extreme job insecurity and of unemployment are large and of comparable magnitudes. The findings are used to compute estimates of the well-being trade-off between increases in job insecurity and increases in employability, relevant to the support of "flexicurity" policies, and of the "misery multiplier", the extent to which the effect of a rise in aggregate unemployment on those becoming unemployed is supplemented by the effects on others' insecurity and employability.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.12.005.abstractZh: 就业能力显著地减弱了失业和就业不稳定性对生活满意度和心理健康的影响。利用澳大利亚具有全国代表性的面板数据，我发现就业能力从零增加到100%时，大约可以抵消四分之三的失业带来的负面影响，在某些情况下甚至更多。对于员工而言，就业能力同样重要：男性就业能力从零增加到100%时，可以將就业不稳定性带来的负面影响减少一半以上。极端就业不稳定性及失业的影响都非常显著，且程度相当。这些发现有助于计算就业不稳定性增加与就业能力增加之间的福祉权衡，这对支持“灵活保障”政策具有重要意义，同时也有助于了解“痛苦乘数”——即总体失业率的上升对失业者的影响，是如何通过对其他人的不稳定性及就业能力的影响来进一步加剧的。

abstract.text: In this paper we examine the pricing behaviour of nonprofit health insurers in the Dutch social health insurance market. Since for-profit insurers were not allowed in this market, potential spillover effects from the presence of for-profit insurers on the behaviour of nonprofit insurers were absent. Using a panel data set for all health insurers operating in the Dutch social health insurance market over the period 1996-2004, we estimate a premium model to determine which factors explain the price setting behaviour of nonprofit health insurers. We find that financial stability rather than profit maximisation offers the best explanation for health plan pricing behaviour. In the presence of weak price competition, health insurers did not set premiums to maximize profits. Nevertheless, our findings suggest that regulations on financial reserves are needed to restrict premiums.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.12.006.abstractZh: 本文研究了荷兰社会健康保险市场中非营利健康保险公司的定价行为。由于该市场不允许营利性保险公司存在，因此营利性保险公司对非营利保险公司行为的潜在溢出效应并不存在。我们利用1996至2004年间在荷兰社会健康保险市场运营的所有健康保险公司的面板数据，建立了一个保费模型，以确定哪些因素能够解释非营利健康保险公司的定价行为。研究发现，财务稳定性而非利润最大化更能解释健康保险计划的定价行为。在价格竞争较弱的情况下，健康保险公司并未通过设定最高价来追求利润最大化。尽管如此，我们的研究结果表明，需要制定相关法规来限制保险公司的保费设定。

abstract.text: The paper examines the influence of health savings accounts (HSAs) on optimal savings, insurance demand and prevention effort over the course of a lifetime. This paper adds to the literature by investigating HSAs as both a form of insurance and as saving vehicle in an expected utility framework. Assuming no regulatory constraints on the deductible, we show that individuals voluntarily choose a positive deductible and increase their savings with HSAs. If the government-imposed minimum deductible becomes too great, however, individuals may instead choose to remain in traditional insurance. We determine the effect of HSAs on prevention effort. We find that an increased tax subsidy may worsen moral hazard issues. Assuming partial risk aversion to be less than or equal to one, individuals will either invest less in the health preservation effort and more money in the HSA or vice versa. However, they will never increase both effort and savings simultaneously as was intended when HSAs were introduced.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.12.007.abstractZh: 本文探讨了健康储蓄账户（HSAs）对一生中最佳储蓄、保险需求及预防努力的影响。通过预期效用框架，本文将HSAs视为一种保险形式以及储蓄工具。假设免赔额不受监管限制，我们发现个人会自愿选择较高的免赔额，并通过HSAs增加储蓄。然而，如果政府设定的最低免赔额过高，个人可能会选择继续依赖传统保险。本文还研究了HSAs对预防努力的影响，发现增加税收补贴可能会加剧道德风险问题。假设部分风险厌恶度小于或等于1，个人要么减少健康维护方面的投入，将更多资金存入HSAs，要么相反。然而，他们永远无法同时增加预防和储蓄，这与HSAs最初设计的初衷不符。

abstract.text: We analyze employee health plan choices when the choice set offered by their employer includes a dominated plan. During our study period, one-third of workers were enrolled in the dominated plan. Some may have selected the plan before it was dominated and then failed to switch out of it. However, a substantial number actively chose the dominated plan when they had an unambiguously better choice. These results suggest limitations in the ability of health reform based solely on consumer choice to achieve efficient outcomes and that implementation of health reform should anticipate, monitor and account for this consumer behavior.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.12.008.abstractZh: 我们分析了员工在雇主提供的选择集中包含被支配计划时的健康保险选择情况。在研究期间，有三分之一的工人选择了被支配计划。有些人可能在该计划被支配之前就选择了它，之后未能更换其他计划。然而，有相当数量的工人在有更优选择时仍然选择了被支配计划。这些结果表明，仅基于消费者选择的医疗改革难以实现高效的结果，因此实施医疗改革时应考虑到这种消费者行为。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of job loss due to business closings on body mass index (BMI) and alcohol consumption. We suggest that the ambiguous findings in the extant literature may be due in part to unobserved heterogeneity in response and in part due to an overly broad measure of job loss that is partially endogenous (e.g., layoffs). We improve upon this literature using: exogenously determined business closings, a sophisticated estimation approach (finite mixture models) to deal with complex heterogeneity, and national, longitudinal data from the Health and Retirement Study. For both alcohol consumption and BMI, we find evidence that individuals who are more likely to respond to job loss by increasing unhealthy behaviors are already in the problematic range for these behaviors before losing their jobs. These results suggest the health effects of job loss could be concentrated among "at risk" individuals and could lead to negative outcomes for the individuals, their families, and society at large.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.12.009.abstractZh: 本文探讨了企业倒闭导致失业对体重指数和酒精消费的影响。我们认为，现有文献中存在的模糊研究结果，部分可能是由于响应的未观测异质性，部分可能是由于对失业的衡量过于宽泛且部分具有内生性（例如，裁员）。我们通过以下方法改进了现有研究：采用外生确定的企业倒闭事件，采用复杂的估计方法（有限混合模型）来处理复杂的异质性问题，以及利用《健康与退休研究》提供的全国性的纵向数据。我们发现，对于酒精消费和体重指数而言，那些更可能通过增加不健康行为来应对失业的个体，在失业之前就已经处于这些行为的问题范围内。这些结果表明，失业对健康的负面影响可能集中在“高风险”个体身上，并可能导致个体、其家庭以及整个社会的负面后果。

abstract.text: In view of population aging, better understanding of what drives long-term care expenditure (LTCE) is warranted. Time-to-death (TTD) has commonly been used to project LTCE because it was a better predictor than age. We reconsider the roles of age and TTD by controlling for disability and co-residence and illustrate their relevance for projecting LTCE. We analyze spending on institutional and homecare for the entire Dutch 55+ population, conditioning on age, sex, TTD, cause-of-death and co-residence. We further examined homecare expenditures for a sample of non-institutionalized conditioning additionally on disability. Those living alone or deceased from diabetes, mental illness, stroke, respiratory or digestive disease have higher LTCE, while a cancer death is associated with lower expenditures. TTD no longer determines homecare expenditures when disability is controlled for. This suggests that TTD largely approximates disability. Nonetheless, further standardization of disability measurement is required before disability could replace TTD in LTCE projections models.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2010.12.010.abstractZh: 鉴于人口老龄化的趋势，有必要更好地理解驱动长期护理支出的因素。时间至死亡时间（TTD）常被用来预测长期护理支出，因为它比年龄更能作为预测指标。我们通过控制残疾和共同居住情况，重新评估年龄和TTD的作用，并说明它们对预测长期护理支出的相关性。我们分析了整个荷兰55岁以上人群在机构护理和家庭护理方面的支出，考虑了年龄、性别、TTD、死因以及共同居住情况等因素。此外，我们还针对非机构化人群的家庭护理支出进行了分析，并额外考虑了残疾情况。结果显示，独居者或因糖尿病、精神疾病、中风、呼吸系统或消化系统疾病去世的人，其长期护理支出较高；而癌症死亡则与较低的支出相关。当控制残疾因素后，TTD不再能完全决定家庭护理支出。这表明TTD在很大程度上可以近似代表残疾情况。不过，在残疾因素能够替代TTD用于长期护理支出预测模型之前，还需要进一步标准化残疾的测量方法。

abstract.text: The effects of maternal employment on children's health are theoretically ambiguous and challenging to identify. There are trade-offs between income and time, and a mother's decision to work reflects, in part, her children's health and her underlying preferences. I utilize exogenous variation in each child's youngest sibling's eligibility for kindergarten as an instrument. Using the restricted-access National Health Interview Survey (1985-2004), I identify the effects on overnight hospitalizations, asthma episodes, and injuries/poisonings for children ages 7-17. Maternal employment increases the probability of each adverse health event by nearly 200 percent. These effects are robust and do not reflect a non-representative local effect.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.01.001.abstractZh: 母亲就业对儿童健康的影响在理论上存在不确定性，且难以明确界定。收入与时间之间存在权衡，母亲是否就业在一定程度上反映了她对孩子的健康状况以及她的个人偏好。我采用每个孩子最小弟妹上幼儿园资格的外生变化作为工具变量。通过1985-2004年的限制访问式全国健康访谈调查，我研究了7-17岁儿童因夜间住院、哮喘发作以及受伤/中毒等健康问题所受到的影响。母亲就业使这些不良健康事件的发生率增加了近200%。这些影响是稳健的，并不反映局部性的非代表性效应。

abstract.text: This paper provides a signaling-game theoretical foundation for empirically testing the effects of quality report cards in the U.S. health care industry. It shows that, when health care providers face an identical distribution of patient illness severities, the multidimensional measures in the existing report cards render them a mechanism that reveals the providers' qualities without causing them to select patients. However, non-identical patient type distributions between providers, attributed to the referring physician, may force the high-quality provider to shun patients in order to signal himself. Despite this imperfection, the existing report cards cause the minimum provider selection compared with alternative report mechanisms. Since the report cards not only may cause providers to select patients, but also cause patients to select providers, the single difference-in-differences estimates used in previous studies are not sufficient to indicate providers' selection behavior. In an updated empirical framework, a treatment effect shall be estimated once every period.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.01.002.abstractZh: 本文为实证检验美国医疗保健行业质量报告卡效果提供了信号博弈的理论基础。研究表明，当医疗服务提供者面临相同程度的患者疾病严重程度分布时，现有报告卡中的多维度指标能够作为一种机制，揭示提供者的质量，而不会导致他们选择特定患者。然而，由于转诊医生的影响，不同医疗服务提供者之间可能存在不同的患者类型分布，这可能会迫使高质量提供者选择远离特定患者，以显示自己的优势。尽管存在这种不完美性，现有报告卡仍然能够减少提供者的选择行为，相较于其他报告机制而言。由于报告卡不仅可能导致提供者选择特定患者，也可能导致患者选择特定提供者，因此以往研究中使用的单变量差异估计方法不足以反映提供者的选择行为。在更新的实证框架中，应每隔一段时间就估算一次治疗效果。

abstract.text: This paper presents the first attempt to use a discrete choice experiment to derive distributional weights for quality adjusted life years (QALYs), based on characteristics (age and severity) of the beneficiaries. A novel approach using the Hicksian compensating variation is applied. Advantages include derivation of weights for QALYs, not just for life or life years saved, and investigation of the impact of the size of the health gain by allowing the gain to be traded against other characteristics. Results suggest one would generally not weight QALYs, except in a small number of specific cases and in those cases the weights are relatively small. Methodological challenges are highlighted as is a future research agenda.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.01.003.abstractZh: 本文首次尝试使用离散选择实验，根据受益人的特征（年龄和疾病严重程度）来推导质量调整生命年（QALYs）的分布权重。采用了一种新颖的方法，即利用希克斯补偿变分法。该方法的好处在于能够推导出QALYs的权重，而不仅仅是生命年或节省的生命年权重，并且可以研究健康增益大小对权重的影响，允许将健康增益与其他特征进行交换。结果表明，通常情况下不会为QALYs分配权重，除非在少数特定情况下，且在这些情况下权重相对较小。文中还指出了方法论上的挑战，并提出了未来的研究方向。

abstract.text: In this paper we investigate the causal effect of years of schooling on health and health-related behavior in West Germany. We apply an instrumental variables approach using as natural experiments several changes in compulsory schooling laws between 1949 and 1969. These law changes generate exogenous variation in years of schooling both across states and over time. We find evidence for a strong and significant causal effect of years of schooling on long-term illness for men but not for women. Moreover, we provide somewhat weaker evidence of a causal effect of education on the likelihood of having weight problems for both sexes. On the other hand, we find little evidence for a causal effect of education on smoking behavior. Overall, our estimates suggest significant non-monetary returns to education with respect to health outcomes but not necessarily with respect to health-related behavior.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.01.004.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了西德教育年限对健康及健康相关行为的因果效应。我们采用了工具变量方法，利用1949年至1969年间义务教育法律发生的若干变化作为自然实验。这些法律变化导致了各州以及不同时期教育年限的外生变化。我们发现，教育年限对男性的长期疾病有显著且强烈的因果效应，但对女性则没有这种效应。此外，我们发现了教育对男女体重问题发生概率的因果效应较为微弱。另一方面，我们发现教育对吸烟行为的因果效应则较为微弱。总体而言，我们的估计结果表明，教育在健康结果方面具有显著的非货币回报，但在健康相关行为方面则不一定如此。

abstract.text: This paper evaluates the impacts of unpaid maternity leave provisions of the 1993 Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) on children's birth and infant health outcomes in the United States. My identification strategy uses variation in pre-FMLA maternity leave policies across states and variation in which firms are covered by FMLA provisions. Using Vital Statistics data and difference-in-difference-in-difference methodology, I find that maternity leave led to small increases in birth weight, decreases in the likelihood of a premature birth, and substantial decreases in infant mortality for children of college-educated and married mothers, who were most able to take advantage of unpaid leave. My results are robust to the inclusion of numerous controls for maternal, child, and county characteristics, state, year, and month fixed effects, and state-year interactions, as well as across several different specifications.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.01.005.abstractZh: 本文评估了1993年《家庭与医疗休假法》中关于无薪产假规定对美国儿童出生和婴儿健康结果的影响。我的研究采用了对各州在《家庭与医疗休假法》实施前的产假政策差异，以及哪些企业受该法律保护的差异进行分析。通过利用生命统计数据和差异分解的方法，我发现产假政策使得大学生的母亲和已婚母亲的婴儿出生体重略有增加，早产的可能性降低，同时婴儿死亡率也显著下降。这些结果在纳入了多种关于母亲、儿童及所在县的特征控制变量、州、年份和月份固定效应，以及州-年份交互作用后依然保持稳定。

abstract.text: This paper contributes to the growing literature on the relationship between business cycles and mental health. It is one of the first applications in the economics literature to incorporate data on web searches from Google Insights for Search, and these unique data allow the opportunity to estimate the association between weekly unemployment insurance (UI) claims, in addition to monthly unemployment rates, and search indexes for "depression" and "anxiety". Results from state fixed effects models yield (1) a positive relationship between the unemployment rate and the depression search index and (2) a negative relationship between initial UI claims on the one hand and the depression and anxiety search indexes on the other. A lag analysis also shows that an extended period of higher levels of continued UI claims is associated with a higher depression search index.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.01.006.abstractZh: 本文为关于商业周期与心理健康之间关系的研究文献做出了贡献。这是经济学文献中首次应用Google Insights for Search的网页搜索数据进行分析，这些独特的数据使得我们能够估算每周失业保险索赔、月度失业率以及“抑郁”和“焦虑”相关的搜索指数之间的关联。状态固定效应模型的结果表明：（1）失业率与抑郁相关搜索指数之间存在正相关关系；（2）初始的失业保险索赔与抑郁和焦虑相关搜索指数之间存在负相关关系。滞后分析还显示，持续较高的失业保险索赔水平与较高的抑郁相关搜索指数之间存在关联。

abstract.text: Over the past decade, several states introduced varying degrees of accountability systems for schools, which became federal law with the passage of the No Child Left Behind Act of 2001. The intent of these accountability laws was to improve academic performance and to make school quality more observable. Nonetheless, schools have reacted to these pressures in several different ways, some of which were not intended. We make use of the variation across states and over time in specific provisions of these accountability laws and find that accountability pressures effect medical diagnoses and subsequent treatment options of school aged children. Specifically, children in states with more stringent accountability laws are more likely to be diagnosed with Attention Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) and consequently prescribed psychostimulant drugs for controlling the symptoms. However, conditional on diagnosis, accountability laws do not further change the probability of receiving medication therapy.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.01.007.abstractZh: 在过去的十年中，多个州引入了不同程度的学校问责制度，这些制度在2001年《不让一个孩子掉队法案》通过后成为联邦法律。这些问责法律的目的是提高学术表现，并使学校质量更加可观察。尽管如此，学校对这些压力的反应方式各不相同，其中一些反应并非初衷。我们通过分析各州以及时间推移中这些问责法律的具体条款变化，发现问责压力对学龄儿童的医疗诊断及后续治疗方案产生了影响。具体而言，在那些问责法律更为严格的州，儿童被诊断出患有注意力缺陷/多动障碍（ADHD）的可能性更高，因此更有可能被开具精神刺激药物来控制症状。然而，在诊断成立的情况下，问责法律并不会进一步改变儿童接受药物治疗的可能性。

abstract.text: This paper investigates how the association between cognitive achievement and self-rated health in middle age differs by race, and attempts to explain these differences. The role of cognition in health determination has received only limited empirical attention, and even less is known about how race may affect this relationship. Using data from the NLSY, I find that while Whites with higher cognitive achievement scores tend to report substantially better general health, this relationship is far weaker or wholly absent among Blacks. Further tests suggest that about 35% of this racial difference can be explained by behavioral decisions during adulthood, and that another portion of the disparity may trace back to prenatal and early childhood experiences. The paper closes by noting that its results are broadly consistent with explanations of the racial health gap that emphasize entrenched forms of racial discrimination.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.01.008.abstractZh: 本文探讨了中年时期认知成就与自我健康评估之间的关联如何因种族而异，并试图解释这些差异。认知在健康决定中的作用仅得到了有限的实证关注，而关于种族如何影响这种关系则知之甚少。通过NLSY的数据分析，我发现，虽然认知成就较高的白人往往报告称自己的整体健康状况明显更好，但这一关系在黑人中则明显较弱或完全不存在。进一步的测试表明，约35%的种族差异可以通过成年时期的行为决策来解释，而另一部分差异则可能源于产前和早期儿童时期的经历。本文最后指出，其研究结果与那些强调根深蒂固的种族歧视对种族健康差距影响的解释大致一致。

abstract.text: The measles, mumps and rubella (MMR) controversy provides an interesting case where, for a short period of time, research publicized in the media, suggested a potential risk of serious side-effects associated with the vaccine, where there was also a sharp behavioral response from the public, and where the initial information was subsequently overturned. We consider the controversy from the perspective of health inequalities and the assimilation of information, focusing on whether and how vaccine uptake behavior in the wake of the controversy differed among groups of parents by education and income. Using panel data on the variation in the uptake of the MMR, and other childhood immunizations, across local Health Authority areas we find that the uptake rate of the MMR declined faster in areas where a larger fraction of parents had stayed in education past the age of 18 than in areas with less educated parents. We also find that the same areas reduced their relative uptake of other uncontroversial childhood immunizations, suggesting a "spillover" effect. Using a supplementary data source we find evidence of a corresponding positive income effect, indicating that wealthier parents avoided the MMR dilemma by purchasing single vaccines.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.01.009.abstractZh: 麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹疫苗争议提供了一个有趣的案例。在较短的时间内，媒体报道了有关该疫苗可能带来严重副作用的担忧，公众也出现了强烈的行为反应，而最初的信息随后被推翻。我们从健康不平等和信息吸收的角度来审视这一争议，重点关注在争议之后，不同教育背景和收入水平的父母群体在疫苗接种行为上是否存在差异，以及这种差异是如何形成的。通过面板数据分析各地卫生当局辖区中麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹疫苗以及其他儿童免疫疫苗接种率的变动情况，我们发现，在那些父母中受过较高教育程度的比例较高的地区，麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹疫苗的接种率下降得更快。我们还发现，同样的地区对其他无争议的儿童免疫疫苗的接种率也有所下降，这表明存在“溢出效应”。通过补充数据来源，我们发现相应的正面收入效应存在，表明较富裕的父母通过购买单一疫苗避免了麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹疫苗带来的选择难题。

abstract.text: We compare employment and usual hours of work for prime-age cancer survivors from the Penn State Cancer Survivor Survey to a comparison group drawn from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics using cross-sectional and difference-in-differences regression and matching estimators. Because earlier research has emphasized workers diagnosed at older ages, we focus on employment effects for younger workers. We find that as long as two to six years after diagnosis, cancer survivors have lower employment rates and work fewer hours than other similarly aged adults.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.02.001.abstractZh: 我们通过横截面分析和差异-差异回归分析，以及匹配估计方法，将宾夕法尼亚州立大学癌症幸存者调查中的壮年癌症幸存者的就业情况及其正常工作时间，与来自收入动态面板研究组的对照组进行了比较。由于早期的研究主要关注在较年长年龄被诊断出的工人，我们重点关注年轻工人的就业状况。研究发现，在诊断后两到六年内，癌症幸存者的就业率较低，工作小时数也少于其他同龄成年人。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of the introduction of the Medicaid program on labor supply decisions among single women in the late 1960s and early 1970s. I use a differences-in-differences-in-differences methodology to estimate the effect of Medicaid on eligible women's labor force participation, using variation in the timing of Medicaid implementation across states and in eligibility across demographic groups. Using March supplements to the CPS from 1963 to 1975, I find no evidence that women who were eligible for Medicaid decreased their labor supply relative to ineligible women, in contrast to clear theoretical predictions of a negative supply response. Positive point estimates suggest that health benefits from health insurance coverage may have contributed to relative increases in labor supply. These results add to an emerging consensus that public health insurance programs for low-income parents and children may be able to improve access to care without substantial indirect costs from labor supply distortions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.02.002.abstractZh: 本文探讨了20世纪60年代末至70年代初，医疗补助计划的引入对单身女性劳动力供给决策的影响。我采用差异中的差异方法，通过考虑各州医疗补助实施时间的差异以及不同人口群体资格条件的差异，来估算医疗补助对符合条件的女性劳动力参与率的影响。利用1963年至1975年的CPS三月补充数据，我发现没有证据表明符合条件的女性相对于不符合条件的女性减少了劳动力供给，这与理论上的负面供给反应预测相反。实证结果表明，健康保险带来的健康福利可能有助于劳动力供给的相对增加。这些结果进一步证实了这样一种共识：针对低收入父母和儿童的公共健康保险计划可以在不造成劳动力供给扭曲的显著间接成本的情况下，改善医疗服务的获取。

abstract.text: This paper provides field evidence on the effects of diet on educational outcomes, exploiting a campaign lead in the UK in 2004, which introduced drastic changes in the meals offered in the schools of one borough - Greenwich - shifting from low-budget processed meals towards healthier options. We evaluate the effect of the campaign on educational outcomes in primary schools using a difference in differences approach; comparing educational outcomes in primary schools (Key Stage 2 outcomes more specifically) before and after the reform, using the neighbouring Local Education Authorities as a control group. We find evidence that educational outcomes did improve significantly in English and Science. We also find that authorized absences - which are most likely linked to illness and health - fell by 14%.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.02.003.abstractZh: 本文通过2004年英国的一项运动作为案例，提供了关于饮食对教育成果影响的实地证据。该运动导致格林尼治市部分学校的餐食发生了重大变化，从低成本的加工食品转向更健康的饮食选择。我们采用差异分析的方法，评估该运动对小学教育成果的影响，具体比较了改革前后小学（尤其是关键阶段2）的教育成果，并将邻近的当地教育当局作为对照组。研究发现，英语和科学的教育成果显著改善。此外，因疾病和健康原因而请假的情况减少了14%。

abstract.text: This paper examines the long run education and labor market effects from early-life exposure to the Greek 1941-1942 famine. Given the short duration of the famine, we can separately identify the famine effects for cohorts exposed in utero, during infancy and at 1 year of age. We find that adverse outcomes due to the famine are largest for infants. Further, in our regression analysis we exploit the fact that the famine was more severe in urban than in rural areas. Consistent with our prediction, we find that urban-born cohorts show larger negative impacts on educational outcomes than rural-born cohorts.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.03.001.abstractZh: 本文探讨了从幼年时期开始接触1941-1942年希腊饥荒对长期教育及劳动力市场的影响。鉴于饥荒持续时间较短，我们可以分别分析在子宫内、婴儿期以及1岁时接触饥荒的人群所受的影响。研究发现，由于饥荒导致的不良后果在婴儿身上最为显著。此外，在回归分析中，我们注意到饥荒在城市的严重程度高于农村。与我们的预测一致，我们发现城市出生的群体在教育成果上的负面影响比农村出生的群体更为严重。

abstract.text: Existing evidence for the role of cigarette excise taxes and prices as significant determinants of youth smoking initiation is mixed. A few studies have considered the possibility that the impact of cigarette taxes and prices might differ by gender or race/ethnicity. In this paper, we address the role of cigarette taxes and prices on youth smoking initiation using the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1997 cohort and discrete-time survival methods. We present results overall and by gender, race/ethnicity, and gender by race/ethnicity. We examine initiation over the age range during which youth are most at risk of initiation and over a period in which substantial changes have occurred in tax and price. The result for cigarette excise taxes is small and mixed across alternative specifications, with the effect strongest for black youth. Cigarette prices are more consistently a significant determinant of youth smoking initiation, especially for black youth.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.03.002.abstractZh: 现有证据表明，香烟消费税和价格对青少年吸烟行为的起始起着重要作用，但研究结果并不一致。少数研究探讨了香烟税费和价格的影响可能因性别或种族/族裔而异。本文利用1997年青少年纵向调查的数据，采用离散时间生存分析方法，探讨了香烟税费和价格对青少年吸烟行为起始的影响。我们整体分析了结果，并分别按性别、种族/族裔以及按性别划分的种族/族裔群体进行了分析。我们研究了青少年在面临最大吸烟风险的年龄段，以及税费和价格发生显著变化的时期。结果显示，香烟消费税的影响较小且结果不一，但对黑人青少年的影响最为显著。而香烟价格则更一致地成为青少年吸烟行为起始的重要影响因素，尤其是对黑人青少年而言。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the short-term effects of public smoking bans on individual smoking behavior. In 2007 and 2008, state-level smoking bans were gradually introduced in all of Germany's federal states. We exploit this variation to identify the effect that smoke-free policies had on individuals' smoking propensity and smoking intensity. Using rich longitudinal data from the German Socio-Economic Panel Study, our difference-in-differences estimates show that the introduction of smoke-free legislation in Germany did not change average smoking behavior within the population. However, our estimates point to important heterogeneous effects. Individuals who go out more often to bars and restaurants did adjust their smoking behavior. Following the ban, they became less likely to smoke and also smoked less.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.03.003.abstractZh: 本文研究了公共禁烟令对个体吸烟行为的短期影响。2007年和2008年，德国所有联邦州逐步实施了省级禁烟令。我们利用这一差异来识别无烟政策对个体吸烟倾向和吸烟强度的影响。通过德国社会经济面板研究提供的丰富纵向数据，我们的差异估计显示，德国无烟立法的实施并未改变人群的平均吸烟行为。然而，我们的估计结果表明存在重要的异质性效应。那些更频繁出入酒吧和餐馆的个体确实调整了他们的吸烟行为。在禁烟令实施后，他们吸烟的可能性降低，吸烟量也减少了。

abstract.text: The United States aspires to use information from comparative effectiveness research (CER) to reduce waste and contain costs without instituting a formal rationing mechanism or compromising patient or physician autonomy with regard to treatment choices. With such ambitious goals, traditional combinations of research designs and analytical methods used in CER may lead to disappointing results. In this paper, I study how alternate regimes of comparative effectiveness information help shape the marginal benefits (demand) curve in the population and how such perceived demand curves impact decision-making at the individual patient level and welfare at the societal level. I highlight the need to individualize comparative effectiveness research in order to generate the true (normative) demand curve for treatments. I discuss methodological principles that guide research designs for such studies. Using an example of the comparative effect of substance abuse treatments on crime, I use novel econometric methods to salvage individualized information from an existing dataset.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.03.004.abstractZh: 美国希望利用比较有效性研究的信息来减少浪费和降低成本，同时不引入正式的配给机制，也不影响患者或医生在治疗选择上的自主权。然而，为了实现这些雄心勃勃的目标，传统的研究设计和分析方法组合可能会导致令人失望的结果。在本文中，我研究了不同的比较有效性信息体系如何影响人群中边际效益（需求）曲线的形成，以及这些感知到的需求曲线如何影响个体患者层面的决策以及社会层面的福利。我强调需要个性化地进行比较有效性研究，以生成真正的治疗需求曲线。我讨论了指导此类研究设计的方法论原则。以物质滥用治疗对犯罪影响的比较效果为例，我采用新的计量经济学方法，从现有数据集中提取个性化的信息。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the impact of income on the long-term care utilization of elderly Americans using a natural experiment that led otherwise similar retirees to receive significantly different Social Security payments based on their year of birth. Using data from the 1993 and 1995 waves of the AHEAD, we estimate instrumental variables models and find that a positive permanent income shock lowers nursing home use but increases the utilization of paid home care services. We find some suggestive evidence that the effects are due to substitution of home care for nursing home utilization. The magnitude of these estimates suggests that moderate reductions in post-retirement income would significantly alter long-term utilization patterns among elderly individuals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.04.001.abstractZh: 本文通过一项自然实验来估计收入对美国老年人长期护理利用的影响。该实验导致其他类似的退休人员根据出生年份获得显著不同的社会保障支付。利用1993年和1995年AHEAD数据，我们建立了工具变量模型，并发现正向的永久性收入冲击会降低养老院的使用率，但会增加付费家庭护理服务的利用。我们发现一些有说服力的证据表明，这些效应是由于家庭护理替代了养老院利用所致。这些估计结果的幅度表明，退休后收入的适度减少将显著改变老年人的长期利用模式。

abstract.text: The utilization of health care services has undergone several important shifts in recent years that have implications for the cost of medical care. We empirically document the presence of these shifts for a broad list of medical conditions and assess the implications for price indexes. Following the earlier literature, we compare the growth of two price measures: one that tracks expenditures for the services actually provided to treat conditions and another that holds the mix of those services fixed over time. Using retrospective claims data for a sample of commercially insured patients, we find that, on average, expenditures to treat diseases rose 11% from 2003Q1 to 2005Q4 and would have risen even faster, 18%, had the mix of services remained fixed at the 2003Q1 levels. This suggests that fixed-basket price indexes, as are used in the official statistics, could overstate true price growth significantly.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.04.002.abstractZh: 近年来，医疗保健服务的利用方式发生了若干重要变化，这些变化对医疗成本产生了影响。我们通过实证分析，记录了这些变化在多种疾病状况中的表现，并评估了其对价格指数的影响。根据现有文献，我们比较了两种价格指标的增长情况：一种追踪用于治疗疾病所实际提供的服务的支出，另一种则保持这些服务组合在一段时间内的固定不变。通过对商业保险患者的理赔数据进行分析，我们发现，从2003年第一季度到2005年第四季度，用于治疗疾病的支出平均增加了11%。如果服务组合在2003年第一季度的水平保持不变，支出增长幅度将会更快，达到18%。这表明，像官方统计数据中使用的固定篮子价格指数可能会显著高估实际价格的增长情况。

abstract.text: Many governments have health programs focused on improving health among the poor and these have an impact on out-of-pocket health payments made by individuals. Therefore, one of the objectives of these programs is to reach the poorest and reduce their out-of-pocket expenditure. In this paper we propose the distributional poverty impact approach to measure the poverty impact of out-of-pocket health payments of different health financing policies. This approach is comparable to the impoverishment methodology proposed by Wagstaff and van Doorslaer (2003) that compares poverty indices before and after out-of-pocket health payments. In order to escape the specification of a particular poverty index, we use the marginal dominance approach that uses non-intersecting curves and can rank poverty reducing health financing policies. We present an empirical application of the out-of-pocket health payments for an innovative social financing policy implemented in Mexico named Seguro Popular. The paper finds evidence that Seguro Popular program has a better distributional poverty impact when families face illness when compared to other poverty reducing policies. The empirical dominance approach uses data from Mexico in 2006 and considers international poverty standards of $2 per person per day.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.04.003.abstractZh: 许多政府都设有旨在改善贫困人口健康的健康计划，这些计划会对个人承担的医疗费用产生影响。因此，这些计划的一个目标是覆盖最贫困的人群，减少他们的个人支出负担。在本文中，我们提出了一种分布式贫困影响评估方法，用于衡量不同健康融资政策下个人医疗费用对贫困的影响。这种方法与Wagstaff和van Doorslaer（2003年）提出的贫困程度评估方法类似，后者通过比较个人医疗费用实施前后的贫困指数来评估贫困状况。为了避免指定特定的贫困指数，我们采用了边际优势法，该方法利用非相交曲线对减少贫困的健康融资政策进行排名。我们以墨西哥实施的创新社会融资政策“Seguro Popular”为例，对其进行了实证分析。研究结果表明，与其他减少贫困的政策相比，“Seguro Popular”政策在家庭面临疾病时具有更好的分布式贫困影响。实证分析采用了2006年墨西哥的数据，并参考了每人每天2美元的国际贫困标准。

abstract.text: The tools to be used and other choices to be made when measuring socioeconomic inequalities with rank-dependent inequality indices have recently been debated in this journal. This paper adds to this debate by stressing the importance of the measurement scale, by providing formal proofs of several issues in the debate, and by lifting the curtain on the confusing debate between adherents of absolute versus relative health differences. We end this paper with a 'matrix' that provides guidelines on the usefulness of several rank-dependent inequality indices under varying circumstances.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.04.004.abstractZh: 关于使用何种工具以及在测量社会经济不平等时选择何种排名依赖型不平等指数，本期刊最近进行了广泛讨论。本文通过强调测量尺度的重要性，对讨论中的几个问题提供了正式证明，并揭示了绝对健康差异与相对健康差异支持者之间令人困惑的争论。本文最后提出了一个“矩阵”，为在不同情况下使用几种排名依赖型不平等指数的有效性提供了指导方针。

abstract.text: Drawing on findings from the biomedical literature, this paper introduces the idea that specific exogenously inherited differences in the genetic code between full biological siblings can be used to test within-family estimators and potentially improve our understanding of economic relationships. These points are illustrated with an application to identify the causal impact of several poor health conditions on academic outcomes. We present evidence that family fixed effects estimators by themselves cannot fully account for the endogeneity of poor health when estimating education production functions. Further, our analysis elucidates the situations under which genetic markers can serve as instrumental variables for specific health conditions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.04.005.abstractZh: 本文基于生物医学领域的研究成果，提出了一种观点：完全生物学意义上的兄弟姐妹之间在遗传代码上的特定外源性差异可以用来检验家庭内部估计方法，并可能有助于我们更好地理解经济关系。文中以识别多种不良健康状况对学术成果影响的案例来说明这一观点。我们的研究表明，仅使用家庭固定效应估计方法无法完全解释在估计教育产出函数时不良健康状况的内生性。此外，我们的分析还揭示了在何种情况下，遗传标记可以作为特定健康状况的工具变量。

abstract.text: Increasing demand for long-term care poses at least five challenges to the policy-maker: (i) How should care be supplied, within a nursing home or within the family? (ii) What level of care should be provided in the different arrangements? (iii) How do the answers relate to the severity of dependence? (iv) How can financial strain be mitigated for families with severely dependent members? (v) What is the role of information constraints for the nature and scope of optimal long-term care policy? We consider a theoretical model of long-term care provision under adverse selection to address these challenges. Our main - and remarkably robust - result is that nursing home care facilitates self selection and mitigates and possibly eliminates distortions in caring levels and transfers. Informational asymmetries may thus lead to care being provided too often within institutions rather than within a family context.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.04.006.abstractZh: 对长期护理需求的增加给政策制定者带来了至少五个挑战：(i) 护理应该由养老院提供，还是由家庭提供？(ii) 在不同安排中应该提供何种程度的护理？(iii) 这些解决方案与依赖程度的严重性有何关系？(iv) 如何减轻有严重依赖家庭成员的家庭的经济压力？(v) 信息限制在最优长期护理政策的性质和范围中扮演什么角色？我们考虑了一个在逆向选择情况下提供长期护理的理论模型，以应对这些挑战。我们的主要结论非常稳健：养老院护理促进了自我选择，并可能减轻甚至消除护理水平和转移过程中的扭曲。因此，信息不对称可能导致护理更多地在机构内提供，而非家庭环境中。

abstract.text: Understanding how physicians respond to incentives from payment schemes is a central concern in health economics research. We introduce a controlled laboratory experiment to analyse the influence of incentives from fee-for-service and capitation payments on physicians' supply of medical services. In our experiment, physicians choose quantities of medical services for patients with different states of health. We find that physicians provide significantly more services under fee-for-service than under capitation. Patients are overserved under fee-for-service and underserved under capitation. However, payment incentives are not the only motivation for physicians' quantity choices, as patients' health benefits are of considerable importance as well. We find that patients in need of a high (low) level of medical services receive larger health benefits under fee-for-service (capitation).

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.05.001.abstractZh: 了解医生对支付方案激励的反应是健康经济学研究中的一个核心问题。我们引入了一个受控实验室实验，来分析按服务收费和按项目付费的激励对医生医疗服务供给的影响。在我们的实验中，医生为不同健康状况的患者选择医疗服务的数量。我们发现，在按服务收费的情况下，医生提供的医疗服务明显多于按项目付费的情况。在按服务收费的情况下，患者得到的医疗服务过多，而在按项目付费的情况下，患者得到的医疗服务不足。然而，支付激励并不是医生选择医疗服务数量的唯一动机，患者的健康收益同样非常重要。我们发现，在按服务收费（按项目付费）的情况下，需要较高（较低）水平医疗服务的患者能够获得更大的健康收益。

abstract.text: Post-war expansion of education in France transformed the distribution of schooling for the cohorts born between the 1940s and the 1970s. However, throughout this expansion the proportion with the highest levels of qualifications remained stable, providing a natural control group. We evaluate the impact of schooling on smoking, for the beneficiaries of the post-war expansion, by comparing changes in their outcomes across birth cohorts with changes within the control group. We uncover robust evidence that educational expansion contributed to a decline in smoking prevalence of 2.9 points of percentage for men and 3.2 points for women at the turn of the 21st century. Our results also suggest that the persistence of the schooling-smoking gradient is better explained by differences in the education-related opportunity costs of smoking than by differences in information about smoking dangers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.05.002.abstractZh: 战后法国教育的扩展改变了1940年代至1970年代出生的人群的受教育状况。然而，在这一扩展过程中，学历水平最高的群体的比例保持稳定，这构成了一个自然的控制组。我们通过比较不同出生队列的结果与控制组内的变化，来评估教育扩展对吸烟行为的影响。研究发现，教育扩展导致21世纪初男性吸烟率下降了2.9个百分点，女性则下降了3.2个百分点。我们的结果还表明，教育背景与吸烟行为之间的关联之所以持续存在，更多是由于与教育相关的机会成本差异所致，而非关于吸烟危害的信息差异。

abstract.text: The World Health Report 2000 proposed three fundamental goals for health systems encompassing population health, health care finance and health systems responsiveness. The goals incorporate both an efficiency and equity dimension. While inequalities in population health and health care finance have motivated two important strands of research, inequalities in responsiveness have received less attention in health economics. This paper examines inequality and polarisation in responsiveness, bridging this gap in the literature and contributing towards an integrated analysis of health systems performance. It uses data from the World Health Survey to measure and compare inequalities in responsiveness across 25 European countries. In order to respect the inherently ordinal nature of the responsiveness data, median-based measures of inequality and polarisation are employed. The results suggest that, in the face of wide differences in the health systems analysed, there exists large variability in inequality in responsiveness across countries.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.05.003.abstractZh: 《2000年世界卫生报告》提出了三个关于卫生系统的根本目标，涵盖人口健康、医疗保健融资以及卫生系统的响应能力。这些目标同时包含了效率和公平两个维度。虽然人口健康与医疗保健融资方面的不平等引发了两项重要的研究，但卫生经济学领域对响应能力方面的不平等关注较少。本文探讨了响应能力方面的不平等与两极分化现象，填补了相关文献中的空白，并为综合分析卫生系统绩效提供了依据。研究采用了世界卫生调查的数据，对25个欧洲国家的响应能力不平等情况进行了测量和比较。为了尊重响应能力数据的顺序性质，本文采用了基于中位数的不平等与两极分化指标。研究结果表明，尽管所分析的卫生系统存在巨大差异，但各国在响应能力方面的不平等程度仍存在较大差异。

abstract.text: Growth in the number of days between an appointment request and the actual appointment reduces demand. Although such waiting times are relatively low in the US, current policy initiatives could cause them to increase. We estimate multiple-equation models of physician utilization and insurance plan choice for Medicare-eligible veterans. We find that a 10% increase in VA waiting times increases demand for Medigap insurance by 5%, implying that a representative patient would be indifferent between waiting an average of 5 more days for VA appointments and paying $300 more in annual premium.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.05.004.abstractZh: 预约请求与实际预约之间的等待天数增加会降低需求。尽管在美国这种等待时间相对较低，但当前的政策举措可能会导致等待时间延长。我们建立了多个方程模型，用于分析有资格享受Medicare的退伍军人的医生利用情况和保险计划选择。研究发现，VA预约等待时间增加10%，会导致Medigap保险需求增加5%。这意味着，一个典型的患者会在等待平均增加5天的预约时间和支付额外300美元的年度保费之间做出选择，而这两种情况对他们来说并无明显差异。

abstract.text: In 2008 the income of female GPs was 70%, and their wages (income per hour) were 89%, of those of male GPs. We estimate Oaxaca decompositions using OLS models of wages and 2SLS models of income and propose a set of new direct tests for within workplace gender discrimination. The direct tests are based on a comparison of the differences in income of female and male GPs in practices with varying proportions of female GPs and with female or male senior partners. These tests provide only weak evidence for discrimination. We also propose a set of indirect tests for discrimination, including a comparison of a GP's actual income with the income they report as an acceptable reward for their job. The indirect tests provide no evidence for gender discrimination within practices.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.05.005.abstractZh: 2008年，女性全科医生的收入占全科医生总收入的70%，她们的时薪（收入）为男性全科医生的89%。我们使用OLS模型估算了瓦哈卡州全科医生的收入结构，并采用2SLS模型对收入进行了分析，同时提出了一组新的直接测试方法来检测工作场所内的性别歧视。这些直接测试基于比较不同比例女性全科医生所在诊所中，女性与男性全科医生的收入差异，以及女性或男性高级合作伙伴的存在对收入的影响。这些测试仅提供了有限的证据来表明存在歧视现象。我们还提出了一组间接测试方法来检测歧视，包括比较全科医生实际收入与他们报告认为可接受的工作报酬之间的差异。这些间接测试并未发现工作场所内存在性别歧视的证据。

abstract.text: We examine the effects of diverse dimensions of hospital quality - including consumers' perceptions of unobserved attributes - on future hospital choice. We utilize consumers' stated preference weights to obtain hospital-specific estimates of perceptions about unmeasured attributes such as reputation. We report three findings. First, consumers' perceptions of reputation and medical services contribute substantially to utility for a hospital choice. Second, consumers tend to select hospitals with high clinical quality scores even before the scores are publicized. However, the effect of clinical quality on hospital choice is relatively small. Third, satisfaction with a prior hospital admission has a large impact on future hospital choice. Our findings suggest that including measures of consumers' experience in report cards may increase their responsiveness to publicized information, but other strategies are needed to overcome the large effects of consumers' beliefs about other quality attributes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.05.006.abstractZh: 我们研究了医院质量的多个维度——包括消费者对未观测属性的感知——对未来医院选择的影响。我们利用消费者的表述偏好权重，来获取关于未测量属性（如声誉）的医院特定估计值。我们得到了三个发现：首先，消费者对医院声誉和医疗服务的感知对医院选择的效用有显著贡献；其次，即使在评分公开之前，消费者也倾向于选择临床质量评分较高的医院。然而，临床质量对医院选择的影响相对较小；第三，之前住院的满意度对未来医院选择有很大影响。我们的研究结果表明，在报告卡中包含消费者体验的衡量指标可能会提高他们对公开信息的响应能力，但还需要其他策略来克服消费者对其他质量属性信念的较大影响。

abstract.text: Scientific research and private-sector technological innovation differ in objectives, constraints, and organizational forms. Scientific research may thus not be driven by the direct practical benefit to others in the way that private-sector innovation is. Alternatively, some - yet largely unexplored - mechanisms drive the direction of scientific research to respond to the expected public benefit. We test these two competing hypotheses of scientific research. This is important because any coherent specification of what constitutes the socially optimal allocation of research requires that scientists take the public practical benefit of their work into account in setting their agenda. We examine whether the composition of medical research responds to changes in disease prevalence, while accounting for the quality of available research opportunities. We match biomedical publications data with disease prevalence data and develop new methods for estimating the quality of research opportunities from textual information and structural productivity parameters.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.05.007.abstractZh: 科学研究与私营部门的技术创新在目标、约束条件和组织形式上有所不同。因此，科学研究可能不会像私营部门创新那样，由对他人的直接实际利益所驱动。或者，有一些尚未被充分探索的机制，促使科学研究朝着预期的公共利益方向进行。我们测试了这两个相互竞争的假设。这一点很重要，因为任何关于研究社会最优分配的合理规定都要求科学家在设定研究议程时考虑其工作的公共实际利益。我们研究医学研究的构成是否会随着疾病发病率的变化而变化，同时考虑到现有研究机会的质量。我们将生物医学出版物数据与疾病发病率数据相结合，并开发了新的方法，从文本信息和结构生产力参数中估算研究机会的质量。

abstract.text: This paper uses the English Longitudinal Survey of Ageing to explore the self-reported effect of cataract operations on eye-sight. A non-parametric analysis shows clearly that most cataract patients report improved eye-sight after surgery and a parametric analysis provides further information: it shows that the beneficial effect is larger the worse was self-reported eye-sight preceding surgery so that those with very good or excellent eye-sight do not derive immediate benefit. Nevertheless, the long-run effect is suggested to be beneficial. Calibrating the results to existing studies of the effect of imperfect eye-sight on quality of life, the impact of cataract operations on Quality Adjusted Life Years is found to be similar to that established in previous studies and well above the costs of cataract operations in most circumstances.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.05.008.abstractZh: 本文利用英国老龄化纵向调查数据，探讨了白内障手术对视力的影响。非参数分析显示，大多数白内障患者报告称手术后的视力有所改善；参数分析则进一步表明，手术带来的益处与患者术前自报的视力状况密切相关，即视力非常好或极佳的患者并未立即感受到明显改善。不过，从长期来看，白内障手术仍被认为具有积极效果。通过将研究结果与现有关于视力不佳对生活质量影响的研究进行对比，发现白内障手术对质量调整生命年的影响与先前研究的结果相似，且在大多数情况下，其益处远高于白内障手术的成本。

abstract.text: We conduct an audit study in which a pair of simulated patients with identical flu-like complaints visits the same physician. Simulated patient A is instructed to ask a question that showcases his/her knowledge of appropriate antibiotic use, whereas patient B is instructed to say nothing beyond describing his/her symptoms. We find that a patient who displays knowledge of appropriate antibiotics use reduces both antibiotic prescription rates and drug expenditures. Such knowledge also increases physicians' information provision about possible side effects, but has a negative impact on the quality of the physician-patient interactions. Our results suggest that antibiotics abuse in China is not driven by patients actively demanding antibiotics, but is largely a supply-side phenomenon.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.05.009.abstractZh: 我们进行了一项审计研究，其中一对症状相似的模拟患者分别就诊于同一位医生。模拟患者A被要求提出一个问题，以展示其对适当抗生素使用的了解，而模拟患者B则被要求仅描述自己的症状，不提出任何问题。我们发现，能够展示出对适当抗生素使用了解的患者，其抗生素处方率和药物支出都会降低。这种知识还能增加医生对可能副作用的信息提供，但会对医患互动的质量产生负面影响。我们的研究结果表明，中国抗生素滥用现象并非由患者主动要求使用抗生素所驱动，而主要是一种供应方面的现象。

abstract.text: This paper uses a regression discontinuity design to estimate the impact of the minimum legal drinking age laws on alcohol consumption, smoking, and marijuana use among young adults. Using data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (1997 Cohort), we find that granting legal access to alcohol at age 21 leads to an increase in several measures of alcohol consumption, including an up to a 13 percentage point increase in the probability of drinking. Furthermore, this effect is robust under several different parametric and non-parametric models. We also find some evidence that the discrete jump in alcohol consumption at age 21 has negative spillover effects on marijuana use but does not affect the smoking habits of young adults. Our results indicate that although the change in alcohol consumption habits of young adults following their 21st birthday is less severe than previously known, policies that are designed to reduce drinking among young adults may have desirable impacts and can create public health benefits.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.05.010.abstractZh: 本文采用回归不连续设计来估计最低法定饮酒年龄法律对年轻人酒精消费、吸烟和大麻使用的影响。利用《全国青年纵向调查》（1997年队列）的数据，我们发现将法定饮酒年龄设定为21岁会导致多种酒精消费指标的增加，包括饮酒概率增加高达13个百分点。此外，这一效应在多种参数和非参数模型下均具有稳健性。我们还发现，21岁时的酒精消费突然增加对大麻使用有负面影响，但并未影响年轻人的吸烟习惯。我们的研究结果表明，尽管年轻人21岁后酒精消费习惯的变化程度低于先前认知的严重程度，但旨在减少年轻人饮酒行为的政策仍可能带来积极的影响，并有助于促进公共健康。

abstract.text: Spousal bereavement at old ages may lead to dramatic changes in health. This paper investigates whether spousal bereavement has a causal effect on health and on mortality of the surviving spouse. We advance on the literature in two main ways. First, we model survivals of both spouses and the dynamic evolution of health jointly, allowing for potential endogeneity of timing of bereavement and health in explaining mortality of the surviving spouse. Second, we use a flexible non-parametric data dimensionality reduction method to thoroughly characterize health (using 22 health indicators) by a limited number of latent health indicators. This allows us to investigate the causal effect of spousal bereavement on mortality and on all aspects of health simultaneously. Our analyses are based on an ongoing longitudinal survey that follows a random sample of older individuals from 1992. We find strong instantaneous effects of bereavement on mortality and on certain aspects of health. Individuals lose on average 12% of residual life expectancy after conjugal bereavement. Conjugal bereavement affects the share of healthy years in residual lifetime, primarily because healthy years are replaced by years with chronic diseases. The strong direct effects of bereavement suggest that monitoring and/or interventions just after spousal bereavement are important for the length and quality of life of older bereaved individuals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.05.011.abstractZh: 老年时期的配偶丧亲可能会带来健康的显著变化。本文探讨了配偶丧亲是否会对健康以及幸存配偶的死亡率产生因果影响。我们在两个方面对现有文献进行了补充。首先，我们同时建模了配偶的存活情况以及健康的动态演变，从而考虑了丧亲时间和健康状况之间的潜在内生性，以解释幸存配偶的死亡率。其次，我们采用了一种灵活的非参数数据降维方法，通过有限的潜在健康指标来全面描述健康状况（使用22个健康指标）。这使我们能够同时研究配偶丧亲对死亡率及健康各方面的因果影响。我们的分析基于一项持续的纵向调查，该调查自1992年起对随机选取的老年个体进行了跟踪。我们发现丧亲对死亡率及某些健康方面的影响非常显著。配偶丧亲后，个体平均会失去12%的剩余预期寿命。配偶丧亲会影响剩余寿命中健康年的比例，主要是因为健康年会被慢性疾病所取代。丧亲的强烈直接效应表明，在配偶丧亲后立即进行监测和/或干预对于老年丧亲者的生活质量和寿命长度至关重要。

abstract.text: Comparative effectiveness research (CER) is thought to identify what works and does not work in health care. We interpret CER as infusing evidence on product quality into markets, shifting the relative demand for products in CER studies. We analyze how shifts in demand affect health and health care spending and demonstrate that CER may raise or lower overall health when treatments have heterogeneous effects, but payers respond with product-specific coverage policies. Among patients with schizophrenia, we calibrate that subsidy policies based on the clinical trial CATIE may have reduced overall health by inducing some patients to switch away from schizophrenia treatments that were effective for them towards winners of the CER.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.05.012.abstractZh: 比较效果研究（CER）被认为能够识别在医疗保健领域哪些方法有效、哪些无效。我们将CER解释为将关于产品质量的证据引入市场，从而改变CER研究中产品的相对需求。我们分析了需求变化对健康和医疗保健支出的影响，并证明当治疗方法的效果存在差异时，CER可能会提高或降低整体健康水平，但支付方会通过针对特定产品的保险政策来应对。在精神分裂症患者中，我们校准了基于临床试验CATIE的补贴政策，发现这些政策可能会通过促使一些患者从对他们有效的精神分裂症治疗方法转向CER推荐的治疗方法，从而降低整体健康水平。

abstract.text: Workplace accidents are an important economic phenomenon. Yet, the pro-cyclical fluctuations in workplace accidents are not well understood. They could be related to fluctuations in effort and working hours, but workplace accidents may also be affected by reporting behavior. Our paper uses unique data on workplace accidents from an Austrian matched worker-firm dataset to study in detail how economic incentives affect workplace accidents. We find that workers who reported an accident in a particular period of time are more likely to be fired later on. And, we find support for the idea that recessions influence the reporting of moderate workplace accidents: if workers think the probability of dismissals at the firm level is high, they are less likely to report a moderate workplace accident.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.05.013.abstractZh: 工作场所事故是一种重要的经济现象。然而，工作场所事故的周期性波动尚未得到充分理解。这些波动可能与劳动力和工作时间的变化有关，但工作场所事故的报告行为也可能对其产生影响。我们的论文利用奥地利匹配工人-企业数据集中的独特数据，详细研究了经济激励因素如何影响工作场所事故。我们发现，在特定时间段内报告了事故的员工，之后被解雇的可能性更高。此外，我们发现经济衰退会影响对中等程度工作场所事故的报告：如果员工认为公司层面的解雇概率较高，他们就不太会报告中等程度的事故。

abstract.text: In 1998, Medicare adopted a per diem Prospective Payment System (PPS) for skilled nursing facility care, which was intended to deter the use of high-cost rehabilitative services. The average per diem decreased under the PPS, but because per diems increased for greater therapy minutes, the ability of the PPS to deter the use of high-intensity services was questionable. In this study, we assess how the PPS affected the volume and intensity of Medicare services. By volume we mean the product of the number of Medicare residents in a facility and the average length-of-stay, by intensity we mean the time per week devoted to rehabilitation therapy. Our results indicate that the number of Medicare residents decreased under PPS, but rehabilitative services and therapy minutes increased while length-of-stay remained relatively constant. Not surprisingly, when subsequent Medicare policy changes increased payment rates, Medicare volume far surpassed the levels seen in the pre-PPS period.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.05.014.abstractZh: 1998年，医疗保险制度采用了按日计费的预期支付系统（PPS）来支付专业护理机构的服务费用，这一制度的目的是抑制高成本康复服务的使用。在PPS实施下，按日费用的平均水平有所下降，但由于治疗分钟数的增加导致按日费用上升，因此PPS在抑制高强度服务方面的效果值得质疑。本研究评估了PPS对医疗保险服务数量和强度的影响。从数量上看，指的是机构内医疗保险患者的数量与平均停留时间相乘的结果；从强度上看，指的是每周用于康复治疗的时长。研究结果表明，在PPS实施期间，医疗保险患者的数量有所下降，而康复服务和治疗分钟数却有所增加，而停留时间则保持相对不变。不出所料，当后续医疗保险政策调整提高了支付率后，医疗保险服务的数量远远超过了PPS实施前的水平。

abstract.text: I exploit exogenous variation in the likelihood to obtain any sort of educational qualification between January- and February-born individuals for 13 academic cohorts in England. For these cohorts compulsory schooling laws interacted with the timing of the CSE and O-level exams to change the probability of obtaining a qualification by around 2-3 percentage points. I then use data on individuals born in these two months from the British Labour Force Survey and the Health Survey for England to investigate the effects of education on health using being February-born as an instrument for education. The results indicate neither an effect of education on various health related measures nor an effect on health related behaviour, e.g., smoking, drinking or eating various types of food.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.05.015.abstractZh: 我研究了英格兰13个学术队列中，1月至2月出生的个体在获得各类教育资格方面的可能性差异。这些队列中的义务教育法规与CSE和O级考试的时间安排相互作用，使得获得资格的概率变化了约2-3个百分点。随后，我利用英国劳动力调查和英格兰健康调查中关于这两个月份出生的个体的数据，研究教育对健康的影响，以出生月份作为教育的一个指标。研究结果表明，教育对各项与健康相关的指标没有影响，也对与健康相关的行为没有影响，例如吸烟、饮酒或食用不同类型的食物。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes and compares the incentive properties of some common payment mechanisms for GPs, namely fee for service (FFS), capitation and fundholding. It focuses on gatekeeping GPs and it specifically recognizes GPs heterogeneity in both ability and altruism. It also allows inappropriate care by GPs to lead to more serious illnesses. The results are as follows. Capitation is the payment mechanism that induces the most referrals to expensive specialty care. Fundholding may induce almost as much referrals as capitation when the expected costs of GPs care are high relative to those of specialty care. Although driven by financial incentives of different nature, the strategic behaviors associated with fundholding and FFS are very much alike. Finally, whether a regulator should use one or another payment mechanism for GPs will depend on (i) his priorities (either cost-containment or quality enhancement) which, in turn, depend on the expected cost difference between GPs care and specialty care, and (ii) the distribution of profiles (diagnostic ability and altruism levels) among GPs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.05.016.abstractZh: 本文分析和比较了几种常见的全科医生支付机制在激励方面的特性，包括按服务收费、按人头付费和基金持有制。文章重点关注了全科医生的行为特点，特别考虑到全科医生在能力和利他主义方面的差异。同时指出，全科医生的不当行为可能导致更严重的疾病。研究结果表明，按人头付费机制最能够促使医生转诊到昂贵的专科护理服务。当全科医生护理的预期成本高于专科护理时，基金持有制可能引发的转诊数量几乎与按人头付费机制相当。尽管两种机制背后的激励因素不同，但基金持有制和按服务收费机制在战略行为上非常相似。最后，监管机构是否应采用某种支付机制，取决于其优先事项（无论是成本控制还是质量提升），而这又取决于全科医生护理与专科护理之间的预期成本差异，以及全科医生在诊断能力和利他主义方面的分布情况。

abstract.text: School buses contribute disproportionately to ambient air quality, pollute near schools and residential areas, and their emissions collect within passenger cabins. This paper examines the impact of school bus emissions reductions programs on health outcomes. A key contribution relative to the broader literature is that we examine localized pollution reduction programs at a fine level of aggregation. We find that school bus retrofits induced reductions in bronchitis, asthma, and pneumonia incidence for at-risk populations. Back of the envelope calculations suggest conservative benefit-cost ratios between 7:1 and 16:1.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.05.017.abstractZh: 校车对 ambient air quality 的影响尤为显著，它们会污染学校及居民区附近的区域，其排放物也会滞留在乘客车厢内。本文探讨了校车排放减少计划对健康结果的影响。与更广泛的文献相比，我们的一个关键贡献在于，我们采用了细粒度聚合的方法来研究局部污染减少计划的效果。我们发现，校车的改造措施有助于降低高危人群中的支气管炎、哮喘和肺炎的发病率。初步的计算结果显示，其效益成本比在7:1到16:1之间。

abstract.text: New regulation of health insurance markets creates multiple levels of health plans, with designations like "Gold" and "Silver." The underlying rationale for the heavy-metal approach to insurance regulation is that heterogeneity in demand for health care is not only due to health status (sick demand more than the healthy) but also to other, "taste" related factors (rich demand more than the poor). This paper models managed competition with demand heterogeneity to consider plan payment and enrollee premium policies in relation to efficiency (net consumer benefit) and fairness (the European concept of "solidarity"). Specifically, this paper studies how to implement a "Silver" and "Gold" health plan efficiently and fairly in a managed competition context. We show that there are sharp tradeoffs between efficiency and fairness.
