10.1093/qje/qjq010.abstractZh: 在肯尼亚进行了一项随机评估，我们测量了春季保护措施对健康的积极影响。这种保护措施能够改善水源质量。我们还估算了家庭对春季保护措施的估值，并模拟了替代现有共同财产权利制度的福利影响，因为现有制度限制了私人投资的积极性。春季基础设施投资可使粪便污染减少66%，但由于重新污染，家庭用水质量的改善幅度较小。儿童腹泻减少了四分之一。基于旅行成本的显示偏好估计显示，家庭对春季保护措施的估值远低于陈述偏好估值和卫生规划者的估值，这与需求对收入高度弹性的模型一致。我们估计，私人财产规范虽然能带来少量额外投资，但由于价格高于边际成本，会带来较大的静态成本；在较高收入水平或水资源短缺的情况下，私人财产制度会发挥更好的作用；其他制度则可能带来帕累托改进。

abstract.text: We study the link between family violence and the emotional cues associated with wins and losses by professional football teams. We hypothesize that the risk of violence is affected by the “gain-loss” utility of game outcomes around a rationally expected reference point. Our empirical analysis uses police reports of violent incidents on Sundays during the professional football season. Controlling for the pregame point spread and the size of the local viewing audience, we find that upset losses (defeats when the home team was predicted to win by four or more points) lead to a 10% increase in the rate of at-home violence by men against their wives and girlfriends. In contrast, losses when the game was expected to be close have small and insignificant effects. Upset wins (victories when the home team was predicted to lose) also have little impact on violence, consistent with asymmetry in the gain-loss utility function. The rise in violence after an upset loss is concentrated in a narrow time window near the end of the game and is larger for more important games. We find no evidence for reference point updating based on the halftime score.

10.1093/qje/qjr001.abstractZh: 我们研究了家庭暴力与职业橄榄球队胜负相关情绪线索之间的联系。我们假设暴力的风险受到比赛结果在理性预期参考点附近的“得失效用”的影响。我们的实证分析使用了职业橄榄球赛季周日警方报告的暴力事件数据。在控制赛前比分差距和当地观众数量的情况下，我们发现令人失望的失利（当主队被预测将领先四分或更多时取得的失败）会导致男性对其妻子和女友实施暴力的概率增加10%。相反，当比赛被预期为平局时，这种影响很小且不显著。令人惊喜的胜利（当主队被预测将失败时的胜利）对暴力行为的影响也很小，这与得失效用函数的不对称性一致。在令人失望的失利之后，暴力行为的增加集中在比赛结束前的短暂时间窗口内，并且对于更重要的比赛来说影响更大。我们没有发现基于半场比分进行参考点更新的证据。

abstract.text: We develop a theory of moral behavior, individual and collective, based on a general model of identity in which people care about “who they are” and infer their own values from past choices. The model sheds light on many empirical puzzles inconsistent with earlier approaches. Identity investments respond nonmonotonically to acts or threats, and taboos on mere thoughts arise to protect beliefs about the “priceless” value of certain social assets. High endowments trigger escalating commitment and a treadmill effect, while competing identities can cause dysfunctional capital destruction. Social interactions induce both social and antisocial norms of contribution, sustained by respectively shunning free riders or do-gooders.

10.1093/qje/qjr002.abstractZh: 我们基于一个关于身份的一般模型，发展了一种关于个体和集体道德行为的理论。在这个模型中，人们关心“自己是谁”，并从过去的选择中推断出自己的价值观。该模型揭示了许多与早期方法不一致的经验性难题。身份投资对行为或威胁的反应是非单调的，而对某些社会资产的“无价”价值信念的保护则导致了禁忌的产生。高额的初始禀赋会引发不断升级的承诺，并出现“跑步机效应”；而不同的身份可能导致功能失调的资本破坏。社会互动既催生了社会性的贡献规范，也催生了反社会性的贡献规范，这些规范分别通过排斥搭便车者或善行者来得以维持。

abstract.text: This paper uses a regression discontinuity design to estimate the effect of home computers on child and adolescent outcomes by exploiting a voucher program in Romania. Our main results indicate that home computers have both positive and negative effects on the development of human capital. Children who won a voucher to purchase a computer had significantly lower school grades but show improved computer skills. There is also some evidence that winning a voucher increased cognitive skills, as measured by Raven's Progressive Matrices. We do not find much evidence for an effect on non-cognitive outcomes. Parental rules regarding homework and computer use attenuate the effects of computer ownership, suggesting that parental monitoring and supervision may be important mediating factors.

10.1093/qje/qjr008.abstractZh: 本文采用回归断点设计，通过利用罗马尼亚的一项代金券计划，来估计家用电脑对儿童和青少年发展的影响。我们的主要结果表明，家用电脑对人类资本的发展既有正面影响，也有负面影响。获得代金券购买电脑的儿童在学业成绩上表现较差，但计算机技能有所提高。此外，有证据表明，获得代金券能够提升认知技能，这一点可以通过拉文渐进式测验来衡量。我们没有发现太多证据表明电脑拥有对非认知成果有显著影响。关于家庭作业和电脑使用方面的规则，能够减弱电脑拥有所带来的影响，这表明父母的监督和指导可能是重要的中介因素。

abstract.text: We exploit regional variation in suitability for cultivating potatoes, together with time variation arising from their introduction to the Old World from the Americas, to estimate the impact of potatoes on Old World population and urbanization. Our results show that the introduction of the potato was responsible for a significant portion of the increase in population and urbanization observed during the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries. According to our most conservative estimates, the introduction of the potato accounts for approximately one-quarter of the growth in Old World population and urbanization between 1700 and 1900. Additional evidence from within-country comparisons of city populations and adult heights also confirms the cross-country findings.

10.1093/qje/qjr009.abstractZh: 我们利用不同地区种植马铃薯的适宜性差异，以及马铃薯从美洲传入旧世界后随时间发生的变化，来估算马铃薯对旧世界人口和城市化进程的影响。研究结果表明，马铃薯的引入在18和19世纪的人口增长和城市化进程中发挥了重要作用。根据我们最保守的估计，马铃薯的引入约占1700年至1900年间旧世界人口和城市化增长的四分之一。来自国内城市人口和成年人身高对比的额外证据也证实了这些跨国的发现。

abstract.text: Over the past thirty years, U.S. manufacturing plants invested heavily in automation machinery. This paper shows these investments substituted for the least-skilled workers and complemented middle-skilled workers at equipment and fabricated metal plants. Specifically, it exploits the fact that some metropolitan areas experienced faster growth in the relative supply of less-skilled labor in the 1980s and 1990s due to an immigration wave and the tendency of immigrants to regionally cluster. Plants in these areas adopted significantly less machinery per unit output, despite having similar adoption plans initially. The results imply that fixed rental rates for automation machinery reduce the effect that immigration has on less-skilled relative wages.

10.1093/qje/qjr011.abstractZh: 在过去三十年中，美国的制造工厂在自动化设备上投入了大量资金。本文指出，这些投资取代了最不熟练的工人，并提升了中等熟练工人的就业水平，尤其是在金属加工工厂中。具体而言，文章指出，由于移民潮以及移民倾向于在特定地区聚集的现象，一些大都市地区在20世纪80年代和90年代相对缺乏低技能劳动力的供应却实现了更快的增长。尽管这些地区的工厂最初都计划采用类似的自动化设备，但每单位产出的设备数量却明显减少。研究结果表明，自动化设备的固定租赁费用降低了移民对低技能劳动力工资水平的影响。

abstract.text: Is there any need to clean up a banking system by closing some banks and forcing others to sell assets if the risk of a crisis becomes high? Impaired banks that may be forced to sell illiquid assets in the future have private incentives to hold, rather than sell, those assets Anticipating a potential fire sale, liquid buyers expect high returns, reducing their incentive to lend. Privately optimal trading decisions therefore lead to a worse fire sale and a larger drop in lending than is necessary. We discuss alternative ways of cleaning up the system and the associated costs and benefits.

10.1093/qje/qjr012.abstractZh: 如果危机风险升高，是否有必要通过关闭一些银行并迫使其他银行出售资产来清理银行体系？那些可能被迫出售流动性不足资产的受损银行，有私人动机持有这些资产而非出售它们。预期可能出现廉价出售的情况，愿意购买资产的买家期望获得高回报，这会降低他们的贷款意愿。因此，私人最优的交易决策会导致更糟糕的廉价出售，以及比必要更严重的贷款下降。我们讨论了清理体系的替代方法以及相关的成本和收益。

abstract.text: We show that the effects of taxes on labor supply are shaped by interactions between adjustment costs for workers and hours constraints set by firms. We develop a model in which firms post job offers characterized by an hours requirement and workers pay search costs to find jobs. We present evidence supporting three predictions of this model by analyzing bunching at kinks using Danish tax records. First, larger kinks generate larger taxable income elasticities. Second, kinks that apply to a larger group of workers generate larger elasticities. Third, the distribution of job offers is tailored to match workers' aggregate tax preferences in equilibrium. Our results suggest that macro elasticities may be substantially larger than the estimates obtained using standard microeconometric methods.

10.1093/qje/qjr013.abstractZh: 我们表明，税收对劳动力供给的影响受到工人调整成本与企业设定的工时限制之间相互作用的影响。我们建立了一个模型，其中企业发布的职位要求包含工时要求，而工人则需要支付搜索成本来寻找工作。我们通过分析丹麦税收记录中出现的“聚集现象”，为该模型的三个预测提供了支持。首先，较大的工时限制会导致更大的应税收入弹性。其次，适用于更多工人的工时限制会产生更大的弹性。第三，职位提供的分配方式在均衡状态下会考虑到工人的总体税收偏好。我们的结果表明，宏观弹性可能远大于使用标准微观计量方法获得的估计值。

abstract.text: This article examines how a decision maker who is only partially aware of his temptations learns about them over time. In facing temptations, individuals use their experience to forecast future self-control problems and choose the appropriate level of commitment. I demonstrate that rational learning can be perpetually partial and need not result in full sophistication. The main result of this article characterizes necessary and sufficient conditions for learning to converge to full sophistication. I apply this result to a consumption-savings environment in which a decision maker is tempted by present bias and establish a learning-theoretic justification for assuming sophistication in this setting. “An individual who finds himself continuously repudiating his past plans may learn to distrust his future behavior, and may do something about it.” — Strotz (1955)

10.1093/qje/qjr014.abstractZh: 本文探讨了那些仅部分意识到自身诱惑的决策者在时间推移过程中如何逐渐了解这些诱惑。面对诱惑时，个体会利用自己的经验来预测未来的自我控制问题，并选择适当的承诺水平。我证明，理性学习可能始终存在局限性，并不一定能够达到完全成熟的程度。本文的主要结论指出了学习达到完全成熟所需的必要充分条件。我将这一结论应用于消费-储蓄环境，在这种环境中，决策者会受到当前偏好的诱惑，并提出了一种基于学习理论的解释，以说明在这种情境下假设决策者具有成熟度的合理性。“一个不断否定自己过去计划的人，可能会学会不信任自己的未来行为，并对此采取行动。”——Strotz（1955）

abstract.text: We propose a tractable variant of the open economy neoclassical growth model that emphasizes political economy and contracting frictions. The political economy frictions involve a preference for immediate spending, while the contracting friction is a lack of commitment regarding foreign debt and expropriation. We show that the political economy frictions slow an economy's convergence to the steady state due to the endogenous evolution of capital taxation. The model rationalizes why openness has different implications for growth depending on the political environment, why institutions such as the treatment of capital income evolve over time, why governments in countries that grow rapidly accumulate net foreign assets rather than liabilities, and why foreign aid may not affect growth.

10.1093/qje/qjr015.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个可行的开放经济新古典增长模型变体，该模型强调政治经济因素和契约摩擦。政治经济摩擦涉及对即时支出的偏好，而契约摩擦则表现为对外部债务和资产没收的缺乏承诺。我们指出，政治经济摩擦由于资本征税的内生演化，会减缓经济向稳态的收敛过程。该模型解释了为什么开放程度对增长的影响会因政治环境的不同而不同，为什么诸如资本收入处理这样的制度会随时间演变，为什么快速增长国家的政府会积累净外部资产而非负债，以及为什么外援可能不会影响经济增长。

abstract.text: We present a dynamic model of legislative bargaining with an endogenously evolving default policy and a persistent agenda setter. Policy making proceeds until the agenda setter can no longer pass a new policy to replace an approved bill. We prove existence and necessary conditions of pure-strategy stationary equilibria for any finite policy space, any number of players, and any preference profile. In equilibrium, the value of proposal power is limited compared to the case that disallows reconsideration, as voters are induced to protect each other's benefits to maintain their future bargaining positions. The agenda setter, in turn, would prefer to limit his ability to reconsider. The lack of commitment due to the possibility of reconsideration, however, enhances policy efficiency.

10.1093/qje/qjr016.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个动态模型，描述了立法谈判的过程，其中默认政策会内生性地演变，而议程设定者则持续提出政策建议。政策制定过程会持续进行，直到议程设定者无法再提出新的政策来替代已批准的法案。我们证明了对于任何有限的政策空间、任意数量的参与者以及任何偏好配置，纯策略稳定均衡的存在性及其必要条件。在均衡状态下，与不允许重新审议的情况相比，提案权的值受到限制，因为选民会倾向于保护彼此的利益，以维持自己未来的谈判地位。反过来，议程设定者则更倾向于限制自己重新审议的能力。然而，由于存在重新审议的可能性，缺乏承诺性反而提升了政策效率。

abstract.text: We use student assignment lotteries to estimate the effect of charter school attendance on student achievement in Boston. We also evaluate a related alternative, Boston's pilot schools. Pilot schools have some of the independence of charter schools but are in the Boston Public School district and are covered by some collective bargaining provisions. Lottery estimates show large and significant score gains for charter students in middle and high school. In contrast, lottery estimates for pilot school students are mostly small and insignificant, with some significant negative effects. Charter schools with binding assignment lotteries appear to generate larger gains than other charters.

10.1093/qje/qjr017.abstractZh: 我们使用学生分配抽签来估计特许学校入学对学生学业成绩的影响，研究对象为波士顿的学生。我们还评估了相关的替代方案——波士顿的试点学校。试点学校在某种程度上具有特许学校的独立性，但隶属于波士顿公立学校学区，并受到一些集体谈判条款的约束。抽签结果显示，特许学校的学生在初中和高中阶段的成绩有显著提升。相比之下，试点学校学生的抽签结果大多较为微弱且不显著，甚至存在一些显著的负面影响。采用有约束力的学生分配抽签机制的特许学校，似乎比其他特许学校能带来更大的成绩提升。

abstract.text: We document a statistical association between the severity of the persecution, displacement and mass murder of Jews by the Nazis during World War II and long-run economic and political outcomes within Russia. Cities that experienced the Holocaust most intensely have grown less, and both cities and administrative districts (oblasts) where the Holocaust had the largest impact have worse economic and political outcomes since the collapse of the Soviet Union. We provide evidence that the lasting impact of the Holocaust may be attributable to a permanent change it induced in the social structure across different regions of Russia.

10.1093/qje/qjr018.abstractZh: 我们记录了二战期间纳粹对犹太人的迫害、驱逐和大规模屠杀的严重程度与俄罗斯长期经济和政治结果之间的统计关联。遭受大屠杀最严重的城市发展较为缓慢，而那些在大屠杀影响最大的城市和行政区在苏联解体后经济和政治状况更为糟糕。我们有证据表明，大屠杀的持久影响可能源于其引发的俄罗斯不同地区社会结构的永久性变化。

abstract.text: This paper develops a simple model of international trade with intermediation. We consider an economy with two islands and two types of agents, farmers and traders. Farmers can produce two goods, but to sell these goods in centralized (Walrasian) markets, they need to be matched with a trader, and this entails costly search. In the absence of search frictions, our model reduces to a standard Ricardian model of trade. We use this simple model to contrast the implications of changes in the integration of Walrasian markets, which allow traders from different islands to exchange their goods, and changes in the access to these Walrasian markets, which allow farmers to trade with traders from different islands. We find that intermediation always magnifies the gains from trade under the former type of integration, but leads to more nuanced welfare results under the latter, including the possibility of aggregate losses.

10.1093/qje/qjr019.abstractZh: 本文发展了一个简单的国际贸易与中介模型。我们考虑一个由两个岛屿组成的经济体，以及两种类型的主体：农民和商人。农民可以生产两种商品，但要将这些商品在集中式（瓦尔拉斯式）市场出售，就需要与商人进行匹配，这一过程需要耗费大量时间。在不存在搜索摩擦的情况下，我们的模型可以简化为标准的李嘉图贸易模型。我们利用这个简单模型来对比两种情况下的影响：一种是不同岛屿上的商人能够交换商品，另一种则是农民能够与不同岛屿上的商人进行交易。我们发现，在前者的情况下，中介行为总是会放大贸易带来的收益；而在后者的情况下，则会导致更复杂的福利结果，包括可能出现的总体损失。

abstract.text: This article attempts to document and account for the long-run evolution of inheritance. We find that in a country like France the annual flow of inheritance was about 20–25% of national income between 1820 and 1910, down to less than 5% in 1950, and back up to about 15% by 2010. A simple theoretical model of wealth accumulation, growth, and inheritance can fully account for the observed U-shaped pattern and levels. Using this model, we find that under plausible assumptions the annual bequest flow might reach about 20–25% of national income by 2050. This corresponds to a capitalized bequest share in total wealth accumulation well above 100%. Our findings illustrate the fact that when the growth rate g is small, and when the rate of return to private wealth r is permanently and substantially larger than the growth rate (say, r = 4–5% versus g = 1–2%), which was the case in the nineteenth century and early twentieth century and is likely to happen again in the twenty-first century, then past wealth and inheritance are bound to play a key role for aggregate wealth accumulation and the structure of lifetime inequality. Contrary to a widespread view, modern economic growth did not kill inheritance.

10.1093/qje/qjr020.abstractZh: 本文试图记录并解释继承制度的长期演变。我们发现，在法国这样的国家，1820年至1910年间，年度继承流量约占国民收入的20-25%，到1950年降至5%以下，而到2010年又回升至约15%。一个关于财富积累、增长和继承的简单理论模型可以完全解释这一U形模式和水平变化。使用该模型，我们发现在合理的假设下，到2050年，年度遗产分配可能达到国民收入的20-25%。这意味着资本化的遗产在总财富积累中的占比将超过100%。我们的研究结果表明，当增长率g较低，且私人财富的回报率r长期且显著地高于增长率时（例如，r=4-5%而g=1-2%），这种情况在19世纪和20世纪初确实存在，并且在21世纪也可能再次发生。在这种情况下，过去的财富和继承制度将在整体财富积累和终身不平等结构中发挥关键作用。与普遍观点相反，现代经济增长并没有扼杀继承制度。

abstract.text: This article develops a general equilibrium model of multiple-product, multiple-destination firms, which allows for heterogeneity in ability across firms and in product attributes within firms. Firms make endogenous entry and exit decisions and each surviving firm chooses optimally the range of products to supply to each market. We show that the resulting selection, across and within firms, provides a natural explanation for a number of features of trade across firms, products, and countries. Using both time-series changes in trade policy and cross-section variation in trade, we provide empirical evidence in support of the predictions of the model.

10.1093/qje/qjr021.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个关于多产品、多目的地企业的通用均衡模型，该模型允许企业之间以及企业内部在能力上存在差异，同时允许产品属性也存在差异。企业会做出内生性的进入和退出决策，而每个存活下来的企业都会最优地选择向每个市场供应哪些产品。我们证明，这种在企业和企业内部的选择机制，为企业在企业间、产品间以及国家间的贸易行为中的多种特征提供了自然的解释。通过研究贸易政策的时间序列变化以及贸易的横截面差异，我们提供了实证证据来支持该模型的预测。

abstract.text: This article offers a unified approach for studying political violence whether it emerges as repression or civil war. We formulate a model where an incumbent or opposition can use violence to maintain or acquire power to study which political and economic factors drive one-sided or two-sided violence (repression or civil war). The model predicts a hierarchy of violence states from peace via repression to civil war; and suggests a natural empirical approach. Exploiting only within-country variation in the data, we show that violence is associated with shocks that can affect wages and aid. As in the theory, these effects are only present where political institutions are noncohesive.

10.1093/qje/qjr025.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种统一的方法来研究政治暴力，无论是作为镇压还是内战。我们构建了一个模型，其中执政党或反对党可以利用暴力来维持或获取权力，以研究哪些政治和经济因素驱动单边或双边暴力（镇压或内战）。该模型预测了暴力状态的等级划分，从和平到镇压再到内战；并提出了一种自然的实证方法。仅通过国内数据的差异，我们发现暴力与可能影响工资和援助的冲击因素有关。正如理论所预测的那样，这些效应仅存在于政治机构不紧密的情况下。

abstract.text: In public sector procurement, social welfare often depends on the time taken to complete the contract. A leading example is highway construction, where slow completion times inflict a negative externality on commuters. Recently, highway departments have introduced innovative contracting methods based on scoring auctions that give contractors explicit time incentives. We characterize equilibrium bidding and efficient design of these contracts. We then gather an extensive data set of highway repair projects awarded by the California Department of Transportation between 2003 and 2008 that includes both innovative and standard contracts. Comparing similar con- tracts in which the innovative design was and was not used, we show that the welfare gains to commuters from quicker completion substantially exceeded the increase in the winning bid. Having argued that the current policy is effective, we then develop a structural econometric model that endogenizes participation and bidding to examine counterfactual policies. Our estimates suggest that while the current policy raised com- muter surplus relative to the contractor's costs by $359M (6.8% of the total contract value), the optimal policy would raise it by $1.52B (29%).

10.1093/qje/qjr026.abstractZh: 在公共部门采购中，社会福利往往取决于完成合同所需的时间。一个典型的例子是公路建设，如果完成时间过慢，就会给通勤者带来负面影响。最近，公路部门引入了基于评分拍卖的创新性合同方式，为承包商提供了明确的时间激励。我们分析了这些合同的均衡投标机制及有效设计。随后，我们收集了2003年至2008年间加利福尼亚州交通部授予的公路修复项目的详细数据，其中包括创新合同和标准合同。通过比较使用创新设计和不使用创新设计的类似合同，我们发现，更快完成项目对通勤者的福利提升远远超过了中标价格的上涨。在论证现行政策有效性的基础上，我们建立了一个结构经济计量模型，以分析替代性政策的效果。我们的估计表明，虽然现行政策使通勤者获得的收益相对于承包商的成本增加了3.59亿美元（占总合同价值的6.8%），但最优政策将使这一收益增加15.2亿美元（占总额的29%）。

abstract.text: This article examines a model in which advertisers bid for “sponsored-link” positions on a search engine. The value advertisers derive from each position is endogenized as coming from sales to a population of consumers who make rational inferences about firm qualities and search optimally. Consumer search strategies, equilibrium bidding, and the welfare benefits of position auctions are analyzed. Implications for reserve prices and a number of other auction design questions are discussed.

10.1093/qje/qjr028.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个模型，其中广告商为搜索引擎上的“赞助链接”位置进行竞价。广告商从每个位置获得的收益被内生化为来自对消费者群体的销售收益，这些消费者能够理性地推断企业的品质并进行最优搜索。文章分析了消费者的搜索策略、均衡竞价以及位置拍卖带来的福利效应。同时，还讨论了保留价格以及其他拍卖设计问题的影响。

abstract.text: Breastfeeding is negatively correlated with future fertility because nursing temporarily reduces fecundity and because mothers usually wean on becoming pregnant again. We model breastfeeding under son-biased fertility preferences and show that breastfeeding duration increases with birth order, especially near target family size; is lowest for daughters and children without older brothers because their parents try again for a son; and exhibits the largest gender gap near target family size, when gender is most predictive of subsequent fertility. Data from India confirm each prediction. Moreover, child survival exhibits similar patterns, especially in settings where the alternatives to breastmilk are unsanitary.

10.1093/qje/qjr029.abstractZh: 母乳喂养与未来生育能力呈负相关，因为哺乳会暂时降低生育能力，而且母亲通常在再次怀孕时才会断奶。我们在儿子偏好的生育偏好下对母乳喂养进行了建模，发现母乳喂养时间随着出生顺序的增加而增加，尤其是在目标家庭规模附近；对于没有年长兄弟的女儿和儿童来说，母乳喂养时间最短，因为他们的父母会再次尝试生育儿子；在目标家庭规模附近，母乳喂养时间显示出最大的性别差异，此时性别对后续生育能力的影响最为显著。来自印度的数据证实了这些预测。此外，儿童存活率也表现出类似的模式，尤其是在母乳替代品不卫生的情况下。

abstract.text: We estimate the impact of coups and top-secret coup authorizations on asset prices of partially nationalized multinational companies that stood to benefit from U.S.-backed coups. Stock returns of highly exposed firms reacted to coup authorizations classified as top-secret. The average cumulative abnormal return to a coup authorization was 9% over 4 days for a fully nationalized company, rising to more than 13% over 16 days. Precoup authorizations accounted for a larger share of stock price increases than the actual coup events themselves. There is no effect in the case of the widely publicized, poorly executed Cuban operations, consistent with abnormal returns to coup authorizations reflecting credible private information. We also introduce two new intuitive and easy to implement nonparametric tests that do not rely on asymptotic justifications.

10.1093/qje/qjr030.abstractZh: 我们估计了政变和最高机密政变授权对部分国有化的跨国公司资产价格的影响，这些公司有可能从美国支持的政变中获益。高度暴露于政变影响的公司的股票回报对被归类为最高机密政变的授权反应显著。对于完全国有化的公司，政变授权的平均累积异常回报在4天内为9%，在16天内则上升至超过13%。政变前的授权在股价上涨中的贡献比例高于实际政变事件本身。对于广为人知但执行不佳的古巴政变，并未观察到任何影响，这与政变授权的异常回报反映了可靠的私人信息相一致。我们还提出了两种新的、直观且易于实施的非参数检验方法，这些方法不依赖于渐近性论证。

abstract.text: This article analyzes the effect of competition on a supermarket firm's incentive to provide product quality. In the supermarket industry, product availability is an important measure of quality. Using U.S. Consumer Price Index microdata to track inventory shortfalls, I find that stores facing more intense competition have fewer shortfalls. Competition from Walmart—the most significant shock to industry market structure in half a century—decreased shortfalls among large chains by about a third. The risk that customers will switch stores appears to provide competitors with a strong incentive to invest in product quality.

10.1093/qje/qjr031.abstractZh: 本文分析了竞争对超市企业提供产品质量动机的影响。在超市行业中，产品供应情况是衡量质量的一个重要指标。通过美国消费者价格指数微观数据来追踪库存短缺情况，我发现面临更激烈竞争的超市库存短缺情况较少。沃尔玛作为半个世纪以来对行业市场结构最具冲击力的竞争对手，其竞争使得大型连锁超市的库存短缺情况减少了约三分之一。顾客可能会转向其他超市的风险，似乎为竞争对手提供了强烈的动力来投资于产品质量。

abstract.text: This article assesses the role of conditionality in cash transfer programs using a unique experiment targeted at adolescent girls in Malawi. The program featured two distinct interventions: unconditional transfers (UCT arm) and transfers conditional on school attendance (CCT arm). Although there was a modest decline in the dropout rate in the UCT arm in comparison with the control group, it was only 43% as large as the impact in the CCT arm at the end of the 2-year program. The CCT arm also outperformed the UCT arm in tests of English reading comprehension. However, teenage pregnancy and marriage rates were substantially lower in the UCT than the CCT arm, entirely due to the impact of UCTs on these outcomes among girls who dropped out of school.

10.1093/qje/qjr032.abstractZh: 本文通过一项针对马拉维青春期女孩的独特实验，评估了条件性措施在现金转移计划中的作用。该计划包含两种不同的干预措施：无条件现金转移（UCT组）和以出勤率为条件的现金转移（CCT组）。尽管在UCT组中辍学率有所下降，但这一下降幅度仅为CCT组在两年计划结束时下降幅度的43%。在英语阅读理解测试中，CCT组的表现也优于UCT组。然而，由于UCT措施对辍学女孩的影响，UCT组的青少年怀孕和结婚率明显低于CCT组。

abstract.text: A striking feature of many financial crises is the collapse of exports relative to output. This article examines whether deteriorations in bank health can help explain the large drops in exports relative to output. Our article is the first to establish a causal link between the health of banks providing trade finance and growth in a firm's exports relative to its domestic sales. We overcome measurement and endogeneity issues by using a unique data set, covering the Japanese financial crises from 1990 through 2010, which enables us to match exporters with the main bank that provides them with trade finance. Our point estimates are economically and statistically significant, suggesting that the health of financial institutions is an important determinant of firm-level exports during crises.

10.1093/qje/qjr033.abstractZh: 许多金融危机的一个显著特征是出口相对于产出的下降。本文探讨了银行健康状况的恶化是否有助于解释出口相对于产出的大幅下降。我们的文章首次建立了提供贸易融资的银行健康状况与企业出口相对于国内销售额增长之间的因果关系。我们通过使用一个独特的数据集来克服测量和内生性问题，该数据集涵盖了1990年至2010年的日本金融危机，使我们能够将出口商与他们获得贸易融资的主要银行进行匹配。我们的点估计在经济学和统计学上都是显著的，表明在危机期间，金融机构的健康状况是决定企业出口水平的重要因素。

abstract.text: While evidence suggests that people evaluate outcomes with respect to reference points, little is known about what determines them. We conduct two experiments that show that reference points are determined, at least in part, by expectations. In an exchange experiment, we endow subjects with an item and randomize the probability they will be allowed to trade. Subjects that are less likely to be able to trade are more likely to choose to keep their item. In a valuation experiment, we randomly assign subjects a high or low probability of obtaining an item and elicit their willingness-to-accept for it. The high probability treatment increases valuation of the item by 20–30%.

10.1093/qje/qjr034.abstractZh: 有证据表明，人们会根据参照点来评估结果，但关于这些参照点由什么因素决定，我们知之甚少。我们进行了两项实验，结果显示参照点至少部分是由预期决定的。在交换实验中，我们给受试者提供了一个物品，并随机决定他们被允许交换该物品的概率。那些被允许交换概率较低的受试者更有可能选择保留自己的物品。在估值实验中，我们随机给受试者分配获得该物品的高概率或低概率，并测量他们愿意接受该物品的程度。高概率处理组使得他们对物品的估值增加了20-30%。

abstract.text: The printing press was the great innovation in early modern information technology, but economists have found no macroeconomic evidence of its impact. This article exploits city-level data. Between 1500 and 1600, European cities where printing presses were established in the 1400s grew 60% faster than otherwise similar cities. Cities that adopted printing in the 1400s had no prior advantage, and the association between adoption and subsequent growth was not due to printers choosing auspicious locations. These findings are supported by regressions that exploit distance from Mainz, Germany—the birthplace of printing—as an instrument for adoption.

10.1093/qje/qjr035.abstractZh: 印刷术是早期现代信息技术中的重大创新，但经济学家并未发现其影响的宏观经济证据。本文利用城市级数据进行分析。在1500至1600年间，欧洲在14世纪建立了印刷术的城市，其经济增长速度比其他类似城市快60%。在14世纪采用印刷术的城市并没有先前的优势，而采用印刷术与随后经济增长之间的关联并非由于印刷商选择了有利的位置。这些发现得到了回归分析的支持，该分析以距离德国美因茨——印刷术的发源地——的距离为变量来研究采用印刷术的情况。

abstract.text: I estimate the impact of attending a first-choice middle or high school on adult crime, using data from public school choice lotteries in Charlotte-Mecklenburg school district (CMS). Seven years after random assignment, lottery winners had been arrested for fewer serious crimes and had spent fewer days incarcerated. The gain in school quality as measured by peer and teacher inputs was equivalent to moving from one of the lowest-ranked schools to one at the district average. The reduction in crime comes largely from years after enrollment in the preferred school is complete. The impacts are concentrated among high-risk youth, who commit about 50% less crime across several different outcome measures and scalings of crime by severity. I find suggestive evidence that school quality explains more of the impact in high school, whereas peer effects are more important in middle school.

10.1093/qje/qjr036.abstractZh: 我利用夏洛特-梅克伦堡学区（CMS）的公立学校选择抽签数据，评估就读于一所首选中学或高中对成年人犯罪的影响。在随机分配七年后，抽签获得者因严重犯罪被捕的次数减少，服刑天数也减少。学校质量的提升，体现在同学和教师的支持方面，相当于从排名最低的学校升入学区平均水平的中等学校。犯罪率的降低主要出现在学生完成入学后的几年内。这些影响主要集中在高风险青少年身上，他们在多种犯罪指标上的犯罪率降低了约50%。我发现，学校质量在高中阶段对犯罪的影响更为显著，而在初中阶段，同伴效应更为重要。

abstract.text: If democracy is to have the good effects said to justify it, it must be self-enforcing in that incumbents choose to hold regular, competitive elections and comply with the results. I consider models of electoral accountability that allow rulers a choice of whether to hold elections and citizens whether to rebel. When individuals observe diverse signals of government performance, coordination to pose a credible threat of protest if the ruler “shirks” is problematic. The convention of an electoral calendar and known rules can provide a public signal for coordinating rebellion if elections are suspended or blatantly rigged, while the elections themselves aggregate private observations of performance. Two threats to this solution to political moral hazard are considered. First, a ruling faction that controls the army may prefer to fight after losing an election, and ex post transfers may not be credible. A party system in which today's losers may win in the future can restore self-enforcing democracy, though at the cost of weaker electoral control. Second, subtle electoral fraud can undermine the threat of coordinated opposition that maintains elections. I show that when there are organizations in society that can observe and announce a signal of the extent of popular discontent, the incumbent may prefer to commit to fair elections over an “accountable autocratic” equilibrium in which public goods are provided but costly rebellions periodically occur.

10.1093/qje/qjr038.abstractZh: 如果民主要发挥其应有的作用，就必须具有自我维持的特性，即现任政府应选择定期举行竞争性选举并遵守选举结果。我提出的选举问责模式允许统治者决定是否举行选举，而公民则可以选择是否反抗。当个人观察到政府表现的多种信号时，如果统治者“逃避”选举责任，那么协调起来以发起抗议就变得困难。如果选举被暂停或明显被操纵，那么固定的选举日程和明确的规则可以为协调反抗提供公共信号；而选举本身则汇总了人们对政府表现的私人观察结果。本文还探讨了这一解决政治道德风险的两个威胁。首先，控制军队的执政派系可能在选举失利后选择继续斗争，而事后转移支付可能不再具有可信性。一个由今天的失败者未来可能获胜的政党体系可以恢复自我维持的民主，尽管这可能会降低选举的管控力度。其次，轻微的选举舞弊可能会削弱维持选举的协调反对力量。研究表明，当社会中有组织能够观察和宣布民众不满程度的信号时，现任政府可能更倾向于坚持公平选举，而不是在“问责型专制”的均衡状态下进行选举，后者虽然能提供公共产品，但也会周期性地引发代价高昂的反抗行为。

abstract.text: This article examines learning-by-doing that is specific not just to individual firms but to pairs of firms working together in a contracting relationship. Using data from the oil and gas industry, I find that the productivity of an oil production company and its drilling contractor increases with their joint experience. This learning is relationship-specific: drilling rigs cannot fully appropriate the productivity gains acquired through experience with one production company to their work for another.This result is robust to ex ante match specificities. Moreover, producers' and rigs'contracting behavior is consistent with maximization of relationship-specific learning's productivity benefits.

10.1093/qje/qjr039.abstractZh: 本文探讨了不仅存在于单个企业之间，还存在于合作关系的企业 pair 中的“边做边学”现象。通过石油和天然气行业的数据分析，我发现石油生产公司与其钻井承包商的生产力随着双方合作经验的积累而提升。这种学习是特定于关系的：钻井平台无法完全将通过与一家生产公司合作获得的经验提升应用到为另一家公司工作时。这一结果在考虑到事前合作关系特殊性后依然成立。此外，生产企业和钻井平台之间的合作行为符合最大化关系特定学习带来的生产力收益的特征。

abstract.text: In Project STAR, 11,571 students in Tennessee and their teachers were randomly assigned to classrooms within their schools from kindergarten to third grade. This article evaluates the long-term impacts of STAR by linking the experimental data to administrative records. We first demonstrate that kindergarten test scores are highly correlated with outcomes such as earnings at age 27, college attendance, home ownership, and retirement savings. We then document four sets of experimental impacts. First, students in small classes are significantly more likely to attend college and exhibit improvements on other outcomes. Class size does not have a significant effect on earnings at age 27, but this effect is imprecisely estimated. Second, students who had a more experienced teacher in kindergarten have higher earnings. Third, an analysis of variance reveals significant classroom effects on earnings. Students who were randomly assigned to higher quality classrooms in grades K–3—as measured by classmates' end-of-class test scores—have higher earnings, college attendance rates, and other outcomes. Finally, the effects of class quality fade out on test scores in later grades, but gains in noncognitive measures persist.

10.1093/qje/qjr041.abstractZh: 在STAR项目中，田纳西州的11,571名学生及其教师被随机分配到各自学校内的不同班级，这些班级涵盖从幼儿园到三年级的阶段。本文通过将实验数据与行政记录相结合，评估STAR项目的长期影响。我们首先证明，幼儿园阶段的测试成绩与27岁时的收入、大学入学率、房屋所有权以及退休储蓄等结果之间存在高度相关性。接着，我们记录了四组实验性影响。首先，小班教学的学生更有可能进入大学，并在其他方面取得进步。班级规模对27岁时的收入没有显著影响，但这种影响估计并不精确。其次，在幼儿园阶段有经验丰富的教师指导的学生，其收入更高。第三，方差分析显示，教室质量对收入有显著影响。那些被随机分配到质量更高的教室中的学生，在幼儿园到三年级期间，其收入、大学入学率以及其他指标都表现更好。最后，教室质量的积极影响在后期年级的测试成绩中逐渐减弱，但在非认知指标方面的影响却持续存在。

abstract.text: We study the price-setting problem of a firm in the presence of both observation and menu costs. The firm optimally decides when to “review” costly information on the adequacy of its price. Upon each review, the firm chooses whether to adjust its price, one or more times, before the next price review. Each price adjustment entails paying a menu cost. The firm's choices map into several statistics: the frequency of price reviews, the frequency of price adjustments, the size distribution of price changes, and the hazard rate of price adjustments. The simultaneous presence of observation and menu costs produces complementarities that change the predictions of simpler models featuring one cost only. For instance, infrequent observations may reflect a high menu cost rather than high observation costs: in spite of these complementarities, we show that the ratio of the two costs is identified by several statistics on price observations and adjustments.

10.1093/qje/qjr043.abstractZh: 我们研究了在观察成本和菜单成本同时存在的情况下，企业的定价问题。企业会最优地决定何时“审查”有关其价格合理性的昂贵信息。每次审查后，企业会决定是否在下次定价审查之前调整价格一次或多次。每次价格调整都需要支付一定的菜单成本。企业的选择可以映射为几个统计量：价格审查的频率、价格调整的频率、价格变化的幅度分布，以及价格调整的风险率。观察成本和菜单成本的同时存在产生了互补性，这改变了仅涉及一种成本的简单模型的预测结果。例如，不频繁的观察可能反映了较高的菜单成本，而不是较高的观察成本：尽管存在这些互补性，我们仍然表明，这两种成本的比率可以通过对价格观察和调整的几个统计量来识别。

abstract.text: We use individual and aggregate data to ask how the Internet is changing the ideological segregation of the American electorate. Focusing on online news consumption, offline news consumption, and face-to-face social interactions, we define ideological segregation in each domain using standard indices from the literature on racial segregation. We find that ideological segregation of online news consumption is low in absolute terms, higher than the segregation of most offline news consumption, and significantly lower than the segregation of face-to-face interactions with neighbors, co-workers, or family members. We find no evidence that the Internet is becoming more segregated over time.

10.1093/qje/qjr044.abstractZh: 我们使用个体数据和汇总数据来研究互联网如何改变美国选民的意识形态隔离现象。重点关注在线新闻消费、线下新闻消费以及面对面社交互动，我们采用相关文献中的标准指标来定义每个领域的意识形态隔离程度。研究发现，在线新闻消费的意识形态隔离程度在绝对数值上较低，高于大多数线下新闻消费的隔离程度，且明显低于与邻居、同事或家人面对面交流时的隔离程度。我们没有发现互联网随着时间的推移而变得更加隔离的证据。

abstract.text: This article describes a series of school-based field experiments in over 200 urban schools across three cities designed to better understand the impact of financial incentives on student achievement. In Dallas, students were paid to read books. In New York, students were rewarded for performance on interim assessments. In Chicago, students were paid for classroom grades. I estimate that the impact of financial incentives on student achievement is statistically 0, in each city. Due to a lack of power, however, I cannot rule out the possibility of effect sizes that would have positive returns on investment. The only statistically significant effect is on English-speaking students in Dallas. The article concludes with a speculative discussion of what might account for intercity differences in estimated treatment effects.

10.1093/qje/qjr045.abstractZh: 本文描述了在三个城市超过200所城市学校开展的一系列基于学校的实地实验，旨在更好地了解经济激励对学生学业成绩的影响。在达拉斯，学生通过阅读书籍获得报酬；在纽约，学生因在中期评估中的表现而获得奖励；在芝加哥，学生因课堂成绩良好而获得报酬。我估计，在每座城市中，经济激励对学生学业成绩的影响在统计上为零。然而，由于数据量的限制，我无法排除存在能够带来积极投资回报的效应大小的可能性。唯一在统计上显著的效应是英语学生的学业成绩。文章最后对造成各城市估计的干预效果差异的原因进行了推测性讨论。

abstract.text: A nation's economic geography can have an enormous impact on its development. In Thailand, we show that a high concentration of enterprise in an area predicts high subsequent growth in and around that area. We also find spatially contiguous convergence of enterprise with stagnant areas left behind. Exogenous physiographic conditions are correlated with enterprise location and growth. We fit a structural, micro-founded model of occupation transitions with fine-tuned geographic capabilities to village data and replicate these salient facts. Key elements of the model include costs, credit constraints on occupation choice, and spatially varying expansion of financial service providers.

10.1093/qje/qjr046.abstractZh: 一个国家的经济地理对其发展有着巨大的影响。在泰国，我们发现某个地区企业高度集中，通常会预示着该地区及其周边地区的后续增长迅速。我们还发现，企业分布的连续性与那些发展停滞的地区之间存在差异。外部地理条件与企业的选址和增长有关。我们构建了一个结构化的、基于微观数据的职业转换模型，并针对村庄数据进行了验证，证实了这些重要现象。该模型的关键要素包括成本、职业选择中的信贷限制，以及金融服务提供者的空间差异化的扩张。

abstract.text: In view of the non-identification of the first-price auction model with risk-averse bidders, this paper proposes some parametric identifying restrictions and a semiparametric estimator for the risk aversion parameter(s) and the latent distribution of private values. Specifically, we exploit heterogeneity across auctioned objects to establish semiparametric identification under a conditional quantile restriction of the bidders' private value distribution and a parameterization of the bidders' utility function. We develop a multistep semiparametric method and we show that our semiparametric estimator of the utility function parameter(s) converges at the optimal rate, which is slower than the parametric one but independent of the dimension of the exogenous variables thereby avoiding the curse of dimensionality. We then consider various extensions including a binding reserve price, affiliation among private values, and asymmetric bidders. The method is illustrated on U.S. Forest Service timber sales, and bidders' risk neutrality is rejected.

10.1093/restud/rdq001.abstractZh: 鉴于首次拍卖模型与风险厌恶投标者之间缺乏一致性，本文提出了一些参数化识别限制条件，并提出了一种半参数估计方法，用于估计风险厌恶参数以及私人价值的潜在分布。具体来说，我们利用拍卖对象之间的异质性，在投标者私人价值分布的条件分位数限制以及投标者效用函数的参数化条件下，建立了半参数识别机制。我们开发了一种多步骤半参数方法，并证明我们的半参数效用函数参数估计在最优速率下收敛，这一收敛速度虽然比参数化方法慢，但与外生变量的维度无关，从而避免了维度诅咒。随后，我们考虑了包括强制保留价格、私人价值之间的关联以及不对称投标者在内的各种扩展情况。该方法在美国森林服务部门木材销售案例中得到了验证，结果表明投标者的风险中性假设被拒绝。

abstract.text: Informational asymmetries between a firm and investors may lead to adverse selection in capital markets. This paper demonstrates that when the market obtains noisy information about a firm over time, this adverse selection problem can be costlessly solved by issuing callable convertible bonds with restrictive call provisions. Such securities can be designed to make the payoff to new claimholders independent of the private information of the manager. This eliminates the possibility of any dilution of equity or underinvestment and implements the symmetric information outcome in either a pooling or a separating equilibrium. The same first-best efficient outcome can also be implemented by issuing floating-price and mandatory convertibles.

10.1093/restud/rdq002.abstractZh: 企业与投资者之间的信息不对称可能导致资本市场中的逆向选择问题。本文指出，当市场随着时间的推移获得关于企业的噪声信息时，可以通过发行具有限制性赎回条款的可转换债券来低成本解决这一逆向选择问题。这类证券的设计可以使新持有人获得的收益不受企业管理者私人信息的影响。这消除了股权稀释或投资不足的可能性，并在集中或分离均衡中实现对称信息的结果。通过发行浮动价格且强制转换的可转换债券，同样可以实现同样的最优效率结果。

abstract.text: The consumption literature uses adult equivalence scales to measure individual-level inequality. This practice imposes the assumption that there is no within-household inequality. In this paper, we show that ignoring consumption inequality within households produces misleading estimates of inequality along two dimensions. To illustrate this point, we use a collective model of household behaviour to estimate consumption inequality in the U.K. from 1968 to 2001. First, the use of adult equivalence scales underestimates the initial level of cross-sectional consumption inequality by 50%, as large differences in the earnings of husbands and wives translate into large differences in consumption allocations within households. Second, we estimate the rise in between-household inequality has been accompanied by an offsetting reduction in within-household inequality. Our findings also indicate that increases in marital sorting on wages and hours worked can simultaneously explain two-thirds of the decline in within-household inequality and between a quarter and one-half of the rise in between-household inequality for one and two adult households.

10.1093/restud/rdq003.abstractZh: 消费文献通常使用成人等值尺度来衡量个体层面的不平等。这种做法假定家庭内部不存在不平等现象。在本文中，我们指出，忽略家庭内部的消费不平等会导致两个维度上的不平等估计出现误导。为了说明这一点，我们使用一个集体模型来估算1968年至2001年间英国的消费不平等情况。首先，使用成人等值尺度会低估初始的横截面消费不平等程度，约50%，因为丈夫和妻子之间的收入差异会导致家庭内部消费分配的巨大差异。其次，我们估计家庭间不平等的上升伴随着家庭内部不平等的相应减少。我们的研究结果还表明，婚姻中对工资和工作时长的排序变化可以同时解释家庭内部不平等下降的三分之二，以及家庭间不平等上升的四分之一到一半。

abstract.text: In many procurement auctions, the bidders' unobserved costs depend both on a common shock and on idiosyncratic private information. Assuming a multiplicative structure, I derive sufficient conditions under which the model is identified and propose a non-parametric estimation procedure that results in uniformly consistent estimators of the cost components' distributions. The estimation procedure is applied to data from Michigan highway procurement auctions. Private information is estimated to account for 34% of the variation in bidders' costs. It is shown that accounting for unobserved auction heterogeneity has important implications for the evaluation of the distribution of rents, efficiency, and optimal auction design.

10.1093/restud/rdq004.abstractZh: 在许多采购拍卖中，投标者的未观测成本既取决于共同的冲击，也取决于独特的私人信息。假设模型具有乘法结构，我推导出了模型被识别的充分条件，并提出了一种非参数估计方法，该方法能够得出成本成分分布的统一一致估计量。该估计方法被应用于密歇根州公路采购拍卖的数据。估计结果显示，私人信息占投标者成本变化的34%。研究表明，考虑未观测的拍卖异质性对于评估租金分布、效率以及最优拍卖设计具有重要意义。

abstract.text: The incentive and project selection effects of agent anonymity are investigated in a setting where an evaluator observes a subjective signal of project quality. Although the evaluator cannot commit ex ante to an acceptance criterion, she decides up front between informed review, where the agent's ability is directly observable, or blind review, where it is not. An ideal acceptance criterion balances the goals of incentive provision and project selection. Relative to this, informed review results in an excessively steep equilibrium acceptance policy: the standard applied to low-ability agents is too stringent and the standard applied to high-ability agents is too lenient. Blind review, in which all types face the same standard, often provides better incentives, but it ignores valuable information for selecting projects. The evaluator prefers a policy of blind (respectively informed) review when the ability distribution puts more weight on high (respectively low) types, the agent's pay-off from acceptance is high (respectively low), or the quality signal is precise (respectively imprecise). Applications discussed include the admissibility of character evidence in criminal trials and academic refereeing.

10.1093/restud/rdq005.abstractZh: 本文研究了代理匿名性对激励和项目选择的影响，研究背景是评估者观察项目质量的主观信号。尽管评估者无法预先确定接受标准，但她仍需在“知情评审”（代理的能力可以直接观察）和“盲评”（无法观察代理能力）之间做出选择。理想的接受标准应平衡激励提供与项目选择的目标。相比之下，知情评审会导致过陡的均衡接受政策：对低能力代理的标准过于严格，而对高能力代理的标准则过于宽松。盲评则对所有类型代理采用相同的标准，通常能提供更有效的激励，但会忽略用于项目选择的宝贵信息。当能力分布更偏向高能力类型时，评估者更倾向于盲评（或知情评审），因为此时代理的接受收益更高，或者质量信号更为精确。本文讨论的应用案例包括刑事审判中品格证据的采纳以及学术评审。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of shifts in monetary policy using the term structure of interest rates. In our no-arbitrage model, the short rate follows a version of the Taylor's (1993, “Discretion Versus Policy Rules in Practice”, Carnegie-Rochester Conference Series on Public Policy, 39, 195–214) rule where the coefficients on the output gap and inflation vary over time. The monetary policy loading on the output gap has averaged around 0·4 and has not changed very much over time. The overall response of the yield curve to output gap components is relatively small. In contrast, the inflation loading has changed substantially over the last 50 years and ranges from close to zero in 2003 to a high of 2·4 in 1983. Long-term bonds are sensitive to inflation policy shifts with increases in inflation loadings leading to higher short rates and widening yield spreads.

10.1093/restud/rdq006.abstractZh: 我们通过利率期限结构来估计货币政策变动的影响。在我们的无套利模型中，短期利率遵循泰勒（1993年）提出的规则，该规则将输出缺口和通货膨胀的系数随时间变化。货币政策对输出缺口的影响平均约为0.4，且随时间变化不大。收益率曲线对输出缺口成分的响应相对较小。相比之下，通货膨胀的影响在过去50年中发生了显著变化，从2003年的接近零上升到1983年的2.4。长期债券对通货膨胀政策的变动非常敏感，通货膨胀影响的增加会导致短期利率上升和收益率差扩大。

abstract.text: I consider a dynamic model of competition between two proprietary networks. Consumers die and are replaced with a constant hazard rate, and firms compete for new consumers to join their network by offering network entry prices. I derive a series of results pertaining to (a) existence and uniqueness of symmetric equilibria, (b) monotonicity of the pricing function (e.g. larger networks set higher prices), (c) network size dynamics (increasing dominance vs. reversion to the mean), and (d) firm value (how it varies with network effects). Finally, I apply my general framework to the study of termination charges in wireless telecommunications. I consider various forms of regulation and examine their impact on firm profits and market share dynamics.

10.1093/restud/rdq007.abstractZh: 我研究了一个关于两个专有网络之间竞争的动态模型。消费者会死亡并被一个恒定的风险率所替代，企业则通过提供网络接入价格来争夺新的消费者加入它们的网络。我得出了以下一系列结果：(a)对称均衡的存在性和唯一性；(b)定价函数的单调性（例如，较大的网络设定更高的价格）；(c)网络规模的动态变化（逐渐增强的支配力与回归均值）；以及(d)企业价值如何随网络效应而变化。最后，我将我的总体框架应用于无线电信中的终止费用研究。我考虑了各种形式的监管措施，并分析了它们对企业利润和市场份额动态的影响。

abstract.text: Our paper examines the impact of heterogeneous trading technologies for households on asset prices and the distribution of wealth. We distinguish between passive traders who hold fixed portfolios of stocks and bonds, and active traders who adjust their portfolios to changes in expected returns. To solve the model, we derive an optimal consumption sharing rule that does not depend on the trading technology, and we derive an aggregation result for state prices. This allows us to solve for equilibrium prices and allocations without having to search for market clearing prices in each asset market separately. We show that the fraction of total wealth held by active traders, not the fraction held by all participants, is critical for asset prices because only these traders respond to variation in state prices and hence absorb the residual aggregate risk created by non-participants. We calibrate the heterogeneity in trading technologies to match the equity premium and the risk-free rate. The calibrated model reproduces the skewness and kurtosis of the wealth distribution in the data. In contrast to existing asset pricing models with heterogeneous agents, our model matches the high volatility of returns and the low volatility of the risk-free rate.

10.1093/restud/rdq008.abstractZh: 我们的论文探讨了家庭采用不同交易技术对资产价格与财富分配的影响。我们区分了持有固定股票和债券组合的无主动交易者，以及根据预期回报变化调整投资组合的主动交易者。为了解决模型问题，我们推导出一个不依赖于交易技术的最优消费分配规则，并得出了状态价格的综合结果。这使我们能够在不分别在每个资产市场寻找市场清算价格的情况下，确定均衡价格和分配情况。我们发现，主动交易者持有的总财富比例，而非所有参与者持有的比例，对资产价格至关重要，因为只有这些交易者会对状态价格的变化作出反应，从而吸收非参与者产生的剩余总风险。我们通过校准交易技术的异质性来匹配股权溢价和无风险利率。经过校准的模型能够再现数据中财富分布的偏态和峰度。与现有具有异质代理人的资产定价模型不同，我们的模型能够很好地匹配高回报率的波动性和低无风险利率的波动性。

abstract.text: We develop a theory of media slant as a systematic filtering of political news that reduces multidimensional politics to the one-dimensional space perceived by voters. Economic and political choices are interdependent in our theory: expected electoral results influence economic choices, and economic choices in turn influence voting behaviour. In a two-candidate election, we show that media favouring the front-runner will focus on issues unlikely to deliver a surprise, while media favouring the underdog will gamble for resurrection. We characterize the socially optimal slant and show that it coincides with the one favoured by the underdog under a variety of circumstances. Balanced media, giving each issue equal coverage, may be worse for voters than partisan media.

10.1093/restud/rdq009.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种关于媒体偏向的理论，认为媒体对政治新闻的系统性筛选将多维度的政治问题简化为选民感知的一维空间。在我们的理论中，经济选择与政治选择是相互依存的：预期的选举结果会影响经济选择，而经济选择反过来又会影响投票行为。在两名候选人的选举中，我们指出，支持领先者的媒体会关注不太可能带来意外结果的问题，而支持弱势者的媒体则会冒险推动弱势者东山再起。我们描述了社会最优的媒体偏向，并表明在多种情况下，这种偏向与弱势者所青睐的偏向是一致的。平衡报道的媒体，即对每个问题给予同等关注，可能对选民来说不如党派性强的媒体。

abstract.text: We present a tractable general equilibrium model with multiple sectors in which firms offer workers incentive contracts and simultaneously raise capital in stock markets. Workers optimally invest in the stock market and at the same time hedge labour income risk. Firms rationally take agents' portfolio decisions into account. In equilibrium, the cost of capital of each sector is endogenous. The distortion induced by moral hazard generates counterintuitive effects on the real economy. For example, the value of labour market participation may be higher under moral hazard than under first best, further a positive productivity shock may decrease welfare in the moral hazard economy. In addition, our model generates predictions on the effects of moral hazard on asset markets. For example, in the presence of moral hazard, the capital asset pricing model fails because firms, by choosing optimal incentive contracts, transfer risk both through wages and through the stock market. This leads to several cross-sectional asset pricing “anomalies”, such as size and value effects. As we characterize optimal contracts, we can also present empirical predictions relating workers' compensation, firm productivity, firm size, and financial market abnormal returns.

10.1093/restud/rdq010.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个具有多个部门的通用均衡模型，在该模型中，企业向工人提供激励合同，并同时在股票市场上筹集资金。工人会最优地投资股市，同时对冲劳动收入风险。企业会理性地考虑代理人的投资组合决策。在均衡状态下，每个部门的资本成本都是内生的。由道德风险引起的扭曲会对实体经济产生反直觉的影响。例如，在道德风险下，劳动力市场的参与价值可能高于最优情况下的价值；此外，积极的生产率冲击可能会在道德风险经济中降低福利。此外，我们的模型还预测了道德风险对资产市场的影响。例如，在道德风险存在的情况下，资本资产定价模型会失效，因为企业通过选择最优激励合同，通过工资和股市将风险转移出去。这导致了多个跨截面资产定价“异常现象”，如规模效应和价值效应。在描述最优合同的同时，我们还可以提出关于工人补偿、企业生产率、企业规模以及金融市场异常回报的实证预测。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a labour market model with job search frictions where workers have private information on match quality and effort. Firms use wage contracts to motivate workers. In addition, wages are also used to attract employees. We define and characterize competitive search equilibrium in this context, and show that it satisfies a simple modified Hosios rule. We also analyse the interplay between macroeconomic variables and optimal wage contracts. Finally, we show that private information may increase the responsiveness of the unemployment rate to changes in the aggregate productivity level and, in particular, to changes in the information structure.

10.1093/restud/rdq011.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个包含求职摩擦的劳动力市场模型，其中劳动者拥有关于匹配质量和努力程度的私人信息。企业通过工资合同来激励劳动者，同时工资也用于吸引员工。我们定义了竞争搜索均衡，并证明其满足一个简单的修改后的Hosios规则。我们还分析了宏观经济变量与最优工资合同之间的相互作用。最后，我们表明私人信息可能会提高失业率对总体生产率水平变化的响应能力，特别是对信息结构变化的响应能力。

abstract.text: Whether campaign advertising influences election outcomes is an open question; a paradox given the amount spent on campaigning in general and TV advertising in particular. We argue that such “absence of documentation” is due to the focus of the empirical literature on the U.S., where the allocation of campaign spending and advertising is decentralized. We explore a quasi-natural experiment that enables us to mitigate the omitted variables and reverse causality problems caused by decentralized allocation. In Brazil, gubernatorial elections work in a two-round system. In the first round, candidates' TV time shares are determined by their coalitions' share of seats in the National Parliament. In the second round, TV time is split equally between the first-round winner and runner-up. Using differences between rounds as a source of variation, we find a large causal effect of TV advertising on election outcomes.

10.1093/restud/rdq012.abstractZh: 竞选广告是否会影响选举结果仍是一个悬而未决的问题；考虑到整体竞选支出以及电视广告的投入，这一矛盾显得尤为明显。我们认为，这种“缺乏文献支持”的现象，是由于实证研究的重点集中在美国，而美国的竞选支出和广告分配是分散式的。我们通过一项准自然实验来尝试解决因分散式分配导致的遗漏变量和反向因果关系问题。在巴西，州长选举采用两轮投票制。在第一轮投票中，候选人的电视播出时间取决于其联盟在全国议会中的席位占比。在第二轮投票中，电视播出时间则平均分配给第一轮和第二轮的获胜者。通过对比两轮投票之间的差异，我们发现电视广告对选举结果具有显著的因果效应。

abstract.text: We offer an explanation for the forward premium puzzle in foreign exchange markets based upon investor overconfidence. In the model, overconfident individuals overreact to their information about future inflation, which causes greater overshooting in the forward rate than in the spot rate. Thus, when agents observe a signal of higher future inflation, the consequent rise in the forward premium predicts a subsequent downward correction of the spot rate. The model can explain the magnitude of the forward premium bias and several other stylized facts related to the joint behaviour of forward and spot exchange rates. Our approach is also consistent with the availability of profitable carry trade strategies.

10.1093/restud/rdq013.abstractZh: 我们基于投资者过度自信的假设，对外汇市场中的远期溢价现象进行了解释。在模型中，过度自信的个体会对未来通胀的信息反应过度，导致远期汇率的波动幅度大于即期汇率。因此，当交易者观察到未来通胀较高的信号时，远期溢价的上升预示着即期汇率随后会下降。该模型能够解释远期溢价偏差的幅度，以及远期和即期汇率联合行为中的其他一些典型现象。我们的方法也与可获得的盈利性套利策略的存在相一致。

abstract.text: Using box-office data for all movies released between 1982 and 2000, I quantify how much the consumption decisions of individuals depend on information they receive from their peers, when quality is ex ante uncertain. In the presence of social learning, we should see different box-office sales dynamics depending on whether opening weekend demand is higher or lower than expected. I use a unique feature of the movie industry to identify ex ante demand expectations: the number of screens dedicated to a movie in its opening weekend reflects the sales expectations held by profit-maximizing theatre owners. Several pieces of evidence are consistent with social learning. First, sales of movies with positive surprise and negative surprise in opening weekend demand diverge over time. If a movie has better than expected appeal and therefore experiences larger than expected sales in Week 1, consumers in Week 2 update upward their expectations of quality, further increasing Week 2 sales. Second, this divergence is small for movies for which consumers have strong priors and large for movies for which consumers have weak priors. Third, the effect of a surprise is stronger for audiences with large social networks. Finally, consumers do not respond to surprises in first-week sales that are orthogonal to movie quality, like weather shocks. Overall, social learning appears to be an important determinant of sales in the movie industry, accounting for 32% of sales for the typical movie with positive surprise. This implies the existence of a large “social multiplier” such that the elasticity of aggregate demand to movie quality is larger than the elasticity of individual demand.

10.1093/restud/rdq014.abstractZh: 通过利用1982年至2000年间所有上映电影的票房数据，我量化了在质量无法预先确定的情况下，个人消费决策在多大程度上依赖于他们从同龄人那里获得的信息。在社交学习的作用下，我们应该看到不同的票房销售动态，这取决于首映周末的需求是高于还是低于预期。我利用电影行业的独特特征来识别预先的需求预期：首映周末用于放映该电影的影院数量反映了以利润最大化为目标的影院业主所持有的销售预期。有几项证据支持社交学习理论。首先，首映周末需求呈现正面惊喜或负面惊喜的电影，其销售情况随时间而变化。如果一部电影比预期更具吸引力，因此在第一周的销量会高于预期，那么第二周的消费者会提升对电影质量的预期，从而进一步增加第二周的销量。其次，对于拥有强烈先验知识的电影来说，这种差异较小；而对于先验知识较弱的电影来说，这种差异则较大。第三，对于拥有庞大社交网络的观众来说，惊喜效应更为显著。最后，消费者对于与电影质量无关的首周销售惊喜反应不大，比如天气变化带来的冲击。总体而言，社交学习似乎是电影行业销售的重要决定因素，对于典型的具有正面惊喜的电影来说，总需求的弹性占到了销售总额的32%。这表明存在一个较大的“社交乘数效应”，使得整体需求对电影质量的弹性大于个体需求对电影质量的弹性。

abstract.text: We study the effects of globalization on risk sharing and welfare. Like the previous literature, we assume that governments cannot commit to enforce the repayment of debts owed by their citizens. Unlike the previous literature, we assume that governments cannot discriminate between domestic and foreign creditors when enforcing debt payments. This creates novel interactions between domestic and international trade in assets. (i) Increases in domestic trade raise the benefits of enforcement and facilitate international trade. In fact, in our set-up, countries can obtain international risk sharing even in the absence of default penalties. (ii) Increases in foreign trade raise the costs of enforcement and hamper domestic trade. As a result, globalization may worsen domestic risk sharing and lower welfare. We show how these effects depend on various characteristics of tradable goods and explore the roles of borrowing limits, debt renegotiations, and trade policy.

10.1093/restud/rdq015.abstractZh: 我们研究了全球化对风险分担和福利的影响。与以往的研究类似，我们假设政府无法承诺强制履行公民所欠债务。与以往的研究不同，我们假设政府在执行债务偿还时无法区分国内和外国债权人。这导致了国内与国际贸易在资产方面的新型互动。(i) 国内贸易的增加提高了执行力度，并促进了国际贸易的发展。实际上，在我们的模型中，即使没有违约惩罚，各国也能实现国际风险分担。(ii) 对外贸易的增加则提高了执行成本，并阻碍了国内贸易的发展。因此，全球化可能会恶化国内风险分担，降低福利水平。我们展示了这些效应如何受到可交易商品各种特征的影响，并探讨了借款限制、债务重新谈判以及贸易政策的作用。

abstract.text: We study a market model in which competing firms use costly marketing devices to influence the set of alternatives which consumers perceive as relevant. Consumers in our model are boundedly rational in the sense that they have an imperfect perception of what is relevant to their decision problem. They apply well-defined preferences to a “consideration set”, which is a function of the marketing devices employed by the firms. We examine the implications of this behavioural model in the context of a competitive market model, particularly on industry profits, vertical product differentiation, the use of marketing devices, and consumers' conversion rates.

10.1093/restud/rdq016.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个市场模型，其中竞争企业使用昂贵的营销手段来影响消费者认为相关的选择范围。我们模型中的消费者具有有限理性，即他们对哪些因素与决策问题相关存在不完美的认知。他们根据企业使用的营销手段，对“考虑集”进行明确的偏好处理。我们探讨了这一行为模型在竞争市场模型中的影响，特别是对行业利润、垂直产品差异化、营销手段的使用以及消费者转化率等方面的影响。

abstract.text: We study a model where the aggregate trading of currency speculators reveals new information to the central bank and affects its policy decision. We show that the learning process gives rise to coordination motives among speculators leading to large currency attacks and introducing non-fundamental volatility into exchange rates and policy decisions. We show that the central bank can improve the ex ante effectiveness of its policy by committing to put a lower weight ex post on the information from the market, and that transparency may either increase or decrease the effectiveness of learning from the market, depending on how it is implemented.

10.1093/restud/rdq017.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个模型，在该模型中，货币投机者的集体交易向中央银行揭示了新的信息，并影响其政策决策。我们发现，这种学习过程促使投机者之间产生协调动机，从而导致大规模的货币攻击，并引入非基本性的波动因素到汇率和政策决策中。我们指出，中央银行可以通过承诺对市场信息的后验权重进行降低，来提高其政策的预期效果；而透明度则可能会根据实施方式的不同，增加或降低从市场学习的效果。

abstract.text: Informational asymmetries between a firm and investors may lead to adverse selection in capital markets. This paper demonstrates that when the market obtains noisy information about a firm over time, this adverse selection problem can be costlessly solved by issuing callable convertible bonds with restrictive call provisions. Such securities can be designed to make the payoff to new claimholders independent of the private information of the manager. This eliminates the possibility of any dilution of equity or underinvestment and implements the symmetric information outcome in either a pooling or a separating equilibrium. The same first-best efficient outcome can also be implemented by issuing floating-price and mandatory convertibles.

10.1093/restud/rdq018.abstractZh: 企业与投资者之间的信息不对称可能导致资本市场中的逆向选择问题。本文指出，当市场随着时间的推移获得关于企业的噪声信息时，可以通过发行具有限制性赎回条款的可转换债券来低成本解决这一逆向选择问题。这类证券的设计可以使新持有人获得的收益不受企业管理者私人信息的影响。这消除了股权稀释或投资不足的可能性，并在集中或分离均衡中实现对称信息的结果。通过发行浮动价格且强制转换的可转换债券，同样可以实现同样的最优效率结果。

abstract.text: We develop a dynamic repeated election model in which citizen candidates are distinguished by both their ideology and valence. Voters observe an incumbent's valence and policy choices but only know the challenger's party. Our model provides a rich set of novel results. In contrast to existing predictions from static models, we prove that dynamic considerations make higher-valence incumbents more likely to compromise and win re-election, even though they compromise to more extreme policies. Consequently, we find that the correlation between valence and extremist policies rises with office-holder seniority. This result may help explain previous empirical findings. Despite this result, we establish that the whole electorate gains from improvements in the distribution of valences. In contrast, fixing average valence, the greater dispersion in valence associated with a high-valence political elite always benefits the median voter but can harm a majority of voters when voters are sufficiently risk averse. We then consider interest groups (IGs) or activists who search for candidates with better skills. We derive a complete theoretical explanation for the intuitive conjectures that policies are more extreme when IGs and activists have more extreme ideologies, and that such extremism reduces the welfare of all voters.

10.1093/restud/rdq019.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个动态重复选举模型，其中公民候选人的特质由意识形态和偏好共同决定。选民可以观察到现任候选人的偏好和政策选择，但只能知道挑战者的政党。我们的模型提供了许多新颖的结果。与静态模型的现有预测不同，我们证明，在动态因素的作用下，偏好较高的现任候选人更有可能妥协并赢得连任，即使他们妥协的是更为极端的政策。因此，我们发现偏好与极端政策之间的关联随着职位持有者的资历增加而增强。这一结果可能有助于解释之前的实证发现。尽管如此，我们仍然发现，整个选民群体都能从偏好分布的改善中获益。相反，如果固定平均偏好，与高偏好政治精英相关的偏好差异越大，对中等偏好选民越有利，但当选民风险厌恶程度较高时，则可能对大多数选民造成伤害。接下来，我们考虑了利益集团或活动人士寻找具有更好能力的候选人。我们为以下直觉性猜想提供了完整的理论解释：当利益集团和活动人士拥有更极端的意识形态时，政策会更加极端，而这种极端主义会降低所有选民的福利。

abstract.text: Quantile regression (QR) is an increasingly important empirical tool in economics and other sciences for analysing the impact a set of regressors has on the conditional distribution of an outcome. Extremal QR, or QR applied to the tails, is of interest in many economic and financial applications, such as conditional value at risk, production efficiency, and adjustment bands in (S,s) models. This paper provides feasible inference tools for extremal conditional quantile models that rely on extreme value approximations to the distribution of self-normalized QR statistics. The methods are simple to implement and can be of independent interest even in the univariate (non-regression) case. We illustrate the results with two empirical examples analysing extreme fluctuations of a stock return and extremely low percentiles of live infant birthweight in the range between 250 and 1500 g.

10.1093/restud/rdq020.abstractZh: 分位数回归是经济学及其他科学领域中一种日益重要的实证工具，用于分析一组回归变量对结果条件分布的影响。极端分位数回归，或应用于尾部分布的分位数回归，在许多经济和金融领域具有应用价值，例如条件价值风险、生产效率，以及(S,s)模型中的调整区间。本文为依赖极端值近似方法来估计自标准化分位数统计量的极端条件分位数模型提供了可行的推断工具。这些方法实施起来相对简单，即使在单变量（非回归）情况下也能产生独立的学术价值。我们通过两个实证案例来说明这些结果，这两个案例分别分析了股票回报的极端波动以及活体婴儿出生体重在250至1500克之间的极低百分位数。

abstract.text: Preemption games are widely used to model economic problems such as patent races. We introduce private information into these games and allow for this information to stochastically change over time. This reflects, e.g. how R&D competitors improve their innovations over time and keep these innovations secret before patenting them. The analysis initially appears intractable because of the complexity of the equilibrium updating of beliefs on opponents' information. However, we demonstrate the existence of a class of equilibria and calculate these equilibria in closed form. We find that the expected durations in these equilibria are longer than when players' information is public but, in some cases, shorter than in the collusive outcome. Hence, R&D secrecy slows down innovation disclosure.

10.1093/restud/rdq021.abstractZh: 预购博弈被广泛用于模拟诸如专利竞争等经济问题。我们将私人信息引入这些博弈中，并允许这些信息随时间随机变化。这反映了例如研发竞争者如何随着时间改进创新，并在专利之前对这些创新进行保密。由于对手信息上信念更新的复杂性，初步分析似乎难以解决。然而，我们证明了存在一类均衡，并能够以封闭形式计算这些均衡。我们发现，在这些均衡中，预期持续时间比信息公开的情景要长，但在某些情况下，则比共谋结果要短。因此，研发保密行为会减缓创新的公开程度。

abstract.text: This paper examines the Faustian dynamics of policy and power. We posit a general class of dynamic games in which current policies affect the future distribution of political power, resulting in the following “Faustian trade-off”: if the current ruler chooses his preferred policy, he then sacrifices future political power; yet if he wants to preserve his future power, he must sacrifice his present policy objectives. The trade-off comes from the fact that the current political ruler/pivotal voter cannot uncouple the direct effect of his policy from its indirect effect on future power. A policy-endogenous (PE) equilibrium describes this endogenous transfer of power and the resulting evolution of policy and political power over time. We show that the Faustian trade-off in a PE equilibrium is decomposed into two basic rationales. The political preservation effect induces more tempered policy choices than if one's policy choice did not affect one's political fortunes. However, the reformation effect induces “more aggressive” policies in order to exploit the productivity gains from policies chosen by even more aggressive successors. We distinguish between political systems that give rise to monotone Faustian dynamics—political power that progressively evolves towards more fiscally liberal types of leaders—and cyclical Faustian dynamics—political power that oscillates between liberal and conservative types of leaders. In each case, we show that the Faustian trade-off moderates the choices of each type of leader.

10.1093/restud/rdq022.abstractZh: 本文探讨了政策与权力之间的“浮士德式”动态关系。我们提出了一类动态博弈模型，其中当前的政策会影响未来政治权力的分配，从而形成所谓的“浮士德式权衡”：如果现任统治者选择自己偏好的政策，那么他就会牺牲未来的政治权力；而如果他希望保留未来的权力，就必须牺牲当前的政策目标。这种权衡源于当前的政治统治者/关键选民无法将政策的直接影响与其对未来权力的影响分离开来。政策内生均衡描述了这种权力的内生转移以及政策与政治权力随时间演变的过程。我们指出，在政策内生均衡中，浮士德式权衡可以分解为两个基本理由：政治保留效应促使政策选择更加谨慎，因为政策选择不会影响个人的政治命运；而改革效应则促使政策选择更加激进，以便利用更激进的继任者所采取的政策带来的生产力提升。我们区分了两种浮士德式动态：一种是单调的浮士德式动态，即政治权力逐渐向更财政自由类型的领导人演变；另一种是周期性浮士德式动态，即政治权力在自由派和保守派类型的领导人之间波动。在每种情况下，我们均发现浮士德式权衡都调节了不同类型领导人的选择。

abstract.text: Which decision rules are the most efficient? Which are the best in terms of maximin or maximax? We study these questions for the case of a group of individuals faced with a collective choice from a set of alternatives. A key message from our results is that the set of optimal decision rules is well defined, particularly simple, and well known: the class of scoring rules. We provide the optimal scoring rules for the three different ideals of justice under consideration: utilitarianism (efficiency), maximin, and maximax. The optimal utilitarian scoring rule depends crucially on the probability distribution of the utilities. The optimal maximin (respectively maximax) scoring rule takes the optimal utilitarian scoring rule and applies a factor that shifts it towards negative voting (respectively plurality voting).

10.1093/restud/rdq023.abstractZh: 哪些决策规则最为高效？在最大化最小值或最大化最大值方面，哪些规则最为理想？我们研究了在个体群体面临一系列替代方案时的决策问题。我们的研究结果表明，最优决策规则是明确且简单的，即得分规则类。我们为所考虑的三种不同的正义理想提供了最优的得分规则：功利主义（效率）、最大化最小值和最大化最大值。最优的功利主义得分规则在很大程度上取决于效用的概率分布。而最优的最大化最小值（或最大化最大值）得分规则则是将最优的功利主义得分规则进行调整，使其倾向于负投票（或多数投票）。

abstract.text: I examine a model of a uniform price auction of a perfectly divisible good with private information in which the bidders submit discrete bidpoints rather than continuous downward sloping demand functions. I characterize necessary conditions for equilibrium bidding. The characterization reveals a close relationship between bidding in multiunit auctions and oligopolistic behaviour. I demonstrate that a recently proposed indirect approach to the revenue comparisons of discriminatory and uniform price auctions is not valid if bid functions have steps. In particular, bidders may bid above their marginal valuation in a uniform price auction. In order to demonstrate that discrete bidding can have important consequences for empirical analysis I use my model to examine a data set consisting of individual bids in uniform price treasury auctions of the Czech government. I propose an alternative method for evaluating the performance of the employed mechanism. My results suggest that the uniform price auction performs well, both in terms of efficiency of the allocation and in terms of revenue maximization. I estimate that the employed mechanism failed to extract at most 3 basis points in terms of the annual yield of T-bills worth of expected surplus while implementing an allocation resulting in almost all the efficient surplus. Failing to account for discreteness of bids would in my application result in overestimating the unextracted revenue by more than 50%.

10.1093/restud/rdq024.abstractZh: 我研究了一个关于完全可分割物品的均匀价格拍卖模型，其中存在私人信息。在这种拍卖中，竞拍者提交的是离散的竞标点，而不是连续的下降需求函数。我描述了均衡竞拍的必要条件。这些描述揭示了多单位拍卖中的竞拍行为与寡头行为之间的密切关系。我证明，如果竞标函数存在阶梯状变化，那么最近提出的用于比较歧视性拍卖和均匀价格拍卖的间接方法就不适用了。具体来说，竞拍者可能会在均匀价格拍卖中出价高于其边际估值。为了证明离散竞标对实证分析可能具有重要意义，我使用我的模型来研究捷克政府均匀价格国债拍卖中的个体竞标数据。我提出了一种评估所采用机制性能的替代方法。我的结果表明，均匀价格拍卖在分配效率以及收入最大化方面都表现良好。我估计，所采用的机制在分配几乎全部有效收益的情况下，未能从国债的年度收益中提取最多3个基点。在我的应用中，如果忽略竞标的离散性，会导致高估未提取的收入超过50%。

abstract.text: We analyse a two-player game of strategic experimentation with two-armed bandits. Either player has to decide in continuous time whether to use a safe arm with a known pay-off or a risky arm whose expected pay-off per unit of time is initially unknown. This pay-off can be high or low and is negatively correlated across players. We characterize the set of all Markov perfect equilibria in the benchmark case where the risky arms are known to be of opposite type and construct equilibria in cut-off strategies for arbitrary negative correlation. All strategies and pay-offs are in closed form. In marked contrast to the case where both risky arms are of the same type, there always exists an equilibrium in cut-off strategies, and there always exists an equilibrium exhibiting efficient long-run patterns of learning. These results extend to a three-player game with common knowledge that exactly one risky arm is of the high pay-off type.

10.1093/restud/rdq025.abstractZh: 我们分析了一个双玩家博弈，该博弈涉及双臂双塔策略实验。每个玩家必须在连续时间内决定使用收益已知的低风险臂还是收益未知的高风险臂。这种收益可能是高的也可能是低的，并且不同玩家之间的收益呈负相关。我们描述了在风险臂类型已知且相反的情况下所有马尔可夫完美均衡的集合，并构建了对于任意负相关性情况下的截断策略均衡。所有策略和收益都可以通过封闭形式得到表达。与两个风险臂类型相同的情况相比，总是存在截断策略均衡，并且总是存在能够展示有效长期学习模式的均衡。这些结果也适用于三个玩家博弈的情况，其中有一个风险臂属于高收益类型，而其他风险臂的类型是已知的。

abstract.text: We study competitive market outcomes in economies where agents have other-regarding preferences (ORPs). We identify a separability condition on monotone preferences that is necessary and sufficient for one's own demand to be independent of the allocations and characteristics of other agents in the economy. Given separability, it is impossible to identify ORPs from market behaviour: agents behave as if they had classical preferences that depend only on own consumption in competitive equilibrium. If preferences, in addition, depend only on the final allocation of consumption in society, the Second Welfare Theorem holds as long as any increase in resources can be distributed in a way that makes all agents better off. The First Welfare Theorem generally does not hold. Allowing agents to care about their own consumption and the distribution of consumption possibilities in the economy, the competitive equilibria are efficient given prices if and only if there is no Pareto-improving redistribution of income.

10.1093/restud/rdq026.abstractZh: 我们研究了在存在相互偏好关系的经济中的竞争市场结果。我们确定了单调偏好的一个分离条件，该条件对于 자신의需求独立于经济中其他代理人的分配和特征来说是必要的且充分的。在分离条件下，无法从市场行为中识别出相互偏好关系：在竞争均衡中，代理人表现得好像他们只有依赖于自身消费的经典偏好。如果偏好还仅依赖于社会中的最终消费分配，那么只要任何资源的增加都能使所有代理人的状况得到改善，第二福利定理就成立。而第一福利定理通常不成立。如果允许代理人关心自身的消费以及经济中消费机会的分配，那么竞争均衡在给定价格的情况下是有效的，当且仅当没有能够改善帕累托效率的再分配行为时。

abstract.text: We build a game-theoretic model where aggression can be triggered by domestic political concerns as well as the fear of being attacked. In the model, leaders of full and limited democracies risk losing power if they do not stand up to threats from abroad. In addition, the leader of a fully democratic country loses the support of the median voter if he attacks a non-hostile country. The result is a non-monotonic relationship between democracy and peace. Using Polity data, we classify countries as full democracies, limited democracies, and dictatorships. For the period 1816–2000, Correlates of War data suggest that limited democracies are more aggressive than other regime types, including dictatorships, and not only during periods when the political regime is changing. In particular, a dyad of limited democracies is more likely to be involved in a militarized dispute than any other dyad (including “mixed” dyads, where the two countries have different regime types). Thus, while full democratization might advance the cause of peace, limited democratization might advance the cause of war. We also find that as the environment becomes more hostile, fully democratic countries become more aggressive faster than other regime types.

10.1093/restud/rdq027.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个博弈论模型，其中侵略行为可能由国内政治问题以及被攻击的恐惧所引发。在该模型中，无论是完全民主国家还是有限民主国家，如果无法应对来自国外的威胁，其领导人都有可能失去权力。此外，如果一个完全民主国家的领导人攻击一个非敌对国家，那么该国家的领导人也会失去中等选民的支持。这一结果表明，民主与和平之间存在着非单调关系。利用Polity数据，我们将各国分类为完全民主国家、有限民主国家和独裁国家。在1816年至2000年期间，《战争相关因素》数据显示，有限民主国家比其他政权类型（包括独裁国家）更具侵略性，而且这种侵略性不仅出现在政治体制发生变革的时期。特别是，两个有限民主国家组成的组合比任何其他组合（包括“混合”组合，即两个国家具有不同政体类型）更容易卷入军事冲突。因此，虽然完全民主化可能促进和平，但有限民主化则可能促进战争。我们还发现，随着环境变得更加敌对，完全民主国家比其他政权类型更快地表现出侵略性。

abstract.text: The Pareto-like tail of the size distribution of firms can arise from random growth of productivity or stochastic accumulation of capital. If the shocks that give rise to firm growth are perfectly correlated within a firm, then the growth rates of small and large firms are equally volatile, contrary to what is found in the data. If firm growth is the result of many independent shocks within a firm, it can take hundreds of years for a few large firms to emerge. This paper describes an economy with both types of shocks that can account for the thick-tailed firm size distribution, high entry and exit rates, and the relatively young age of large firms. The economy is one in which aggregate growth is driven by the creation of new products by both new and incumbent firms. Some new firms have better ideas than others and choose to implement those ideas at a more rapid pace. Eventually, such firms slow down when the quality of their ideas reverts to the mean. As in the data, average growth rates in a cross section of firms will appear to be independent of firm size, for all but the smallest firms.

10.1093/restud/rdq028.abstractZh: 企业规模分布的帕累托尾部可能源于生产力的随机增长或资本的随机积累。如果导致企业增长的冲击在企业内部完全相关，那么小型和大型企业的增长率都会同样不稳定，这与数据中的情况相反。如果企业增长是由企业内部多种独立冲击共同作用的结果，那么少数大型企业可能需要数百年才能出现。本文描述了一个包含这两种类型冲击的经济体系，这种体系可以解释企业规模分布呈厚尾状、企业进入和退出率较高以及大型企业相对年轻的现象。在这个经济体系中，总体增长是由新企业和现有企业共同创造新产品所推动的。一些新企业拥有比其他人更好的想法，并选择以更快的速度实施这些想法。最终，当这些企业的想法质量恢复到平均水平时，它们的增长速度就会放缓。正如数据所示，在企业的横截面上，平均增长率似乎与企业的规模无关，除了最小的那些企业。

abstract.text: The “new classical” theory states that families in low-skill occupations with low levels of human capital can stay poor from one generation to the next, while families in high-skill occupations with correspondingly high levels of human capital stay wealthy, despite being endowed with the same level of ability on average. This paper proposes an informal institutional mechanism—the community-based network—through which families belonging to the same neighbourhood or kinship group can bootstrap their way out of such low-skill occupational traps. The insight from the dynamic model that is developed is that once they form, new networks providing mutual support to their members and substituting for inherited parental human capital and wealth will strengthen most rapidly in historically disadvantaged communities, generating a correspondingly high level of intergenerational mobility. These predictions are successfully tested using unique data from India. The analysis in this paper, coupled with an emerging empirical literature on networks and migration, provides a new perspective on mobility in developing countries, with restrictive traditional networks decaying even as new networks supporting collective mobility form and strengthen over time.

10.1093/restud/rdq029.abstractZh: “新古典”理论认为，低技能职业的家庭由于人力资本水平较低，可能会一代又一代地保持贫困状态，而高技能职业的家庭则能够保持富裕，尽管它们的平均能力水平相同。本文提出了一个非正式的制度机制——基于社区的网络——通过这种机制，属于同一社区或亲属群体的家庭可以摆脱低技能职业带来的困境。动态模型表明，一旦这种网络形成，为成员提供相互支持、替代继承的父辈人力资本和财富的新网络，在历史上处于劣势的社区中发展得最为迅速，从而显著提高代际流动性。这些预测通过印度独特的数据得到了验证。本文的分析，结合关于网络和迁移的实证文献，为发展中国家的人口流动提供了新的视角。在传统的限制性网络逐渐瓦解的同时，支持集体流动的新网络会随着时间的推移不断形成并加强。

abstract.text: The higher legislative success of parliamentary governments relative to presidential governments has been used to argue that legislative success is driven by parliamentary governments' superior agenda power or their control of legislative majorities. We show that this approach is at odds with some of the empirical regularities across and within political systems. We then propose a legislative bargaining model to elucidate this puzzle. In the model, the policies of a confidence-dependent parliamentary government enjoy more predictable support from governing coalition members because their short-term policy goals are less important than the government's survival. Coalition support is stronger when the government has more agenda power and is weaker with a larger ruling coalition. We explore the empirical implications of these findings and their consequences for the comparative study of legislative institutions.

10.1093/restud/rdq030.abstractZh: 议会政府相对于总统政府的立法成功程度较高，这一事实常被用来论证立法成功是由议会政府的议程优势或其对立法多数的控制所驱动的。然而，我们发现这种方法与一些政治体系内部及不同政治体系之间的实证规律相矛盾。因此，我们提出了一个立法谈判模型来阐释这一谜题。在该模型中，依赖信任的议会政府的政策能够获得执政联盟成员更可预测的支持，因为其短期政策目标不如政府的生存重要。当政府拥有更多的议程优势时，联盟支持会更强；而当执政联盟规模较大时，联盟支持则会减弱。我们探讨了这些发现的实证意义及其对立法制度比较研究的启示。

abstract.text: I present a sticky-wage model of exchange rate pass-through with heterogeneous producers and endogenous markups. The model shows that low levels of exchange rate pass-through to firm- and aggregate-level import prices coexist with large movements in trade flows. After an exchange rate shock, aggregate import prices are subject to a composition bias due to changes in the extensive margin of trade (the number of goods traded between countries). At the firm level, each producer adjusts its markups depending on its own productivity and the change in the competitive environment generated by the exchange rate movement. Firm-level price responses are asymmetric—different for appreciations and depreciations—and adjustments in the intensive margin of trade (firm-level exports) are substantial. In general equilibrium, the model shows that firm reallocations increase the persistence of exogenous shocks.

10.1093/restud/rdq031.abstractZh: 我提出了一个具有异质生产者和内生加成率的汇率传递粘性工资模型。该模型表明，汇率对企业和整体层面的进口价格存在较低的传递效应，同时贸易流量会出现较大波动。在汇率冲击之后，整体进口价格会因贸易广度的变化而受到偏向性影响。在企业层面，每个生产者会根据自身生产效率和汇率变动带来的竞争环境变化来调整其加成率。企业层面的价格反应是不对称的——升值和贬值时的反应不同——并且贸易密集型边际（企业出口）的调整幅度较大。在一般均衡条件下，该模型表明企业的重新分配行为增强了外部冲击的持续性。

abstract.text: This paper demonstrates the existence and robustness of partially revealing rational expectations equilibria in general exchange economies when some traders have non-smooth ambiguity-averse preferences. This finding illustrates that models with non-smooth ambiguity aversion provide a relatively tractable framework through which partial information revelation may be studied in a general equilibrium setting without relying on particular distributional or von Neumann–Morgenstern utility assumptions or the presence of “noise.”

10.1093/restud/rdq032.abstractZh: 本文证明了在一般交换经济中，当部分交易者具有非平滑的厌恶模糊性偏好时，部分揭示的理性预期均衡的存在性和稳健性。这一发现表明，具有非平滑厌恶模糊性的模型提供了一个相对可行的框架，通过这一框架可以在一般均衡环境中研究部分信息揭示现象，而无需依赖特定的分布假设或冯·诺伊曼-摩根斯坦效用假设，也无需考虑“噪声”的存在。

abstract.text: The paper studies procurement contracts with pre-project investigations in the presence of adverse selection and moral hazard. To model the procurer's problem, we extend a standard sequential screening model to endogenous information acquisition with moral hazard. The optimal contract displays systematic distortions in information acquisition.
