Due to a rent effect, adverse selection induces too much information acquisition to prevent cost overruns and too little information acquisition to prevent false project cancellations. Moral hazard mitigates the distortions related to cost overruns yet exacerbates those related to false negatives. The optimal mechanism is a menu of option contracts that achieves the dual goal of providing incentives for information acquisition and truthful information revelation.

10.1093/restud/rdq033.abstractZh: 本文研究了在逆向选择和道德风险存在的情况下，通过项目前期调查来签订采购合同的问题。为了建模采购方的问题，我们将标准的顺序筛选模型扩展为包含道德风险的内生信息获取模型。最优合同在信息获取方面表现出系统性扭曲。由于租金效应，逆向选择导致信息获取过多，以防止成本超支；而信息获取过少则无法防止项目被错误取消。道德风险可以缓解与成本超支相关的扭曲，但会加剧与错误拒绝相关的扭曲。最优机制是一系列选择合同，这些合同能够实现激励信息获取和真实信息披露的双重目标。

abstract.text: Assortative matching between workers and firms provides evidence of the complementarities or substitutes in production. The presence of complementarities is important for policies that aim to achieve the optimal allocation of resources, e.g. unemployment insurance. We argue that using wage data alone, it is virtually impossible to identify whether assortative matching is positive or negative. Even though we cannot identify the sign of the sorting, we can identify the strength, i.e. the magnitude of the cross-partial and the associated welfare loss. We first show that the wage for a given worker is non-monotonic in the type of his employer. This is due to the fact that in a sorting model, wages reflect the opportunity cost of mismatch. We analytically show that this non-monotonicity prevents standard firm fixed effects to correlate with the true type of the firm. We then propose an alternative procedure that measures the strength of sorting in the presence of search frictions. Knowing the strength of sorting facilitates the measurement of the output loss due to mismatch.

10.1093/restud/rdq034.abstractZh: 工人与企业之间的匹配关系体现了生产中的互补性或替代性。互补性的存在对于实现资源最优分配的政策至关重要，例如失业保险。我们认为，仅依靠工资数据几乎无法判断匹配关系是正向还是负向。尽管我们无法确定排序的符号，但可以确定其强度，即不同部门之间的匹配程度以及由此导致的福利损失。我们首先发现，特定工人的工资与其雇主类型之间存在非单调性。这是因为在排序模型中，工资反映了不匹配的机会成本。我们通过分析表明，这种非单调性使得标准的企业固定效应无法与企业的真实类型相关联。随后，我们提出了一种替代方法，用于衡量存在搜寻摩擦情况下的排序强度。了解排序强度有助于衡量由于不匹配而导致的产出损失。

abstract.text: Economic models employ assumptions about agents ’ infinite hierarchies of belief. We might hope to achieve reasonable approximations by specifying only finitely many levels in the hierarchy. However, it is well known since Rubinstein (1989) that the behaviors of some fully specified hierarchies can be very different from the behavior of such finite approximations. Examples and earlier results in the literature suggest that these critical types are characterized by some strong assumptions on higher-order beliefs. We formalize this connection. We define a critical type to be any hierarchy at which the rationalizable correspondence exhibits a discontinuity. We show that critical types are precisely those types for which there is common belief in a certain class of event. All types from finite type spaces and almost all types in common prior type spaces are critical. On the other hand, we show that regular types, i.e. types which exhibit no discontinuities, are generic. In particular they form a residual set in the product topology. This second result strengthens a previous one due to Weinstein and Yildiz (2006) in two ways. First, while Weinstein and Yildiz (2006) considered a fixed game, our regular types have continuous behavior across all games. Second, our result applies to an arbitrary space of basic uncertainty and does not require the rich-fundamentals assumption employed by Weinstein and Yildiz (2006). Our proofs involve a novel characterization of the strategic topology first introduced by Dekel, Fudenberg, and Morris (2006a). 1.

10.1093/restud/rdq035.abstractZh: 经济模型基于关于代理人无限层次信念的假设。我们或许希望通过仅指定层次结构中的有限多个层次来实现合理的近似。然而，自Rubinstein（1989年）以来，人们已经知道，某些完全指定的层次结构的行为与这种有限近似的行为会有很大差异。文献中的例子和早期结果表明，这些关键类型的特点是对高阶信念有一些强假设。我们将这种联系形式化。我们将关键类型定义为任何在可理性对应关系中表现出不连续性的层次结构。我们证明，关键类型正是那些在某一类事件上存在共同信念的类型。从有限类型空间中的所有类型，以及几乎所有在共同先验类型空间中的类型都是关键类型。另一方面，我们证明，常规类型，即不表现出不连续性的类型，是普遍存在的。特别地，它们在乘积拓扑中构成了一个剩余集合。这一结果在两个方面加强了Weinstein和Yildiz（2006年）之前的研究。首先，虽然Weinstein和Yildiz（2006年）考虑的是固定游戏，但我们的常规类型在所有游戏中都具有连续行为。其次，我们的结果适用于任意的基本不确定性空间，并且不需要Weinstein和Yildiz（2006年）所采用的丰富基础假设。我们的证明涉及了一种由Dekel、Fudenberg和Morris（2006a）首次提出的战略拓扑的新表征方法。

abstract.text: To analyse the role that the World Trade Organization (WTO) plays in enforcing international trade agreements, this paper first explores what countries can achieve alone by characterizing optimal private trigger strategies (PTS) under which each country triggers a punishment phase by imposing an explicit tariff based on privately observed imperfect signals of the other country's concealed trade barriers. It identifies the condition under which countries can restrain the use of concealed barriers based on PTS and establishes that countries will not reduce the cooperative protection level to its minimum attainable level under the optimal PTS. This paper then considers third-party trigger strategies (TTS) under which the WTO allows each country to initiate a punishment phase based on the WTO's judgement about potential violations. By comparing the optimal PTS and optimal TTS, it demonstrates that the WTO facilitates a better cooperative equilibrium by changing the nature of punishment-triggering signals from private to public, which in turn enables countries to use a more efficient punishment, such as an asymmetric and a minimum punishment.

10.1093/restud/rdq036.abstractZh: 本文旨在分析世界贸易组织（WTO）在执行国际贸易协定中的作用。首先，本文探讨了各国单独实施最优私人触发策略所能取得的成果。在这种策略下，每个国家根据其他国家隐藏的贸易壁垒的不完全信号，通过实施明确的关税来触发惩罚阶段。文章指出了各国在何种条件下可以限制隐藏壁垒的使用，并证明在最优私人触发策略下，各国的合作保护水平不会降至最低可达水平。随后，本文考虑了第三方触发策略，即WTO允许各国根据其对潜在违规行为的判断来启动惩罚阶段。通过比较最优私人触发策略与最优第三方触发策略，文章表明WTO通过将惩罚触发信号的性质从私人转向公共，从而促进了更好的合作均衡，使各国能够采用更有效的惩罚措施，如不对称惩罚和最低惩罚。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the relationship between media bias and the influence of the media on voting in the context of newspaper endorsements. We first develop a simple econometric model in which voters choose candidates under uncertainty and rely on endorsements from better informed sources. Newspapers are potentially biased in favour of one of the candidates and voters thus rationally account for the credibility of any endorsements. Our primary empirical finding is that endorsements are influential in the sense that voters are more likely to support the recommended candidate after publication of the endorsement. The degree of this influence, however, depends upon the credibility of the endorsement. In this way, endorsements for the Democratic candidate from left-leaning newspapers are less influential than are endorsements from neutral or right-leaning newspapers and likewise for endorsements for the Republican. We also find that endorsements are more influential among moderate voters and those more likely to be exposed to the endorsement. In sum, these findings suggest that voters do rely on the media for information during campaigns but that the extent of this reliance depends upon the degree and direction of any bias.

10.1093/restud/rdq037.abstractZh: 本文探讨了媒体偏见与媒体对投票影响之间的关系，重点关注报纸推荐在选举中的作用。我们首先建立了一个简单的计量经济模型，其中选民在不确定性下选择候选人，并依赖来自更可靠来源的推荐。报纸可能倾向于支持某一候选人，因此选民会理性地考虑任何推荐的可信度。我们的主要实证发现是，推荐在某种程度上具有影响力，即选民在看到推荐后更有可能支持被推荐的候选人。然而，这种影响力的程度取决于推荐的可信度。例如，来自左倾报纸的民主党候选人推荐的影响较小，而来自中立或右倾报纸的推荐则具有更大的影响力。我们还发现，推荐对温和选民以及那些更容易接触到推荐信息的选民来说更具影响力。总之，这些发现表明，选民确实依赖媒体获取竞选信息，但这种依赖的程度取决于媒体的偏见程度和方向。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effect of the early childhood environment on a large array of social and economic outcomes lasting almost 60 years. To do this, we exploit variation in the living conditions experienced by Yemenite children after being airlifted to Israel in 1949. We find that children who were placed in a more modern environment (i.e. with better sanitary and infrastructure conditions) were more likely to obtain higher education, marry at an older age, have fewer children, and work at age 55. They were also more likely to be assimilated into Israeli society, to be less religious, and have more worldly tastes in music and food. However, these effects are found mainly for women and not for men. We also find an effect on the next generation—children who lived in a better environment grew up to have children with more education.

10.1093/restud/rdq038.abstractZh: 本文估计了幼儿时期环境对长达近60年的各种社会和经济结果的影响。为此，我们利用了1949年也门儿童被空运至以色列后所经历的生活条件差异。研究发现，生活在更现代化环境中的儿童更有可能接受高等教育，在较年长的年龄结婚，生育子女数量较少，并在55岁时开始工作。这些儿童也更有可能融入以色列社会，宗教观念较为淡薄，在音乐和食物方面则具有更世俗的品味。然而，这些影响主要出现在女性身上，而非男性。我们还发现，这种影响会延续到下一代——生活在更好环境中的儿童会培养出受教育程度更高的子女。

abstract.text: We study dynamic incentives and behaviour in markets with costly discovery of past transactions. In our model, a sequence of short-lived customers interact over time with a single long-lived firm that privately knows its type (good or opportunistic). Customers must pay to observe the firm's past behaviour. We characterize the equilibrium structure that features accumulation, consumption, and restoration of reputation. The opportunistic firm deliberately builds its reputation up to a point where the maximum periods of information acquired by customers do not reveal past opportunistic behaviour and exploits the customers who most trust the firm.

10.1093/restud/rdq039.abstractZh: 我们研究了在需要耗费资源去了解过去交易行为的市场中的动态激励与行为。在我们的模型中，一系列短暂存在的顾客与一家长期存在的企业互动，而企业本身私下知道自己的类型（是诚信的还是机会主义的）。顾客必须支付费用来观察企业的过往行为。我们描述了一种均衡结构，其中包含了声誉的积累、消费以及恢复。机会主义的企业会刻意提升自己的声誉，直到顾客获取的信息最多也无法揭示其过去的机会主义行为，从而能够利用那些最信任该企业的顾客。

abstract.text: This paper provides a new, empirically driven application of the dynamic Mirrleesian framework by studying a feasible and potentially powerful tax reform: age-dependent labour income taxation. I show analytically how age dependence improves policy on both the intratemporal and intertemporal margins. I use detailed numerical simulations, calibrated with data from the U.S. Panel Study of Income Dynamics, to generate robust policy implications: age dependence (1) lowers marginal taxes on average and especially on high-income young workers and (2) lowers average taxes on all young workers relative to older workers when private saving and borrowing are restricted. Finally, I calculate and characterize the welfare gains from age dependence. Despite its simplicity, age dependence generates a welfare gain equal to between 0·6% and 1·5% of aggregate annual consumption, and it captures more than 60% of the gain from reform to the dynamic optimal policy. The gains are due to substantial increases in both efficiency and equity. When age dependence is restricted to be Pareto improving, the welfare gain is nearly as large.

10.1093/restud/rdr001.abstractZh: 本文通过研究一种可行且可能具有影响力的税收改革方案——基于年龄的劳动力收入征税，为动态Mirrleesian框架提供了一种新的、基于实证的应用方法。我们从分析角度展示了年龄依赖性如何改善政策效果，无论是在同一时期还是跨时期。我们采用详细的数值模拟方法，并结合美国收入动态研究的数据进行校准，以得出稳健的政策建议：年龄依赖性（1）降低了平均收入以及高收入年轻工人的边际税收；（2）在私人储蓄和借贷受限的情况下，降低了所有年轻工人的平均税收。最后，我们计算并描述了年龄依赖性带来的福利收益。尽管这种方案较为简单，但它带来的福利收益相当于总年消费量的0.6%到1.5%，并且这一收益占了对动态最优政策进行改革所带来的收益的60%以上。这些收益源于效率和公平性的显著提升。当年龄依赖性被限制为帕累托改进时，福利收益几乎与前者相当。

abstract.text: Using Norwegian register data, we estimate how children's school performance is affected by their parents' exposure to plant closure. Our estimates suggest that paternal job loss has a negative effect on children's school performance. In contrast, maternal job loss is associated with a non-significant increase in school performance. Importantly, the negative effect of paternal job loss appears largely unrelated to its effect on father's income, father's employment status, a shift in maternal time towards employment, marital dissolution, and residential relocation. A disparate effect of job loss across fathers and mothers is, however, consistent with recent empirical studies documenting that the mental distress experienced by displaced workers is generally more severe for men than women.

10.1093/restud/rdr002.abstractZh: 利用挪威的登记数据，我们研究了父母因工厂关闭而失业对子女学业表现的影响。我们的估计表明，父亲失业会对子女的学业表现产生负面影响。相比之下，母亲失业则与学业表现的非显著提升相关。重要的是，父亲失业的负面影响与其收入、就业状况、母亲就业时间的转移、婚姻破裂以及居住迁移等因素无明显关联。然而，父亲和母亲在失业影响上的差异与近期实证研究结果一致，这些研究指出，失业工人所经历的心理健康问题通常对男性来说更为严重。

abstract.text: The paper studies the effects and the determinants of interregional redistribution in a model of residential and political choice. We find that paradoxical consequences of interjurisdictional transfers arise if people are mobile: while self-sufficient regions are necessarily identical with respect to policies and average incomes in our model, interregional redistribution always leads to the divergence of regional policies and per capita incomes. Thus, interregional redistribution prevents interregional equality. At the same time, however, transfers may allow for more interpersonal equality among the inhabitants of each region. The voting population may therefore in a decision over the fiscal constitution deliberately implement such a transfer scheme to foster regional divergence. Empirical evidence from panel data from OECD countries and Canadian provinces is consistent with the theory.

10.1093/restud/rdr003.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个关于居民和政治选择模型的区域间再分配效应及其决定因素。我们发现，如果人们具有流动性，则会出现区域间转移带来的矛盾结果：在我们的模型中，自给自足的地区在政策和平均收入方面必然是相同的，而区域间再分配总是会导致区域政策和人均收入的差异。因此，区域间再分配实际上阻碍了区域间的平等。然而，同时，这种转移也可能促进各区域内居民之间的平等。因此，在决定财政制度时，投票人群可能会有意实施这样的转移方案，以促进区域间的差异。来自OECD国家和加拿大省份的面板数据的实证结果与该理论一致。

abstract.text: We study the (perfect Bayesian) equilibrium of a sequential learning model over a general social network. Each individual receives a signal about the underlying state of the world, observes the past actions of a stochastically generated neighbourhood of individuals, and chooses one of two possible actions. The stochastic process generating the neighbourhoods defines the network topology. We characterize pure strategy equilibria for arbitrary stochastic and deterministic social networks and characterize the conditions under which there will be asymptotic learning—convergence (in probability) to the right action as the social network becomes large. We show that when private beliefs are unbounded (meaning that the implied likelihood ratios are unbounded), there will be asymptotic learning as long as there is some minimal amount of “expansion in observations”. We also characterize conditions under which there will be asymptotic learning when private beliefs are bounded.

10.1093/restud/rdr004.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个基于一般社交网络的序列学习模型的（完美贝叶斯）均衡问题。每个个体都会收到关于世界状态的信号，观察随机生成的邻域个体的过去行为，并选择两种可能的行动之一。生成邻域的随机过程决定了网络的拓扑结构。我们描述了任意随机和确定性社交网络的纯策略均衡，并确定了在何种条件下会出现渐进学习——即随着社交网络规模的扩大，个体会（概率上）趋向于正确的行动。我们表明，当私人信念是无界的（意味着隐含的似然比也是无界的），只要存在一定程度的“观察扩展”，就会存在渐进学习。我们还描述了在私人信念是有界的情况下，何时会出现渐进学习的条件。

abstract.text: In this paper, I examine ε-equilibria of stationary dynamic economies with heterogeneous agents and possibly incomplete financial markets. I give a simple example to show that even for arbitrarily small ε > 0, allocation and prices can be far away from exact equilibrium allocations and prices. That is, errors in market clearing or individuals' optimality conditions do not provide enough information to assess the quality of an approximation. I derive a sufficient condition for an ε-equilibrium to be close to an exact equilibrium. If the economic fundamentals are semi-algebraic, one can verify computationally whether this condition holds. The condition can be interpreted economically as a robustness requirement on the set of ε-equilibria which form a neighbourhood of the computed approximation. I illustrate the main result and the computational method using an infinite horizon economy with overlapping generations and incomplete financial markets.

10.1093/restud/rdr005.abstractZh: 在本文中，我研究了具有异质代理人且金融市场可能不完善的静态动态经济系统中的ε-均衡问题。我通过一个简单的例子表明，即使ε>0的值任意小，分配和价格也可能远离精确均衡。也就是说，市场清算或个人最优条件下的误差并不能提供足够的信息来评估近似解的质量。我推导出一个充分条件，使得ε-均衡能够接近精确均衡。如果经济基本变量是半代数的，那么可以通过计算来验证这个条件是否成立。从经济角度来看，这个条件可以被解释为对构成计算得到的近似解的邻域的ε-均衡集合的鲁棒性要求。我通过一个无限时域经济模型来说明主要结果和计算方法，该模型包含重叠世代且金融市场不完善。

abstract.text: We derive a closed-form solution for Tobin's Q in a stochastic dynamic framework. We show analytically that investment is positively related to Tobin's Q and cash flow, even in the absence of adjustment costs or financing frictions. Both Q and investment move in the same direction as expected revenue growth, so changes in expected revenue growth induce Q and investment to comove positively. Similarly, shocks to current cash flow, arising from shocks to the user cost of capital in our model, cause investment and cash flow per unit of capital to comove positively. Furthermore, we show that this alternative mechanism for the relationship among investment, Q, and cash flow delivers larger cash flow effects for smaller- and faster-growing firms, as observed in the data. Moreover, the empirically small sensitivity of investment to Tobin's Q does not imply implausibly large adjustment costs in our model (since there are no adjustment costs). Calibrating the model generates values of Q similar to those in the data; investment is more sensitive to cash flow than it is to Q, and both responses are of empirically plausible magnitudes.

10.1093/restud/rdr006.abstractZh: 我们在随机动态框架中推导出了Tobin's Q的封闭形式解。我们从分析上表明，即使在没有调整成本或融资摩擦的情况下，投资也与Tobin's Q和现金流呈正相关。Q和投资都随着预期收入的增长而同向变动，因此预期收入增长的变化会导致Q和投资同向变动。同样，由于模型中资本使用成本的变动，当前现金流的变动也会导致单位资本的投资和现金流同向变动。此外，我们表明，这种投资、Q和现金流之间关系的替代机制能够为企业带来更大的现金流效应，尤其是在规模较小且增长较快的企业中，这一点在数据中得到了验证。此外，投资对Tobin's Q的敏感性虽然较低，但这并不意味着我们的模型中存在不切实际的巨大调整成本（因为模型中不存在调整成本）。通过校准模型，我们得到的Q值与数据中的值相似；投资对现金流的敏感性高于对Q的敏感性，而且这两种反应的幅度都是符合实际观测结果的。

abstract.text: We analyse information aggregation in a stopping game with uncertain pay-offs that are correlated across players. Players learn from their own private experiences as well as by observing the actions of other players. We give a full characterization of the symmetric mixed strategy equilibrium, and show that information aggregates in randomly occurring exit waves. Observational learning induces the players to stay in the game longer. The equilibria display aggregate randomness even for large numbers of players.

10.1093/restud/rdr007.abstractZh: 我们分析了在具有不确定收益且各参与者之间收益存在相关性的停止博弈中的信息聚合现象。参与者通过自身的私人经验以及观察其他参与者的行为来学习。我们对对称混合策略均衡进行了全面的描述，并表明在随机出现的退出波中，信息聚合会导致参与者在博弈中停留的时间更长。即使参与者的数量很大，均衡仍然表现出聚合的随机性。

abstract.text: We propose a computationally feasible way of deriving the identified features of models with multiple equilibria in pure or mixed strategies. It is shown that in the case of Shapley regular normal form games, the identified set is characterized by the inclusion of the true data distribution within the core of a Choquet capacity, which is interpreted as the generalized likelihood of the model. In turn, this inclusion is characterized by a finite set of inequalities and efficient and easily implementable combinatorial methods are described to check them. In all normal form games, the identified set is characterized in terms of the value of a submodular or convex optimization program. Efficient algorithms are then given and compared to check inclusion of a parameter in this identified set. The latter are illustrated with family bargaining games and oligopoly entry games.

10.1093/restud/rdr008.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种计算上可行的方法，用于推导具有多个纯策略或混合策略均衡的模型的识别特征。研究表明，在Shapley正则正规形式博弈中，识别集合的特征在于真实数据分布被包含在一个Choquet容量核内，该容量被解释为模型的广义似然。这种包含关系由一组有限的不等式来表征，并且描述了高效且易于实施的组合方法来验证这些不等式。在所有正规形式博弈中，识别集合的特征可以通过一个次模或凸优化程序的值来表征。随后给出了高效算法，并对其进行比较，以验证某个参数是否包含在识别集合中。这些算法通过家庭讨价还价博弈和寡头进入博弈进行了说明。

abstract.text: While there is an extensive literature on how economic agents bargain to divide an asset, little is known about the decision to initiate bargaining and how the initiation affects the outcome of bargaining. We address these questions in the context of high-stakes poker tournaments in which the last few players often negotiate the division of the remaining prize money rather than risk playing the tournament to the end. In 63% of the tournaments in our sample players enter into negotiations, and in 31%, they successfully reach an agreement. We find that the identity of the player who initiates bargaining affects whether a deal is completed but does not affect the terms of the eventual deal. The initiator tends to have a weaker than average position at the table, but the likelihood that a deal will be completed increases in the initiator's strength in the game and history of winning past tournaments. These findings indicate that initiating negotiations conveys information that is relevant to whether a deal will emerge. Nevertheless, initiating bargaining does not affect the initiator's pay-off in a completed deal. Lastly, we find strong evidence that bargaining tends to be initiated and is more likely to be successful when participants' stakes are about equal, consistent with the theoretical work of Cramton, Gibbons and Klemperer (1987, “Dissolving a Partnership Efficiently”, Econometrica, 55, 615–632).

10.1093/restud/rdr009.abstractZh: 虽然关于经济主体如何协商分配资产的研究文献很多，但对于是否发起协商的决策以及这种启动行为如何影响协商结果，却知之甚少。我们在高风险扑克锦标赛的背景下探讨了这些问题。在这些锦标赛中，最后几名选手通常会协商剩余奖金的分配，而不是冒险继续比赛直到结束。在我们的样本中，有63%的锦标赛中选手会进行协商，而在31%的锦标赛中，他们成功达成了协议。我们发现，发起协商的选手身份会影响交易是否完成，但不会影响最终交易的条款。发起协商的选手往往处于比平均水平更弱的地位，但交易完成的可能性会随着选手在游戏中的实力以及过去赢得锦标赛的经验而增加。这些发现表明，发起协商可以传递与交易是否达成相关的信息。不过，发起协商并不会影响发起者在完成交易后的收益。最后，我们发现有强有力的证据表明，当参与者的赌注大致相等时，协商更有可能被发起并成功，这与Cramton、Gibbons和Klemperer在1987年发表的《高效解散合作关系》一文中提出的理论观点一致。

abstract.text: We evaluate the effects of a fundamental lever of constitutional design: the duration of public office terms. We present a simple model grounded in interviews with legislators and highlight three forces shaping incentives to exert legislative effort. We exploit two natural experiments in the Argentine Congress (where term lengths were assigned randomly) to ascertain which forces are empirically dominant. Results for separate measures as well as an aggregate index of legislative effort show that longer terms increase effort. Shorter terms appear to discourage effort not due to campaign distractions but due to an investment payback logic: when effort yields returns over multiple periods, longer terms yield a higher chance of capturing those returns. A broader implication is that job stability may promote effort despite making individuals less accountable.

10.1093/restud/rdr010.abstractZh: 我们评估了宪法设计中的一个基本因素——公职任期长度的影响。我们基于与立法者的访谈构建了一个简单模型，并强调了三种影响立法努力的因素。我们通过阿根廷国会的两次自然实验（其中任期长度被随机分配）来确认哪些因素在实证上更为显著。对于单独的指标以及立法努力的综合指数进行分析后发现，较长的任期确实会增加立法努力。较短的任期似乎会抑制努力，但这并非由于竞选活动的干扰，而是出于投资回报的逻辑：当努力在多个时期都能带来回报时，较长的任期更有机会获得这些回报。更广泛的意义是，职位稳定性可能会促进努力，尽管这会使个人承担的责任减少。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the comparative statics of “more ambiguity aversion” as defined by Klibanoff, Marinacci and Mukerji (2005, “A Smooth Model of Decision Making under Ambiguity”, Econometrica, 73 (6), 1849–1892). The analysis uses the static two-asset portfolio problem with one safe asset and one uncertain one. While it is intuitive that more ambiguity aversion would reduce demand for the uncertain asset, this is not necessarily the case. We derive sufficient conditions for a reduction in the demand for the uncertain asset and for an increase in the equity premium. An example that meets the sufficient conditions is when the set of plausible distributions for returns on the uncertain asset can be ranked according to their monotone likelihood ratio. It is also shown how ambiguity aversion distorts the price kernel in the alternative portfolio problem with complete markets for contingent claims.

10.1093/restud/rdr013.abstractZh: 本文研究了Klibanoff、Marinacci和Mukerji（2005年，《在不确定性下的决策制定：一个平滑模型》，Econometrica，73(6)，1849-1892）所定义的“更明显的厌恶”的静态特性。分析采用了一种静态的两资产投资组合问题，其中有一个安全资产和一个不确定资产。虽然直觉上，更明显的厌恶会减少对不确定资产的需求，但实际情况未必如此。我们推导出了需求减少以及股权溢价增加的充分条件。一个满足这些条件的例子是，当不确定资产回报的合理分布可以根据其单调似然比进行排序时。此外，本文还展示了在完全市场条件下，不确定性如何扭曲替代投资组合问题的价格核。

abstract.text: We analyze the cost of quality improvement in hospitals, dealing with two challenges. Hospital quality is multidimensional and hard to measure, while unobserved productivity may influence quality supply. We infer the quality of hospitals in Los Angeles from patient choices. We then incorporate ‘revealed quality’ into a cost function, instrumenting with hospital demand. We find that revealed quality differentiates hospitals, but is not strongly correlated with clinical quality. Revealed quality is quite costly, and tends to increase with hospital productivity. Thus, non-clinical aspects of the hospital experience (perhaps including patient amenities) play important roles in hospital demand, competition, and costs.

10.1111/j.1467-6451.2011.00468.x.abstractZh: 我们分析了医院质量提升的成本，面临两个挑战。医院质量具有多维度且难以衡量，而未观察到的生产力可能会影响质量供给。我们通过患者选择来推断洛杉矶医院的质量。随后，我们将“显性质量”纳入成本函数，并通过医院需求进行工具变量处理。我们发现，显性质量确实能区分不同医院，但与临床质量并无强烈相关性。显性质量的提升成本相当高，且往往随着医院生产力的提高而增加。因此，医院体验中的非临床方面（可能包括患者设施）在医院需求、竞争和成本方面起着重要作用。

abstract.text: Summary We study the influence of social interaction on patients’ choice of hospital and its relationship with the quality that is delivered by hospitals, using Italian data. We explore the effect on individual choices of a set of variables such as travel distance and individual- and hospital-specific characteristics, as well as a variable capturing the effect of the neighbourhood. The richness of our data allows us to disentangle the influence of sharing information (the network) on patients’ choices of hospital from contextual effects. Our empirical investigation suggests that past experience in the utilization of health services by the network plays a significant role in explaining current patients’ choices of hospital. Other relevant factors that influence patients’ decisions of being admitted in a particular hospital are prior use of health services in that hospital, patient-to-hospital distance and supply factors such as the number of beds and number of doctors. We then investigate the relationship between a set of health outcome indicators and the sensitivity of patients’ choices to the network, to test whether sharing information increases the likelihood of selecting a high quality hospital. Our results suggest that social interaction does not have an influence on health outcomes, and in some cases it may even mislead patients, who end up in low quality institutions. One explanation for this result is the absence of a source of information on the quality of hospitals that is accessible to all individuals, such as guidelines or star ratings, which may exacerbate the influence of information that is gathered locally on choices of hospital and may result in a lower degree of competition between hospitals and lower quality.

10.1111/j.1467-985x.2011.01008.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了社会互动对患者选择医院的影响，以及这种影响与医院提供的服务质量之间的关系，研究数据来自意大利。我们探讨了诸如旅行距离、个人及医院特定特征等变量，以及反映社区影响的因素，对个体选择医院的影响。我们数据的丰富性使我们能够区分信息共享（网络）对患者选择医院的影响与情境效应。我们的实证研究表明，网络在医疗服务利用方面的过往经验在解释当前患者选择医院时起着重要作用。其他影响患者决定是否入住特定医院的因素包括在该医院之前的医疗服务使用情况、患者与医院之间的距离，以及供应因素，如床位数量和医生数量。接着，我们研究了一系列健康结果指标与患者选择医院的敏感性之间的关系，以测试信息共享是否会增加选择高质量医院的可能性。我们的结果表明，社会互动对健康结果没有影响，在某些情况下，它甚至可能误导患者，导致他们选择低质量的医院。这一结果的一个解释是，缺乏一个可供所有人获取的医院质量信息来源，例如指南或星级评级，这可能会加剧当地收集的信息对医院选择的影响，从而导致医院之间的竞争程度降低，服务质量下降。

abstract.text: CONTEXT: Hospital cost shifting--charging private payers more in response to shortfalls in public payments--has long been part of the debate over health care policy. Despite the abundance of theoretical and empirical literature on the subject, it has not been critically reviewed and interpreted since Morrisey did so nearly fifteen years ago. Much has changed since then, in both empirical technique and the health care landscape. This article examines the theoretical and empirical literature on cost shifting since 1996, synthesizes the predominant findings, suggests their implications for the future of health care costs, and puts them in the current policy context. METHODS: The relevant literature was identified by database search. Papers describing policies were considered first, since policy shapes the health care market in which cost shifting may or may not occur. Theoretical works were examined second, as theory provides hypotheses and structure for empirical work. The empirical literature was analyzed last in the context of the policy environment and in light of theoretical implications for appropriate econometric specification. FINDINGS: Most of the analyses and commentary based on descriptive, industry-wide hospital payment-to-cost margins by payer provide a false impression that cost shifting is a large and pervasive phenomenon. More careful theoretical and empirical examinations suggest that cost shifting can and has occurred, but usually at a relatively low rate. Margin changes also are strongly influenced by the evolution of hospital and health plan market structures and changes in underlying costs. CONCLUSIONS: Policymakers should view with a degree of skepticism most hospital and insurance industry claims of inevitable, large-scale cost shifting. Although some cost shifting may result from changes in public payment policy, it is just one of many possible effects. Moreover, changes in the balance of market power between hospitals and health care plans also significantly affect private prices. Since they may increase hospitals' market power, provisions of the new health reform law that may encourage greater provider integration and consolidation should be implemented with caution.

10.1111/j.1468-0009.2011.00621.x.abstractZh:
背景：医院成本转移——即因公共支付不足而向私人支付方收取更多费用——长期以来一直是医疗政策讨论的一部分。尽管关于这一主题的理论和实证文献非常丰富，但自Morrisey在近十五年前进行首次系统研究以来，这些文献并未得到严格的审查和解释。自那时以来，无论是实证技术还是医疗领域都发生了许多变化。本文回顾了1996年以来关于成本转移的理论和实证文献，综合了主要的研究成果，探讨了这些研究对医疗成本未来的影响，并将其置于当前的政策背景下。

方法：通过数据库搜索确定了相关文献。首先考虑了描述政策的论文，因为政策决定了成本转移可能发生的医疗市场。其次分析了理论著作，因为理论为实证研究提供了假设和结构。最后，在政策环境的背景下分析了实证文献，并考虑了理论对适当计量经济学模型的规定性影响。

研究结果：大多数基于描述性、全行业医院支付与成本差额的分析和评论，给人一种成本转移是一个普遍且大规模现象的错误印象。更仔细的理论和实证研究表明，成本转移确实发生过，但通常发生频率较低。成本差额的变化也受到医院和医疗计划市场结构的变化以及基础成本变化的影响。

结论：政策制定者应对医院和保险行业关于必然发生大规模成本转移的说法持怀疑态度。虽然一些成本转移可能是由于公共支付政策的变化所导致的，但这只是众多可能的影响之一。此外，医院与医疗保健计划之间的市场力量平衡的变化也会显著影响私人价格。由于这些变化可能会增强医院的市场力量，因此应谨慎实施新医改法中的那些可能促进医疗服务提供者整合和合并的条款。

abstract.text: Recent substantive reforms to the English National Health Service expanded patient choice and encouraged hospitals to compete within a market with fixed prices. This study investigates whether these reforms led to improvements in hospital quality. We use a difference-in-difference-style estimator to test whether hospital quality (measured using mortality from acute myocardial infarction) improved more quickly in more competitive markets after these reforms came into force in 2006. We find that after the reforms were implemented, mortality fell (i.e. quality improved) for patients living in more competitive markets. Our results suggest that hospital competition can lead to improvements in hospital quality.

10.1111/j.1468-0297.2011.02449.x.abstractZh: 最近对英国国家卫生服务的实质性改革扩大了患者的选择范围，并促使医院在固定价格的市场中竞争。本研究旨在探讨这些改革是否提升了医院的服务质量。我们采用差异估计方法，来检验在2006年这些改革实施之后，在竞争更为激烈的市场中，医院的服务质量（以急性心肌梗死导致的死亡率来衡量）是否得到了更快的提升。研究发现，在改革实施后，生活在竞争更为激烈的市场中的患者死亡率有所下降，这表明医院服务质量有所改善。我们的研究结果表明，医院之间的竞争确实能够提升医院的服务质量。

abstract.text: This paper presents a list of the top 20 articles published in the American Economic Review during its first 100 years. This list was assembled in honor of the AER's one-hundredth anniversary by a group of distinguished economists at the request of AER's editor. A brief description accompanies the citations of each article.

10.1257/aer.101.1.1.abstractZh: 本文列出了《美国经济评论》在成立后的前100年中发表的20篇最佳文章。该榜单是由一群杰出的经济学家应《美国经济评论》编辑的要求编制而成的，旨在纪念该杂志成立一百周年。每篇文章的引用后都附有简短的描述。

abstract.text: By extending his data, we document the instability of low-frequency regression coefficients that Lucas (1980) used to express the quantity theory of money. We impute the differences in these regression coefficients to differences in monetary policies across periods. A DSGE model estimated over a subsample like Lucas's implies values of the regression coefficients that confirm Lucas's results for his sample period. But perturbing monetary policy rule parameters away from the values estimated over Lucas's subsample alters the regression coefficients in ways that reproduce their instability over our longer sample. (JEL C51, E23, E31, E43, E51, E52)

10.1257/aer.101.1.109.abstractZh: 通过扩展我们的数据，我们证明了Lucas（1980）用于表达货币数量理论中的低频回归系数存在不稳定性。我们将这些回归系数的差异归因于不同时期之间的货币政策差异。像Lucas那样在子样本上估计的DSGE模型得出的回归系数与Lucas在其样本时期内的结果一致。但是，将货币政策规则参数从Lucas子样本估计的值偏离，会导致回归系数发生变化，这些变化再现了我们在更长样本中所观察到的不稳定性。（JEL C51, E23, E31, E43, E51, E52）

abstract.text: Although experimental studies have documented systematic decision errors, many leading scholars believe that experience, competition, and large stakes will reliably extinguish biases. We test for the presence of a fundamental bias, loss aversion, in a high-stakes context: professional golfers' performance on the PGA Tour. Golf provides a natural setting to test for loss aversion because golfers are rewarded for the total number of strokes they take during a tournament, yet each individual hole has a salient reference point, par. We analyze over 2.5 million putts using precise laser measurements and find evidence that even the best golfers—including Tiger Woods—show evidence of loss aversion. (JEL D03, D81, L83).

10.1257/aer.101.1.129.abstractZh: 尽管实验研究已经记录了系统性的决策错误，但许多顶尖学者认为，经验、竞争和巨大的风险能够可靠地消除偏见。我们在一个高风险的背景下测试了基本偏见——损失厌恶现象是否存在：即职业高尔夫球手在PGA巡回赛中的表现。高尔夫提供了一个天然的测试环境来检验损失厌恶现象，因为高尔夫球手在比赛中的总击球数会得到奖励，然而每个单独的洞都有一个明显的参考点，即标准杆。我们通过精确的激光测量分析了超过250万次推杆动作，发现即使是最优秀的高尔夫球手，包括泰格·伍兹在内，也表现出损失厌恶现象。（JEL D03, D81, L83）

abstract.text: This paper uses age-at-school-entry policies to identify the effect of female education on fertility and infant health. We focus on sharp contrasts in schooling, fertility, and infant health between women born just before and after the school entry date. School entry policies affect female education and the quality of a woman's mate and have generally small, but possibly heterogeneous, effects on fertility and infant health. We argue that school entry policies manipulate primarily the education of young women at risk of dropping out of school.

10.1257/aer.101.1.158.abstractZh: 本文利用入学年龄政策来研究女性教育对生育率和婴儿健康的影响。我们重点关注在入学日期前后出生的女性之间在教育程度、生育率以及婴儿健康方面的显著差异。入学政策会影响女性的教育水平以及其伴侣的质量，并且这些政策对生育率和婴儿健康的影响通常较小，但可能存在差异。我们认为，入学政策主要影响了那些有辍学风险的年轻女性的教育状况。

abstract.text: We construct a growth model consistent with China's economic transition: high output growth, sustained returns on capital, reallocation within the manufacturing sector, and a large trade surplus. Entrepreneurial firms use more productive technologies, but due to financial imperfections they must finance investments through internal savings. State-owned firms have low productivity but survive because of better access to credit markets. High-productivity firms outgrow low-productivity firms if entrepreneurs have sufficiently high savings. The downsizing of financially integrated firms forces domestic savings to be invested abroad, generating a foreign surplus. A calibrated version of the theory accounts quantitatively for China's economic transition. (JEL E21, E22, E23, F43, L60, O16, O53, P23, P24, P31).

10.1257/aer.101.1.196.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个与中国的经济转型相一致的成长模型：高产出增长、资本回报持续上升、制造业内部的重新分配，以及巨大的贸易顺差。创业型企业采用更高效的技术，但由于金融制度的缺陷，它们必须通过内部储蓄来融资。国有企业的生产率较低，但由于能更好地获取信贷市场，它们得以生存。如果企业家拥有足够高的储蓄，高生产率企业就会超越低生产率企业。财务上整合良好的企业规模缩小，迫使国内储蓄被投资到国外，从而产生外汇盈余。该理论的一个校准版本能够定量解释中国的经济转型。（JEL E21, E22, E23, F43, L60, O16, O53, P23, P24, P31）

abstract.text: We assess the importance of nominal rigidities using a new weekly scanner dataset. We find that nominal rigidities take the form of inertia in reference prices and costs, defined as the most common prices and costs within a given quarter. Reference prices are particularly inertial and have an average duration of roughly one year, even though weekly prices change roughly once every two weeks. We document the relation between prices and costs and find sharp evidence of state dependence in prices. We use a simple model to argue that reference prices and costs are useful statistics for macroeconomic analysis. (JEL L11, L25, L81).

10.1257/aer.101.1.234.abstractZh: 我们使用新的每周扫描数据集来评估名义刚性的重要性。我们发现，名义刚性表现为参考价格和成本的惯性，这些价格和成本是指在特定季度内最常见的价格与成本。参考价格具有显著的惯性，其平均持续时间约为一年，尽管每周的价格大约每两周发生变化一次。我们揭示了价格与成本之间的关系，并发现价格中存在明显的状态依赖性。我们通过一个简单的模型论证，参考价格和成本是宏观经济分析中有用的统计指标。（JEL L11, L25, L81）

abstract.text: Multiproduct firms can set separate prices for all possible bundled combinations of its products (“mixed bundling”). However, this is impractical for firms with more than a few products, because the number of prices increases exponentially with the number of products. We find that simple pricing strategies are often nearly optimal. Specifically, we show that bundle-size pricing—setting prices that depend only on the size of bundle purchased—tends to be more profitable than offering the individual products priced separately and tends to closely approximate the profits from mixed bundling. (JEL D24, D42, L11, L13, L25).

10.1257/aer.101.1.263.abstractZh: 多产品企业可以为其产品的所有可能组合（“混合捆绑”）设定不同的价格。然而，对于拥有多个产品的企业来说，这种做法并不实际，因为价格数量会随着产品数量的增加而呈指数级增长。我们发现，简单的定价策略往往是最优的。具体来说，我们表明，根据所购买的捆绑包的大小来设定价格，往往比单独为单个产品定价更有利可图，并且这种定价方式往往能够接近混合捆绑带来的利润水平。（JEL D24, D42, L11, L13, L25）

abstract.text: This paper studies the impact of a regional free trade agreement, MERCOSUR, on technology upgrading by Argentinean firms. To guide empirical work, I introduce technology choice in a model of trade with heterogeneous firms. The joint treatment of the technology and exporting choices shows that the increase in revenues produced by trade integration can induce exporters to upgrade technology. An empirical test of the model reveals that firms in industries facing higher reductions in Brazil's tariffs increase investment in technology faster. The effect of tariffs is highest in the upper-middle range of the firm-size distribution, as predicted by the model. (JEL F13, F15, O19, O24, O33).

10.1257/aer.101.1.304.abstractZh: 本文研究了区域自由贸易协定MERCOSUR对阿根廷企业技术升级的影响。为了指导实证研究，我在一个包含异质企业的贸易模型中引入了技术选择。对技术和出口选择的联合处理表明，贸易一体化带来的收入增长可以促使出口商升级技术。模型的实证检验显示，在巴西关税降低幅度较大的行业中，企业投资技术的速度更快。正如模型所预测的，关税的影响在企业规模分布的中高端范围内最为显著。（JEL F13, F15, O19, O24, O33）

abstract.text: With positive trend inflation, the Taylor principle does not guarantee a determinate equilibrium. We provide new theoretical results on determinacy in New Keynesian models with positive trend inflation and new empirical findings on the Federal Reserve's reaction function before and after the Volcker disinflation to find that, (i) while the Fed likely satisfied the Taylor principle before Volcker, the US economy was still subject to self-fulfilling fluctuations in the 1970s, (ii) the US economy switched to determinacy during the Volcker disinflation, and (iii) the switch reflected changes in the Fed's response to macroeconomic variables and the decline in trend inflation. (JEL E12, E23, E31, E32, E52)

10.1257/aer.101.1.341.abstractZh: 在通胀呈上升趋势的情况下，泰勒原则并不能保证一个确定的均衡状态。我们为具有上升趋势通胀的新凯恩斯模型提供了关于确定性的新理论结果，并获得了关于美联储在沃尔克紧缩政策前后反应函数的新实证发现。研究发现：(i) 在沃尔克之前，美联储可能满足了泰勒原则，但20世纪70年代美国经济仍然受到自我实现的波动影响；(ii) 在沃尔克紧缩政策期间，美国经济转向了确定性状态；(iii) 这种转变反映了美联储对宏观经济变量的反应以及趋势通胀下降的变化。(JEL E12, E23, E31, E32, E52)

abstract.text: The lead article in the inaugural issue of the AER examines the common property resource problem as applied to water in the Western United States.

10.1257/aer.101.1.36.abstractZh: 《AER》创刊号的首篇文章探讨了适用于美国西部地区的水资源共有资源问题。

abstract.text: We study the long-run relation between money (inflation or interest rates) and unemployment. We document positive relationships between these variables at low frequencies. We develop a framework where money and unemployment are modeled using explicit microfoundations, providing a unified theory to analyze labor and goods markets. We calibrate the model and ask how monetary factors account for labor market behavior. We can account for a sizable fraction of the increase in unemployment rates during the 1970s. We show how it matters whether one uses monetary theory based on the search-and-bargaining approach or on an ad hoc cash-in-advance constraint. (JEL E24, E31, E41, E43, E52)

10.1257/aer.101.1.371.abstractZh: 我们研究了货币（通货膨胀或利率）与失业之间的长期关系。我们发现这些变量在较低频率下存在正相关关系。我们构建了一个框架，在该框架中，货币和失业通过明确的微观基础进行建模，从而提供了一个统一的理论来分析劳动市场和商品市场。我们对模型进行了校准，并探讨了货币因素如何解释劳动力市场的行为。我们发现，在20世纪70年代，失业率的增加在很大程度上可以归因于货币因素。我们还探讨了使用基于搜索与谈判方法的货币理论，还是基于预先现金约束的货币理论，这两种理论对解释失业率的影响是不同的。（JEL E24, E31, E41, E43, E52）

abstract.text: Despite its widespread use, the Boston mechanism has been criticized for its poor incentive and welfare performances compared to the Gale-Shapley deferred acceptance algorithm (DA). By contrast, when students have the same ordinal preferences and schools have no priorities, we find that the Boston mechanism Pareto dominates the DA in ex ante welfare, that it may not harm but rather benefit participants who may not strategize well, and that, in the presence of school priorities, the Boston mechanism also tends to facilitate greater access than the DA to good schools for those lacking priorities at those schools. (JEL D82, I21, I28)

10.1257/aer.101.1.399.abstractZh: 尽管波士顿机制被广泛使用，但其激励效果和福利表现仍受到批评，与Gale-Shapley延迟接受算法相比存在不足。相比之下，当学生具有相同的序数偏好且学校没有优先级时，我们发现波士顿机制在事前福利方面优于延迟接受算法。此外，对于那些策略能力较弱的参与者而言，波士顿机制可能并不会造成伤害，反而会带来好处。在存在学校优先级的情况下，波士顿机制还倾向于为那些缺乏优先级的学生提供更好的学校选择，从而使其更容易获得优质教育资源。（JEL D82, I21, I28）

abstract.text: A usual criticism of the theory of infinitely repeated games is that it does not provide sharp predictions since there may be a multiplicity of equilibria. To address this issue, we present experimental evidence on the evolution of cooperation in infinitely repeated prisoner's dilemma games as subjects gain experience. We show that cooperation may prevail in infinitely repeated games, but the conditions under which this occurs are more stringent than the subgame perfect conditions usually considered or even a condition based on risk dominance. (JEL C71, C73)

10.1257/aer.101.1.411.abstractZh: 对无限重复博弈理论的一个常见批评是，由于可能存在多个均衡，该理论无法做出精确预测。为了解决这一问题，我们提供了实验证据，以研究在无限重复囚徒困境游戏中，随着参与者经验的积累，合作行为如何演变。我们发现，在无限重复博弈中，合作行为确实可能占主导地位，但实现这一条件的要求比通常考虑的亚游戏完美条件更为严格，甚至超过了基于风险优势的条件。（JEL C71, C73）

abstract.text: It is instructive to read the article that Katharine Coman published in the first issue of the American Economic Review to gain insight into the problems of collective action related to irrigation in the American West. One gains further understanding of the problems Coman identifies by using a social-ecological system (Ostrom 2007, 2009) to organize the diverse variables identified by Coman. One gains a general lesson from this analysis that changing the formal governance structure of irrigation is not sufficient to ensure efficient investment in facilities or that farmers are able to acquire property and make a reasonable living. Building knowledge and trust are, however, essential for solving collective-action problems. (JEL B31, N51, Q15, Q25)

10.1257/aer.101.1.49.abstractZh: 阅读Katharine Coman在《美国经济评论》第一期中发表的论文，有助于了解美国西部灌溉领域集体行动所面临的问题。通过使用社会-生态系统理论（Ostrom 2007, 2009）来组织Coman所识别的多种变量，可以更深入地理解这些问题。这一分析得出的一个普遍结论是，仅仅改变灌溉项目的正式治理结构，并不足以确保设施的有效投资，也无法确保农民能够拥有财产并获得合理的收入。然而，建立知识和信任对于解决集体行动问题至关重要。（JEL B31, N51, Q15, Q25）

abstract.text: Katharine Coman's “Some Unsettled Problems of Irrigation,” published in March 1911 in the first issue of the American Economic Review, addressed issues of water supply, rights, and organization. These same issues have relevance today, in the face of growing concern about the availability of fresh water worldwide. The central point of this article is that appropriative water rights and irrigation districts that emerged in the American West in the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries in response to aridity to facilitate agricultural water delivery, use, and trade raise the transaction costs today of water markets. These markets are vital for smooth reallocation of water to higher-valued uses elsewhere in the economy and for flexible response to greater hydrological uncertainty. This institutional path dependence illustrates how past arrangements to meet conditions of the time constrain contemporary economic opportunities. They cannot be easily significantly modified or replaced ex post. (JEL N51, Q15, Q25, Q54)

10.1257/aer.101.1.64.abstractZh: 凯瑟琳·科曼在1911年3月发表于《美国经济评论》第一期的论文《一些灌溉问题》中，探讨了供水、权利及组织方面的问题。这些问题在今天仍然具有相关性，尤其是在全球范围内对淡水供应日益关注的背景下。该文章的核心观点是，19世纪末至20世纪初，美国西部为应对干旱而出现的取水权制度和灌溉区，虽然有助于农业用水的输送、使用与交易，但如今却增加了水市场的交易成本。这些市场对于将水资源更高效地分配到经济中的其他高价值用途，以及应对更大的水文不确定性，至关重要。这种制度上的路径依赖表明，过去为满足特定时期条件而制定的安排，限制了当代的经济机会。这些安排无法轻易地被显著修改或替代。（JEL N51, Q15, Q25, Q54）

abstract.text: The problem of the commons is more important to our lives and thus more central to economics than a century ago when Katharine Coman led off the first issue of the American Economic Review. As the US and other economies have grown, the carrying capacity of the planet—in regard to natural resources and environmental quality—has become a greater concern, particularly for common-property and open-access resources. The focus of this article is on some important, unsettled problems of the commons. Within the realm of natural resources, there are special challenges associated with renewable resources, which are frequently characterized by open-access. An important example is the degradation of open-access fisheries. Critical commons problems are also associated with environmental quality. A key contribution of economics has been the development of market-based approaches to environmental protection. These instruments are key to addressing the ultimate commons problem of the twenty-first century—global climate change. (JEL Q15, Q21, Q22, Q25, Q54)

10.1257/aer.101.1.81.abstractZh: 公地问题对我们生活的重要性比一个世纪前更为显著，那时凯瑟琳·科曼发表了《美国经济评论》的第一期文章。随着美国及其他经济体的发展，地球在自然资源和环境质量方面的承载能力已成为一个更为重要的议题，尤其是对于那些需要共同使用且开放获取的资源而言。本文重点探讨了一些关于公地问题的关键且未解决的问题。在自然资源领域，可再生资源带来了特殊的挑战，这些资源通常具有开放获取的特性。一个典型的例子就是开放获取渔业的退化问题。公地问题还与环境质量密切相关。经济学的一个重要贡献在于提出了基于市场的环境保护方法。这些工具对于解决二十一世纪面临的全球气候变化这一终极公地问题至关重要。（JEL Q15, Q21, Q22, Q25, Q54）

abstract.text: Written in celebration of the 100th anniversary of the American Economic Review, this paper recounts the history of the journal. The recounting has an analytic core that sees the American Economic Association as an organization supplying goods and services to its members, one of which is the Review. Early in its history the Review was a multipurpose publication with highly disparate content. Over time the economics profession expanded and more economics research was produced, primarily in the form of journal articles. Editors accommodated this shift by allocating more resources to the refereeing and editing process and more space to research papers. (JEL A14, B19, B29)

10.1257/aer.101.1.9.abstractZh: 本文为庆祝《美国经济学评论》创刊100周年而撰写，回顾了该期刊的历史。文章分析指出，美国经济学协会是一个为会员提供服务的组织，而《美国经济学评论》便是其中的一份刊物。在创刊初期，《美国经济学评论》是一份内容多样、用途广泛的出版物。随着时间的推移，经济学领域不断扩展，更多的经济学研究成果得以发表，主要以期刊文章的形式呈现。编辑们通过增加资源投入审稿和编辑工作，以及为研究论文提供更多空间，来适应这一变化。（JEL A14, B19, B29）

abstract.text: In a market-clearing economy, declines in demand from one sector do not cause large declines in aggregate output because other sectors expand. The key price mediating the response is the interest rate. A decline in the rate stimulates all categories of spending. But in a low-inflation economy, the room for a decline in the rate is small, because of the notorious lower limit of zero on the nominal interest rate. In the Great Depression, substantial deflation caused the real interest rate to reach high levels. In the Great Slump that began at the end of 2007, low inflation resulted in an only slightly negative real rate when full employment called for a much lower real rate because of declines in demand. Fortunately, the inflation rate hardly responded to conditions in product and labor markets, else deflation might have occurred, with an even higher real interest rate. I concentrate on three closely related sources of declines in demand: the buildup of excess stocks of housing and consumer durables, the corresponding expansion of consumer debt that financed the buildup, and financial frictions that resulted from the decline in real-estate prices. (JEL E23, E24, E31, E32, E65)

10.1257/aer.101.2.431.abstractZh: 在市场出清的经济中，一个部门需求的下降并不会导致总体产出的大幅下降，因为其他部门会进行扩张。调节这种反应的关键价格是利率。利率的下降会刺激所有类型的支出。但在低通胀的经济环境中，利率下降的空间很小，因为名义利率的界限是零。在大萧条期间，严重的通货紧缩导致实际利率达到较高水平。在2007年底开始的严重经济衰退中，低通胀导致实际利率仅略为负值，而充分就业则需要更低的实际利率，因为需求下降。幸运的是，通胀率对产品和劳动力市场的状况几乎没有反应，否则可能会出现更严重的通货紧缩，导致实际利率进一步上升。我重点关注三个密切相关的需求下降来源：住房及耐用消费品库存的积累、相应增加的消费债务以及房地产价格下降引发的金融摩擦。（JEL E23, E24, E31, E32, E65）

abstract.text: A key open question for theories of reference-dependent preferences is: what determines the reference point? One candidate is expectations: what people expect could affect how they feel about what actually occurs. In a real-effort experiment, we manipulate the rational expectations of subjects and check whether this manipulation influences their effort provision. We find that effort provision is significantly different between treatments in the way predicted by models of expectation-based, reference-dependent preferences: if expectations are high, subjects work longer and earn more money than if expectations are low. (JEL D12, D84, J22)

10.1257/aer.101.2.470.abstractZh: 关于参照依赖偏好理论的一个关键未解问题是：什么决定了参照点？一个可能的解释是预期：人们所预期的情景可能会影响他们对实际发生情况的感受。在一项实际实验中，我们操纵了受试者的理性预期，并检验这种操纵是否会影响他们的努力付出。我们发现，根据基于预期的参照依赖偏好模型预测，不同处理组之间的努力付出存在显著差异：如果预期较高，受试者工作的时长和收入都会高于预期较低的情况。（JEL D12, D84, J22）

abstract.text: Hart and John Moore (2008) introduce new behavioral assumptions that can explain long-term contracts and the employment relation. We examine experimentally their idea that contracts serve as reference points. The evidence confirms the prediction that there is a trade-off between rigidity and flexibility. Flexible contracts—which would dominate rigid contracts under standard assumptions—cause significant shading in ex post performance, while under rigid contracts much less shading occurs. The experiment appears to reveal a new behavioral force: ex ante competition legitimizes the terms of a contract, and aggrievement and shading occur mainly about outcomes within the contract. (JEL D44, D86, J41)

10.1257/aer.101.2.493.abstractZh: Hart和John Moore在2008年的研究中提出了新的行为假设，这些假设可以解释长期合同和雇佣关系。我们通过实验验证了他们关于合同作为参考点的观点。实验结果证实了刚性与灵活性之间存在权衡的观点。在标准假设下，灵活的合同会占据主导地位，导致事后表现出现显著的差异；而在刚性合同下，这种差异则较小。实验似乎揭示了一种新的行为力量：事前竞争使得合同条款具有合法性，而争议和差异主要发生在合同范围内的结果上。（JEL D44, D86, J41）

abstract.text: Credence goods markets are characterized by asymmetric information between sellers and consumers that may give rise to inefficiencies, such as under- and overtreatment or market breakdown. We study in a large experiment with 936 participants the determinants for efficiency in credence goods markets. While theory predicts that liability or verifiability yield efficiency, we find that liability has a crucial, but verifiability at best a minor, effect. Allowing sellers to build up reputation has little influence, as predicted. Seller competition drives down prices and yields maximal trade, but does not lead to higher efficiency as long as liability is violated. (JEL D12, D82)

10.1257/aer.101.2.526.abstractZh: 信任商品市场的特点在于买卖双方之间存在信息不对称，这可能导致效率低下，例如治疗不足或过度治疗，甚至市场崩溃。我们在一项涉及936名参与者的大型实验中研究了信任商品市场中效率的决定因素。理论预测，责任或可验证性能够提升效率，但我们发现，责任虽然具有关键作用，但可验证性对其效果影响甚微。允许卖家建立声誉对效率的影响很小，这与预期一致。卖家之间的竞争能够降低价格并增加交易量，但只要违反了责任原则，这种竞争并不会带来更高的效率。（JEL D12, D82）

abstract.text: This paper studies the impact of incentives on worker self-selection in a controlled laboratory experiment. Subjects face the choice between a fixed and a variable payment scheme. Depending on the treatment, the variable payment is a piece rate, a tournament, or a revenue-sharing scheme. We find that output is higher in the variable-payment schemes compared to the fixed-payment scheme. This difference is largely driven by productivity sorting. In addition, different incentive schemes systematically attract individuals with different attitudes, such as willingness to take risks and relative self-assessment as well as gender, which underlines the importance of multidimensional sorting. (JEL C91, D81, D82, J16, J31)

10.1257/aer.101.2.556.abstractZh: 本文研究了激励措施对工人自我选择的影响，实验在受控实验室环境中进行。参与者面临固定支付和可变支付两种方案的选择。根据激励方式的不同，可变支付可以是计件工资、锦标赛形式或收益共享模式。研究发现，与固定支付方案相比，可变支付方案下的产出更高。这种差异主要源于生产力的差异。此外，不同的激励方案会系统地吸引具有不同态度的人，如风险承担意愿、相对自我评估能力，以及性别因素，这凸显了多维差异的重要性。（JEL C91, D81, D82, J16, J31）

abstract.text: Using a unique dataset, we test whether households' deductible choices in auto and home insurance reflect stable risk preferences. Our test relies on a structural model that assumes households are objective expected utility maximizers and claims are generated by household-coverage specific Poisson processes. We find that the hypothesis of stable risk preferences is rejected by the data. Our analysis suggests that many households exhibit greater risk aversion in their home deductible choices than their auto deductible choices. Our results are robust to several alternative modeling assumptions. (JEL D11, D83)

10.1257/aer.101.2.591.abstractZh: 通过独特的数据集，我们测试了家庭在汽车和房屋保险中的免赔额选择是否反映了稳定的风险偏好。我们的测试基于一个结构模型，该模型假设家庭是客观的预期效用最大化者，而索赔则是由覆盖特定家庭的泊松过程产生的。我们发现，数据否定了稳定风险偏好的假设。我们的分析表明，许多家庭在房屋保险的免赔额选择中表现出比汽车保险更高的风险厌恶。我们的结果对多种不同的建模假设都是稳健的。（JEL D11, D83）

abstract.text: This paper examines moral hazard in teams over time. Agents are collectively engaged in a project whose duration and outcome are uncertain, and their individual efforts are unobserved. Free-riding leads not only to a reduction in effort, but also to procrastination. Collaboration among agents dwindles over time, but does not cease as long as the project has not succeeded. In addition, the delay until the project succeeds, if it ever does, increases with the number of agents. We show why deadlines, but not necessarily better monitoring, help to mitigate moral hazard. (JEL D81, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.101.2.632.abstractZh: 本文探讨了团队中随时间变化的道德风险问题。参与者共同参与一个持续时间及结果都不确定的项目，而他们的个人努力则未被观察到。搭便车行为不仅会导致努力减少，还会引发拖延行为。随着时间的推移，参与者之间的合作会逐渐减弱，但只要项目尚未成功，这种合作就不会完全停止。此外，项目成功所需的等待时间，如果项目最终成功的话，会随着参与者的数量增加而延长。我们揭示了为什么截止日期有助于缓解道德风险，而更好的监控措施则不一定能起到同样的作用。（JEL D81, D82, D83）

abstract.text: We analyze risk preferences using an experiment with real incentives in a representative sample of 1,422 Dutch respondents. Our econometric model incorporates four structural parameters that vary with observed and unobserved characteristics: utility curvature, loss aversion, preferences toward the timing of uncertainty resolution, and the propensity to choose randomly rather than on the basis of preferences. We find that all four parameters contribute to explaining choice behavior. The structural parameters are significantly associated with socioeconomic variables, but it is essential to incorporate unobserved heterogeneity in each of them to match the rich variety of choice patterns in the data. (JEL D12, D81)

10.1257/aer.101.2.664.abstractZh: 我们通过一项具有真实激励的实验，对1,422名荷兰受访者的代表性样本进行了风险偏好的分析。我们的计量经济模型包含了四个结构参数，这些参数会随着观察到的和未观察到的特征而变化：效用曲率、损失厌恶、对不确定性解决时间的偏好，以及选择随机而非基于偏好的倾向。我们发现这四个参数都对解释选择行为有贡献。这些结构参数与社会经济变量显著相关，但必须考虑每个参数中的未观察到的异质性，以匹配数据中丰富的选择模式。（JEL D12, D81）

abstract.text: We often deal with uncertain events for which no probabilities are known. Several normative models have been proposed. Descriptive studies have usually been qualitative, or they estimated ambiguity aversion through one single number. This paper introduces the source method, a tractable method for quantitatively analyzing uncertainty empirically. The theoretical key is the distinction between different sources of uncertainty, within which subjective (choice-based) probabilities can still be defined. Source functions convert those subjective probabilities into willingness to bet. We apply our method in an experiment, where we do not commit to particular ambiguity attitudes but let the data speak. (JEL D81)

10.1257/aer.101.2.695.abstractZh: 我们经常会处理那些没有已知概率的不确定事件。已经提出了几种规范模型。描述性研究通常采用定性方法，或者通过单一数值来估计模糊厌恶。本文介绍了源方法，这是一种用于实证分析不确定性的可行方法。理论上的关键在于区分不同来源的不确定性，在这些不确定性中，主观（基于选择的）概率仍然可以被定义。源函数将这些主观概率转化为赌注意愿。我们在实验中应用了这种方法，并不对特定的模糊态度做出承诺，而是让数据本身来说话。（JEL D81）

abstract.text: I study how limited abilities to process information affect choice behavior. I model the decision-making process by an automaton, and measure the complexity of a specific choice rule by the minimal number of states an automaton implementing the rule uses to process information. I establish that any choice rule that is less complicated than utility maximization displays framing effects. I then prove that choice rules that result from an optimal trade-off between maximizing utility and minimizing complexity are history-dependent satisficing procedures that display primacy and recency effects. (JEL D01, D03, D11, D83)

10.1257/aer.101.2.724.abstractZh: 我研究信息处理能力的限制如何影响选择行为。我通过自动机来模拟决策过程，并通过自动机处理信息所需的状态数量来衡量特定选择规则的复杂性。我发现，任何比效用最大化更复杂的选择规则都会表现出框架效应。然后，我证明了那些在最大化效用与最小化复杂性之间实现最优权衡的选择规则，实际上是依赖于历史的信息筛选过程，并表现出优先性和近期性效应。（JEL D01, D03, D11, D83）

abstract.text: We employ a novel approach to identify overbidding in auctions. We compare online auction prices to fixed prices for the same item on the same webpage. In detailed data on auctions of a board game, 42 percent of auctions exceed the simultaneous fixed price. The result replicates in a broad cross-section of auctions (48 percent overbidding). A small fraction of overbidders, 17 percent of bidders, suf fices to generate the large fraction of auctions with overbidding. We show that the observed behavior is inconsistent with rational behavior, even allowing for uncertainty about prices and switching costs, since the expected auction price also exceeds the fixed price. Limited attention best explains our results. (JEL D12, D44)

10.1257/aer.101.2.749.abstractZh: 我们采用了一种新颖的方法来识别拍卖中的过度出价行为。我们将在线拍卖价格与同一网页上同一物品的固定价格进行比较。在对一款棋盘游戏的拍卖数据的详细分析中，有42%的拍卖价格超过了固定的同步价格。这一结果在广泛的拍卖中得到了复制，有48%的拍卖存在过度出价现象。只有一小部分出价者，即17%的竞拍者，足以导致大部分拍卖出现过度出价的情况。我们发现，这种行为与理性行为不符，即使考虑到价格的不确定性和转换成本，因为预期的拍卖价格也超过了固定价格。我们的研究结果似乎缺乏足够的解释。（JEL D12, D44）

abstract.text: We examine Popper's falsifiability within an economic model in which a tester hires a potential expert to produce a theory. Payments are contingent on the performance of the theory vis-à-vis data. We show that if experts are strategic, falsifiability has no power to distinguish scientific theories from worthless theories. The failure of falsification in screening informed and uninformed experts motivates questions on the broader concepts of refutation and verification. We demonstrate an asymmetry between the two concepts. Like falsification, verification contracts have no power to distinguish between informed and uninformed experts, but some refutation contracts are capable of screening experts. (JEL B41)

10.1257/aer.101.2.788.abstractZh: 我们在经济模型中探讨了波普尔的可证伪性。在这个模型中，测试者雇佣潜在专家来提出理论，报酬取决于该理论与数据的匹配程度。我们发现，如果专家具有策略性，那么可证伪性就无法区分科学理论与无价值的理论。可证伪性在筛选知情与不知情专家方面的失败，引发了关于反驳与验证这两个概念之间差异的疑问。我们证明了这两个概念之间存在不对称：与可证伪性类似，验证契约也无法区分知情与不知情专家，但某些反驳契约能够筛选出专家。（JEL B41）

abstract.text: This paper provides the first experimental test of Edward Lazear's (1979) model of deferred compensation. We examine the relation ship between firms' wage offers and workers' effort supply in a multi-period environment. If firms can ex ante commit to a wage schedule with deferred compensation, workers should respond by supplying sufficient effort to avoid dismissal. We contrast this full-commitment case to controls with no commitment and computer-generated wages in order to examine the roles of monetary incentives, social preferences, and reciprocity. Finally, we examine a setup without formal commitment, but where firms can build a reputation for paying deferred wages. (JEL D86, J22, J31, J33, J41)

10.1257/aer.101.2.819.abstractZh: 本文首次对Edward Lazear（1979年）的递延补偿模型进行了实验性检验。我们研究了企业在多期环境下提供的工资待遇与员工努力供给之间的关系。如果企业能够预先承诺提供带有递延补偿的工资安排，员工就会通过提供足够的努力来避免被解雇。我们将这种完全承诺的情况与无承诺的情况以及计算机生成的工资进行了对比，以考察金钱激励、社会偏好和互惠关系的作用。最后，我们研究了一种没有正式承诺的情况，但企业可以建立支付递延工资的声誉。（JEL D86, J22, J31, J33, J41）

abstract.text: A striking fact about pricing is the prevalence of “sales”: large temporary price cuts followed by prices returning to exactly their former levels. This paper builds a macroeconomic model with a rationale for sales based on firms facing customers with different price sensitivities. Even if firms can adjust sales without cost, monetary policy has large real effects owing to sales being strategic substitutes: a firm's incentive to have a sale is decreasing in the number of other firms having sales. Thus the flexibility seen in individual prices due to sales does not translate into flexibility of the aggregate price level. (JEL E13, E31, E52, L11, L25, L81, M31)

10.1257/aer.101.2.844.abstractZh: 关于定价的一个显著现象是“促销”的普遍存在：先是大幅的临时降价，随后价格又恢复到原来的水平。本文构建了一个宏观经济模型，以企业面临不同价格敏感性的顾客这一因素为理论基础来解释促销行为。即使企业可以在不增加成本的情况下调整促销策略，但由于促销是战略性的替代品，货币政策仍会产生显著的实际影响：其他企业进行促销的激励程度会下降。因此，由于促销导致的个别价格上的灵活性并不会转化为整体价格水平的灵活性。（JEL E13, E31, E52, L11, L25, L81, M31）

abstract.text: Debt and equity issuance are procyclical for most size-sorted firm categories of listed US firms and the procyclicality of equity issuance decreases monotonically with firm size. At the aggregate level, however, the results for equity issuance are not conclusive due to different behavior of the largest firms, especially those in the top one percent. During a deterioration in economic conditions, firms limit the impact of the reduction in external financing on investment by shedding financial assets. This is true for a worsening in aggregate as well as firm-specific conditions. (JEL E32, G32, L11, L25)

10.1257/aer.101.2.877.abstractZh: 债务和股权发行对大多数美国上市企业的规模类别具有顺周期性，且股权发行的顺周期性随着企业规模的减小而单调递减。然而，在总体层面上，由于最大型企业，尤其是排名前百分之一的企业的不同行为，股权发行的结果并不具有决定性。在经济状况恶化期间，企业会通过抛售金融资产来减轻外部融资减少对投资的影响。这种情况既适用于整体经济状况的恶化，也适用于企业特定状况的恶化。（JEL E32, G32, L11, L25）

abstract.text: We study decisions that involve choosing between different numbers of options under time pressure using eye-tracking to monitor the search process of the subjects. We find that subjects are quite adept at optimizing within the set of items that they see, that the initial search process is random in value, that subjects use a stopping rule to terminate the search process that combines features of optimal search and satisficing, and that subjects search more often in certain focal regions of the display, which leads to choice biases. (JEL C91, D12, M31)

10.1257/aer.101.2.900.abstractZh: 我们研究了在时间压力下，受试者需要在多个选项中做出选择的情况，通过眼动追踪来监测受试者的搜索过程。我们发现，受试者在他们所看到的选项集合内进行优化时表现得相当熟练，初始的搜索过程具有随机性，受试者使用一种结合了最优搜索和满意搜索特征的停止规则来终止搜索过程，并且受试者在显示屏的某些特定区域更频繁地进行搜索，这导致了选择偏差。（JEL C91, D12, M31）

abstract.text: We explore the relationship between outcomes in a coordination game and a pre-play asset market where asset values are determined by outcomes in the subsequent coordination game. Across two experiments, we vary the payoffs from the market relative to the game, the degree of interdependence in the game, and whether traders' asset payoffs are dependent on outcomes in their own or another game. Markets lead to significantly lower efficiency across treatments, even when they produce no distortion of incentives in the game. Market prices forecast game outcomes. Our experiments shed light on how financial markets may influence affiliated economic outcomes. (JEL C91, D83, G13, G14)

10.1257/aer.101.2.927.abstractZh: 我们探讨了协调游戏中的结果与游戏前资产市场之间的关系，其中资产价值由后续协调游戏的结果决定。通过两项实验，我们改变了市场收益与游戏收益的比例、游戏中的相互依赖程度，以及交易者资产收益是否依赖于他们自己的游戏或另一场游戏的结果。即使市场不会在游戏中产生激励扭曲，市场仍然会导致处理效率显著下降。市场价格能够预测游戏的结果。我们的实验揭示了金融市场如何影响相关的经济结果。（JEL C91, D83, G13, G14）

abstract.text: While widely accepted labor market search models imply a constant reservation wage policy, empirical evidence strongly suggests that reservation wages decline in search duration. This paper reports the results of the first real-time-search laboratory experiment. The controlled environment subjects face is stationary, and the payoff-maximizing reservation wage is constant. Nevertheless, subjects' reservation wages decline sharply over time. We investigate two hypotheses to explain this decline: 1. Searchers respond to the stock of accruing search costs. 2. Searchers experience non-stationary subjective costs of time spent searching. Our data support the latter hypothesis, and we substantiate this conclusion both experimentally and econometrically. (JEL C91, D83, J64)

10.1257/aer.101.2.948.abstractZh: 虽然广泛接受的劳动力市场搜索模型假设保留工资是恒定的，但实证证据强烈表明，在搜索持续时间内，保留工资会下降。本文报告了首次实时搜索实验室实验的结果。在受控的环境中，受试者面临的支付最大化保留工资是恒定的。然而，受试者的保留工资随时间显著下降。我们探讨了两个假设来解释这一下降现象：1. 搜索者会对累积的搜索成本作出反应。2. 搜索者会经历非静态的搜索时间成本。我们的数据支持后一个假设，并且我们通过实验和计量经济学方法证实了这一结论。（JEL C91, D83, J64）

abstract.text: Although backward induction is a cornerstone of game theory, most laboratory experiments have found that agents are not able to successfully backward induct. We analyze the play of world-class chess players in the centipede game, which is ill-suited for testing backward induction, and in pure backward induction games—Race to 100 games. We find that chess players almost never play the backward induction equilibrium in the centipede game, but many properly backward induct in the Race to 100 games. We find no systematic within-subject relationship between choices in the centipede game and performance in pure backward induction games. (JEL C73)

10.1257/aer.101.2.975.abstractZh: 尽管向后归纳是博弈论的基石，但大多数实验室实验发现，参与者无法成功进行向后归纳。我们分析了世界级棋手在不适合测试向后归纳的蜈蚣博弈中的表现，以及在纯向后归纳博弈——百胜竞赛中的表现。我们发现，棋手几乎从不选择蜈蚣博弈中的向后归纳均衡策略，但在百胜竞赛中却经常正确进行向后归纳。我们未发现蜈蚣博弈中的选择与纯向后归纳博弈中的表现之间存在系统性关系。（JEL C73）

abstract.text: Peter A. Diamond delivered his Prize Lecture on 8 December 2010 at Aula Magna, Stockholm University.

10.1257/aer.101.4.1045.abstractZh: 彼得·A·戴蒙德于2010年12月8日在斯德哥尔摩大学的大礼堂发表了他的获奖演讲。

abstract.text: What are search frictions? What role do they play in the analysis of markets? Why are they important? These are the questions I will try to answer. Along the way, I will also present a short history of the development of the ideas and relate those developments to the current labor market conditions in Europe and the United States.

10.1257/aer.101.4.1073.abstractZh: 什么是搜索摩擦？它们在市场分析中扮演什么角色？为什么它们很重要？这些都是我试图回答的问题。在讨论的过程中，我还将简要回顾这些概念的发展历史，并将这些发展与现代欧洲和美国的劳动力市场状况联系起来。

abstract.text: Christopher A. Pissarides delivered his Prize Lecture on 8 December 2010 at Aula Magna, Stockholm University.(This abstract was borrowed from another version of this item.)

10.1257/aer.101.4.1092.abstractZh: 克里斯托弗·A·皮萨里德斯于2010年12月8日在斯德哥尔摩大学的大礼堂发表了他的获奖演讲。（此摘要摘自该文章的另一个版本。）

abstract.text: This paper investigates how trading frictions vary with the thickness of the asset market by examining patterns of asset allocations and prices in commercial aircraft markets. The empirical analysis indicates that assets with a thinner market are less liquid—i.e., more difficult to sell. Thus, firms hold on longer to them amid profitability shocks. Hence, when markets for assets are thin, firms' average productivity and capacity utilization are lower, and the dispersions of productivity and of capacity utilization are higher. In turn, prices of assets with a thin market are lower and have a higher dispersion. (JEL A12, L11, L93)

10.1257/aer.101.4.1106.abstractZh: 本文通过研究商用飞机市场的资产分配和价格模式，探讨交易摩擦如何随资产市场的厚度而变化。实证分析表明，市场较薄的资产流动性较低，即更难出售。因此，企业在盈利出现冲击时会更长时间持有这些资产。因此，当资产市场较为薄弱时，企业的平均生产效率和产能利用率较低，生产效率和产能利用率的离散度也较高。相应地，市场较薄的资产价格较低，离散度也较高。（JEL A12, L11, L93）

abstract.text: Existing indicators of technical change are plagued by shortcomings. I present new measures based on books published in the field of technology that resolve many of these problems and use them to identify the impact of technology shocks on economic activity. They are positively linked to changes in R&D and scientific knowledge, and capture the new technologies' commercialization dates. Changes in information technology are found to be important sources of economic fluctuations in the post-WWII period, and total factor productivity, investment, and, to a lesser extent, labor are all shown to increase following a positive technology shock. (JEL E22, E23, E32, O33, O34, O47)

10.1257/aer.101.4.1144.abstractZh: 现有的技术变革指标存在诸多缺陷。我提出了基于技术领域出版书籍的新衡量方法，这些方法能够解决许多问题，并用于识别技术冲击对经济活动的影响。这些指标与研发和科学知识的变化呈正相关，并且能够捕捉新技术的商业化时间。在二战后的时期，信息技术的变化被认为是经济波动的重要来源，而全要素生产率、投资以及在一定程度上劳动力水平，在受到技术冲击后都会有所提升。（JEL E22, E23, E32, O33, O34, O47）

abstract.text: We evaluate the choices of elders across their insurance options under the Medicare Part D Prescription Drug plan, using a unique data set of prescription drug claims matched to information on the characteristics of choice sets. We document that elders place much more weight on plan premiums than on expected out of pocket costs; value plan financial characteristics beyond any impacts on their own financial expenses or risk; and place almost no value on variance reducing aspects of plans. Partial equilibrium welfare analysis implies that welfare would have been 27% higher if patients had all chosen rationally.

10.1257/aer.101.4.1180.abstractZh: 我们评估了老年人在选择Medicare Part D处方药计划下的保险选项时的决策，使用了与选择特征信息相匹配的处方药索赔的独特数据集。我们发现，老年人更看重计划的保费，而非预期的自付费用；他们重视计划的财务特性，而并不关心这些特性对自己财务开支或风险的影响；他们对计划中减少差异性的方面几乎不感兴趣。部分均衡福利分析表明，如果所有患者都能做出理性选择，福利水平将提高27%。

abstract.text: We show experimentally that whether and how communication achieves beneficial social outcomes in a hidden-information context depends crucially on whether low-talent agents can participate in a Pareto-improving outcome. Communication is effective (and pat terns of lies and truth quite systematic) when this is feasible, but otherwise completely ineffective. We examine the data in light of two potentially relevant behavioral models: cost-of-lying and guilt-from-blame. (JEL D82, D83, Z13)

10.1257/aer.101.4.1211.abstractZh: 我们通过实验表明，在信息隐藏的情况下，沟通是否能够以及如何取得有益的社会成果，关键在于低能力个体是否能够参与到能够提升帕累托最优的结果中。当这一条件可行时，沟通是有效的（而谎言与真相的模式也相当系统化），否则沟通则完全无效。我们基于两个可能相关的行为模型来研究这些数据：谎言成本模型与因责备而产生的内疚模型。（JEL D82, D83, Z13）

abstract.text: According to the terms-of-trade theory, governments use trade agreements to escape from a terms-of-trade-driven prisoner's dilemma. We use the terms-of-trade theory to develop a relationship that predicts negotiated tariff levels on the basis of pre-negotiation data: tariffs, import volumes and prices, and trade elasticities. We then confront this predicted relationship with data on the outcomes of tariff negotiations associated with the accession of new members to the World Trade Organization. We find strong and robust support for the central predictions of the terms-of-trade theory in the observed pattern of negotiated tariff cuts. (JEL F11, F13)

10.1257/aer.101.4.1238.abstractZh: 根据贸易条件理论，政府通过贸易协定来摆脱由贸易条件驱动的囚徒困境。我们利用贸易条件理论来发展一种关系，该关系基于谈判前的数据预测了谈判后的关税水平：关税、进口量和价格以及贸易弹性。然后，我们将这一预测关系与关于新成员加入世界贸易组织后关税谈判结果的数据进行对比。我们发现，在观察到的关税削减模式中，贸易条件理论的中心预测得到了强有力的支持。（JEL F11, F13）

abstract.text: We show that political institutions affect corruption levels. We use audit reports in Brazil to construct new measures of political corruption in local governments and test whether electoral accountability affects the corruption practices of incumbent politicians. We find significantly less corruption in municipalities where mayors can get reelected. Mayors with reelection incentives misappropriate 27 percent fewer resources than mayors without reelection incentives. These effects are more pronounced among municipalities with less access to information and where the likelihood of judicial punishment is lower. Overall our findings suggest that electoral rules that enhance political accountability play a crucial role in constraining politician's corrupt behavior. (JEL D72, K42, O17)

10.1257/aer.101.4.1274.abstractZh: 我们表明，政治制度会影响腐败程度。我们利用巴西的审计报告来构建地方政府政治腐败的新衡量指标，并测试选举问责制是否会影响现任政治人物的腐败行为。研究发现，在市长可以连任的市镇，腐败程度明显较低。有连任激励的市长挪用资源的程度比没有连任激励的市长低27%。在信息获取较少且司法惩罚可能性较低的市镇，这些效应更为明显。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，能够增强政治问责的选举规则在约束政治人物的腐败行为方面起着至关重要的作用。（JEL D72, K42, O17）

abstract.text: This paper estimates a dynamic structural model of a producer's decision to invest in R&D and export, allowing both choices to endogenously affect the future path of productivity. Using plant-level data for the Taiwanese electronics industry, both activities are found to have a positive effect on the plant's future productivity. This in turn drives more plants to self-select into both activities, contributing to further productivity gains. Simulations of an expansion of the export market are shown to increase both exporting and R&D investment and generate a gradual within-plant productivity improvement. (JEL D24, F14, G31, L63, O31, O33)

10.1257/aer.101.4.1312.abstractZh: 本文估计了一个动态结构模型，用于分析生产者在研发和出口方面的决策，发现这两种选择都会内生性地影响生产率的未来路径。通过对台湾电子行业的工厂级数据进行分析，发现这两种活动都对工厂未来的生产率有积极影响。这反过来又促使更多的工厂选择参与这两种活动，从而进一步促进生产率的提升。模拟结果显示，扩大出口市场会增加出口和研发投资，并逐步提升工厂内部的生产率水平。（JEL D24, F14, G31, L63, O31, O33）

abstract.text: In this paper we study a behavioral model of conflict that provides a basis for choosing certain indices of dispersion as indicators for conflict. We show that a suitable monotone transform of the equilibrium level of conflict can be proxied by a linear function of the Gini coefficient, the Herfindahl-Hirschman fractionalization index, and a specific measure of polarization due to Esteban and Ray. (JEL D31, D63, D74)

10.1257/aer.101.4.1345.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了一个冲突的行为模型，为选择某些分散指标作为冲突指标提供了基础。我们表明，冲突均衡水平的适当单调变换可以通过基尼系数、赫芬达尔-赫希曼分数化指数以及Esteban和Ray提出的特定极化度量来近似表示。（JEL D31, D63, D74）

abstract.text: Estimating the cost of regulation is difficult. Firms sometimes reveal costs indirectly, however, when they exploit loopholes to avoid regulation. We apply this insight to fuel economy standards for automobiles. These standards feature a loophole that gives automakers a bonus when they equip a vehicle with flexible-fuel capacity. Profit-maximizing automakers will equate the marginal cost of compliance using the loophole, which is observable, with the unobservable costs of strategies that genuinely improve fuel economy. Based on this insight, we estimate that tightening standards by one mile per gallon would have cost automakers just $9–$27 per vehicle in recent years. (JEL L51, L62, Q48)

10.1257/aer.101.4.1375.abstractZh: 估算监管成本是一件困难的事情。然而，企业有时会通过利用监管漏洞来间接透露成本。我们将这一洞察应用于汽车燃油经济性标准。这些标准中存在一个漏洞，当汽车制造商为车辆配备灵活燃料系统时，可以获得奖励。追求利润最大化的汽车制造商会将利用这一漏洞的边际成本与真正提高燃油经济性的策略所付出的不可观测成本进行权衡。基于这一洞察，我们估计，近年来，将标准每加仑英里数提高一英里，对汽车制造商每辆车而言，成本仅为9至27美元。（JEL L51, L62, Q48）

abstract.text: Major League Baseball umpires express their racial/ethnic prefer ences when they evaluate pitchers. Strikes are called less often if the umpire and pitcher do not match race/ethnicity, but mainly where there is little scrutiny of umpires. Pitchers understand the incentives and throw pitches that allow umpires less subjective judgment (e.g., fastballs over home plate) when they anticipate bias. These direct and indirect effects bias performance measures of minorities downward. The results suggest how discrimination alters discriminated groups' behavior generally. They imply that biases in measured productivity must be accounted for in generating measures of wage discrimination. (JEL J15, J31, J44, J71, L83)

10.1257/aer.101.4.1410.abstractZh: 美国职业棒球大联盟的裁判在评估投手时表现出种族/族裔偏好。如果裁判与投手的种族/族裔不匹配，裁判判罚出局的情况会较少，但这主要发生在对裁判监督较少的情况下。投手了解这些偏见，并会投出一些能让裁判减少主观判断的球（例如，投向本垒区的快速球），以规避偏见。这些直接和间接的影响都会使少数群体的表现指标下降。研究结果表明，歧视如何普遍改变被歧视群体的行为。这些结果意味着，在衡量工资歧视时，必须考虑生产力方面的偏见因素。（JEL J15, J31, J44, J71, L83）

abstract.text: The macroeconomic implications of downward nominal wage rigidities are analyzed via a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model featuring aggregate and idiosyncratic shocks. A closed-form solution for a long-run Phillips curve relates average output gap to average wage inflation: it is virtually vertical at high inflation and flattens at low inflation. Macroeconomic volatility shifts the curve outwards and reduces output. The results imply that stabilization policies play an important role, and that optimal inflation may be positive and differ across countries with different macroeconomic volatility. Results are robust to relaxing the wage constraint, for example, when large idiosyncratic shocks arise. (JEL E23, E24, E31, E63)

10.1257/aer.101.4.1436.abstractZh: 本文通过动态随机一般均衡模型分析了名义工资刚性下降的宏观经济影响，该模型考虑了总体冲击和特定冲击。对于长期菲利普斯曲线，存在一种封闭形式的解，它将平均产出缺口与平均工资通胀联系起来：在高通胀时，菲利普斯曲线几乎呈垂直状态，而在低通胀时则趋于平坦。宏观经济波动会使曲线向外移动，从而减少产出。研究结果表明，稳定政策发挥着重要作用，并且最优通胀率可能是正值，且会因不同国家的宏观经济波动程度而有所差异。即使放宽工资约束，例如在大范围特定冲击出现的情况下，研究结果仍然具有稳健性。（JEL E23, E24, E31, E63）

abstract.text: Using a model of statistical discrimination and educational sorting, we explain why blacks get more education than whites of similar cognitive ability, and we explore how the Armed Forces Qualification Test (AFQT), wages, and education are related. The model suggests that one should control for both AFQT and education when comparing the earnings of blacks and whites, in which case a substantial black-white wage differential emerges. We reject the hypothesis that differences in school quality between blacks and whites explain the wage and education differentials. Our findings support the view that some of the black-white wage differential reflects the operation of the labor market. (JEL I21, J15, J24, J31, J71)

10.1257/aer.101.4.1467.abstractZh: 通过统计歧视和教育排序模型，我们解释了为什么具有相似认知能力的黑人的教育水平高于白人，并探讨了武装部队资格测试（AFQT）、工资与教育之间的关系。该模型表明，在比较黑人与白人的收入时，应同时考虑AFQT和教育水平，在这种情况下，黑人与白人之间的工资差异会非常明显。我们否定了学校质量差异能够解释黑人与白人之间工资和教育差异的假设。我们的研究结果支持这样一种观点，即黑人与白人之间的工资差异部分反映了劳动力市场的运作机制。（JEL I21, J15, J24, J31, J71）

abstract.text: People pay attention to the appearance of others, and personal characteristics can affect many types of decisions. We ask, is there informational value in a face in a situation where trust and reciprocity can increase earnings? We use a laboratory trust game experiment where subjects are unable to observe a counterpart, must observe a counterpart, or can pay to reveal a counterpart's photograph. Both senders and responders are willing to pay to observe the photos, and we show that behavior, earnings, and efficiency are affected. When subjects are “face to face,” efficiency is enhanced, and senders have higher earnings. (JEL D12, D83, Z13)

10.1257/aer.101.4.1497.abstractZh: 人们会关注他人的外表，个人特征会影响许多类型的决策。我们提出这样一个问题：在信任和互惠能够增加收益的情况下，面部特征是否具有信息价值？我们通过一个实验室信任游戏实验来研究这个问题，实验中参与者要么无法观察到对方，要么必须观察到对方，或者可以支付费用来查看对方的照片。无论是发送者还是接收者都愿意支付费用来查看照片，我们发现这种行为、收益和效率都受到了影响。当参与者“面对面”交流时，效率得到了提升，发送者的收益也更高。（JEL D12, D83, Z13）

abstract.text: This paper provides cross-country empirical evidence on term premia. I construct a panel of zero-coupon nominal government bond yields spanning ten industrialized countries and nearly two decades. I hence compute forward rates and use two different methods to decompose these forward rates into expected future short-term interest rates and term premiums. The first method uses an affine term structure model with macroeconomic variables as unspanned risk factors; the second method uses surveys. I find that term premiums declined internationally over the sample period, especially in countries that apparently reduced inflation uncertainty by making substantial changes in their monetary policy frameworks. (JEL E13, E43, E52, G12, H63)

10.1257/aer.101.4.1514.abstractZh: 本文提供了关于期限溢价跨国实证证据。我构建了一个包含十个工业化国家、近二十年的零息名义政府债券收益率面板数据。随后，我计算了远期利率，并采用两种不同的方法将这些远期利率分解为预期的未来短期利率和期限溢价。第一种方法采用带有宏观经济变量作为未分散风险因素的仿射期限结构模型；第二种方法则采用调查数据。研究发现，在样本期间，国际上的期限溢价有所下降，尤其是在那些通过大幅调整货币政策框架来降低通胀不确定性的国家中。（JEL E13, E43, E52, G12, H63）

abstract.text: Since Akerlof (1970), economists have understood the adverse selection problem that information asymmetries can create in used goods markets. The remarkable growth in online used goods auctions thus poses a puzzle. Part of the solution is that sellers voluntarily disclose their private information on the auction web page. This defines a precise contract -- to deliver the car shown for the closing price -- which helps protect the buyer from adverse selection. I test this theory using data from eBay Motors, finding that online disclosures are important price determinants, and that disclosure costs impact both the level of disclosure and prices. (JEL D44, D82, L81)

10.1257/aer.101.4.1535.abstractZh: 自Akerlof在1970年提出这一理论以来，经济学家们逐渐认识到信息不对称性在二手商品市场中可能引发的逆向选择问题。因此，在线二手商品拍卖市场的显著增长便构成了一个谜题。部分解决方案是卖家在拍卖页面上自愿披露他们的私人信息。这构成了一个明确的契约——以收盘价成交所展示的车辆——这有助于保护买家免受逆向选择的侵害。我使用eBay Motors的数据对这一理论进行了验证，发现在线披露是重要的价格决定因素，而披露成本则影响着披露的程度和价格。（JEL D44, D82, L81）
