abstract.text: Machina (2009) introduced two examples that falsify Choquet expected utility, presently one of the most popular models of ambiguity. This article shows that Machina's examples falsify not only the model mentioned, but also four other popular models for ambiguity of the literature, namely maxmin expected utility, variational preferences, α-maxmin, and the smooth model of ambiguity aversion. Thus, Machina's examples pose a challenge to most of the present field of ambiguity. Finally, the paper discusses how an alternative representation of ambiguity-averse preferences works to accommodate the Machina paradoxes and what drives the results. (JEL D81)

10.1257/aer.101.4.1547.abstractZh: Machina在2009年提出了两个例子，这些例子证明了Choquet期望效用模型的正确性受到了质疑，而Choquet期望效用模型目前仍是处理模糊性问题的热门模型之一。本文指出，Machina的例子不仅证明了上述模型的错误，还证明了文献中其他四个流行的模糊性模型也存在问题，这些模型包括最大最小期望效用模型、变分偏好模型、α-最大最小模型以及平滑模糊厌恶模型。因此，Machina的例子对当前大多数模糊性研究领域提出了挑战。最后，本文探讨了另一种模糊厌恶偏好表示方式如何能够解释Machina悖论，以及是什么驱动了这些结果。（JEL D81）

abstract.text: Svensson (2006) argues that Morris and Shin (2002) is, contrary to what is claimed, pro-transparency. This paper reexamines the issue but with an important modification to the original Morris and Shin framework. Recognizing that central banks impact the economy not only indirectly via public announcements, but also directly through policy actions, we consider the social value of public information in the presence of active policy intervention. Our results strengthen Morris and Shin's conclusions considerably: in particular, we find that public disclosure of the central bank's information is unambiguously, i.e., regardless of parameter values, undesirable. (JEL D82, D83, E52, E58)

10.1257/aer.101.4.1561.abstractZh: Svensson（2006）认为，与Morris和Shin（2002）所声称的相反，他们的观点实际上支持透明度原则。本文重新审视了这一问题，并对Morris和Shin的原始框架进行了重要修改。我们认识到，中央银行不仅通过公开声明间接影响经济，还通过政策行动直接对经济产生影响。因此，在政策干预活跃的情况下，我们需要考虑公共信息的社会价值。我们的研究结果显著加强了Morris和Shin的结论：特别是，我们发现公开披露中央银行的信息是绝对不理想的，无论参数值如何。（JEL D82, D83, E52, E58）

abstract.text: This paper explains why payment card networks charge fees that are proportional to the transaction values instead of charging fixed per-transaction fees. We show that, when card networks and merchants both have market power, card networks earn higher profits by charging proportional fees. It is also shown that competition among merchants reduces card networks' gains from using proportional fees relative to fixed per-transaction fees. Merchants are found to earn lower profits under proportional fees, whereas consumer utility and social welfare are higher. Our welfare results are then evaluated with respect to the current regulatory policy debates. (JEL E42, G21, G28)

10.1257/aer.101.4.1575.abstractZh: 本文解释了为什么支付卡网络收取与交易金额成正比的手续费，而不是收取固定的每笔交易费用。我们指出，当卡网络和商家都具有市场力量时，卡网络通过收取比例性手续费可以获得更高的利润。同时，我们还发现，商家之间的竞争会降低卡网络通过比例性手续费获得的收益，相对于固定的每笔交易费用而言。研究发现，在比例性手续费下，商家的利润较低，而消费者效用和社会福利则更高。随后，我们将我们的福利分析结果与当前的监管政策讨论进行了对比评估。（JEL E42, G21, G28）

abstract.text: In the theoretical literature on consumer search, one conclusion is nearly universal: as buyers become better able to observe and compare prices ex ante, sellers will set lower prices in equilibrium. In this paper, I examine a standard consumer search model with one small -- yet often relevant -- additional restriction: I assume that sellers are capacity constrained. In this environment, I illustrate that the conventional wisdom regarding information and prices does not necessarily hold: having more informed consumers can lead to a decrease in prices, have no effect at all, or even lead to an increase in prices.

10.1257/aer.101.4.1591.abstractZh: 在关于消费者搜索的理论文献中，有一个结论几乎是普遍认可的：随着买家能够更清楚地观察和比较价格，卖方在均衡状态下会设定更低的价格。在本文中，我研究了一个标准的消费者搜索模型，并加入了一个虽小但往往很重要的限制条件：假设卖方存在产能限制。在这种环境下，我证明了关于信息和价格的传统观点并不一定成立：信息更充分的消费者可能会导致价格下降，或者完全没有影响，甚至可能导致价格上升。

abstract.text: The literature on the private provision of public goods suggests an inverse relationship between incentives to contribute and group size. We find, however, that after an exogenous reduction of group size at Chinese Wikipedia, the nonblocked contributors decrease their contributions by 42.8 percent on average. We attribute the cause to social effects: contributors receive social benefits that increase with both the amount of their contributions and group size, and the shrinking group size weakens these social benefits. Consistent with our explanation, we find that the more contributors value social benefits, the more they reduce their contributions after the block. (JEL H41, L17, L82)

10.1257/aer.101.4.1601.abstractZh: 关于私人提供公共物品的文献表明，贡献动机与群体规模之间存在反比关系。然而，我们发现，在中国维基百科上，由于群体规模的外生减少，非阻塞贡献者的贡献量平均减少了42.8%。我们认为这一现象是由社会效应引起的：贡献者获得的社交收益随着他们的贡献量和群体规模的增加而增加，而群体规模的缩小则削弱了这些社交收益。与我们的解释一致，我们发现，贡献者越重视社交收益，他们在被屏蔽后减少贡献的程度就越高。（JEL H41, L17, L82）

abstract.text: This study presents a framework to include environmental externalities into a system of national accounts. The paper estimates the air pollution damages for each industry in the United States. An integrated-assessment model quantifies the marginal damages of air pollution emissions for the US which are multiplied times the quantity of emissions by industry to compute gross damages. Solid waste combustion, sewage treatment, stone quarrying, marinas, and oil and coal-fired power plants have air pollution damages larger than their value added. The largest industrial contributor to external costs is coal-fired electric generation, whose damages range from 0.8 to 5.6 times value added. (JEL E01, L94, Q53, Q56)

10.1257/aer.101.5.1649.abstractZh: 本研究提出了一个将环境外部性纳入国民账户体系的框架。论文估算了美国各行业的空气污染损害。通过综合评估模型，量化了美国空气污染排放的边际损害，该数值乘以各行业的排放量，以计算总损害。固体废弃物燃烧、污水处理、采石业、码头以及石油和燃煤发电厂的空气污染损害大于其增加值。造成外部成本最大的行业是燃煤发电，其损害程度为增加值的0.8到5.6倍。（JEL E01, L94, Q53, Q56）

abstract.text: Newly developed historical time series on public debt, along with data on external debts, allow a deeper analysis of the debt cycles underlying serial debt and banking crises. We test three related hypotheses at both “world” aggregate levels and on an individual country basis. First, external debt surges are an antecedent to banking crises. Second, banking crises (domestic and those in financial centers) often precede or accompany sovereign debt crises; we find they help predict them. Third, public borrowing surges ahead of external sovereign default, as governments have “hidden domestic debts” that exceed the better documented levels of external debt. (JEL E44, F34, F44, G01, H63, N20)

10.1257/aer.101.5.1676.abstractZh: 新开发的历史时间序列数据，包括公共债务和对外债务的信息，使我们能够更深入地分析导致债务周期和银行危机的潜在因素。我们在“全球”总体层面以及单个国家层面测试了三个相关假设。首先，对外债务的激增是银行危机的前兆。其次，银行危机（无论是国内还是金融中心发生的）往往先于或伴随主权债务危机；我们发现这些危机有助于预测主权债务危机。第三，公共债务的激增往往发生在对外主权违约之前，因为政府存在“隐藏的国内债务”，这些债务超过了较为明确的对外债务水平。（JEL E44, F34, F44, G01, H63, N20）

abstract.text: The CPI component indices are obtained from comparing price quotes at a given store in different periods. If we omit comparisons from goods in the store in the initial, but not in the comparison, period we generate a selection bias: goods that exit are disproportionately obsolete goods that have falling prices. Building on Pakes (2003), we explain why standard hedonic predictions for second-period prices of exiting goods do not account for this bias. New hedonic methods are derived, shown to have desirable properties, and are applied to three CPI samples where they generate significant selection corrections. (JEL C43, E31)

10.1257/aer.101.5.1707.abstractZh: CPI成分指数是通过比较同一商店在不同时期的价格数据获得的。如果我们仅比较初始时期商店内商品的价格，而不考虑后续时期的价格变化，就会产生选择偏差：那些在初始时期价格下降的商品会被过度选中。基于Pakes（2003）的研究，我们解释了为什么传统的 hedonic 预测方法无法解释这些偏差。我们提出了新的 hedonic 方法，并证明这些方法具有理想的特性。这些方法被应用于三个 CPI 样本数据，结果显示它们能够显著纠正选择偏差。（JEL C43, E31）

abstract.text: To the extent that students benefit from high-achieving peers, tracking will help strong students and hurt weak ones. However, all students may benefit if tracking allows teachers to better tailor their instruction level. Lower-achieving pupils are particularly likely to benefit from tracking when teachers have incentives to teach to the top of the distribution. We propose a simple model nesting these effects and test its implications in a randomized tracking experiment conducted with 121 primary schools in Kenya. While the direct effect of high-achieving peers is positive, tracking benefited lower-achieving pupils indirectly by allowing teachers to teach to their level. (JEL I21, J45, O15)

10.1257/aer.101.5.1739.abstractZh: 在某种程度上，学生可以从成绩优异的同伴那里受益，而排名制度则可能对成绩较好的学生有帮助，而对成绩较差的学生产生负面影响。然而，如果排名制度能让教师更好地调整教学水平，那么所有学生都可能受益。当教师有激励去针对成绩较好的学生进行教学时，成绩较低的学生尤其有可能从中受益。我们提出了一个简单的模型来综合这些效应，并在肯尼亚的121所小学进行了随机排名实验，以验证其影响。虽然成绩优异的同伴的直接影响是积极的，但排名制度通过让教师根据学生的水平进行教学，间接使成绩较低的学生受益。（JEL I21, J45, O15）

abstract.text: We examine the impact of state child care regulations on the supply and quality of care in child care markets. We exploit panel data on both individual establishments and local markets to control for state, time, and, where possible, establishment-specific fixed effects to mitigate the potential bias due to policy endogeneity. We find that the imposition of regulations reduces the number of center-based child care establishments, especially in lower income markets. However, such regulations increase the quality of services provided, especially in higher income areas. Thus, there are winners and losers from the regulation of child care services.

10.1257/aer.101.5.1775.abstractZh: 我们研究了州级儿童保育法规对儿童保育市场中的供给和服务质量的影响。我们利用关于单个保育机构和当地市场的面板数据，以控制州级、时间因素，以及可能的机构特定固定效应，从而减轻政策内生性带来的潜在偏差。我们发现，法规的实施减少了以中心为基地的保育机构的数量，尤其是在低收入市场。然而，这些法规提高了所提供的服务质量，尤其是在高收入地区。因此，对儿童保育服务的监管存在赢家和输家。

abstract.text: We study simultaneous security-bid second-price auctions with competition among sellers for potential bidders. The sellers compete by designing ordered sets of securities that the bidders can offer as payment for the assets. Upon observing auction designs, potential bidders decide which auctions to enter. We characterize all symmetric equilibria and show that there always exist equilibria in which auctions are in standard securities or their combinations. In large markets the unique equilibrium is auctions in pure cash. We extend the model for competition in reserve prices and show that binding reserve prices never constitute equilibrium as long as equilibrium security designs are not call options. (JEL D44, D82, G10)

10.1257/aer.101.5.1806.abstractZh: 我们研究了同时进行的、具有卖方竞争的安全 Bid 二次价格拍卖。卖方通过设计一系列证券来竞争潜在投标人的青睐，这些证券可以作为资产支付的筹码。在观察了拍卖设计后，潜在投标人会决定参与哪种拍卖。我们描述了所有对称均衡，并证明总是存在以标准证券或其组合进行拍卖的均衡。在大型市场中，唯一的均衡是以纯现金进行的拍卖。我们将模型扩展到储备价格竞争的情况，并证明只要均衡证券设计不是看涨期权，约束性的储备价格永远不会构成均衡。（JEL D44, D82, G10）

abstract.text: We analyze the effect of search frictions in the market for commercial health insurance. Frictions increase insurance premiums (enough to transfer 13.2 percent of consumer surplus from fully insured employer groups to insurers—approximately $34.4 billion in 1997); and increase insurance turnover (by 64 percent for the average policy). This rent transfer harms consumers and—when combined with heightened turnover—reduces incentives to invest in future health. We also find that a publicly financed insurance option can improve the efficiency of private insurance markets by reducing search friction induced distortions in pricing and marketing efforts. (JEL D83 G22, I18)

10.1257/aer.101.5.1842.abstractZh: 我们分析了搜索摩擦对商业健康保险市场的影响。这些摩擦导致保险费用上升（足以将13.2%的消费者剩余从完全投保的雇主群体转移到保险公司——1997年约为344亿美元）；同时增加了保险合同的周转率（平均保单的周转率上升了64%）。这种租金转移对消费者不利，并且与较高的周转率相结合时，会降低人们未来投资健康保障的意愿。我们还发现，由公共资金支持的保险选项可以通过减少搜索摩擦引起的定价和市场营销方面的扭曲，从而提高私人保险市场的效率。（JEL D83 G22, I18）

abstract.text: We provide a new compilation of data on ethnic, linguistic, and religious composition at the subnational level for a large number of countries. Using these data, we measure segregation of groups within the country. To overcome the endogeneity problem that arises because of mobility and endogenous internal borders, we construct an instrument for segregation. We find that more ethnically and linguistically segregated countries, i.e., those where groups live more spatially separately, have a lower quality of government; there is no relationship between religious segregation and governance. Trust is an important channel of influence; it is lower in more segregated countries. (JEL H11, H77, J15, O17, Z12, Z13)

10.1257/aer.101.5.1872.abstractZh: 我们提供了一份关于大量国家次国家级的种族、语言和宗教构成的新数据汇编。利用这些数据，我们可以衡量国内各群体的隔离程度。为了克服由于人口流动和内部边界动态变化而产生的内生性问题，我们构建了一个用于衡量隔离程度的工具。我们发现，种族和语言隔离程度较高的国家，即各群体在空间上更加分离的国家，其政府质量较低；而宗教隔离与治理水平之间并无关联。信任是影响关系的重要渠道；在隔离程度较高的国家，信任度较低。（JEL H11, H77, J15, O17, Z12, Z13）

abstract.text: This paper proposes a model of cab drivers' labor supply, building on Henry S. Farber's (2005, 2008) empirical analyses and Botond Kőszegi and Matthew Rabin's (2006; henceforth “KR”) theory of reference-dependent preferences. Following KR, our model has targets for hours as well as income, determined by proxied rational expectations. Our model, estimated with Farber's data, reconciles his finding that stopping probabilities are significantly related to hours but not income with Colin Camerer et al.'s (1997) negative “wage” elasticity of hours; and avoids Farber's criticism that estimates of drivers' income targets are too unstable to yield a useful model of labor supply. (JEL J22, J31, L92)

10.1257/aer.101.5.1912.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个出租车司机劳动力供给模型，该模型基于Henry S. Farber（2005年、2008年）的实证分析以及Botond Kőszegi和Matthew Rabin（2006年；以下简称“KR”）关于参照依赖偏好理论的研究。根据KR的理论，我们的模型设定了小时数以及收入的目标值，这些目标值由近似的理性预期决定。利用Farber的数据对模型进行估计后，我们发现Farber发现停止工作的概率与小时数显著相关，但与收入无关这一结论，与Colin Camerer等人（1997年）提出的小时数对收入的负“工资”弹性理论相符。同时，该模型避免了Farber对司机收入目标估计过于不稳定的批评，从而能够构建一个有效的劳动力供给模型。（JEL J22, J31, L92）

abstract.text: While cumulative knowledge production is central to growth, little empirical research investigates how institutions shape whether existing knowledge can be exploited to create new knowledge. This paper assesses the impact of a specific institution, a biological resource center, whose objective is to certify and disseminate knowledge. We disentangle the marginal impact of this institution on cumulative research from the impact of selection, in which the most important discoveries are endogenously linked to research-enhancing institutions. Exploiting exogenous shifts of biomaterials across institutional settings and employing a difference-in-differences approach, we find that effective institutions amplify the cumulative impact of individual scientific discoveries. (JEL D02, D83, I23, O30)

10.1257/aer.101.5.1933.abstractZh: 虽然累积知识生产是经济增长的核心，但很少有实证研究探讨制度如何塑造现有知识是否被利用来创造新的知识。本文评估了一个特定制度——生物资源中心的影响，该中心的目标是认证和传播知识。我们区分了这一制度对累积研究的边际影响，以及选择效应带来的影响，其中最重要的发现与能够增强研究的制度之间存在内在联系。通过利用不同制度环境下生物材料的外部变化，并采用差异-差异方法，我们发现有效的制度能够放大个体科学发现的累积效应。（JEL D02, D83, I23, O30）

abstract.text: We develop a quantitative framework to explain the relationship between aggregate/sector-level total factor productivity (TFP) and financial development across countries. Financial frictions distort the allocation of capital and entrepreneurial talent across production units, adversely affecting measured productivity. In our model, sectors with larger scales of operation (e.g., manufacturing) have more financing needs, and are hence disproportionately vulnerable to financial frictions. Our quantitative analysis shows that financial frictions account for a substantial part of the observed cross-country differences in output per worker, aggregate TFP, sector-level relative productivity, and capital-to-output ratios. (JEL E23, E44, O41, O47)

10.1257/aer.101.5.1964.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个定量框架，用于解释国家间总体/行业层面全要素生产率与金融发展之间的关系。金融摩擦会扭曲资本和企业家才能在生产单位之间的分配，从而对实际生产率产生不利影响。在我们的模型中，经营规模较大的行业（如制造业）需要更多的融资支持，因此更容易受到金融摩擦的影响。我们的定量分析表明，金融摩擦在解释各国间每工人产出、总体全要素生产率、行业层面相对生产率以及资本与产出比率的差异方面起着重要作用。（JEL E23, E44, O41, O47）

abstract.text: This paper examines the central hypothesis of the influential Malthusian theory, according to which improvements in the technological environment during the pre-industrial era had generated only temporary gains in income per capita, eventually leading to a larger, but not significantly richer, population. Exploiting exogenous sources of cross-country variations in land productivity and the level of technological advancement the analysis demonstrates that, in accordance with the theory, technological superiority and higher land productivity had significant positive effects on population density but insignificant effects on the standard of living, during the time period 1-1500 CE.

10.1257/aer.101.5.2003.abstractZh: 本文探讨了具有影响力的马尔萨斯理论的核心假设。根据该理论，前工业时代技术环境的改善仅带来了人均收入的暂时增长，最终导致人口数量增加，但生活水平并未显著提高。通过分析跨国范围内的土地生产力和技术进步水平的差异，本文表明，在公元1至1500年期间，技术优势及更高的土地生产力对人口密度有显著的正面影响，但对生活水平的影响却微不足道。

abstract.text: We study an infinite horizon game in which pairs of players connected in a network are randomly matched to bargain. Players who reach agreement are replaced by new players at the same positions in the network. We show that all equilibria are payoff equivalent. The payoffs and the set of agreement links converge as players become patient. Several new concepts—mutually estranged sets, partners, and shortage ratios—provide insights into the relative strengths of the positions in the network. We develop a procedure to determine the limit equilibrium payoffs for all players. Characterizations of equitable and nondiscriminatory networks are also obtained. (JEL C78, D85)

10.1257/aer.101.5.2042.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个无限视界博弈，其中通过网络连接的玩家对随机匹配进行交易。达成协议的玩家会被网络中的新玩家取代。我们证明所有均衡都是支付等价的。随着玩家变得耐心，支付方式和协议链接的集合会趋于稳定。几个新的概念——相互疏远集、合作伙伴和短缺比率——为我们提供了对网络中各个位置相对实力的洞察。我们开发了一种程序来确定所有玩家的极限均衡支付。同时，我们也获得了公平且无歧视网络的特征描述。（JEL C78, D85）

abstract.text: This paper examines the equilibrium price effects of the privatization of housing assets that were previously owned and allocated by the state. I develop a theoretical framework that shows that privatization can have ambiguous effects on prices in the private market, and that the degree of misallocation of the assets prior to privatization determines the subsequent price effects. I test the predictions of the model using a large-scale housing reform in China. The results suggest that the removal of price distortions allowed households to increase their consumption of housing and led to an increase in equilibrium housing prices. (JEL L33, O18, P25, R31, R38)

10.1257/aer.101.5.2081.abstractZh: 本文探讨了此前由国家拥有和分配的住房资产私有化对均衡价格的影响。我构建了一个理论框架，表明私有化对私人市场的价格可能产生双重影响，而私有化前资产分配的不合理程度决定了后续的价格变化。我利用中国大规模住房改革的数据来验证该模型的预测。结果表明，消除价格扭曲使得家庭能够增加住房消费，从而导致均衡房价上升。（JEL L33, O18, P25, R31, R38）

abstract.text: This paper uses data on all house transactions in Massachusetts over the last 20 years to show that houses sold after foreclosure, or close in time to the death or bankruptcy of a seller, are sold at lower prices than other houses. Foreclosure discounts are on average at 27 percent of the value of a house. Moreover, foreclosures that take place within small local geographies of a house lower the price at which it is sold. Our preferred estimate is that a foreclosure at a distance of 0.05 miles lowers the price of a house by about 1 percent. JEL: D14, R31

10.1257/aer.101.5.2108.abstractZh: 本文利用过去20年马萨诸塞州所有房屋交易的数据表明，在止赎后出售的房屋，或者在卖方死亡或破产前出售的房屋，其售价低于其他房屋。止赎带来的折扣平均占房屋价值的27%。此外，发生在房屋所在小范围内的止赎行为也会降低房屋的售价。我们估计，在0.05英里范围内发生止赎的情况，会使房屋的售价降低约1%。JEL: D14, R31

abstract.text: Borrowing against the increase in home equity by existing homeowners was responsible for a significant fraction of the rise in US household leverage from 2002 to 2006 and the increase in defaults from 2006 to 2008. Instrumental variables estimation shows that homeowners extracted 25 cents for every dollar increase in home equity. Home equity–based borrowing was stronger for younger households and households with low credit scores. The evidence suggests that borrowed funds were used for real outlays. Home equity–based borrowing added $1.25 trillion in household debt from 2002 to 2008, and accounts for at least 39 percent of new defaults from 2006 to 2008. JEL: D14, R31

10.1257/aer.101.5.2132.abstractZh: 现有房主的房屋净值增加用于借款，这在2002年至2006年间美国家庭杠杆率的上升以及2006年至2008年间违约率的上升中起到了重要作用。工具变量估计显示，房主每增加一美元的房屋净值，就会额外提取25美分用于借款。基于房屋净值的借款在年轻家庭和信用评分较低的家庭中更为普遍。证据表明，借款资金被用于实际支出。从2002年到2008年，基于房屋净值的借款增加了1.25万亿美元的家庭债务，并且至少占2006年至2008年间新违约事件的39%。JEL: D14, R31

abstract.text: In this paper we study the causal impact of police on crime, looking at what happened to crime and police before and after the terror attacks that hit central London in July 2005. The attacks resulted in a large redeployment of police officers to central London as compared to outer London. During this time, crime fell significantly in central relative to outer London. The instrumental variable approach we use uncovers an elasticity of crime with respect to police of approximately -0.3 to -0.4, so that a 10 percent increase in police activity reduces crime by around 3 to 4 percent. JEL: K42

10.1257/aer.101.5.2157.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了警察对犯罪行为的因果影响，重点关注2005年7月伦敦市中心发生恐怖袭击前后犯罪率和警察部署情况的变化。此次袭击导致大量警察被重新部署到伦敦市中心，而伦敦外围地区的警察部署则相对较少。在此期间，伦敦市中心的犯罪率相对于伦敦外围地区显著下降。我们采用的工具变量分析表明，犯罪率与警察数量之间存在约-0.3至-0.4的弹性关系，即警察数量增加10%，犯罪率会相应降低3%至4%。JEL: K42

abstract.text: I present a tractable dynamic model of political economy where disagreements about the composition of public spending result in implementation of short-sighted policies. Excessive taxation reduces the return to physical capital and hence investment rates, which slows down growth along the transition. In the long run, output, consumption and welfare are inefficiently low. The larger is the degree of polarization, the greater is the inefficiency. Political stability mitigates the effects of polarization by making the incumbent internalize the dynamic inefficiencies introduced by the choice of growth-retarding policies. JEL: D72, E22, E23, E62, H25, O16, O17

10.1257/aer.101.5.2182.abstractZh: 我提出了一个可行的政治经济学动态模型，其中关于公共支出构成的分歧导致实施短视政策。过度征税会降低实物资本的回报，从而降低投资率，这会减缓转型过程中的经济增长。从长远来看，产出、消费和福利都会低效地低下。两极分化的程度越大，效率低下就越严重。政治稳定可以通过让执政者承担因选择阻碍增长的政策而带来的动态效率低下问题，来减轻两极分化的影响。JEL: D72, E22, E23, E62, H25, O16, O17

abstract.text: The distribution of city populations has attracted much attention, in part because it constrains models of local growth. However, there is no consensus on the distribution below the very upper tail, because available data need to rely on “legal” rather than “economic” definitions for medium and small cities. To remedy this difficulty, we construct cities “from the bottom up” by clustering populated areas obtained from high-resolution data. We find that Zipf 's law for population holds for cities as small as 5,000 inhabitants in Great Britain and 12,000 inhabitants in the US. We also find a Zipf 's law for areas. JEL: R11, R12, R23

10.1257/aer.101.5.2205.abstractZh: 城市人口的分布引起了广泛关注，部分原因是它限制了地方增长的模型。然而，对于极低人口密度的区域分布，目前还没有共识，因为现有数据在中等和小城市层面需要依赖“法律”而非“经济”定义。为了克服这一困难，我们采用“从下到上”的方法，通过聚类高分辨率数据获得的居民区来构建城市。我们发现，即使是在英国仅有5,000名居民、在美国仅有12,000名居民的城市，Zipf的人口分布定律仍然适用。我们还发现，对于区域而言，也存在Zipf定律。JEL: R11, R12, R23

abstract.text: Each week, the Dutch Postcode Lottery (PCL) randomly selects a postal code, and distributes cash and a new BMW to lottery participants in that code. We study the effects of these shocks on lottery winners and their neighbors. Consistent with the life-cycle hypothesis, the effects on winners' consumption are largely confined to cars and other durables. Consistent with the theory of in-kind transfers, the vast majority of BMW winners liquidate their BMWs. We do, however, detect substantial social effects of lottery winnings: PCL nonparticipants who live next door to winners have significantly higher levels of car consumption than other nonparticipants. JEL: D14, D91, H23, H27

10.1257/aer.101.5.2226.abstractZh: 每周，荷兰邮政编码彩票（PCL）会随机选择一个邮政编码，并向该编码下的彩票参与者分发现金和一辆新的宝马汽车。我们研究了这些奖励对中奖者及其邻居的影响。与生命周期假说一致，这些奖励对中奖者消费的影响主要局限于汽车和其他耐用消费品。与实物转移理论一致，绝大多数赢得宝马汽车的人都会出售他们的车辆。然而，我们确实发现了彩票奖金带来的显著社会效应：与中奖者相邻的非参与者，其汽车消费水平明显高于其他非参与者。JEL: D14, D91, H23, H27

abstract.text: I show that after accounting for predictable variation arising from movements in real interest rates, preferences and income shocks, liquidity constraints and measurement errors, volatility of household consumption in the US increased by 25 percent between 1970 and 2004. The increase was lower than that of volatility of family income. Nonwhite and those with less than 13 years of education, for whom there was no differential increase in income volatility, experienced a significantly larger increase in volatility of household consumption. Substantial differences in wealth and access to credit markets point to the main reason for this divide. JEL: D12, D14, E21, J15

10.1257/aer.101.5.2248.abstractZh: 我指出，在考虑了实际利率变动、偏好变化、收入冲击、流动性限制以及测量误差所带来的可预测变化后，美国家庭消费波动在1970年至2004年间增加了25%。这一增长幅度低于家庭收入波动的增长幅度。非白人以及受教育年限少于13年的群体，其收入波动的增加幅度明显低于其他群体，而家庭消费波动的增加幅度则更为显著。财富水平的显著差异以及信贷市场的获取能力差异，是造成这种差异的主要原因。JEL分类：D12、D14、E21、J15

abstract.text: I study a dynamic model of trial-and-error search in which agents do not have complete knowledge of how choices are mapped into outcomes. Agents learn about the mapping by observing the choices of earlier agents and the outcomes that are realized. The key novelty is that the mapping is represented as the realized path of a Brownian motion. I characterize for this environment the optimal behavior each period as well as the trajectory of experimentation and learning through time. Applied to new product development, the model shares features of the data with the well-known Product Life Cycle. (JEL D81, D83, D92, L26)

10.1257/aer.101.6.2277.abstractZh: 我研究了一个动态模型，该模型描述了试错搜索过程，其中代理人并不完全了解选择如何映射到结果上。代理人通过观察早期代理人的选择以及实际实现的结果来学习这种映射关系。该模型的一个关键创新点在于，映射关系被表示为布朗运动的实际路径。我针对这一环境描述了每个时期的最优行为，以及实验与学习随时间变化的轨迹。将该模型应用于新产品开发时，它与众所周知的产品生命周期理论具有相似之处。（JEL D81, D83, D92, L26）

abstract.text: This paper presents new evidence that increases in college enrollment lead to a decline in the average quality of college graduates between 1960 and 2000, resulting in a decrease of 6 percentage points in the college premium. A standard demand and supply framework can qualitatively account for the trend in the college and age premia over this period, but substantial quantitative adjustments are needed to account for changes in quality. (JEL I23, J24, J31)

10.1257/aer.101.6.2309.abstractZh: 本文提出了新的证据，表明大学入学人数的增加导致1960年至2000年间大学毕业生平均质量下降，从而使大学教育的溢价降低了6个百分点。标准的供需框架可以定性地解释这一时期内大学教育和年龄溢价的变化趋势，但需要进行大量的定量调整以解释质量方面的变化。（JEL I23, J24, J31）

abstract.text: We model farmers as facing small fixed costs of purchasing fertilizer and assume some are stochastically present biased and not fully sophisticated about this bias. Such farmers may procrastinate, postponing fertilizer purchases until later periods, when they may be too impatient to purchase fertilizer. Consistent with the model, many farmers in Western Kenya fail to take advantage of apparently profitable fertilizer investments, but they do invest in response to small, time-limited discounts on the cost of acquiring fertilizer (free delivery) just after harvest. Calibration suggests that this policy can yield higher welfare than either laissez-faire policies or heavy subsidies. (JEL Q13, Q12, Q16, Q18)

10.1257/aer.101.6.2350.abstractZh: 我们将农民视为面临较小的固定成本，用于购买肥料。假设部分农民存在随机的偏见，且对这种偏见了解不够充分。这样的农民可能会拖延购买肥料的时间，直到后期再购买，因为他们可能过于急躁而无法及时购买肥料。与模型一致的是，肯尼亚西部的许多农民未能利用看似有盈利的肥料投资，但他们会在收获后享受短暂的肥料购买折扣（免费送货）而投资购买肥料。校准结果表明，这种政策能够带来更高的福利，优于放任不管的政策或大规模补贴政策。（JEL Q13, Q12, Q16, Q18）

abstract.text: We study the purchasing power parity (PPP) puzzle in a multisector, two-country, sticky-price model. Sectors differ in the extent of price stickiness, leading to heterogeneous sectoral real exchange rate dynamics. Deviations from PPP are more volatile and persistent than in an otherwise identical one-sector world economy with the same average frequency of price changes. Under the empirical distribution of price stickiness of the US economy, the model produces PPP deviations with a half-life of 39 months. We provide a structural interpretation of the approaches found in the empirical literature on aggregation and PPP, and reconcile its apparently conflicting findings. (JEL F31, G31)

10.1257/aer.101.6.2391.abstractZh: 我们在一个多部门、两个国家的粘性价格模型中研究了购买力平价（PPP）难题。不同部门的价格粘性程度不同，导致各部门的实际汇率动态存在差异。与平均价格变化频率相同的单一部门世界经济相比，PPP偏差的波动性和持续性更强。根据美国经济价格粘性的实证分布，该模型产生的PPP偏差的半衰期为39个月。我们对实证文献中关于聚合和PPP的研究方法进行了结构性解释，并调和了这些看似矛盾的研究结果。（JEL F31, G31）

abstract.text: Motivated by recent cartel practices, a stable collusive agreement is characterized when firms' prices and quantities are private information. Conditions are derived whereby an equilibrium exists in which firms truthfully report their sales and then make transfers within the cartel based on these reports. The properties of this equilibrium fit well with the cartel agreements in a number of markets including citric acid, lysine, and vitamins. (JEL D43, D82, K21, L12, L61, L65)

10.1257/aer.101.6.2425.abstractZh: 受近期卡特尔行为的启发，当企业的价格和数量属于私人信息时，一种稳定的共谋协议便得以形成。本文推导出了一种均衡条件，即企业如实报告其销售情况，然后基于这些报告在卡特尔内部进行交易。这种均衡的特性与多个市场中的卡特尔协议非常吻合，包括柠檬酸、赖氨酸和维生素等领域。（JEL D43, D82, K21, L12, L61, L65）

abstract.text: Relative cross-border retail prices, in a common currency, comove closely with the nominal exchange rate. Using product-level prices and wholesale costs from a grocery chain operating in the United States and Canada, we decompose this variation into relative costs and markup components. The high correlation of nominal and real exchange rates is driven mainly by changes in relative costs. National borders segment markets. Retail prices respond to changes in costs in neighboring stores within the same country but not across the border. Prices have a median discontinuous change of 24 percent at the border and 0 percent at state boundaries. (JEL F31, L11, L81)

10.1257/aer.101.6.2450.abstractZh: 在共同货币体系下，相对跨境零售价格与名义汇率密切相关。通过研究在美国和加拿大运营的某连锁杂货店的产品价格和批发成本，我们将这种价格变动分解为相对成本和加价部分。名义汇率与实际汇率之间的高度相关性主要源于相对成本的变化。国家边界分割了市场，零售价格会响应同一国家内邻近店铺的成本变化，而不会对跨境店铺产生影响。在边境，价格的中值变动为24%，而在州界处则为零。（JEL F31, L11, L81）

abstract.text: We develop a human capital model with borrowing constraints explicitly derived from government student loan (GSL) programs and private lending under limited commitment. The model helps explain the persistent strong positive correlation between ability and schooling in the United States, as well as the rising importance of family income for college attendance. It also explains the increasing share of undergraduates borrowing the GSL maximum and the rise in student borrowing from private lenders. Our framework offers new insights regarding the interaction of government and private lending, as well as the responsiveness of private credit to economic and policy changes. (JEL D14, H52, I22, I23, J24)

10.1257/aer.101.6.2487.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个包含借贷约束的人力资本模型，这些约束源自政府学生贷款计划以及有限承诺下的私人贷款。该模型有助于解释美国能力与受教育程度之间持续存在的强烈正相关性，以及家庭收入对大学入学率的重要性日益增加。它还解释了本科生借用政府学生贷款最高限额的比例不断增加，以及从私人贷款机构借款的学生数量上升现象。我们的框架为政府与私人贷款之间的互动提供了新的见解，同时也揭示了私人信贷对经济和政策变化的响应能力。（JEL D14, H52, I22, I23, J24）

abstract.text: We show how changes in the volatility of the real interest rate at which small open emerging economies borrow have an important effect on variables like output, consumption, investment, and hours. We start by documenting the strong evidence of time-varying volatility in the real interest rates faced by four emerging economies: Argentina, Brazil, Ecuador, and Venezuela. We estimate a stochastic volatility process for real interest rates. Then, we feed this process in a standard small open economy business cycle model. We find that an increase in real interest rate volatility triggers a fall in output, consumption, investment, hours, and debt. (JEL E13, E20, E32, E43, F32, F43, 011)

10.1257/aer.101.6.2530.abstractZh: 我们展示了小型开放经济体的实际利率波动变化对产出、消费、投资和劳动时间等变量的重要影响。我们首先证实了四个新兴经济体——阿根廷、巴西、厄瓜多尔和委内瑞拉的实际利率存在随时间变化的显著波动现象。随后，我们为实际利率定义了一个随机波动过程，并将其纳入一个标准的小型开放经济商业周期模型中。研究发现，实际利率波动的增加会导致产出、消费、投资、劳动时间和债务水平的下降。（JEL E13, E20, E32, E43, F32, F43, 011）

abstract.text: When does a common group identity improve efficiency in coordination games? To answer this question, we propose a group-contingent social preference model and derive conditions under which social identity changes equilibrium selection. We test our predictions in the minimum-effort game in the laboratory under parameter configurations which lead to an inefficient low-effort equilibrium for subjects with no group identity. For those with a salient group identity, consistent with our theory, we find that learning leads to ingroup coordination to the efficient high-effort equilibrium. Additionally, our theoretical framework reconciles findings from a number of coordination game experiments. (JEL C71, C91, D71)

10.1257/aer.101.6.2562.abstractZh: 在什么情况下，一个共同的群体身份能够提升协调博弈中的效率？为了回答这个问题，我们提出了一个基于群体条件的社会偏好模型，并推导出社会身份改变均衡选择的条件。我们在实验室中最小努力博弈中测试了我们的预测结果，这些实验的参数配置导致没有群体身份的个体处于效率较低的低努力均衡状态。对于那些拥有显著群体身份的个体来说，与我们的理论一致，我们发现学习行为能够促使群体内部的协调行为向高效的高努力均衡转变。此外，我们的理论框架还与多项协调博弈实验的结果相吻合。（JEL C71, C91, D71）

abstract.text: When is it possible for one person to persuade another to change her action? We consider a symmetric information model where a sender chooses a signal to reveal to a receiver, who then takes a noncontractible action that affects the welfare of both players. We derive necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of a signal that strictly benefits the sender. We characterize sender-optimal signals. We examine comparative statics with respect to the alignment of the sender's and the receiver's preferences. Finally, we apply our results to persuasion by litigators, lobbyists, and salespeople. (JEL D72, D82, D83, K40, M31)

10.1257/aer.101.6.2590.abstractZh: 何时一个人能够说服另一个人改变其行为？我们考虑一个对称信息模型，其中发送者选择一个信号来告知接收者，接收者随后会采取一个不可契约的行为，这种行为会影响双方的利益。我们推导了存在严格有利于发送者的信号的必要和充分条件。我们描述了发送者最优信号的特征。我们研究了与发送者和接收者偏好对齐相关的比较静态问题。最后，我们将我们的结果应用于诉讼律师、说客和销售人员的说服行为。（JEL D72, D82, D83, K40, M31）

abstract.text: We investigate the effect of lane kilometers of roads on vehicle-kilometers traveled (VKT) in US cities. VKT increases proportionately to roadway lane kilometers for interstate highways and probably slightly less rapidly for other types of roads. The sources for this extra VKT are increases in driving by current residents, increases in commercial traffic, and migration. Increasing lane kilometers for one type of road diverts little traffic from other types of road. We find no evidence that the provision of public transportation affects VKT. We conclude that increased provision of roads or public transit is unlikely to relieve congestion. (JEL R41, R48)

10.1257/aer.101.6.2616.abstractZh: 我们研究了道路车道公里数对美国城市车辆行驶公里数的影响。对于州际高速公路，车辆行驶公里数与道路车道公里数成正比增加，而其他类型的道路则增加速度可能稍慢。这种额外的车辆行驶公里数的来源包括当地居民的驾驶量增加、商业交通的增加以及人口迁移。一种类型道路的车道公里数增加并不会使其他类型道路的流量减少。我们没有发现公共交通的提供会影响车辆行驶公里数的证据。因此，增加道路建设或公共交通的供给不太可能缓解交通拥堵问题。（JEL R41, R48）

abstract.text: We use data from highway procurement auctions subject to California's Small Business Preference program to study the effect of bid preferences on auction outcomes. Our analysis is based on an estimated model of firms' bidding and participation decisions, which allows us to evaluate the effects of current and alternative policy designs. We show that incorporating participation responses significantly alters the assessment of preferential treatment policies. (JEL D44, H76, R42)

10.1257/aer.101.6.2653.abstractZh: 我们利用加州小型企业优先计划下的公路采购拍卖数据，研究投标偏好对拍卖结果的影响。我们的分析基于一个估计模型，该模型能够反映企业的投标和参与决策，从而让我们评估当前政策及替代政策设计的效果。研究表明，纳入参与响应会显著改变对优先待遇政策的评估。（JEL D44, H76, R42）

abstract.text: This paper examines whether US gasoline content regulations, which impose substantial costs on consumers, have successfully reduced ozone pollution. We take advantage of spatial and temporal variation in the regulations' implementation to show that federal gasoline standards, which allow refiners flexibility in choosing a compliance mechanism, did not improve air quality. This outcome occurred because minimizing the cost of compliance does not reduce emissions of those compounds most prone to forming ozone. In California, however, we find that precisely targeted, inflexible regulations requiring the removal of particularly harmful compounds significantly improved air quality. (JEL L51, L71, L78, Q53, Q58)

10.1257/aer.101.6.2687.abstractZh: 本文探讨了美国对汽油成分的监管规定是否成功减少了臭氧污染。这些规定给消费者带来了巨大的成本。我们利用监管实施中的空间和时间差异发现，联邦汽油标准虽然允许炼油商选择不同的合规机制，但并未改善空气质量。这一结果是因为，降低合规成本并不能减少那些最容易形成臭氧的化合物的排放。然而，在加利福尼亚州，我们发现，针对特定有害化合物的严格且不可变通的监管规定显著改善了空气质量。（JEL L51, L71, L78, Q53, Q58）

abstract.text: In 2005–2008, over a dozen put warrants traded in China went so deep out of the money that they were almost certain to expire worthless. Nonetheless, each warrant was traded more than three times each day at substantially inflated prices. This bubble is unique in that the underlying stock prices make warrant fundamentals publicly observable and that warrants have predetermined finite maturities. This sample allows us to examine a set of bubble theories. In particular, our analysis highlights the joint effects of short-sales constraints and heterogeneous beliefs in driving bubbles and confirms several key findings of the experimental bubble literature. (JEL G12, G13, O16, P34)

10.1257/aer.101.6.2723.abstractZh: 在2005年至2008年期间，中国有十几份看跌权证的价格跌得如此之深，以至于几乎可以肯定它们在到期时将会一文不值。尽管如此，每份权证每天仍被交易超过三次，且价格被大幅抬高。这种泡沫的独特之处在于，相关股票的价格使得权证的基本面信息能够公开获取，同时权证具有预定的有限到期日。这一样本使我们能够检验一系列泡沫理论。具体而言，我们的分析强调了卖空限制与不同信念共同作用下推动泡沫形成的机制，并证实了实验性泡沫研究中的几个关键发现。（JEL G12, G13, O16, P34）

abstract.text: This paper estimates marginal returns to college for individuals induced to enroll in college by different marginal policy changes. The recent instrumental variables literature seeks to estimate this parameter, but in general it does so only under strong assumptions that are tested and found wanting. We show how to utilize economic theory and local instrumental variables estimators to estimate the effect of marginal policy changes. Our empirical analysis shows that returns are higher for individuals with values of unobservables that make them more likely to attend college. We contrast our estimates with IV estimates of the return to schooling.

10.1257/aer.101.6.2754.abstractZh: 本文通过不同的边际政策变化，估算了促使个体选择上大学的边际回报。近期关于工具变量文献试图估算这一参数，但通常是在严格的假设条件下进行的，而这些假设往往被证明是不充分的。我们展示了如何利用经济理论和局部工具变量估计方法来计算边际政策变化的效应。我们的实证分析表明，对于那些具有使自身更有可能上大学的不可观测变量的个体来说，回报更高。我们将我们的估计结果与工具变量估计的受教育回报进行了对比。

abstract.text: A well-known problem with revealed preference methods is that when data are found to satisfy their restrictions it is hard to know whether this should be viewed as a triumph for economic theory, or a warning that these conditions are so undemanding that almost anything goes. This paper allows researchers to make this distinction. Our approach uses an axiomatic characterization of a measure of predictive success due to Selten (1991). We illustrate the idea using a panel dataset. The results show that this approach can lead us to radically reassess our view of the empirical performance of economic theory. JEL: D11, D12

10.1257/aer.101.6.2782.abstractZh: 揭示性偏好方法的一个众所周知的问题是，当数据满足其限制条件时，很难判断这是否应被视为经济理论的胜利，还是一个警告，表明这些条件要求如此宽松，以至于几乎任何情况都可以被接受。本文使研究人员能够做出这种区分。我们的方法采用了Selten（1991）提出的关于预测成功度量的公理化描述。我们通过一个面板数据集来说明这一思想。结果表明，这种方法可以让我们彻底重新评估对经济理论实证表现的看法。JEL: D11, D12

abstract.text: This paper examines optimal monetary policy in an open-economy two-country world with sticky prices under pricing to market. We show that currency misalignments are inefficient and lower world welfare. We find that optimal policy must target consumer price inflation, the output gap, and the currency misalignment. The paper derives the loss function of a cooperative monetary policymaker and the optimal targeting rules. The model is a modified version of Clarida, Galí, and Gertler (JME, 2002). The key change is that we allow pricing to market or local-currency pricing and consider the policy implications of currency misalignments. JEL: E52, F31, F41

10.1257/aer.101.6.2796.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在开放经济的两国模型中，存在价格粘性且实行市场定价的条件下，最优货币政策问题。我们指出，货币错配会导致效率低下并降低全球福利。研究发现，最优政策应针对消费者价格通胀、产出缺口以及货币错配进行调控。文章还推导了合作货币政策制定者的损失函数以及最优目标设定规则。该模型是Clarida、Galí和Gertler（JME, 2002）模型的改进版本。主要变化在于我们引入了市场定价或本地货币定价机制，并考虑了货币错配的政策影响。JEL分类：E52, F31, F41

abstract.text: This paper develops a tractable extension of a Mortensen-Pissarides style matching model that allows for risk averse workers with limited ability to smooth consumption. I show that this leads to a form of equilibrium wage rigidity, as the inability of workers to smooth their consumption across unemployment and employment spells changes how unemployed workers value wage offers, and hence also the offers that employers find profitable to make. In the model risk-averse entrepreneurs use optimal long-term contracts to attract risk averse workers facing limited access to asset markets. A simple analytic representation for the equilibrium is derived. JEL: D81, E21, E24, E32, J31, J41, J64

10.1257/aer.101.6.2823.abstractZh: 本文发展了一种可操作的Mortensen-Pissarides式匹配模型的扩展版本，该模型允许风险厌恶的工人以有限的资产来平滑消费。研究表明，这种模型会导致一种均衡工资刚性现象，因为工人无法在失业和就业期间平滑消费，这改变了失业工人对工资报价的评估，从而也影响了雇主认为有利可图的报价。在模型中，风险厌恶的企业家通过最优的长期合同来吸引那些在资产市场获取能力有限的工人。文中还推导出了均衡状态的简单解析表达式。相关分类：JEL: D81, E21, E24, E32, J31, J41, J64

abstract.text: This paper develops a theory of expectations-driven business cycles based on learning. Agents have incomplete knowledge about how market prices are determined and shifts in expectations of future prices affect dynamics. Learning breaks the tight link between fundamentals and equilibrium prices, inducing periods of erroneous optimism or pessimism about future returns to capital and wages which subsequent data partially validate. In a real business cycle model, the theoretical framework amplifies and propagates technology shocks. Moreover, it produces agents' forecast errors consistent with business cycle properties of forecast errors for a wide range of variables from the Survey of Professional Forecasters. JEL: C53, D83, D84, E32, E37

10.1257/aer.101.6.2844.abstractZh: 本文基于学习理论，发展了一种由预期驱动的商业周期理论。代理人对市场价格的形成方式了解有限，对未来价格预期的变动会影响商业周期的动态。学习打破了基本因素与均衡价格之间的紧密联系，导致代理人对资本和工资的未来回报产生错误的乐观或悲观预期，而后续数据部分验证了这些预期。在一个真实的商业周期模型中，该理论框架能够放大并传播技术冲击。此外，该理论产生的代理人预测误差与《职业预测师调查》中多种变量的商业周期预测误差特性一致。JEL: C53, D83, D84, E32, E37

abstract.text: We propose a new measure of frictional wage dispersion: the meanmin wage ratio. For a large class of search models, we show that this measure is independent of the wage-offer distribution but depends on statistics of labor-market turnover and on preferences. Under plausible preference parameterizations, observed magnitudes for worker flows imply that in the basic search model, and in most of its extensions, frictional wage dispersion is very small. Notable exceptions are some of the most recent models of on-the-job search. Our new measure allows us to rationalize the diverse empirical findings in the large literature estimating structural search models. (JEL D81, D83, J31, J41, J64)

10.1257/aer.101.7.2873.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的摩擦性工资差异度量方法：平均最低工资比率。对于一大类搜索模型，我们证明这一度量与工资供给分布无关，但取决于劳动力市场流动性的统计数据和偏好设定。在合理的偏好参数设定下，观察到的工人流动情况表明，在基本的搜索模型中，以及其大多数扩展形式中，摩擦性工资差异非常小。值得注意的例外是一些最新的在职搜索模型。我们的新度量方法有助于解释大量文献中估计结构性搜索模型时出现的不同实证结果。（JEL D81, D83, J31, J41, J64）

abstract.text: Many everyday decisions are made without full examination of all available options, and, as a result, the best available option may be missed. We develop a search-theoretic choice experiment to study the impact of incomplete consideration on the quality of choices. We find that many decisions can be understood using the satisficing model of Herbert Simon (1955): most subjects search sequentially, stopping when a “satisficing” level of reservation utility is realized. We find that reservation utilities and search order respond systematically to changes in the decision making environment. (JEL D03, D12, D83)

10.1257/aer.101.7.2899.abstractZh: 许多日常决策是在没有全面考虑所有可用选项的情况下做出的，因此，最佳选项可能会被忽略。我们开发了一个基于搜索理论的选择实验，来研究不完全考虑对决策质量的影响。我们发现，许多决策可以通过赫伯特·西蒙在1955年提出的满意模型来理解：大多数受试者会依次进行搜索，当达到“满意”的保留效用水平时就会停止。我们还发现，保留效用和搜索顺序会系统地响应决策环境的变化。（JEL D03, D12, D83）

abstract.text: Is lifetime inequality mainly due to differences across people established early in life or to differences in luck experienced over the working lifetime? We answer this question within a model that features idiosyncratic shocks to human capital, estimated directly from data, as well as heterogeneity in ability to learn, initial human capital, and initial wealth. We find that, as of age 23, differences in initial conditions account for more of the variation in lifetime earnings, lifetime wealth, and lifetime utility than do differences in shocks received over the working lifetime. (JEL D31, D91, J24, J31)

10.1257/aer.101.7.2923.abstractZh: 终身不平等主要是由于人们在早年形成的差异，还是由于工作生涯中经历的运气差异造成的？我们通过一个模型来回答这个问题。该模型考虑了直接从数据中估算的人类资本的独特冲击，以及学习能力的异质性、初始人力资本和初始财富的差异。我们发现，到23岁时，初始条件的差异对终身收入、终身财富和终身效用的变化贡献更大，而工作生涯中受到的冲击差异则贡献较小。（JEL D31, D91, J24, J31）

abstract.text: We use new data on entries and exits of US daily newspapers from 1869 to 2004 to estimate effects on political participation, party vote shares, and electoral competitiveness. Our identification strategy exploits the precise timing of these events and allows for the possibility of confounding trends. We focus our analysis on the years 1869– 1928, and we use the remaining years of data to look at changes over time. We find that newspapers have a robust positive effect on political participation, with one additional newspaper increasing both presidential and congressional turnout by approximately 0.3 percentage points. Newspaper competition is not a key driver of turnout: our effect is driven mainly by the first newspaper in a market, and the effect of a second or third paper is significantly smaller. The effect on presidential turnout diminishes after the introduction of radio and television, while the estimated effect on congressional turnout remains similar up to recent years. We find no evidence that partisan newspapers affect party vote shares, with confidence intervals that rule out even moderate-sized effects. We find no clear evidence that newspapers systematically help or hurt incumbents. (JEL D72, L11, L82, N41, N42, N81, N82)

10.1257/aer.101.7.2980.abstractZh: 我们利用1869年至2004年间美国日报的注册与注销数据，来估算这些事件对政治参与、政党得票率和选举竞争力的影响。我们的分析策略利用了这些事件的精确时间节点，并考虑了混杂趋势的可能性。我们重点关注1869至1928年这一时间段，并利用剩余的数据来观察随时间的变化情况。研究发现，报纸对政治参与有显著的积极影响，每增加一份报纸，总统选举和国会选举的投票率分别增加约0.3个百分点。报纸竞争并非投票率提升的主要驱动力：我们的影响主要来自于市场中的第一份报纸，而第二或第三份报纸的影响则明显较小。随着广播和电视的引入，报纸对总统选举投票率的影响逐渐减弱，而国会选举投票率的影响则一直保持相似水平，直到最近几年也是如此。我们没有发现党派性报纸会影响政党得票率，其置信区间甚至排除了中等规模的影响。此外，我们也没有发现报纸会系统性地帮助或损害现有政党。（JEL D72, L11, L82, N41, N42, N81, N82）

abstract.text: This paper examines the residential location and school choice responses to the desegregation of large urban public school districts. We decompose the well documented decline in white public enrollment following desegregation into migration to suburban districts and increased private school enrollment, and find that migration was the more prevalent response. Desegregation caused black public enrollment to increase significantly outside of the South, mostly by slowing decentralization of black households to the suburbs, and large black private school enrollment declines in southern districts. Central district school desegregation generated only a small portion of overall urban population decentralization between 1960 and 1990.

10.1257/aer.101.7.3019.abstractZh: 本文探讨了大型城市公立学区废除种族隔离后，居民居住地点和学校选择的变化。我们将废除种族隔离后白人公立学校入学人数下降的现象分解为向郊区迁移以及私立学校入学人数的增加，并发现迁移是更为普遍的反应。废除种族隔离导致南方以外的黑人公立学校入学人数显著增加，这主要是由于黑人家庭向郊区的迁移速度减缓所致。而南方地区的黑人私立学校入学人数则出现了大幅下降。在1960年至1990年间，中央学区废除种族隔离仅导致了城市总人口迁移的较小程度的变化。

abstract.text: We investigate the effects of the institutional settings of the US health care system on individuals' life-cycle medical expenditures. Health is a form of general human capital; labor turnover and labor-market frictions prevent an employer-employee pair from capturing the entire surplus from investment in an employee’s health. Thus, the pair underinvests in health during working years, thereby increasing medical expenditures during retirement. We provide empirical evidence consistent with the comparative statics predictions of our model using the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey (MEPS) and the Health and Retirement Study (HRS). Our estimates suggest significant inefficiencies in health investment in the United States.

10.1257/aer.101.7.3047.abstractZh: 我们研究了美国医疗体系制度环境对个人生命周期医疗支出的影响。健康是一种一般人力资本；劳动力流动和劳动力市场摩擦使得雇主与雇员之间无法完全从员工健康投资中获益。因此，双方在工作期间对健康的投资不足，导致退休后的医疗支出增加。我们通过《医疗支出面板调查》和《健康与退休研究》提供的实证数据，证实了模型预测的统计结果。我们的估计表明，美国的健康投资存在显著效率低下问题。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the impact of electrification on employment growth by analyzing South Africa's mass roll-out of electricity to rural households. Using several new data sources and two different identification strategies (an instrumental variables strategy and a fixed effects approach), I find that electrification significantly raises female employment within five years. This new infrastructure appears to increase hours of work for men and women, while reducing female wages and increasing male earnings. Several pieces of evidence suggest that household electrification raises employment by releasing women from home production and enabling microenterprises. Migration behavior may also be affected. (JEL H54, L94, L98, O15, O18, R23)

10.1257/aer.101.7.3078.abstractZh: 本文通过分析南非向农村家庭大规模推广电力的情况，估算了电力普及对就业增长的影响。通过利用多种新的数据来源和两种不同的识别策略（工具变量策略和固定效应方法），我发现电力普及在五年内显著提高了女性的就业率。这种新的基础设施似乎增加了男女的工作时间，同时降低了女性的工资，提高了男性的收入。多项证据表明，家庭电力普及通过让女性摆脱家庭生产活动，并支持微型企业的发展，从而提升了就业率。此外，迁移行为也可能受到影响。（JEL H54, L94, L98, O15, O18, R23）

abstract.text: We conduct a random-assignment experiment to investigate whether positive affect impacts time preference, where time preference denotes a preference for present over future utility. Our result indicates that, compared to neutral affect, mild positive affect significantly reduces time preference over money. This result is robust to various specification checks, and alternative interpretations of the result are considered. Our result has implications for the effect of happiness on time preference and the role of emotions in economic decision making, in general. Finally, we reconfirm the ubiquity of time preference and start to explore its determinants. (DJEL D12, D83, I31)

10.1257/aer.101.7.3109.abstractZh: 我们进行了随机分配实验，以研究积极情绪是否会影响时间偏好，其中时间偏好指的是对当前效用而非未来效用的偏好。我们的结果表明，与中性情绪相比，轻微的积极情绪显著降低了时间对金钱的时间偏好。这一结果在各种规范检验中均保持稳定，并且我们考虑了结果的多种解释。我们的研究结果对幸福对时间偏好的影响以及情绪在经济决策中的作用具有启示意义。最后，我们再次确认了时间偏好的普遍性，并开始探索其决定因素。（DJEL D12, D83, I31）

abstract.text: We examine US local telephone markets shortly after the Telecommunications Act of 1996. The data suggest that more experienced, better-educated managers tend to enter markets with fewer competitors. This motivates a structural econometric model based on behavioral game theory that allows heterogeneity in managers' ability to conjecture competitor behavior. We find that manager characteristics are key determinants in managerial ability. This estimate of ability predicts out-of-sample success. Also, the measured level of ability rises following a shakeout, suggesting that our behavioral assumptions may be most relevant early in the industry's life cycle. (JEL L96, L98, M10)

10.1257/aer.101.7.3130.abstractZh: 我们研究了1996年《电信法》颁布后美国的本地电话市场。数据显示，经验更丰富、教育程度更高的管理者往往倾向于进入竞争较少的市场。这促使我们基于行为博弈理论构建了一个结构性计量经济模型，该模型能够考虑管理者在推测竞争对手行为方面的能力差异。我们发现，管理者特征是管理能力的关键决定因素。这一能力估计值能够预测样本外的情况。此外，在市场竞争加剧后，管理者的实际能力水平有所提升，这表明我们的行为假设在行业生命周期的早期阶段可能最为重要。（JEL L96, L98, M10）

abstract.text: In the sixteenth century, North America contained 25 to 30 million buffalo; by the late nineteenth century fewer than 100 remained. While removing the buffalo east of the Mississippi took over 100 years, the remaining 10 to 15 million buffalo on the Great Plains were killed in a punctuated slaughter lasting little more than ten years. I employ theory, international trade statistics, and first-person accounts to argue the slaughter was initiated by a foreign-made innovation and fueled by a foreign demand for industrial leather. European demand and American policy failure are jointly responsible for the “Slaughter on the Plains.” (JEL F14, N51, N71, Q57)

10.1257/aer.101.7.3162.abstractZh: 在十六世纪，北美地区有2500万到3000万头水牛；到了十九世纪末，数量已减少到不足100头。将密西西比河以东的水牛赶走花费了超过100年的时间，而大平原上剩余的1000万到1500万头水牛则在短短十多年内被屠杀殆尽。我运用理论分析、国际贸易统计数据以及第一手资料来论证，这种屠杀是由一种外国制造的创新技术引发的，并且是由对外工业皮革的需求所推动的。欧洲的需求和美国政策的失误共同导致了“大平原上的屠杀”。(JEL F14, N51, N71, Q57)

abstract.text: We study David Gale's (1963) economy using laboratory markets. Tatonnement theory predicts prices will diverge from an equitable interior equilibrium toward infinity or zero depending only on initial prices. The inequitable equilibria determined by these dynamics give all gains from exchange to one side of the market. We show surprisingly strong support for these predictions. In most sessions one side of the market eventually outgains the other by more than 20 times, leaving the disadvantaged side to trade for mere pennies. We also find preliminary evidence that these dynamics are sticky, resisting exogenous interventions designed to reverse their trajectories. (JEL C92, D50)

10.1257/aer.101.7.3196.abstractZh: 我们运用实验室市场模型研究了David Gale（1963）提出的经济模型。Tatonnement理论预测，价格会偏离公平的内部均衡点，趋向于无穷大或零，这一变化仅取决于初始价格。由这些动态决定的不公平均衡状态意味着市场的一方会获得所有的交换收益。我们的研究出乎意料地支持了这一预测。在大多数情况下，市场的一方最终获得的收益是另一方的20倍以上，而处于劣势的一方只能获得微薄的收益。我们还发现了初步证据，表明这种动态具有粘性，难以被旨在改变其轨迹的外源干预所逆转。（JEL C92, D50）

abstract.text: We show that current differences in trust levels within Africa can be traced back to the transatlantic and Indian Ocean slave trades. Combining contemporary individual-level survey data with historical data on slave shipments by ethnic group, we find that individuals whose ancestors were heavily raided during the slave trade are less trusting today. Evidence from a variety of identification strategies suggests that the relationship is causal. Examining causal mechanisms, we show that most of the impact of the slave trade is through factors that are internal to the individual, such as cultural norms, beliefs, and values. (JEL J15, N57, Z13)

10.1257/aer.101.7.3221.abstractZh: 我们指出，非洲当前在信任水平上的差异可以追溯到跨大西洋和印度洋的奴隶贸易。通过结合当代个体层面的调查数据与按种族群体划分的奴隶运输历史数据，我们发现那些在奴隶贸易期间祖先遭受严重劫掠的个体，如今信任程度较低。来自多种身份识别策略的证据表明，这种关系具有因果关系。通过研究因果机制，我们发现奴隶贸易的大部分影响是通过个体内部因素产生的，如文化规范、信仰和价值观等。（JEL J15, N57, Z13）

abstract.text: This paper compares electoral outcomes of 1999 parliamentary elections in Russia among geographical areas with differential access to the only national TV channel independent from the government. It was available to three-quarters of Russia's population and its signal availability was idiosyncratic, conditional on observables. Independent TV decreased aggregate vote for the government party by 8.9 percentage points, increased the combined vote for major opposition parties by 6.3 percentage points, and decreased turnout by 3.8 percentage points. The probability of voting for opposition parties increased for individuals who watched independent TV even controlling for voting intentions measured one month before elections. (JEL D72, L82, P26)

10.1257/aer.101.7.3253.abstractZh: 本文比较了1999年俄罗斯议会选举中，不同地理区域选举结果的差异，这些地区在获取唯一一个独立于政府的全国电视频道方面存在差异。该电视频道可供俄罗斯四分之三的人口观看，其信号可用性取决于多种可观测因素。独立电视频道使政府党的总得票率下降了8.9个百分点，主要反对党的总得票率上升了6.3个百分点，同时投票率下降了3.8个百分点。即使控制了选举前一个月的投票意向，观看独立电视频道的个人投票支持反对党的概率仍然有所上升。（JEL D72, L82, P26）

abstract.text: The French Revolution had a momentous impact on neighboring countries. It removed the legal and economic barriers protecting oligarchies, established the principle of equality before the law, and prepared economies for the new industrial opportunities of the second half of the 19th century. We present within-Germany evidence on the long-run implications of these institutional reforms. Occupied areas appear to have experienced more rapid urbanization growth, especially after 1850. A two-stage least squares strategy provides evidence consistent with the hypothesis that the reforms instigated by the French had a positive impact on growth. JEL: N13, N43, O47

10.1257/aer.101.7.3286.abstractZh: 法国大革命对周边国家产生了重大影响。它消除了保护寡头政治的法律和经济障碍，确立了法律面前人人平等的原则，并为19世纪后半叶新的工业机遇准备了经济环境。我们提供了关于这些制度性改革长期影响的德国国内证据。被占领地区似乎经历了更快的城市化进程，尤其是在1850年之后。两阶段最小二乘法分析提供的证据与这一假设一致，即法国引发的改革对经济增长产生了积极影响。JEL: N13, N43, O47

abstract.text: Longitudinal administrative data show that rejected male applicants to the Disability Insurance (DI) program who are younger or have low-mortality impairments such as back pain and mental health problems exhibit substantial labor force attachment. While we confirm that employment rates of older rejected applicants are low, continued high numbers of younger and low-mortality beneficiaries have raised the potential employment of DI beneficiaries. Three findings support economic inducement to apply. Mean preapplication earnings have fallen, rejected applicants experience preapplication declines in earnings, and beneficiaries whose first applications were rejected at the DDS level but who ultimately received benefits exhibit substantial employment. JEL: H55, J14, J28, J31

10.1257/aer.101.7.3308.abstractZh: 纵向行政数据表明，被拒绝的残疾保险项目的男性申请人中，年龄较小或患有低死亡率疾病（如背痛和心理健康问题）的申请人，其劳动力参与度较高。虽然我们确认年龄较大的被拒绝申请人的就业率较低，但年轻且患有低死亡率疾病的受益人的数量持续增加，这提高了残疾保险受益人的就业潜力。有三个发现支持了申请的经济动机：申请前的平均收入有所下降，被拒绝的申请人申请前的收入也有所下降，而那些在DDS级别首次申请被拒但最终获得福利的受益人，其就业率也较高。JEL: H55, J14, J28, J31

abstract.text: This paper investigates the relationship between relative earnings and giving in a two-stage, real-effort experiment. In the first stage, four players compete in a tournament that determines their earnings. In the second stage, they decide whether to make a transfer to one or more of their group members. Our main finding is that those ranked first are significantly less likely to give than those ranked second. This difference disappears if individuals learn about the second stage after earning their income or if earnings are randomly determined. This suggests that our main finding is driven by selection based on other-regarding preferences. JEL: D64, J31

10.1257/aer.101.7.3330.abstractZh: 本文通过一项两阶段的实际努力实验，研究了相对收益与给予行为之间的关系。在第一阶段，四位参与者参加一场决定他们收益的比赛。在第二阶段，他们决定是否向一个或多个小组成员进行转账。我们的主要发现是，排名靠前的参与者给予的可能性明显低于排名靠后的参与者。如果个体在获得收入后得知第二阶段的决策，或者收入是随机确定的，这种差异就会消失。这表明我们的主要发现是由基于他人偏好的选择所驱动的。JEL: D64, J31

abstract.text: This paper characterizes the optimal contract for a principal who repeatedly chooses among N potential agents under the threat of holdup. Over time, the principal would like to trade with different agents; however, the possibility of ex-post opportunism allows agents to collect rents and creates a fixed cost of initiating new relationships. In the optimal contract, the principal divides agents into “insiders” with whom she trades efficiently, and “outsiders” whom she is biased against. The optimal contract is self-enforcing if the principal is sufficiently patient and can be implemented by an “employment contract” that is robust to asymmetric information. JEL: C73, D82, D83, D86

10.1257/aer.101.7.3349.abstractZh: 本文描述了在存在垄断威胁的情况下，委托人如何在多个潜在代理人中反复选择最优契约。随着时间的推移，委托人希望与不同的代理人进行交易；然而，事后机会主义的可能性使得代理人能够获取租金，并产生了建立新关系的固定成本。在最优契约中，委托人将代理人分为“内部人”和“外部人”——与内部人高效交易，而对外部人则存在偏见。如果委托人具有足够的耐心，并且可以通过一种能够应对信息不对称问题的“雇佣合同”来实施该契约，那么该契约就能自我维持。JEL: C73, D82, D83, D86

abstract.text: This paper estimates the technological progress that has occurred since 1980 in the automobile industry and the trade-offs faced when choosing between fuel economy, weight, and engine power characteristics. The results suggest that if weight, horsepower, and torque were held at their 1980 levels, fuel economy could have increased by nearly 60 percent from 1980 to 2006. Once technological progress is considered, meeting the CAFE standards adopted in 2007 will require halting the trend in weight and engine power characteristics, but little more. In contrast, the standards recently announced by the new administration, while attainable, require nontrivial "downsizing.” JEL: L50, L60

10.1257/aer.101.7.3368.abstractZh: 本文估算了自1980年以来汽车工业的技术进步，以及在选择燃油经济性、重量和发动机功率特性时面临的权衡。研究结果表明，如果重量、马力和扭矩保持在1980年的水平，从1980年到2006年，燃油经济性可以提高近60%。一旦考虑到技术进步，达到2007年制定的CAFE标准只需要停止重量和发动机功率特性的下降趋势，无需进行太多调整。相比之下，新政府最近宣布的标准虽然可实现，但需要进行相当大的“小型化”改造。JEL: L50, L60

abstract.text: Credit constraints linking debt to market-determined prices embody a systemic credit externality that drives a wedge between competitive and constrained socially optimal equilibria, inducing private agents to overborrow. This externality arises because private agents fail to internalize the financial amplification effects of carrying a large amount of debt when credit constraints bind. We conduct a quantitative analysis of this externality in a two-sector dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model of a small open economy calibrated to emerging markets. Raising the cost of borrowing during tranquil times restores constrained efficiency and significantly reduces the incidence and severity of financial crises. JEL: E13, E32, E44, F41, G01

10.1257/aer.101.7.3400.abstractZh: 信用约束将债务与市场确定的价格联系起来，这种系统性信用外部性会在竞争性与受约束的社会最优均衡之间制造差距，导致私人行为者过度借贷。这种外部性产生的原因在于，当信用约束存在时，私人行为者无法内部化承担大量债务所带来的财务放大效应。我们对这种外部性进行了定量分析，研究基于一个小型开放经济的两部门动态随机一般均衡模型，该模型经过校准以适应新兴市场的情况。在平稳时期提高借贷成本可以恢复受约束的效率，并显著减少金融危机的发生频率和严重程度。JEL分类：E13, E32, E44, F41, G01

abstract.text: One of the most robust findings in experimental economics is that individuals in one-shot ultimatum games reject unfair offers. Puzzlingly, rejections have been found robust to substantial increases in stakes. By using a novel experimental design that elicits frequent low offers and uses much larger stakes than in the literature, we are able to examine stakes' effects over ranges of data that are heretofore unexplored. Our main result is that proportionally equivalent offers are less likely to be rejected with high stakes. In fact, our paper is the first to present evidence that as stakes increase, rejection rates approach zero. JEL: C72, C78, C91

10.1257/aer.101.7.3427.abstractZh: 实验经济学中最有力的发现之一是，在一次性 ultimatum 游戏中，个体会拒绝不公平的提议。令人惊讶的是，这些拒绝行为在赌注大幅增加的条件下仍然保持稳定。通过采用一种新颖的实验设计，我们能够引发频繁的低额提议，并使用比现有文献中更大的赌注，从而研究赌注对结果的影响。我们的主要结论是，在高赌注的情况下，比例相当的提议被拒绝的可能性较低。事实上，我们的论文首次提供了证据，表明随着赌注的增加，拒绝率趋近于零。JEL: C72, C78, C91

abstract.text: Counter to extant stylized facts, using newly available data on country allocations in US investors' foreign equity portfolios we find that (i) US investors do not exhibit returns-chasing behavior, but, consistent with partial portfolio rebalancing, tend to sell past winners; and (ii) US investors increase portfolio weights on a country's equity market just prior to its strong performance, behavior inconsistent with an informational disadvantage. Over the past two decades, US investors' foreign equity portfolios outperformed a value-weighted foreign benchmark by 160 basis points per year. JEL: C58, G11, G15

10.1257/aer.101.7.3440.abstractZh: 与现有的风格化事实相反，通过利用新获得的美国投资者海外股票投资组合中各国配置的数据，我们发现：(i) 美国投资者并未表现出追逐回报的行为，而是倾向于进行部分投资组合的重新平衡，即出售过去表现良好的股票；(ii) 美国投资者在某一国家股市表现强劲之前会增加该国的股票在投资组合中的权重，这种行为与信息劣势无关。在过去二十年里，美国投资者的海外股票投资组合每年的表现优于一个按价值加权后的海外基准指数，高出160个基点。JEL: C58, G11, G15

abstract.text: Healthcare spending varies widely across markets, and previous empirical studies find little evidence that higher spending translates into better health outcomes. The main innovation in this paper exploits this cross-sectional variation in hospital spending in a new way by considering patients who are exposed to healthcare systems not designed for them: patients far from home when a health emergency strikes. Visitors to Florida who become ill in high-spending areas have significantly lower mortality rates compared to visitors in lower-spending areas. The results are robust within groups of similar visitors and within groups of destinations that appear to be close demand substitutes-areas that likely attract similar visitors.

10.1257/app.3.3.221.abstractZh: 不同市场的医疗保健支出存在很大差异，以往的研究发现，较高的支出并不一定能带来更好的健康结果。本文的主要创新之处在于，通过考虑那些身处不适合自己的医疗体系中的患者，来揭示这种医院支出方面的横向差异。例如，当健康紧急情况发生时，远离家乡的患者所面临的医疗状况可能更为严峻。在佛罗里达州，那些在高支出地区生病的人，其死亡率明显低于在低支出地区生病的人。这些结果在相似特征的访问者群体以及那些看似具有相近需求替代性的目的地中同样成立——这些地方很可能吸引着类似特征的访问者。

abstract.text: Economists have shown that large and persistent differences in productivity levels across businesses are ubiquitous. This finding has shaped research agendas in a number of fields, including (but not limited to) macroeconomics, industrial organization, labor, and trade. This paper surveys and evaluates recent empirical work addressing the question of why businesses differ in their measured productivity levels. The causes are manifold, and differ depending on the particular setting. They include elements sourced in production practices—and therefore over which producers have some direct control, at least in theory—as well as from producers' external operating environments. After evaluating the current state of knowledge, I lay out what I see are the major questions that research in the area should address going forward. (JEL D24, G31, L11, M10, O30, O47)

10.1257/jel.49.2.326.abstractZh: 经济学家们已经证明，不同企业之间在生产力水平上的巨大且持续性的差异是普遍存在的。这一发现影响了多个领域的研究方向，包括（但不仅限于）宏观经济学、产业组织学、劳动经济学和贸易经济学。本文对近期关于企业生产力水平差异问题的实证研究进行了综述和评估。造成这种差异的原因多种多样，并且会因具体环境的不同而有所差异。这些原因既包括生产实践中的因素——至少在理论上，生产者对这些因素有一定的直接控制能力——也包括生产者的外部运营环境。在评估了当前的知识水平之后，我提出了我认为该领域未来研究应该关注的主要问题。（JEL D24, G31, L11, M10, O30, O47）

abstract.text: In the United States, health care technology has contributed to rising survival rates, yet health care spending relative to GDP has also grown more rapidly than in any other country.We develop a model of patient demand and supplier behavior to explain these parallel trends in technology growth and cost growth.We show that health care productivity depends on the heterogeneity of treatment effects across patients, the shape of the health production function, and the cost structure of procedures such as MRIs with high fixed costs and low marginal costs.The model implies a typology of medical technology productivity: (I) highly cost-effective "home run" innovations with little chance of overuse, such as anti-retroviral therapy for HIV, (II) treatments highly effective for some but not for all (e.g.stents), and (III) "gray area" treatments with uncertain clinical value such as ICU days among chronically ill patients.Not surprisingly, countries adopting Category I and effective Category II treatments gain the greatest health improvements, while countries adopting ineffective Category II and Category III treatments experience the most rapid cost growth.Ultimately, economic and political resistance in the U.S. to ever-rising tax rates will likely slow cost growth, with uncertain effects on technology growth.

10.1257/jel.50.3.645.abstractZh: 在美国，医疗技术促进了生存率的提高，但医疗保健支出相对于GDP的增长速度比其他任何国家都要快。我们通过患者需求和供应商行为的模型来解释这种技术增长与成本增长并行的趋势。我们发现，医疗生产力取决于患者之间治疗效果的异质性、健康生产函数的形状以及诸如MRI等程序的成本结构，这些程序具有较高的固定成本和较低的边际成本。该模型将医疗技术生产力分为三类：(I)具有高度成本效益的“一劳永逸”的创新，如抗逆转录病毒疗法，这些疗法几乎没有过度使用的风险；(II)对某些患者非常有效但对其他患者无效的治疗，例如支架手术；(III)临床价值不确定的“灰色区域”治疗，如慢性病患者在重症监护室中的天数。不出所料，采用第一类有效治疗和第二类有效治疗的国家会获得最大的健康改善，而采用无效的第二类和第三类治疗的国家则会出现最快的成本增长。最终，美国经济和政治上对不断上升的税率的抵制可能会减缓成本增长，但这对技术增长的影响并不确定。

abstract.text: This paper focuses on a broad movement toward a fundamentally different way of paying healthcare providers. The approach reaches beyond the old dichotomies about whether healthcare providers are reimbursed on a fee-for-service or a "capitated" or per-person payment. Instead, these reforms seek to create direct linkages between payments to healthcare providers and measures of the quality and efficiency of care. After an overview of payment reforms for healthcare providers and their welfare implications, this paper discusses a range of empirical studies. These often small-scale studies suggest that provider payment reforms in conjunction with greater attention to improving measurements of care quality and outcomes can have a significant impact on quality of care and, in some cases, resource use and costs of care.

10.1257/jep.25.2.69.abstractZh: 本文聚焦于一种全新的支付方式，旨在改变医疗提供者的付费方式。这种支付方式超越了传统的二分法，不再区分医疗提供者是基于服务收费还是基于“包干制”或人均付费。相反，这些改革旨在将医疗提供者的付费与护理质量和效率的指标直接联系起来。在概述了医疗提供者的付费改革及其对福利的影响之后，本文讨论了一系列实证研究。这些通常是小规模的研究表明，结合对护理质量和结果指标的更多关注，对提供者的付费改革能够显著影响护理质量，在某些情况下还能降低资源使用成本和护理费用。

abstract.text: Health insurance companies seek to influence the type of care patients receive in order to increase value in relation to cost. Traditional health insurance relies primarily on price mechanisms to affect patients' and doctors' choices, whereas managed care plans such as HMOs, as the name implies, affect choices directly thorough various forms of managed care. I investigate the effect of pecuniary and non-pecuniary incentives used by health insurance companies to influence prescription decisions in an important class of pharmaceuticals, cholesterol-lowering drugs called Statins, using a discrete-choice demand model on patient-level data. My results suggest that HMOs are significantly more successful at influencing drug choice than traditional indemnity insurers. In conjunction with volume-contingent discounts given by drug producers, this could explain part of the cost-effectiveness differential between HMOs and traditional indemnity insurers.

10.2202/1935-1682.2665.abstractZh: 健康保险公司试图影响患者接受的护理类型，以提高成本效益。传统健康保险主要依赖价格机制来影响患者和医生的决策，而像HMO这样的管理式护理计划则通过各种形式的“管理式护理”直接影响决策。我使用患者层面的离散选择需求模型，研究了健康保险公司在影响某些重要药物——降胆固醇药物他汀类药物的处方决策时所使用的金钱和非金钱激励措施的效果。我的研究结果表明，HMO在影响药物选择方面比传统的赔偿型保险公司更为成功。结合药品生产商提供的按销量给予的折扣，这可以解释HMO与传统赔偿型保险公司之间在成本效益上的差异。

abstract.text: Market definition is essential to merger analysis. Because no standard approach to market definition exists, opposing parties in antitrust cases often disagree about the extent of the market. These differences have been particularly relevant in the hospital industry, where the courts have denied seven of eight merger challenges since 1994, due largely to disagreements over geographic market definition. We compare geographic markets produced using common ad hoc methodologies to a method that directly applies the "SSNIP test" to hospitals in California using a structural model. Our results suggest that previously employed methods overstate hospital demand elasticities by a factor of 2.4 to 3.4 and define larger markets than would be implied by the merger guidelines's hypothetical monopolist test. The use of these methods in differentiated product industries may lead to mistaken geographic market delineation, and was likely a contributing factor to the permissive legal environment for hospital mergers.

10.3386/w16656.abstractZh: 市场定义对于合并分析至关重要。由于不存在标准的市场定义方法，反垄断案件中的对立双方往往对市场的范围存在分歧。在医院行业，这种差异尤为明显，自1994年以来，法院在八起合并挑战中仅驳回了七起，主要原因是对于地理市场定义的争议。我们对比了使用常见方法生成的地理市场，以及直接应用“SSNIP测试”对加利福尼亚州医院进行结构模型分析的方法。我们的研究结果表明，之前使用的方法高估了医院需求的弹性，其高估幅度为2.4至3.4倍，并且所定义的市场范围比合并指南中的假设垄断者测试所暗示的要大。在差异化产品行业中使用这些方法可能会导致错误的地理市场划分，这可能是医院合并获得宽松法律环境的一个因素。

abstract.text: Exploiting variation in welfare reform across states and over time and using relevant comparison groups, this study estimates the effects of welfare reform on an important source of human capital acquisition among women at risk for relying on welfare: vocational education and training. The results indicate that welfare reform reduced enrollment in full-time vocational education and had no significant effects on part-time vocational education or participation in other types of work-related courses, though there is considerable heterogeneity across states with respect to the strictness of educational policy and the strength of work incentives under welfare reform. In addition, we find heterogeneous effects by prior educational attainment. We find no evidence that the previously-observed negative effects of welfare reform on formal education (including college enrollment), which we replicated in this study, have been offset by increases in vocational education and training.

10.3386/w16659.abstractZh: 本研究通过利用各州之间以及不同时期福利改革的变化情况，并采用相关的比较组，来估算福利改革对女性人力资本获取的重要来源——职业教育与培训的影响。研究结果表明，福利改革减少了女性参加全日制职业教育的比例，但对非全日制职业教育或其他类型与工作相关的课程的参与没有显著影响。不过，各州在教育政策的严格程度以及福利改革下工作激励的强度方面存在显著差异。此外，我们发现不同教育背景下的效果也有所不同。我们没有发现福利改革对正规教育（包括大学入学）的负面影响在本研究中得到了职业教育与培训的增加所抵消的证据。

abstract.text: This paper describes the findings from a new, and intrinsically interdisciplinary, literature on happiness and human well-being. The paper focuses on international evidence. We report the patterns in modern data; we discuss what has been persuasively established and what has not; we suggest paths for future research. Looking ahead, our instinct is that this social-science research avenue will gradually merge with a related literature -- from the medical, epidemiological, and biological sciences -- on biomarkers and health. Nevertheless, we expect that intellectual convergence to happen slowly.

10.3386/w16668.abstractZh: 本文介绍了关于幸福与人类福祉的新研究成果，这些研究具有跨学科性质。文章重点关注国际层面的证据。我们分析了现代数据中的模式，讨论了哪些观点已经得到有力支持，哪些尚未得到证实，并提出了未来研究的方向。展望未来，我们认为这一社会科学研究方向将逐渐与医学、流行病学和生物学领域的相关研究相结合，以探讨生物标志物与健康之间的关系。不过，我们预计这种思想上的融合会是一个缓慢的过程。

abstract.text: We examine the effects of state health insurance mandates requiring coverage of screening mammograms. We find robust evidence that mammography mandates significantly increased mammography screenings by 4.5-25 percent. Effects are larger for women with less than a high school degree in states that ban deductibles, a policy similar to a provision of federal health reform that eliminates cost-sharing for preventive care. We also find that mandates increased detection of early stage in-situ pre-cancers. Finally, we find a substantial proportion of the increased screenings were attributable to mandates that are not consistent with current recommendations of the American Cancer Society.

10.3386/w16669.abstractZh: 我们研究了州级健康保险强制要求覆盖筛查性乳腺X光检查的影响。研究发现，强制要求筛查性乳腺X光检查使筛查率增加了4.5%至25%。在禁止免赔额的州，这一影响更为显著，这一政策与联邦健康改革中的一项规定类似，该规定取消了预防性护理的费用分担。我们还发现，强制要求筛查性乳腺X光检查增加了对早期原位癌的检出率。最后，我们发现，筛查率的增加在很大程度上是由于那些与美国癌症协会当前建议不符的强制要求所导致的。

abstract.text: In this paper, we investigate the impact of attending school on body weight and obesity. We use school starting age cutoff dates to compare weight outcomes for similar age children with different years of school exposure. As is the case with academic outcomes, school exposure is related to unobserved determinants of weight outcomes because some families choose to have their child start school late (or early). If one does not account for this endogeneity, it appears that an additional year of school exposure results in a greater BMI and a higher probability of being overweight or obese. When actual exposure is instrumented with expected exposure based on school starting dates and birthday, the significant positive effects disappear, and most point estimates become negative and insignificant. However, for children not eating the school lunch, there is a significant negative effect on the probability of being overweight.

10.3386/w16673.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了就学对体重和肥胖的影响。我们通过学校入学年龄的截止日期来比较不同年龄儿童在相同的年龄阶段但因学校入学时间不同而获得的体重结果。与学业成绩类似，学校入学时间也与体重结果的未观测因素相关，因为一些家庭选择让孩子晚些或早些入学。如果不考虑这种内生性因素，那么每增加一年的学校入学时间，BMI就会增加，超重或肥胖的概率也会上升。然而，当实际入学时间以基于学校入学日期和出生日期的预期入学时间作为工具变量时，这些显著的积极影响就消失了，大多数点估计值变得负面且不显著。不过，对于不食用学校午餐的儿童来说，学校入学时间对超重概率有显著的负面影响。

abstract.text: This paper estimates social effects of incentivizing people in teams. In two field experiments featuring exogenous team formation and opportunities for repeated social interactions, we find large team effects that operate through social channels. The team compensation system induced agents to choose effort as if they valued a marginal dollar of compensation for their teammate from two-thirds as much (in one study) to twice as much as they valued a dollar of their own compensation (in the other study). We conclude that social effects of monetary team incentives exist and can induce effort at lower cost than through direct individual payment.

10.3386/w16687.abstractZh: 本文研究了激励团队中的成员所带来的社会效应。通过两项实地实验，这些实验涉及外生的团队形成以及重复社交互动的机会，我们发现团队效应显著，且这种效应通过社交渠道发挥作用。团队补偿制度促使参与者付出努力，其程度相当于他们为团队成员付出的每一分钱价值三分之二的补偿（在一项研究中），甚至达到自身补偿价值的两倍（在另一项研究中）。我们得出结论，货币形式的团队激励确实能够产生社会效应，并且其成本低于直接对个人进行支付的方式。

abstract.text: We analyze whether decreased emergency department access (measured by increased driving time to the nearest ED) results in adverse patient outcomes or changes in the patient health profile for patients suffering from acute myocardial infarction. Data sources include 100% Medicare Provider Analysis and Review, AHA hospital annual surveys, Medicare hospital cost reports, and longitude and latitude information for 1995-2005. We define four ED access change categories and estimate a zip codes fixed-effects regression models on the following AMI outcomes: time-specific mortality rates, age, and probability of PTCA on the day of admission. We find a small increase in 30-day to 1-year mortality rates among patients in communities that experience <10-minute increase in driving time. Among patients in communities with >30-minute increases in driving time, we find a substantial increase in long-term mortality rates, a shift to younger ages (suggesting that the older ones die en route) and a higher probability of immediate PTCA. Most of the adverse effects disappear after the initial three-year transition window.

10.3386/w16690.abstractZh: 我们分析了减少急诊科的可及性（通过增加前往最近急诊科的驾驶时间来衡量）是否会导致急性心肌梗塞患者的不良后果，或影响患者的健康状况。数据来源包括100%的Medicare医疗服务提供者分析和审查、AHA医院年度调查、Medicare医院成本报告，以及1995-2005年的经度和纬度信息。我们定义了四种急诊科可及性变化类别，并针对以下急性心肌梗塞结果建立了邮政编码固定效应回归模型：特定时间的死亡率、年龄，以及入院当天进行经皮冠状动脉介入手术的概率。我们发现，在驾驶时间增加<10分钟的社区中，30天至1年的死亡率略有上升。而在驾驶时间增加>30分钟的社区中，我们发现长期死亡率显著上升，患者年龄趋于年轻（表明年长者在途中死亡的可能性更大），并且立即进行经皮冠状动脉介入手术的概率也更高。大多数不良影响在最初的三年过渡期后消失。

abstract.text: In this paper, we examine the impact of poor water quality on avoidance behavior by estimating the change in bottled water purchases in response to drinking water violations. Using data from a national grocery chain matched with water quality violations, we find an increase in bottled water sales of 22 percent from violations due to microorganisms and 17 percent from violations due to elements and chemicals. Back-of-the envelope calculations yield costs of avoidance behavior at roughly $60 million for all nationwide violations in 2005, which likely reflects a significant understatement of the total willingness to pay to eliminate violations.

10.3386/w16695.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们通过估算因饮用水违规而引发的瓶装水购买变化，来研究水质不良对人们回避行为的影响。利用全国连锁超市的数据以及水质违规记录，我们发现因微生物违规导致的瓶装水销量增加了22%，而因元素和化学物质违规导致的销量则增加了17%。粗略估算，2005年全国所有违规事件导致的回避行为成本约为6000万美元，这一数字很可能低估了人们为消除违规行为而愿意支付的总金额。

abstract.text: While it has long been known that genetic-environmental covariance is likely to be non-trivial and confound estimates of narrow-sense (additive) heritability for social and behavioral outcomes, there has not been an effective way to address this concern. Indeed, in a classic paper, Goldberger (1979) shows that by varying assumptions of the GE-covariance, a researcher can drive the estimated heritability of an outcome, such as IQ, down to zero or up close to one. Survey questions that attempt to measure directly the extent to which more genetically similar kin (such as monozygotic twins) also share more similar environmental conditions than, say, dizygotic twins, represent poor attempts to gauge a very complex underlying phenomenon of GE-covariance. Methods that rely on concordance between interviewer classification and self-report offer similar concerns about validity. In the present study, we take advantage of a natural experiment to address this issue from another angle: Misclassification of twin zygosity in a nationally-representative study (Add Health). Since such twins were reared under one "environmental regime of similarity" while genetically belonging to another group, this reverses the typical GE-covariance and allows us bounded estimates of heritability for a range of outcomes of interest to medical and behavioral scientists.
