10.3386/w16711.abstractZh: 长期以来，人们已经知道遗传与环境之间的协变关系很可能并非简单明了，这会干扰对狭义（加性）遗传力的估计。实际上，在一项经典研究中，Goldberger（1979）指出，通过改变遗传与环境协变关系的假设，研究人员可以将某个结果的遗传率估计值降至零或接近一。那些试图直接衡量基因相似程度较高的亲属（如单卵双胞胎）与双卵双胞胎相比，是否具有相似的环境条件的调查方法，并不能很好地反映遗传与环境协变关系的复杂现象。依赖于访谈分类与自我报告之间一致性的方法，同样存在有效性方面的担忧。在本研究中，我们利用了一个自然实验，从另一个角度来解决这个问题：在一项具有全国代表性的Add Health研究中，对双胞胎性别的分类出现了错误分类。由于这些双胞胎在相同的“环境制度”下成长，而基因上属于另一组，这就逆转了典型的遗传与环境协变关系，使我们能够较为准确地估计医学和行为科学所关注的各类结果的遗传率。

abstract.text: As multi-hospital kidney exchange clearinghouses have grown, the set of players has grown from patients and surgeons to include hospitals. Hospitals have the option of enrolling only their hard-to-match patient-donor pairs, while conducting easily arranged exchanges internally. This behavior has already started to be observed. We show that the cost of making it individually rational for hospitals to participate fully is low in almost every large exchange pool (although the worst-case cost is very high), while the cost of failing to guarantee individually rational allocations could be large, in terms of lost transplants. We also identify an incentive compatible mechanism.

10.3386/w16720.abstractZh: 随着多医院肾脏交换中心的不断发展，参与方的范围已经从患者和外科医生扩展到医院。医院可以选择只处理那些难以匹配的医患配对，同时可以在内部进行较为简单的交换。这种现象已经开始出现。我们指出，让医院全面参与交换的成本在几乎所有大型交换池中都是较低的（尽管最坏情况下的成本非常高），而未能确保个体最优分配的代价可能很大，表现为移植手术的成功率降低。我们还提出了一个激励相容的机制。

abstract.text: A growing body of work suggests that education offers a wide-range of benefits that extend beyond increases in labor market productivity. Improvements in education can lower crime, improve health, and increase voting and democratic participation. This chapter reviews recent developments on these 'non-production' benefits of education with an emphasis on contributions made by economists.

10.3386/w16722.abstractZh: 越来越多的研究表明，教育不仅有助于提高劳动力市场的生产力，还能带来广泛的益处。教育水平的提高可以降低犯罪率、改善健康状况，并增加投票和民主参与。本章回顾了关于教育这些“非生产性”益处的近期研究进展，重点介绍了经济学家们所做出的贡献。

abstract.text: We present a graphical framework for analyzing both theoretical and empirical work on selection in insurance markets. We begin by using this framework to review the "textbook" adverse selection environment and its implications for insurance allocation, social welfare, and public policy. We then discuss several important extensions to this classical treatment that are necessitated by important real world features of insurance markets and which can be easily incorporated in the basic framework. Finally, we use the same graphical approach to discuss the intuition behind recently developed empirical methods for testing for the existence of selection and examining its welfare consequences. We conclude by discussing some important issues that are not well-handled by this framework and which, perhaps not unrelatedly, have been little addressed by the existing empirical work.

10.3386/w16723.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个图形框架，用于分析保险市场中选择问题的理论研究和实证工作。首先，我们利用该框架回顾了“教科书式”的逆向选择环境及其对保险分配、社会福利和公共政策的影响。接着，我们讨论了这一经典处理方式的几个重要扩展，这些扩展是由于保险市场中的现实特征所必需的，并且可以很容易地融入基本框架中。最后，我们使用相同的图形方法来探讨最近开发的用于检验选择问题存在性及分析其福利后果的实证方法背后的直觉。最后，我们讨论了该框架未能很好处理的一些重要问题，这些问题或许与现有实证工作较少关注的问题有关。

abstract.text: A positive correlation between insurance coverage and ex post risk can be an indicator for private information in insurance markets. However, this test fails if agents have heterogeneous risk attitudes. We propose a new test that conditions on unobserved types of individuals who differ in their risks preferences. This makes it possible to detect asymmetric information without direct evidence of private information - even if agents have heterogeneous risk attitudes. We apply our technique to the market for long-term care insurance. Finkelstein and McGarry (2006) provide direct evidence for the existence of private information in this market. At the same time they fail to find a positive correlation between insurance coverage and ex post risk. Our method indicates the existence of private information, without using direct evidence of private information. Our methodology is applicable to other insurance markets and markets where proxies for private information are not available.

10.3386/w16738.abstractZh: 保险覆盖与事后风险之间的正相关性可能是保险市场中私人信息的指标。然而，如果代理人具有异质的风险态度，这一检验将失效。我们提出了一种新的检验方法，该方法基于未观察到的个体类型，这些个体在风险偏好上存在差异。这使得即使代理人具有异质的风险态度，也能在不直接证据显示私人信息存在的情况下，检测出信息不对称现象。我们将这一技术应用于长期护理保险市场。Finkelstein和McGarry（2006）为这一市场中私人信息的存在提供了直接证据。同时，他们未能发现保险覆盖与事后风险之间的正相关性。我们的方法表明存在私人信息，而无需使用直接证据。我们的方法适用于其他保险市场以及那些无法获得私人信息替代指标的市场。

abstract.text: The fraction of GDP devoted to health care in the United States is the highest in the world and rising rapidly. Recent economic studies have highlighted the growing value of health improvements, but less attention has been paid to the efficiency costs of tax-financed spending to pay for such improvements. This paper uses a life cycle model of labor supply, saving, and longevity improvement to measure the balanced-budget impact of continued growth in the Medicare and Medicaid programs. The model predicts that top marginal tax rates could rise to 70 percent by 2060, depending on the progressivity of future tax changes. The deadweight loss of the tax system is greater when the financing is more progressive. If the share of taxes paid by high-income taxpayers remains the same, the efficiency cost of raising the revenue needed to finance the additional health spending is $1.48 per dollar of revenue collected, and GDP declines (relative to trend) by 11 percent. A proportional payroll tax has a lower efficiency cost (41 cents per dollar of revenue averaged over all tax hikes, a 5 percent drop in GDP) but more than doubles the share of the tax burden borne by lower income taxpayers. Empirical support for the model comes from analysis of OECD country data showing that countries facing higher tax burdens in 1979 experienced slower health care spending growth in subsequent decades. The rising burden imposed by the public financing of health care expenditures may therefore serve as a brake on health care spending growth.

10.3386/w16772.abstractZh: 美国用于医疗保健的GDP比例位居世界首位，并且正在迅速上升。最近的经济研究强调了健康改善所带来的价值，但人们对税收资助支出以支付这些改善所需的效率成本关注较少。本文采用劳动力供给、储蓄和寿命改善的生命周期模型，来衡量Medicare和Medicaid项目持续发展的平衡预算影响。模型预测，到2060年，最高边际税率可能上升至70%，这取决于未来税收改革的累进性。当税收制度更加累进时，税收系统的无谓损失更大。如果高收入纳税人所缴纳的税款比例保持不变，那么为增加医疗保健支出所需的收入每增加1美元，效率成本将达到1.48美元，GDP将相对趋势下降11%。比例性工资税的效率成本较低（平均每个税收增加41美分，GDP下降5%），但会使低收入纳税人承担的税收负担增加一倍多。模型得到了OECD国家数据的实证支持，数据显示，1979年税收负担较重的国家，在随后的几十年里医疗保健支出的增长较为缓慢。因此，公共资金对医疗保健支出的负担可能成为抑制医疗保健支出增长的因素。

abstract.text: We use longitudinal data from the 1984 through 2007 waves of the Panel Study of Income Dynamics to examine how occupational status is related to the health transitions of 30 to 59 year-old U.S. males. A recent history of blue-collar employment predicts a substantial increase in the probability of transitioning from very good into bad self-assessed health, relative to white-collar employment, but with no evidence of occupational differences in movements from bad to very good health. These findings are robust to a series of sensitivity analyses. The results suggest that blue-collar workers "wear out" faster with age because they are more likely, than their white-collar counterparts, to experience negative health shocks. This partly reflects differences in the physical demands of blue-collar and white-collar jobs.

10.3386/w16794.abstractZh: 我们利用1984年至2007年《收入动态面板研究》的纵向数据，来探讨职业状况与30至59岁美国男性健康转变之间的关系。根据历史数据，蓝领职业的从业者从自评健康非常好的状态转变为较差状态的概率，相对于白领职业者而言，有显著的增加；但并未发现职业差异对从较差健康状态转变为非常好的健康状态的进程产生显著影响。这些发现经过一系列敏感性分析后依然保持稳定。研究结果表明，蓝领工人随着年龄的增长，健康状况的恶化速度更快，因为他们比白领工人更容易受到负面健康冲击的影响。这在一定程度上反映了蓝领和白领工作的物理要求差异。

abstract.text: Preferences and attitudes to illicit drug policy held by individuals are likely to be an important influence in the development of illicit drug policy. Among the key factors impacting on an individual's preferences over substance use policy are their beliefs about the costs and benefits of drug use, their own drug use history, and the extent of drug use amongst their peers. We use data from the Australian National Drug Strategy's Household Surveys to study these preferences. We find that current use and past use of cannabis are major determinants of being in favor of legalization. These results control for reverse causality from favorable attitudes to use. We also find that cannabis users are more in favor of legalization the longer they have used cannabis and, among past users, the more recent their own drug using experience. This may reflect that experience with cannabis provides information about the costs and benefits of using this substance. Finally, we uncover some evidence that peers' use of cannabis impacts on preferences towards legalization.

10.3386/w16795.abstractZh: 个人对非法毒品政策的偏好和态度可能会对非法毒品政策的发展产生重要影响。影响个人对毒品使用政策偏好的关键因素包括他们对毒品使用的成本和收益的看法、个人的毒品使用历史，以及同龄人中的毒品使用程度。我们利用澳大利亚国家毒品战略的家庭调查数据来研究这些偏好。研究发现，当前和过去使用大麻的行为是决定支持合法化政策的重要因素。这些结果控制了从积极态度到实际使用的反向因果关系。我们还发现，使用大麻的时间越长，以及过去使用大麻的经历越近期，个人越支持合法化政策。这可能是因为使用大麻的经历提供了关于使用该物质成本和收益的信息。最后，我们发现同龄人使用大麻的行为也会影响个人对合法化的偏好。

abstract.text: Recent research shows that health at birth is affected by many factors, including maternal education, behaviors, and participation in social programs. In turn, endowments at birth are predictive of adult outcomes, and of the outcomes of future generations. Exposure to environmental pollution is one potential determinant of health at birth that has received increasing attention. A large literature outside of economics advocates for "Environmental Justice," and argues that poor and minority families are disproportionately exposed to environmental hazards. I provide new evidence on this question, showing that children born to less educated and minority mothers are more likely to be exposed to pollution in utero and that white, college educated mothers are particularly responsive to changes in environmental amenities. I estimate that differences in exposure to toxic releases may explain 6% of the gap in incidence of low birth weight between infants of white college educated mothers and infants of black high school dropout mothers.

10.3386/w16798.abstractZh: 近期研究表明，出生时的健康状况受到多种因素的影响，包括母亲的教育水平、行为方式以及参与社会项目的程度。反过来，出生时的健康状况可以预测成年后的结果，甚至影响后代的结局。环境污染是出生时健康状况的一个潜在决定因素，这一因素越来越受到关注。经济学领域之外的许多研究都倡导“环境正义”，并指出贫困家庭和少数族裔家庭更容易暴露于环境危害之中。我提供了关于这一问题的新证据，表明受教育程度较低和属于少数族裔的母亲所生的孩子更可能在子宫内接触到污染，而受过大学教育的白人母亲则对环境条件的变化反应更为敏感。我的估计表明，有毒物质释放造成的暴露差异可能解释了白人大学教育背景的母亲所生的婴儿与黑人高中辍学母亲所生的婴儿之间低出生体重发生率差异的6%。

abstract.text: Occupational choice is a significant input into individuals' health investments, operating in a manner that can be either health-promoting or health-depreciating. Recent studies have highlighted the potential importance of initial occupational choice on subsequent outcomes pertaining to morbidity. This study is the first to assess the existence and strength of a causal relationship between initial occupational choice at labor entry and subsequent health behaviors and habits. We utilize the Panel Study of Income Dynamics to analyze the effect of first occupation, as identified by industry category and blue collar work, on subsequent health outcomes relating to body mass index, obesity, alcohol consumption, and physical activity in 1999-2005. Our findings suggest that initial occupations described as craft, operative, and service are related to higher body mass index and obesity later in life, while labor occupations are related to higher probabilities of smoking later in life. Blue collar work early in life is associated with increased probabilities of obesity and smoking, and decreased physical activity later in life, although effects may be masked by unobserved heterogeneity. Few effects are found for the effect of initial occupation on alcohol consumption. The weight of the evidence bearing from various methodologies, which account for non-random unobserved selection, indicates that at least part of this effect is consistent with a causal interpretation. These estimates also underscore the potential durable impact of early labor market experiences on later health.

10.3386/w16803.abstractZh: 职业选择对个人健康投资有着重要的影响，其效果既可能促进健康，也可能损害健康。最近的研究强调了初次职业选择对后续健康结果的重要性。本研究首次评估了劳动就业时初次职业选择与后续健康行为和习惯之间的因果关系。我们利用收入动态面板研究来分析1999-2005年间，根据行业类别和蓝领工作类型确定的初次职业对随后体重指数、肥胖、酒精消费和体力活动等健康结果的影响。研究发现，初次从事工艺、操作和服务行业的人，其晚年体重指数和肥胖率较高，而从事劳动行业的人晚年吸烟的概率较高。生命早期从事蓝领工作与肥胖和吸烟的概率增加有关，而晚年体力活动减少。关于初次职业对酒精消费的影响，发现的影响较少。来自不同方法的证据表明，至少部分这种影响与因果解释一致。这些估计结果还强调了早期劳动力市场经历对后期健康的潜在持久影响。

abstract.text: We estimate the impacts of the introduction of National Health Insurance (NHI) in Taiwan in March 1995 on the health of infants. Prior to NHI, government workers (the control group) possessed health insurance policies with comprehensive coverage for births and infant medical care services. Private sector industrial workers and farmers (the treatment groups) lacked this coverage. All households received coverage for the services just mentioned as of March 1995. Since stringent requirements for reporting births introduced in 1994 produced artificial upward trends in early infant deaths, we focus on postneonatal mortality (deaths from the 28th through the 364th day of life per thousand survivors of the first 27 days of life). We find that the introduction of NHI led to reductions in this rate for infants born in farm households but not for infants born in private sector households. For the former group, the rate fell by 0.5 deaths per thousand survivors or by 13 percent relative to the mean in the pre-NHI period of 4 deaths per thousand survivors. An especially large decline of 6 deaths per thousand survivors occurred for pre-term infants-- a 36 percent drop relative to the pre-NHI mean of 17 deaths per thousand survivors.

10.3386/w16811.abstractZh: 我们估算了1995年3月台湾实施国民健康保险对婴儿健康的影响。在国民健康保险实施之前，政府工作人员（对照组）拥有涵盖分娩和婴儿医疗服务的全面医疗保险。私营部门工业工人和农民（治疗组）则缺乏这种保险覆盖。截至1995年3月，所有家庭都获得了上述服务的保险覆盖。由于1994年引入严格的出生报告要求导致婴儿早期死亡人数出现人为上升趋势，我们重点关注新生儿后的死亡率（即出生后第28天至第364天内的死亡人数，以每千名出生后27天内的幸存者计算）。研究发现，国民健康保险的引入使得出生于农户家庭的婴儿这一死亡率有所下降，而出生于私营部门家庭的婴儿则没有这种变化。对于前者，死亡率下降了0.5例/千名幸存者，相对于国民健康保险实施前的平均4例/千名幸存者，下降了13%。对于早产婴儿来说，死亡率更是大幅下降，相对于国民健康保险实施前的平均17例/千名幸存者，下降了36%。

abstract.text: Physicians prescribing drugs for patients with schizophrenia and related conditions are remarkably concentrated in their choice among antipsychotic drugs. In 2007 the single antipsychotic drug prescribed by a physician accounted for 66% of all antipsychotic prescriptions written by that physician. Which particular branded antipsychotic was the prescriber's "favorite" varied widely across physicians, i.e. physician prescribing concentration patterns are diverse. Building on Frank and Zeckhauser's [2007] characterization of physician treatments varying from "custom made" to "ready-to-wear", we construct a model of physician learning that generates a number of hypotheses. Using 2007 annual antipsychotic prescribing behavior on 17,652 physicians from IMS Health, we evaluate these predictions empirically. While physician prescribing behavior is generally quite concentrated, prescribers having greater volumes, those with training in psychiatry, male prescribers, and those not approaching retirement age tend to have less concentrated prescribing patterns.

10.3386/w16823.abstractZh: 为患有精神分裂症及相关疾病的患者开药的医生在选择抗精神病药物时表现出显著的集中性。在2007年，一位医生所开的抗精神病药物占该医生所有抗精神病药物处方的66%。不同医生所选择的特定品牌抗精神病药物存在很大差异，即医生在药物选择上的集中模式各不相同。基于Frank和Zeckhauser在2007年对医生治疗方式的分类，即治疗方式从“定制”到“现成可用”的不同，我们构建了一个医生学习模型，并提出了若干假设。通过利用IMS Health提供的2007年17,652名医生抗精神病药物处方数据，我们对这些假设进行了实证评估。虽然医生在药物选择上的行为总体上相当集中，但处方量较大、具有精神病学培训背景、男性医生以及尚未接近退休年龄的医生，其处方模式则相对不那么集中。

abstract.text: We exploit an exogenous health shock--the birth of a child with a severe health condition--to investigate the causal effect of a life shock on homelessness. Using survey data from the Fragile Families and Child Wellbeing study that have been augmented with information from hospital medical records, we find that the health shock increases the likelihood of homelessness three years later, particularly in cities with high housing costs. Homelessness is defined using both a traditional measure and a more contemporary measure that includes residential instability and doubling up without paying rent. The findings are consistent with the economic theory of homelessness, which posits that homelessness results from a conjunction of adverse circumstances in which housing markets and individual characteristics collide. They also add to a growing body of evidence that housing markets are an important contributor to homelessness and suggest that homelessness is a problem not easily addressed by existing public support programs.

10.3386/w16826.abstractZh: 我们利用一个外生性的健康冲击——即出生了一个患有严重健康问题的孩子——来研究生活冲击对无家可归现象的影响。通过《脆弱家庭与儿童福祉研究》的调查数据，并结合医院医疗记录的信息，我们发现这种健康冲击会在三年后增加无家可归的可能性，尤其是在住房成本较高的城市。无家可归现象采用传统的衡量标准以及更现代的衡量标准来定义，后者包括居住不稳定和无偿居住的情况。这些发现与无家可归现象的经济理论一致，该理论认为无家可归现象是由多种不利因素共同作用的结果，这些因素包括住房市场和个人特征之间的冲突。这些发现进一步证明了住房市场是无家可归现象的重要成因，并表明无家可归问题并非现有的公共支持项目能够轻易解决。

abstract.text: We are the first to examine the effect of Superfund cleanups on infant health rather than focusing on proximity to a site. We study singleton births to mothers residing within 5km of a Superfund site between 1989-2003 in five large states. Our "difference in differences" approach compares birth outcomes before and after a site clean-up for mothers who live within 2,000 meters of the site and those who live between 2,000- 5,000 meters of a site. We find that proximity to a Superfund site before cleanup is associated with a 20 to 25% increase in the risk of congenital anomalies.

10.3386/w16844.abstractZh: 我们首次研究了超级基金清理行动对婴儿健康的影响，而非关注与清理现场的地理位置距离。我们研究了1989年至2003年间，五个大州内居住在超级基金清理现场5公里范围内的母亲所生的单胎婴儿的情况。我们的“差异差异”方法比较了清理现场前后，居住在清理现场2000米范围内和2000至5000米范围内的母亲所生婴儿的出生结果。我们发现，在清理前，靠近超级基金清理现场会增加20%至25%的先天性异常风险。

abstract.text: An extensive literature has documented a robust correlation between socioeconomic status--measured in a variety of ways--and health outcomes; however, much uncertainty remains regarding what causal processes underlie this association. The present paper builds on a growing literature that seeks to better document how and why wealth and SES are related. Specifically, we ask the extent to which health shocks affect net worth--a less-studied dimension of socioeconomic status. Given a lack of instruments that meet the exclusion restriction, we use data from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics to pursue a first-differences identification strategy. We estimate a parameter for acute illnesses (which should have a causal effect on wave-to-wave wealth changes) and compare this coefficient to a counterfactual parameter for the presence of chronic illnesses (which we argue should be less causally related to wealth differences year-to-year). Additionally, we interact these health indicators with insurance status as a further test that the health-wealth relationship is likely causal net of covariates. Results show that the onset of an acute illness has a negative effect on family wealth levels and that the onset of chronic illnesses only makes an impact when it occurs for those uninsured. In intergenerational models, parental health insurance status also seems to matter. When parents suffer from chronic illness and have no health insurance, adult children's net worth declines. Adult children in white families also face a greater likelihood of falling into debt (excluding wealth from home equity) when parental medical expenses increase. Together, these findings suggest that health dynamics play an important role in intergenerational stratification processes--at least under the current health regime of the United States.

10.3386/w16857.abstractZh: 大量文献已经证明了社会经济地位（以多种方式进行衡量）与健康结果之间存在稳健的关联；然而，关于这种关联背后的因果过程仍存在许多不确定性。本文基于越来越多的研究，试图更详细地探讨财富与社会经济地位之间为何以及如何存在关联。具体来说，我们研究了健康冲击对净资产的影响——这是社会经济地位中较少被研究的维度。由于缺乏满足排除限制的计量工具，我们采用了收入动态面板研究的数据，采用首次差分识别策略进行分析。我们估计了急性疾病的参数（这些疾病应该对财富的变化产生因果影响），并将该系数与慢性疾病存在的反事实参数进行比较（我们认为慢性疾病与年度财富差异的因果关系较弱）。此外，我们将这些健康指标与保险状况结合起来，进一步检验健康与财富之间的关系是否可能独立于协变量而存在因果关系。研究结果表明，急性疾病的出现会对家庭财富水平产生负面影响，而慢性疾病的出现仅在无保险的人群中产生影响。在代际模型中，父母的健康保险状况似乎也很重要。当父母患有慢性疾病且没有健康保险时，成年子女的净资产会下降。在白人家庭中，当父母医疗费用增加时，成年子女陷入债务的可能性也更大（不包括房屋净值带来的财富）。这些发现表明，在当前的美国医疗体系下，健康动态在代际分层过程中起着重要作用。

abstract.text: There is insufficient research on the direct effects of food advertising on children's diet and diet-related health, particularly in non-experimental settings. We employ a nationally-representative sample from the Early Childhood Longitudinal Survey-Kindergarten Cohort (ECLS-K) and the Nielsen Company data on spot television advertising of cereals, fast food restaurants and soft drinks to children across the top 55 designated-market areas to estimate the relation between exposure to food advertising on television and children's food consumption and body weight. Our results suggest that soft drink and fast food television advertising is associated with increased consumption of soft drinks and fast food among elementary school children (Grade 5). Exposure to 100 incremental TV ads for sugar-sweetened carbonated soft drinks during 2002-2004 was associated with a 9.4% rise in children's consumption of soft drinks in 2004. The same increase in exposure to fast food advertising was associated with a 1.1% rise in children's consumption of fast food. There was no detectable link between advertising exposure and average body weight, but fast food advertising was significantly associated with body mass index for overweight and obese children (>=85th BMI percentile), revealing detectable effects for a vulnerable group of children. Exposure to advertising for calorie-dense nutrient-poor foods may increase overall consumption of unhealthy food categories.

10.3386/w16858.abstractZh: 关于食品广告对儿童饮食及健康影响的直接效应，尤其是在非实验性环境中的研究尚不充分。我们采用了来自“早期儿童纵向调查-幼儿园队列”和尼尔森公司关于谷物、快餐店及软饮料在指定市场区域电视广告投放数据的全国代表性样本，来估算电视食品广告曝光量与儿童食品消费和体重之间的关系。研究结果表明，快餐和软饮料的电视广告与小学生（五年级学生）对软饮料和快餐的消费增加有关。在2002-2004年间，每观看100则含糖碳酸软饮料广告，儿童在2004年的软饮料消费量增加了9.4%。同样，快餐广告曝光量的增加与儿童快餐消费量的增加相关，增幅为1.1%。然而，广告曝光量与儿童平均体重之间未发现明显关联，但快餐广告与超重和肥胖儿童的身体质量指数存在显著关联，这表明这一群体受到了明显影响。对热量密集且营养匮乏食品的广告曝光可能会增加整体不健康食品的消费。

abstract.text: This study examines the long term impact of Medicare payment reductions on patient outcomes using a natural experiment - the Balance Budget Act (BBA) of 1997. We use predicted Medicare revenue changes due to BBA, with simulated BBA payment cuts as an instrument, to categorize hospitals by degrees of payment cuts (small, moderate, or large), and follow Medicare patient outcomes in these hospitals over a 11 year panel: 1995-1997 pre-BBA, 1998-2000 initial years of BBA, and 2001-2005 post-BBA years. We find that Medicare AMI mortality trends stay similar across hospitals when comparing between pre-BBA and initial-BBA periods. However, the trends began to diverge in 2001-2005: hospitals facing large payment cuts saw increased mortality rates relative to that of hospitals facing small cuts in the post-BBA period (2001-2005) after controlling for their pre-BBA trends. We find support that part of the higher AMI mortalities among large-cut hospitals are explained by reductions in staffing level and operating cost following the payment cuts.

10.3386/w16859.abstractZh: 本研究通过1997年的“预算平衡法案”这一自然实验，考察了医疗保险支付减少对患者结果的长期影响。我们利用因该法案而预测的医疗保险收入变化，并以模拟的支付削减作为工具，根据医院面临的支付削减程度（小、中等或大）对医院进行分类，并跟踪这些医院在1995-1997年预算平衡法案实施前、1998-2000年预算平衡法案初期以及2001-2005年预算平衡法案实施后的11年间医疗保险患者的治疗效果。研究发现，在比较预算平衡法案实施前和初期阶段时，不同医院的医疗保险急性心肌梗死（AMI）死亡率趋势相似。然而，在2001-2005年期间，这些趋势开始出现差异：在控制预算平衡法案实施前的死亡率趋势后，面临较大支付削减的医院在预算平衡法案实施后的2001-2005年间，其死亡率相对于面临较小削减的医院有所上升。我们的研究还发现，大型削减医院较高的AMI死亡率部分可以归因于支付削减后人员配备和运营成本的增加。

abstract.text: This paper investigates how accountability pressures under No Child Left Behind (NCLB) may affect children's rate of overweight. Schools facing increased pressures to produce academic outcomes may reallocate their efforts in ways that have unintended consequences for children's health. For example, schools may cut back on recess and physical education in favor of increasing time on tested subjects. To examine the impact of school accountability programs, we create a unique panel data set of schools in Arkansas that allows us to test the impact of NCLB rules on students' weight outcomes. Our main approach is to consider schools to be facing increased pressures if they are on the margin of passing - that is, if any subgroup at the school has a passing rate that is close to the AYP passing threshold, where we define close as being 5 percentage points above or below the threshold. We find evidence of small effects of accountability pressures on the percent of students at a school that are overweight. A follow-up survey of school principals points to reductions in physical activity and worsening of the food environment as potential mechanisms.

10.3386/w16873.abstractZh: 本文研究了《不让一个孩子掉队》法案下的问责压力如何影响儿童超重率。面临更高学术成果压力的学校可能会调整资源分配，从而对儿童健康产生意想不到的影响。例如，学校可能会减少课间休息和体育活动的时间，而增加测试科目的学习时间。为了研究学校问责计划的影响，我们创建了一个独特的阿肯色州学校面板数据集，以便测试NCLB规则对学生体重结果的影响。我们的主要方法是将处于通过边缘的学校视为面临更高压力的学校——即，如果学校中的某个子群体的通过率接近年度目标通过阈值，我们将该子群体的通过率定义为距离阈值上下5个百分点。我们发现，问责压力对学校中超重学生比例的影响较小。对学校校长的后续调查表明，体育活动减少和食品环境恶化可能是导致这一问题的潜在机制。

abstract.text: The pricing of medical products and services in the U.S. is notoriously complex. In health care, supply prices (those received by the manufacturer) are distinct from demand prices (those paid by the patient) due to health insurance. The insurer, in designing the benefit, decides what prices patients pay out-of-pocket for drugs and other products. In this primer we characterize cost and supply conditions in markets for generic and branded drugs, and apply basic tools of microeconomics to describe how an insurer, acting on behalf of its enrollees, would set demand prices for drugs. Importantly, we show how the market structure on the supply side, characterized alternatively by monopoly (unique brands), Bertrand differentiated product markets (therapeutic competition), and competition (generics), influences the insurer's choices about demand prices. This perspective sheds light on the choice of coinsurance versus copayments, the structure of tiered formularies, and developments in the retail market.

10.3386/w16879.abstractZh: 美国医疗产品和服务的定价问题非常复杂。在医疗保健领域，供应价格（制造商获得的收入）与需求价格（患者支付的费用）是不同的，这主要是由于健康保险的影响。保险公司在设计福利计划时，会决定患者为药品和其他产品支付的自付费用。在这篇入门文章中，我们描述了仿制药和品牌药品市场的成本和供应状况，并运用微观经济学的基本工具来说明保险公司如何代表其参保者设定药品的需求价格。重要的是，我们展示了供应侧的市场结构——无论是垄断性品牌市场、伯特兰差异化的产品市场，还是竞争性的仿制药市场——如何影响保险公司对需求价格的选择。这一视角有助于我们理解共保与自付费用的选择、分层处方结构的发展，以及零售市场的变化。

abstract.text: We propose and empirically implement a test for the presence of racial prejudice among emergency department (ED) physicians based on the bounceback rates of the patients who were discharged after receiving diagnostic tests during their initial ED visits. A bounceback is defined as a return to the ED within 72 hours of being initially discharged. Based on a plausible model of physician behavior, we show that differential bounceback rates across patients of different racial groups who are discharged after receiving diagnostic tests from their ED visits are informative of the racial prejudice of the physicians. Applying the test to administrative data of ED visits from California and New Jersey, we do not find evidence of prejudice against black and Hispanic patients. Our finding suggests that, at least in the emergency department setting, taste based discrimination does not play an important role in the racial disparities in health care.

10.3386/w16888.abstractZh: 我们提出并实证检验了急诊科医生是否存在种族偏见，这一检验基于患者在初次急诊就诊后接受诊断测试后出院后的恢复情况。恢复率被定义为在初次出院后72小时内再次前往急诊的情况。基于一个合理的医生行为模型，我们发现，不同种族群体患者在初次急诊就诊后接受诊断测试后出院时的恢复率差异，能够反映医生的种族偏见。将这一检验应用于加利福尼亚州和新泽西州的急诊就诊行政数据，我们没有发现对黑人和西班牙裔患者的偏见证据。我们的研究结果表明，至少在急诊科环境中，基于偏好的歧视在种族医疗差异中并不起重要作用。

abstract.text: The United States aspires to use information from comparative effectiveness research (CER) to reduce waste and contain costs without instituting a formal rationing mechanism or compromising patient or physician autonomy with regard to treatment choices. With such ambitious goals, traditional combinations of research designs and analytical methods used in CER may lead to disappointing results. In this paper, I study how alternate regimes of comparative effectiveness information help shape the marginal benefits (demand) curve in the population and how such perceived demand curves impact decision-making at the individual patient level and welfare at the societal level. I highlight the need to individualize comparative effectiveness research in order to generate the true (normative) demand curve for treatments. I discuss methodological principles that guide research designs for such studies. Using an example of the comparative effect of substance abuse treatments on crime, I use novel econometric methods to salvage individualized information from an existing dataset.

10.3386/w16900.abstractZh: 美国希望利用比较有效性研究的信息来减少浪费和降低成本，同时不引入正式的配给机制，也不影响患者或医生在治疗选择上的自主权。然而，为了实现这些雄心勃勃的目标，传统的研究设计和分析方法组合可能会导致令人失望的结果。在本文中，我研究了不同的比较有效性信息体系如何影响人群中边际效益（需求）曲线的形成，以及这些感知到的需求曲线如何影响个体患者层面的决策以及社会层面的福利。我强调需要个性化地进行比较有效性研究，以生成真正的治疗需求曲线。我讨论了指导此类研究设计的方法论原则。以物质滥用治疗对犯罪影响的比较效果为例，我采用新的计量经济学方法，从现有数据集中提取个性化的信息。

abstract.text: Because individuals with HIV are more likely to fall into poverty, and the poor may be at higher risk of contracting HIV, simple estimates of the effect of HIV status on economic outcomes will tend to be biased. In this paper, we use two econometric methods based on the propensity score to estimate the causal effect of HIV status on employment outcomes in South Africa. We rely on rich data on sexual behavior and knowledge of HIV from a large national household-based survey, which included HIV testing, to control for systematic differences between HIV-positive and HIV-negative individuals. This paper provides the first nationally representative estimates of the impact of HIV status on labor market outcomes for southern Africa. We find that being HIV-positive is associated with a 6 to 7 percentage point increase in the likelihood of being unemployed. South Africans with less than a high school education are 10 to 11 percentage points more likely to be unemployed if they are HIV-positive. Despite high unemployment rates, being HIV-positive confers a disadvantage and reinforces existing inequalities in South Africa.

10.3386/w16901.abstractZh: 由于感染HIV的个体更容易陷入贫困，而贫困人群可能面临更高的HIV感染风险，因此单纯基于HIV状态对经济结果影响的估计往往会存在偏差。在本文中，我们采用了两种基于倾向得分的计量经济学方法来估计HIV状态对南非就业结果的影响。我们利用了来自一项大型全国性家庭调查的数据，该调查包含了HIV检测内容，这些数据有助于控制HIV阳性与HIV阴性个体之间的系统性差异。本文首次提供了关于HIV状态对南部非洲劳动力市场结果影响的全国代表性估计。研究发现，HIV阳性者与失业的可能性相比，其失业率增加了6到7个百分点。对于受教育程度低于高中学历的南非人来说，如果他们是HIV阳性，失业的可能性则增加了10到11个百分点。尽管失业率很高，但HIV阳性状态仍然会带来不利影响，并加剧南非现有的不平等现象。

abstract.text: Explicit financial incentives, especially pay-for-performance (P4P) incentives, have been extensively employed in recent years by health plans and governments in an attempt to improve the quality of health care services. This study exploits a natural experiment in the province of Ontario, Canada to identify empirically the impact of pay-for-performance (P4P) incentives on the provision of targeted primary care services, and whether physicians' responses differ by age, practice size and baseline compliance level. We use an administrative data source which covers the full population of the province of Ontario and nearly all the services provided by practicing primary care physicians in Ontario. With an individual-level data set of physicians, we employ a difference-in-differences approach that controls for both "selection on observables" and "selection on unobservables" that may cause estimation bias in the identification. We also implemented a set of robustness checks to control for confounding from the other contemporary interventions of the primary care reform in Ontario. The results indicate that, while all responses are of modest size, physicians responded to some of the financial incentives but not the others. The differential responses appear related to the cost of responding and the strength of the evidence linking a service with quality. Overall, the results provide a cautionary message regarding the effectiveness of pay-for-performance schemes for increasing quality of care.

10.3386/w16909.abstractZh: 近年来，健康计划和政府广泛采用了明确的财务激励措施，尤其是基于绩效的激励措施，以试图提高医疗服务的质量。本研究利用加拿大安大略省的一个自然实验，实证分析了基于绩效的激励措施对目标初级医疗服务提供的影响，以及医生的反应是否因年龄、执业规模和基础合规水平而异。我们使用了涵盖安大略省全体人口以及该省执业初级医生提供的几乎所有服务的行政数据来源。通过医生个体层面的数据集，我们采用了差异-差异方法，控制了可能导致识别偏差的“基于可观测变量的选择”和“基于不可观测变量的选择”。我们还实施了一系列稳健性检验，以控制安大略省初级医疗改革其他干预措施带来的混杂因素。研究结果表明，尽管所有反应规模都较为适中，但医生对部分财务激励措施做出了反应，而对其他激励措施则没有反应。这些不同的反应似乎与响应成本以及将服务与质量联系起来的证据强度有关。总体而言，这些结果提醒我们，基于绩效的激励方案在提高医疗质量方面的有效性存在不确定性。

abstract.text: The purpose of this paper is to empirically estimate the propensity for alcohol-related policies to influence rates of entry into foster care and the length of time spent in foster care. Alcohol consumption is believed to be major contributing factor to child maltreatment, associated with an increased likelihood of abuse and longer durations once in foster care. We analyze a panel of state-level foster care entry rates over time, followed by a duration analysis of individual-level cases. The alcohol regulations of interest include beer, wine, and liquor taxes and prices, and a measure of alcohol availability. Overall, these alcohol control policies appear to have limited power to alter foster care entry rates and duration once in care. We find that higher alcohol taxes and prices are not effective in reducing foster care entry rates, however, once in foster care, the duration of stay may be influenced with higher taxes, particularly when the entry was a result of an alcohol abusing parent.

10.3386/w16915.abstractZh: 本文旨在实证估计与酒精相关的政策对儿童进入寄养机构的比例以及在寄养机构中的停留时间的影响。人们认为，酒精消费是儿童虐待的主要促成因素之一，与虐待行为的发生概率增加以及进入寄养机构后的停留时间延长有关。我们分析了各州随时间变化的寄养机构进入率，并对个体案例的停留时间进行了分析。关注的酒精控制政策包括啤酒、葡萄酒和烈酒的税收和价格，以及酒精的供应情况。总体而言，这些酒精控制政策在改变寄养机构的进入率和进入后停留时间方面似乎效果有限。我们发现，较高的酒精税收和价格并不能有效降低寄养机构的进入率，然而，一旦进入寄养机构，较高的税收可能会影响停留时间，尤其是在父母存在酒精滥用行为的情况下。

abstract.text: Roughly one half of hospitals in the U.S. are in rural areas, yet researchers have largely studied the effects of hospital ownership in the urban context. We examine differences in the provision of profitable and unprofitable medical services in rural areas across nonprofit, for-profit, and government hospitals. We also consider the effect of hospital ownership mix within rural hospital markets. We find that rural nonprofit hospitals are more likely than for-profit hospitals to offer unprofitable services, many of which are underprovided services. Nonprofits respond less than for-profits to changes in service profitability. Nonprofits with more for-profit competitors offer more profitable services and fewer unprofitable services than those with fewer for-profit competitors.

10.3386/w16926.abstractZh: 在美国，大约一半的医院位于农村地区，然而研究人员主要研究的是城市背景下医院所有权的效应。我们考察了非营利性、营利性和政府性质医院在提供盈利和非盈利医疗服务方面的差异。我们还研究了农村医院市场中医院所有权组合的影响。研究发现，与营利性医院相比，非营利性农村医院更有可能提供非盈利服务，其中许多服务供应不足。非营利性医院对服务盈利性的变化反应不如营利性医院强烈。拥有更多营利性竞争对手的非营利性医院比那些营利性竞争对手较少的医院提供更盈利的服务，并且非盈利服务的数量也较少。

abstract.text: While descriptive evidence suggests that deployment in the Global War on Terrorism is associated with adverse mental health, the causal effect of combat is not well established. Using data drawn from the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent Health, we exploit exogenous variation in deployment assignment and find that soldiers deployed to combat zones where they engage in frequent enemy firefight or witness allied or civilian deaths are at substantially increased risk for suicidal ideation, psychological counseling, and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). Our estimates imply lower-bound health care costs of $1.5 to $2.7 billion for combat-induced PTSD.

10.3386/w16927.abstractZh: 虽然描述性证据表明，在全球反恐战争中部署与不良心理健康状况有关，但战斗的因果效应尚未得到充分证实。通过利用《全国青少年健康纵向研究》的数据，我们发现被部署到频繁遭遇敌袭或目睹盟军及平民死亡的战区中的士兵，出现自杀念头、寻求心理辅导以及创伤后应激障碍的风险显著增加。我们的估计表明，由战斗引发的创伤后应激障碍所导致的医疗保健成本至少为15亿至27亿美元。

abstract.text: The long-standing argument that focused operations outperform others stands in contrast to claims about the benefits of broader operational scope. The performance benefits of focus are typically attributed to reduced complexity, lower uncertainty, and the development of specialized expertise, while the benefits of greater breadth are linked to the economies of scope achieved by sharing common resources, such as advertising or production capacity, across activities. Within the literature on corporate strategy, this tension between focus and breadth is reconciled by the concept of related diversification (i.e., a firm with multiple operating units, each specializing in distinct but related activities). We consider whether there are similar benefits to related diversification within an operating unit and examine the mechanism that generates these benefits. Using the empirical context of cardiovascular care within hospitals, we first examine the relationship between a hospital's level of specialization in cardiovascular care and the quality of its clinical performance on cardiovascular patients. We find that, on average, focus has a positive effect on quality performance. We then distinguish between positive spillovers and complementarities to examine: (1) the extent to which a hospital's specialization in areas related to cardiovascular care directly impacts performance on cardiovascular patients (positive spillovers) and (2) whether the marginal benefit of a hospital's focus in cardiovascular care depends on the degree to which the hospital "co-specializes" in related areas (complementarities). In our setting, we find evidence of such complementarities in specialization.

10.3386/w16937.abstractZh: 长期以来，人们认为专注于特定业务领域的企业表现优于其他类型企业，这与关于扩大业务范围所带来的好处的观点形成对比。专注于特定领域的企业表现优势通常归因于降低复杂性、减少不确定性以及培养专业专长，而扩大业务范围的好处则体现在通过共享广告或生产能力等公共资源来降低成本。在企业战略文献中，这种专注于特定领域与扩大业务范围之间的矛盾可以通过相关多元化这一概念来调和，即企业拥有多个运营单位，每个单位专注于不同但相关的业务领域。我们探讨了在运营单位内部是否存在类似的相关多元化所带来的好处，并研究了产生这些好处的机制。以医院心血管护理领域的实证数据为基础，我们首先研究了医院在心血管护理领域的专业化程度与其对心血管患者临床治疗效果之间的关系。研究发现，总体而言，专注于特定领域对治疗效果有积极影响。随后，我们区分了正面溢出效应和互补性，以探讨：(1)医院在心血管护理相关领域的专业化程度如何直接影响其对心血管患者的治疗效果（正面溢出效应）；(2)医院在心血管护理领域的专注程度是否取决于其在相关领域的“共同专业化”程度（互补性）。在我们的研究环境中，我们发现了这种专业化的互补性证据。

abstract.text: This summary of The Changing Body: Health, Nutrition, and Human Development in the Western World since 1700 (Cambridge) was prepared for presentation at the University of Alabama at Birmingham School of Public Health in March 2011. The book is built on the authors' work with 300 years of height and nutrition data and discusses their findings in the context of technophysio evolution, a uniquely modern form of rapid physiological development, the result of humanity's ability to control its environment and create technological innovations to adapt to it.

10.3386/w16938.abstractZh: 这篇关于《变化的身体：1700年以来西方世界的健康、营养与人类发展》的论文摘要，是为2011年3月在阿拉巴马大学伯明翰公共卫生学院进行演讲而准备的。该书基于作者们对300年身高与营养数据的研究，并在技术生理进化的背景下探讨了他们的研究发现。技术生理进化是一种独特的现代快速生理发展形式，它是人类能够控制环境并创造技术创新以适应环境的结果。

abstract.text: In the United States, health care technology has contributed to rising survival rates, yet health care spending relative to GDP has also grown more rapidly than in any other country. We develop a model of patient demand and supplier behavior to explain these parallel trends in technology growth and cost growth. We show that health care productivity depends on the heterogeneity of treatment effects across patients, the shape of the health production function, and the cost structure of procedures such as MRIs with high fixed costs and low marginal costs. The model implies a typology of medical technology productivity: (I) highly cost-effective "home run" innovations with little chance of overuse, such as anti-retroviral therapy for HIV, (II) treatments highly effective for some but not for all (e.g. stents), and (III) "gray area" treatments with uncertain clinical value such as ICU days among chronically ill patients. Not surprisingly, countries adopting Category I and effective Category II treatments gain the greatest health improvements, while countries adopting ineffective Category II and Category III treatments experience the most rapid cost growth. Ultimately, economic and political resistance in the U.S. to ever-rising tax rates will likely slow cost growth, with uncertain effects on technology growth.

10.3386/w16953.abstractZh: 在美国，医疗技术促进了生存率的提高，但相对于GDP而言，医疗支出增长的速度比其他任何国家都要快。我们建立了一个患者需求和供应商行为的模型，以解释技术发展和成本增长之间的这种平行趋势。我们发现，医疗生产力取决于患者之间治疗效果的异质性、健康生产函数的形状以及诸如MRI等程序的成本结构，这些程序具有较高的固定成本和较低的边际成本。该模型将医疗技术生产力分为三类：(I)具有高度成本效益的“一劳永逸”的创新，如抗逆转录病毒疗法，几乎不会造成过度使用；(II)对某些患者非常有效但对其他患者无效的治疗，例如支架手术；(III)临床价值不确定的“灰色区域”治疗，如慢性病患者在重症监护室中的天数。不出所料，采用第一类有效治疗的国家会获得最大的健康改善，而采用无效的第二类和第三类治疗的国家则会经历最快的成本增长。最终，美国对不断上升的税率的经济和政治抵制可能会减缓成本增长，但对技术发展的影响尚不确定。

abstract.text: When SARS struck Taiwan in the spring of 2003, many people feared that the disease would spread through the healthcare system. As a result, outpatient medical visits fell by over 30 percent in the course of a few weeks. This paper examines how both public information (SARS incidence reports) and private information (the behavior and opinions of peers) contributed to this public reaction. We identify social learning through a difference-in-difference strategy that compares long time community residents to recent arrivals, who are less socially connected. We find that people learned from both public and private sources during SARS. In a dynamic simulation based on the regressions, social learning substantially magnifes the response to SARS.

10.3386/w16955.abstractZh: 2003年春季，SARS袭击台湾时，许多人担心这种疾病会通过医疗系统传播。结果，在几周的时间里，门诊就诊量减少了30%以上。本文探讨了公共信息（SARS发病率报告）和私人信息（同龄人的行为和意见）如何共同影响了公众的反应。我们通过差异-差异策略来识别社会学习现象，比较了长期居住在该地区的居民与新近到达的居民的社交联系情况。我们发现，在SARS期间，人们从公共和私人两个来源都获得了信息。基于回归分析的动态模拟结果显示，社会学习显著增强了人们对SARS的应对能力。

abstract.text: In this paper we explore the possibility that individuals may select insurance coverage in part based on their anticipated behavioral response to the insurance contract. Such "selection on moral hazard" can have important implications for attempts to combat either selection or moral hazard. We explore these issues using individual-level panel data from a single firm, which contain information about health insurance options, choices, and subsequent claims. To identify the behavioral response to health insurance coverage and the heterogeneity in it, we take advantage of a change in the health insurance options offered to some, but not all of the firm's employees. We begin with descriptive evidence that is suggestive of both heterogeneous moral hazard as well as selection on it, with individuals who select more coverage also appearing to exhibit greater behavioral response to that coverage. To formalize this analysis and explore its implications, we develop and estimate a model of plan choice and medical utilization. The results from the modeling exercise echo the descriptive evidence, and allow for further explorations of the interaction between selection and moral hazard. For example, one implication of our estimates is that abstracting from selection on moral hazard could lead one to substantially over-estimate the spending reduction associated with introducing a high deductible health insurance option.

10.3386/w16969.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们探讨了个体可能部分基于其对保险合同的预期行为反应来选择保险覆盖范围的可能性。这种“基于道德风险的选择”对于打击选择行为或道德风险问题具有重要意义。我们采用来自一家单一公司的个体级面板数据来研究这些问题，这些数据包含了关于健康保险选项、选择以及后续索赔的信息。为了识别对健康保险覆盖范围的的行为反应及其异质性，我们利用了部分员工而非所有员工获得了不同健康保险选项这一变化。我们首先提供了描述性证据，这些证据表明存在异质性的道德风险以及基于风险的选择行为，选择更多保险覆盖范围的个体似乎表现出更强的行为反应。为了形式化这一分析并探讨其含义，我们开发并估计了一个关于计划选择和医疗利用的模型。模型的结果与描述性证据一致，并允许进一步探索选择与道德风险之间的相互作用。例如，我们的估计结果表明，如果忽略基于风险的选择行为，可能会导致人们严重高估引入高免赔额健康保险选项所带来的支出减少效果。

abstract.text: Governments often contract with private firms to provide public services such as health care and education. To decrease firms' incentives to selectively enroll low-cost individuals, governments frequently "risk-adjust" payments to firms based on enrollees' characteristics. We model how risk adjustment affects selection and differential payments---the government's payments to a firm for covering an individual minus the counterfactual cost had the government directly covered her. We show that firms reduce selection along dimensions included in the risk-adjustment formula, while increasing selection along excluded dimensions. These responses can actually increase differential payments relative to pre-risk-adjustment levels and thus risk adjustment can raise the total cost to the government of providing the public service. We confirm both selection predictions using individual-level data from Medicare, which in 2004 began risk-adjusting payments to private Medicare Advantage plans. We find that differential payments actually rise after risk adjustment and estimate that they totaled $30 billion in 2006, or nearly eight percent of total Medicare spending.

10.3386/w16977.abstractZh: 政府经常与私人企业合作，提供诸如医疗保健和教育等公共服务。为了降低企业选择性招募低成本个体的动机，政府通常会根据参保人的特征对支付进行“风险调整”。我们模拟了风险调整如何影响选择以及差异支付——即政府向企业支付的费用减去如果政府直接为个体提供服务的实际成本。我们发现，企业在风险调整公式中包含的维度上减少了选择行为，而在其他维度上则增加了选择行为。这些反应实际上可能会使差异支付高于风险调整前的水平，因此风险调整实际上会增加政府提供公共服务的总成本。我们使用2004年开始对私人Medicare Advantage计划进行风险调整支付的Medicare个体数据，证实了这些选择预测。我们发现，风险调整后差异支付实际上有所上升，估计在2006年总计达300亿美元，占Medicare总支出的近8%。

abstract.text: Most existing work on the price elasticity of demand for health insurance focuses on employees' decisions to enroll in employer-provided plans. Yet any attempt to achieve universal coverage must focus on the uninsured, the vast majority of whom are not offered employer-sponsored insurance. In the summer of 2008, we conducted a survey experiment to assess the willingness to pay for a health plan among a large sample of uninsured Americans. The experiment yields price elasticities substantially greater than those found in most previous studies. We use these results to estimate coverage expansion under the Affordable Care Act, with and without an individual mandate. We estimate that 39 million uninsured individuals would gain coverage and find limited evidence of adverse selection.

10.3386/w16978.abstractZh: 目前关于健康保险需求价格弹性的研究大多集中在员工选择参加雇主提供的保险计划上。然而，任何实现全民医保的尝试都必须关注未投保的人群，而他们中的绝大多数并未获得雇主提供的保险。2008年夏季，我们开展了一项调查实验，以评估大量未投保美国人的支付意愿。实验得出的价格弹性远高于以往大多数研究的结果。我们利用这些结果来估算《平价医疗法案》实施后的保险覆盖情况，包括有无个人强制保险的规定。我们的估计显示，有3900万未投保的人将获得保险覆盖，并且几乎没有证据表明存在逆向选择现象。

abstract.text: All developed countries have been struggling with a trend toward health care absorbing an ever-larger fraction of government and private budgets. Adopting any treatment that improves health outcomes, no matter what the cost, can worsen allocative inefficiency by paying dearly for small health gains. One potential solution is to rely more heavily on studies of the costs and effectiveness of new technologies in an effort to ensure that new spending is justified by a commensurate gain in consumer benefits. But not everyone is a fan of such studies and we discuss the merits of comparative effectiveness studies and its cousin, cost-effectiveness analysis. We argue that effectiveness research can generate some moderating effects on cost growth in healthcare if such research can be used to nudge patients away from less-effective therapies, whether through improved decision making or by encouraging beefed-up copayments for cost-ineffective procedures. More promising still for reducing growth is the use of a cost-effectiveness framework to better understand where the real savings lie--and the real savings may well lie in figuring out the complex interaction and fragmentation of healthcare systems.

10.3386/w16990.abstractZh: 所有发达国家都在应对一个趋势，即医疗保健所占据的政府和私人预算的比例不断上升。无论成本如何，采用任何能够改善健康结果的治疗方法都可能因付出高昂代价而加剧资源配置的低效。一个潜在的解决方案是更多地依赖对新技术成本和效果的研究，以确保新的支出能够带来相应的消费者利益提升。但并非所有人都喜欢这类研究，我们讨论了比较效果研究及其类似方法——成本效益分析的优点。我们认为，如果这类研究能够引导患者放弃效果较差的治疗方法，无论是通过改善决策还是鼓励对成本效益较低的程序增加自付费用，那么效果研究可以在医疗保健成本增长方面产生一些抑制作用。更令人期待的是，利用成本效益框架来更好地理解真正的节省之处——真正的节省可能在于理清医疗保健系统的复杂互动和碎片化问题。

abstract.text: Environmental protection is typically cast as a tax on the labor market and the economy in general. Since a large body of evidence links pollution with poor health, and health is an important part of human capital, efforts to reduce pollution could plausibly be viewed as an investment in human capital and thus a tool for promoting economic growth. While a handful of studies have documented the impacts of pollution on labor supply, this paper is the first to rigorously assess the less visible but likely more pervasive impacts on worker productivity. In particular, we exploit a novel panel dataset of daily farm worker output as recorded under piece rate contracts merged with data on environmental conditions to relate the plausibly exogenous daily variations in ozone with worker productivity. We find robust evidence that ozone levels well below federal air quality standards have a significant impact on productivity: a 10 ppb decrease in ozone concentrations increases worker productivity by 4.2 percent.

10.3386/w17004.abstractZh: 环境保护通常被视为对劳动力市场及整体经济的负担。大量证据表明，污染与健康状况不佳之间存在关联，而健康又是人力资本的重要组成部分。因此，减少污染的努力可以被视为对人力资本的投资，从而成为促进经济增长的手段。虽然有一些研究记录了污染对劳动力供应的影响，但本文首次严格评估了污染对工人生产力的影响——这一影响可能更为隐蔽，但更为普遍。我们利用了一个包含每日农场工人产量的新型面板数据集，该数据基于计件合同记录，并结合了环境状况数据，以分析臭氧浓度变化对工人生产力的影响。我们发现，即使臭氧浓度远低于联邦空气质量标准，也会对生产力产生显著影响：臭氧浓度每降低10 ppb，工人生产力就会提高4.2%。

abstract.text: We use a combination of administrative and survey data to estimate the fraction of individuals newly enrolled in public health coverage (Wisconsin's combined Medicaid and CHIP program) that had access to private, employer-sponsored health insurance at the time of their enrollment and the fraction that dropped this coverage. We estimate that after expansion of eligibility for public coverage, approximately 20% of new enrollees had access to private health insurance at the time of enrollment and that only 8% dropped this coverage (with the remaining 12% having both private and public coverage). We also identify an "upper bound" estimate, which suggests that the percentage of new enrollees with private insurance coverage at the time of enrollment is, at most, 27%. These estimates of crowd-out are relatively low compared with estimates from the literature based on Medicaid and CHIP expansions, although based both on different data and on a different method.

10.3386/w17009.abstractZh: 我们结合行政数据和调查数据，估算了新加入公共健康保险体系（威斯康星州的联合医疗补助和CHIP计划）的个体中，在加入时能够获得私人雇主赞助的医疗保险的比例，以及放弃这种保险的比例。我们的估计显示，在公共保险资格扩展之后，大约20%的新加入者能够在加入时获得私人医疗保险，而只有8%的人放弃了这种保险（其余12%的人同时拥有私人保险和公共保险）。我们还得出了一个“上限”估计值，表明在加入时拥有私人保险的新加入者比例最多为27%。与基于医疗补助和CHIP扩展的文献中的估计相比，这些退出比例相对较低，尽管我们的数据来源和方法有所不同。

abstract.text: There is considerable debate about the impact of health care reform on the growth in medical spending. Medical innovation is thought to be a central contributor to that growth. We argue that there is a unique linkage between reforms that affect output markets for medical care and medical R&D costs. This linkage is due to the fact that potential consumers of medical care are also potential participants in clinical trials that are required to develop new medical products. Therefore, reforms that increase the quality or reduce the price of already developed treatments reduce the incentive of patients to participate in trials of experimental treatments. This delays development and reduce the returns to in innovation. We provide evidence of this "subject market effect" by considering the impact of changes in the quality of conventional care on development. We document a dramatic drop in trial recruitment following introduction of break-through HIV/AIDS therapies in 1996. We conclude by discussing additional positive and normative implications of the subject market effect that link input and output markets for medical products.

10.3386/w17011.abstractZh: 关于医疗改革对医疗支出增长的影响，存在相当大的争议。人们认为，医疗创新是这一增长的主要推动因素之一。我们认为，影响医疗输出市场的改革与医疗研发成本之间存在独特的联系。这种联系源于医疗服务的潜在消费者同时也是临床试验的潜在参与者，而临床试验是开发新医疗产品所必需的。因此，提高现有治疗方法的质量或降低其价格的改革，会削弱患者参与实验性治疗试验的意愿。这会延迟创新的发展，并降低创新的回报。我们通过考虑常规护理质量变化对创新发展的影响，提供了这一“主体市场效应”的证据。我们记录了1996年突破性艾滋病疗法问世后，临床试验招募人数急剧下降的情况。最后，我们讨论了这一主体市场效应所带来的其他积极和规范性影响，该效应将医疗产品的输入市场和输出市场联系起来。

abstract.text: We study the effects of generic entry on prices and utilization using both event study models that exploit the differential timing of generic entry across drug molecules and cast studies. Our analysis examines drugs treating hypertension, high blood pressure, type 2 diabetes, and depression using price and utilization data from the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey. We find that utilization of drug molecules starts decreasing in the two years prior to generic entry and continues to decrease in the years following generic entry, despite decreases in prices offered by generic versions of a drug. This decrease coincides with the market entry and increased utilization of branded reformulations of a drug going off patent. We show case study evidence that utilization patterns coincide with changes in marketing by branded drug manufacturers. While the reformulations---often extended-release versions of the patent-expiring drug---offer potential health benefits, the FDA does not require evidence that the reformulations are improvements over the previous drug in order to grant a patent. Indeed, in a number of experiments comparing the efficacies of the patent-expiring and reformulated drugs do not find statistical differences in health outcomes calling into question the patent-extension policy.

10.3386/w17046.abstractZh: 我们研究了通用药品进入市场对价格和使用率的影响，采用了两种事件研究模型：一种利用通用药品进入不同药物分子的差异化时间，另一种则采用案例研究。我们的分析涉及治疗高血压、高血糖、2型糖尿病和抑郁症的药物，使用了医疗支出调查中的价格和使用率数据。研究发现，在通用药品进入前的两年里，这些药物的使用率开始下降，并且在通用药品进入后的几年里继续下降，尽管通用版本的药物价格有所降低。这种下降与品牌仿制药进入市场后使用率增加的情况相吻合。我们通过案例研究证明，品牌制药公司的市场策略与药物使用模式的变化是一致的。虽然仿制药——通常是专利过期药物的延长释放版本——提供了潜在的健康益处，但美国食品药品监督管理局并不要求提供证据证明仿制药比原版药物有改进，才能授予专利。事实上，在多项比较专利过期药物和仿制药疗效的实验中，并未发现健康结果的统计学差异，这质疑了专利延长的政策。

abstract.text: We propose a new classification of experiments that captures the extent to which the experimental design and analysis are linked to economic theory. We then use this system to classify all published field experiments in the five top economics journals from 1975 to 2010. We find that the vast majority of field experiments (68%) are Descriptive studies that lack any explicit model; 18% are Single Model studies that test a single model-based hypothesis; 6% are Competing Models studies that test competing model-based hypotheses; and 8% are Parameter Estimation studies that estimate structural parameters in a completely specified model. Using the same system to classify laboratory experiments published over the same period, we find that economic theory has played a more central role in the laboratory than in the field. Finally, we discuss in detail three sets of field experiments, on gift exchange, on charitable giving, and on negative income tax, that illustrate both the benefits and the potential costs of a tighter link between experimental design and theoretical underpinnings.

10.3386/w17047.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的实验分类方法，该方法能够反映实验设计与分析与经济理论之间的关联程度。随后，我们利用这一系统对1975年至2010年间发表在五本顶级经济学期刊上的所有实地实验进行了分类。研究发现，绝大多数实地实验（68%）属于描述性研究，缺乏明确的模型描述；18%的实验属于单一模型研究，旨在验证单一模型下的假设；6%的实验属于竞争模型研究，旨在验证不同模型下的假设；另有8%的实验属于参数估计研究，旨在在完全明确的模型中对结构参数进行估计。同样使用该系统对同期发表的实验室实验进行分类后，我们发现经济理论在实验室中的作用比在实地实验中更为关键。最后，我们详细讨论了三组实地实验：关于礼物交换、慈善捐赠以及负所得税的实验，这些实验既展示了实验设计与理论基础之间紧密联系的益处，也揭示了其潜在的成本。

abstract.text: Over the last thirty years pathways to retirement have changed substantially in the UK. They have been dominated by spells of unemployment in the late 1970s, with then an increased importance of disability spells from the mid-1980s onwards. At the end of the period the direct route from work to retirement was increasingly more common. General economic conditions seem to have been important driving forces during the entire period. In contrast changes in health do not seem to provide convincing explanations for these trends: mortality has been falling over the period without any apparent link to the share of the population reporting ill health or disability or to the number claiming benefits. We also find evidence that recent reforms have had some impact. The halting of the previous growth in the rate of in-flow onto disability benefits in the mid-1990s coincided with the implementation of a major reform. Evidence from the pilots of the Pathways-to-Work programme in 2003-2005 suggests that those moving onto disability benefits moved off these benefits faster than they would otherwise have done as a direct result of the programme.

10.3386/w17049.abstractZh: 在过去三十年中，英国的退休途径发生了显著变化。1970年代末，失业期成为主要的退休途径，而从1980年代中期开始，残疾期的重要性逐渐增加。在这一时期末期，从工作直接退休的情况变得越来越普遍。整体经济状况似乎在整个时期都是重要的驱动因素。相比之下，健康状况的变化似乎无法为这些趋势提供令人信服的解释：该时期的死亡率一直在下降，而这与报告健康状况不佳或残疾的人口比例以及领取福利的人数之间没有明显关联。我们还发现，最近的一些改革确实产生了一定影响。1990年代中期，残疾福利的流入速度有所减缓，这与一项重大改革的实施时间相吻合。2003-2005年“工作路径”计划试点项目的证据表明，由于该计划的直接作用，那些转向残疾福利的人比不通过该计划更快地放弃了这些福利。

abstract.text: We report results from economic experiments of decisions that are best described as petty larceny, with high school and college students who can anonymously steal real money from each other. Our design allows exogenous variation in the rewards of crime, and the penalty and probability of detection. We find that the probability of stealing is increasing in the amount of money that can be stolen, and that it is decreasing in the probability of getting caught and in the penalty for getting caught. Furthermore, the impact of the certainty of getting caught is larger when the penalty is bigger, and the impact of the penalty is bigger when the probability of getting caught is larger.

10.3386/w17059.abstractZh: 我们报告了经济实验的结果，这些实验研究的是可以被描述为轻微盗窃的决策。实验对象包括高中生和大学生，他们可以匿名地从彼此那里偷取真实的金钱。我们的实验设计允许在犯罪奖励、惩罚以及被发现的几率等方面引入外部变量。研究发现，可偷取的金额越大，偷窃的概率越高；而被捕的几率以及被捕后的惩罚越轻，偷窃的概率就越低。此外，当惩罚越严重时，被捕的确定性对偷窃行为的影响越大；而当被捕的概率越高时，惩罚对偷窃行为的影响也越大。

abstract.text: There is suggestive evidence that rates of major depression have risen markedly in the U.S. concurrent with the rise in obesity. The economic burden of depression, about $100 billion annually, is under-estimated if depression has a positive causal impact on obesity. If depression plays a causal role in increasing the prevalence of obesity, then policy interventions aimed at promoting mental health may also have the indirect benefits of promoting a healthy bodyweight. However, virtually the entire existing literature on the connection between the two conditions has examined merely whether they are significantly correlated, sometimes holding constant a limited set of demographic factors. This study utilizes multiple large-scale nationally-representative datasets to assess whether, and the extent to which, the positive association reflects a causal link from major depression to higher BMI and obesity. While contemporaneous effects are considered, the study primarily focuses on the effects of past and lifetime depression to bypass reverse causality and further assess the role of non-random selection on unobservable factors. There are expectedly no significant or substantial effects of current depression on BMI or overweight/obesity, given that BMI is a stock measure that changes relatively slowly over time. Results are also not supportive of a causal interpretation among males. However, among females, estimates indicate that past or lifetime diagnosis of major depression raises the probability of being overweight or obese by about seven percentage points. Results also suggest that this effect appears to plausibly operate through shifts in food consumption and physical activity. We estimate that this higher risk of overweight and obesity among females could potentially add about 10% (or $9.7 billion) to the estimated economic burden of depression.

10.3386/w17068.abstractZh: 有证据表明，美国重度抑郁症的发病率与肥胖率的上升同步显著增加。抑郁症的经济负担约为每年1000亿美元，如果抑郁症对肥胖有积极的因果影响，这一数字会被低估。如果抑郁症在增加肥胖患病率中起着因果作用，那么旨在促进心理健康的政策干预也可能间接促进健康的体重。然而，几乎所有关于这两种状况之间联系的现有文献都仅考察了它们是否显著相关，有时在有限的人口统计因素保持不变的情况下进行研究。本研究利用多个大规模、具有全国代表性的数据集，评估这种正相关是否以及多大程度上反映了从重度抑郁症到更高BMI和肥胖的因果联系。虽然考虑了同时期的影响，但该研究主要关注过去和一生中患抑郁症的影响，以避免反向因果关系，并进一步评估非随机选择对不可观测因素的影响。鉴于BMI是一个相对变化缓慢的存量指标，当前抑郁症对BMI或超重/肥胖没有显著或实质性的影响，这一点在意料之中。结果也不支持男性中存在因果关系的观点。然而，在女性中，估计表明过去或一生中诊断出重度抑郁症会使超重或肥胖的概率增加约7个百分点。结果还表明，这种效应似乎是通过食物消费和体力活动的改变来实现的。我们估计，女性超重和肥胖的风险增加，可能会使抑郁症的经济负担增加约10%（或97亿美元）。

abstract.text: Since Brazil's adoption of universal health care in 1988, the country's health care system has consisted of a mix of private providers and free public providers. We test whether income-based disparities in medical visits and medications remain in Brazil despite universal coverage using a nationally representative sample of over 48,000 households. Additional income is associated with less public sector utilization and more private sector utilization, both using simple correlations and regressions controlling for household characteristics and local area fixed effects. Importantly, the increase in private care use is greater than the drop in public care use. Also, income and unmet medical needs are negatively associated. These results suggest that access limitations remain for low-income households despite the availability of free public care.

10.3386/w17069.abstractZh: 自巴西在1988年实施全民医疗保健制度以来，该国的医疗保健体系由私人医疗服务提供者和免费的公共医疗服务提供者共同构成。我们采用超过48,000户家庭的全国代表性样本，研究在全民覆盖的情况下，基于收入的医疗就诊和药物使用差异是否仍然存在。研究结果显示，额外收入与较少的公共部门利用以及更多的私人部门利用相关，这一结论通过简单相关性分析和控制家庭特征及地区固定效应的回归分析得出。值得注意的是，私人医疗服务的使用增加幅度大于公共医疗服务使用下降的幅度。此外，收入与未满足的医疗需求之间存在负相关关系。这些结果表明，尽管有免费的公共医疗服务，低收入家庭在获取医疗服务方面仍然存在限制。

abstract.text: In the United States, public health insurance programs cover over 90 million individuals. Changes in the scope of these programs, such as the Medicaid expansions under the recently passed Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, may have large effects on physician behavior. This study finds that following the implementation of the State Children's Health Insurance Program, physicians decreased the number of hours spent with patients, but increased their participation in the expanded program. Suggestive evidence is found that this decrease in hours was a result of shorter office visits. These findings are consistent with the predictions from a mixed-economy model of physician behavior with public and private payers and also provide evidence of crowd out resulting from the creation of SCHIP.

10.3386/w17070.abstractZh: 在美国，公共健康保险计划覆盖了超过9000万人口。这些计划范围的变更，例如根据最近通过的《患者保护与平价医疗法案》而扩大的医疗补助计划，可能会对医生的行为产生重大影响。本研究发现，在实施州儿童健康保险计划后，医生与患者相处的时间减少了，但参与扩大的计划的比例却增加了。有证据表明，就诊时间的减少是由于门诊次数减少所致。这些发现与基于公共和私人支付者之间的混合经济模型对医生行为的预测一致，同时也证明了由于SCHIP计划的设立而导致的挤出效应。

abstract.text: Risky health behaviors such as smoking, drinking alcohol, drug use, unprotected sex, and poor diets and sedentary lifestyles (leading to obesity) are a major source of preventable deaths. This chapter overviews the theoretical frameworks for, and empirical evidence on, the economics of risky health behaviors. It describes traditional economic approaches emphasizing utility maximization that, under certain assumptions, result in Pareto-optimal outcomes and a limited role for policy interventions. It also details nontraditional models (e.g. involving hyperbolic time discounting or bounded rationality) that even without market imperfections can result in suboptimal outcomes for which government intervention has greater potential to increase social welfare. The chapter summarizes the literature on the consequences of risky health behaviors for economic outcomes such as medical care costs, educational attainment, employment, wages, and crime. It also reviews the research on policies and strategies with the potential to modify risky health behaviors, such as taxes or subsidies, cash incentives, restrictions on purchase and use, providing information and restricting advertising. The chapter concludes with suggestions for future research.

10.3386/w17081.abstractZh: 诸如吸烟、饮酒、药物使用、无保护性行为以及不良饮食和久坐生活方式（导致肥胖）等危险健康行为，是可预防死亡的主要来源。本章概述了关于危险健康行为经济学的理论框架和实证证据。它描述了传统的经济分析方法，这些方法强调效用最大化，在某些假设下能够产生帕累托最优结果，并且政策干预的作用有限。此外，本章还详细介绍了非传统模型（例如涉及 hyperbolic time discounting 或 bounded rationality 的模型），即使没有市场缺陷，这些模型也可能导致次优结果，此时政府干预更有潜力提高社会福利。本章总结了关于危险健康行为对经济结果的影响的文献，如医疗成本、教育水平、就业、工资和犯罪等。同时，还回顾了有关政策和策略的研究，这些政策和策略有可能改变危险健康行为，例如税收或补贴、现金激励、购买和使用限制、提供信息以及限制广告。最后，本章提出了未来研究的建议。

abstract.text: Some technologies save lives -- new vaccines, new surgical techniques, safer highways. Others threaten lives -- pollution, nuclear accidents, global warming, the rapid global transmission of disease, and bioengineered viruses. How is growth theory altered when technologies involve life and death instead of just higher consumption? This paper shows that taking life into account has first-order consequences. Under standard preferences, the value of life may rise faster than consumption, leading society to value safety over consumption growth. As a result, the optimal rate of consumption growth may be substantially lower than what is feasible, in some cases falling all the way to zero.

10.3386/w17094.abstractZh: 一些技术能够拯救生命——比如新型疫苗、新的外科手术技术以及更安全的公路设施。然而，另一些技术则可能对生命构成威胁——比如污染、核事故、全球变暖、疾病的快速全球传播，以及生物工程病毒。当技术涉及生死问题时，增长理论会发生怎样的变化呢？本文指出，将生命因素纳入考量会产生重要的后果。在标准的偏好设定下，生命的价值可能会比消费增长更快地上升，从而导致社会更加重视安全而非消费增长。因此，消费增长的最佳速率可能会远低于实际可行的水平，在某些情况下甚至可能降至零。

abstract.text: In this paper we examine the link between retrospectively reported measures of childhood health and the prevalence of various major and minor diseases at older ages. Our analysis is based on comparable retrospective questionnaires placed in the Health and Retirement Study and the English Longitudinal Study of Ageing - nationally representative surveys of the age 50 plus population in America and England respectively. We show that the origins of poorer adult health among older Americans compared to the English trace right back into the childhood years - the American middle and old-age population report higher rates of specific childhood health conditions than their English counterparts. The transmission into poor health in mid life and older ages of these higher rates of childhood illnesses also appears to be higher in America compared to England. Both factors contribute to higher rates of adult illness in the United States compared to England although even in combination they do not explain the full extent of the country difference in late-life health outcomes.

10.3386/w17096.abstractZh: 本文探讨了回顾性报告的儿童健康指标与老年时期各种主要和次要疾病发病率之间的关联。我们的分析基于“健康与退休研究”和“英格兰老龄化纵向研究”中的可比回顾性问卷数据，这两项研究分别代表了美国和英格兰50岁以上人口的国家代表性调查。我们发现，与英格兰相比，美国老年人健康状况较差的根源可以追溯到儿童时期——美国的中老年人报告的具体儿童健康问题的发生率高于英格兰同龄人。此外，这些儿童时期疾病在中年及老年时期导致健康状况恶化的概率，在美国也高于英格兰。这两个因素共同导致了美国成年人疾病发病率高于英格兰，尽管即使将两者结合起来，也无法完全解释两国在晚年健康结果上的差异。

abstract.text: We examine provider responses to the Medicare inpatient rehabilitation facility (IRF) prospective payment system (PPS), which simultaneously reduced marginal reimbursement and increased average reimbursement. IRFs could respond to the PPS by changing the total number of patients admitted, admitting different types of patients, or changing the intensity of care for admitted patients. We use Medicare claims data to separately estimate each type of provider response to the PPS. We also examine changes in patient outcomes and spillover effects on other post acute care providers. We find that costs of care initially fell following the PPS implementation, which we attribute to changes in treatment decisions rather than the types of patients admitted to IRFs. However, the probability of admission to IRFs increased after the PPS due to the expanded admission policies of providers. We find modest spillover effects on skilled nursing home costs and no substantive impact on patient health outcomes.

10.3386/w17125.abstractZh: 我们研究了医疗服务提供者对医疗保险住院康复设施（IRF）前瞻性支付系统（PPS）的反应。该支付系统同时降低了边际报销金额并提高了平均报销金额。IRF可以通过改变入院患者总数、接纳不同类型的患者或调整入院患者的护理强度来应对PPS。我们利用医疗保险索赔数据分别估算每种医疗服务提供者对PPS的反应。我们还研究了患者结果的变化以及对其他急性护理提供者的溢出效应。我们发现，在PPS实施后，护理成本最初有所下降，我们认为这是由于治疗决策的变化而非入院患者类型的变化所致。然而，由于医疗服务提供者的入院政策放宽，PPS实施后进入IRF的概率有所增加。我们发现，对专业护理院的成本有轻微的溢出效应，但对患者健康结果的影响并不显著。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the interaction between measures of health, disability pension take up and labor market performance in Denmark by charting their development over time and by examining how they are affected by key policy reforms in the area of early retirement. The main emphasis is on the long-run development of the Social Disability Pension (SDP) program, and whether it concurs with trends in population health based on mortality indicators (both overall and cause-specific) and with self-reported health. A strong relationship is found between labor force activity measures and non-health related programs for early retirement for those 60 and older. However, no clear relationship is evident between SDP take up and the health indicators. One reason for the lack of a correlation is most probably that SDP is "on its own track" due to program innovations and reforms creating competing risks or program substitution especially for the 50+ population.

10.3386/w17138.abstractZh: 本文研究了丹麦健康指标、残疾养老金领取情况与劳动力市场表现之间的相互作用，通过随时间的变化趋势分析，并探讨这些指标如何受到提前退休政策改革的影响。研究重点在于社会残疾养老金计划的长期发展，以及其是否与基于死亡率指标（包括总体死亡率和特定病因死亡率）以及自我报告健康状况的人口健康趋势相一致。研究发现，劳动力活动指标与针对60岁及以上人群的与健康无关的早期退休计划之间存在密切关联。然而，残疾养老金的领取情况与健康指标之间并未显示出明显的关联。这种缺乏关联的原因可能是，由于计划创新与改革，残疾养老金在50岁以上人群中产生了竞争风险或替代方案，因此该计划本身处于稳定的发展轨道上。

abstract.text: In this paper, we characterize the multi-faceted health of the elderly and understand how health along multiple dimensions has changed over time. Our data are from the Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey, 1991-2007. We show that 19 measures of health can be combined into three broad categories: a first dimension representing severe physical and social incapacity such as difficulty dressing or bathing; a second dimension representing less severe difficulty such as walking long distances or lifting heavy objects; and a third dimension representing vision and hearing impairment. These dimensions have changed at different rates over time. The first and third have declined rapidly over time, while the second has not. The improvement in health is not due to differential mortality of the sick or a new generation of more healthy people entering old age. Rather, the aging process itself is associated with less rapid deterioration in health. We speculate about the factors that may lead to this.

10.3386/w17148.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们描述了老年人多方面的健康状况，并探讨了不同维度上的健康状况随时间的变化情况。我们的数据来源于1991年至2007年的《医疗保险当前受益人调查》。研究发现，19项健康指标可以归纳为三个大类：第一类包括严重的身体和社会功能障碍，如穿衣或洗澡困难；第二类包括较轻微的障碍，如长距离行走或举重；第三类包括视力和听力障碍。这些维度随时间的变化速度各不相同。第一类和第三类的健康状况随时间迅速下降，而第二类则没有这种变化。健康状况的改善并非由于病人的死亡率差异或新一代更健康的老年人进入老年阶段所致。相反，老龄化过程本身与健康状况的恶化速度较慢有关。我们推测了可能导致这一现象的因素。

abstract.text: Social networks and social interactions affect individual and social norms. We develop a direct test of this using Dutch survey data on how respondents evaluate work disability of hypothetical people with some work related health problem (vignettes). We analyze how the thresholds respondents use to decide what constitutes a (mild or more serious) work disability depend on the number of people receiving disability insurance benefits (DI) in their reference group. We find that reference group effects are significant and contribute substantially to an explanation of why self-reported work disability in the Netherlands is much higher than in, for example, the US.

10.3386/w17153.abstractZh: 社交网络和社会互动影响个人和社会规范。我们利用荷兰的调查数据，对受访者如何评估患有某些与工作相关的健康问题的假设性人群的工作残疾进行了直接测试。我们分析了受访者用来判断工作残疾是否属轻度或严重程度的阈值，这些阈值取决于其参考群体中获得残疾保险福利的人数。研究发现，参考群体效应显著，并且对解释荷兰自我报告的工作残疾率远高于美国等国家的现象有重要贡献。

abstract.text: Smoking during pregnancy has been shown to have significant adverse health effects for new born babies. Smoking is the leading preventable cause of low birth weight of infants who in turn, need more resources at delivery and are more likely to have related health problems in infancy and beyond. Despite these outcomes, many women still smoke during pregnancy. The main question for policy makers is whether tobacco control policies can influence maternal smoking and reduce adverse birth outcomes. We examine this question using data from the Pregnancy Risk Assessment Monitoring System data from 2000 to 2005. This is a time period during which states significantly changed their tobacco control policies by raising excise taxes and imposing strong restrictions on indoor smoking. We estimate reduced form models of birth weight and gestational weeks, focusing on the effects of taxes and workplace restrictions on smoking as the policies of interest. We also estimate demand equations for the probability of smoking during the third trimester. Results show that the smoking policies are effective, but limited to babies born to mothers of certain age groups. For babies born to teenage mothers, higher cigarette taxes are associated with small increases in birth weight and gestational weeks. For babies born to mothers ages 25-34, restrictions on smoking in the workplace are associated with small increases in gestational weeks.

10.3386/w17160.abstractZh: 研究表明，孕妇吸烟会对新生儿的健康造成显著不良影响。吸烟是导致婴儿低出生体重的主要可预防因素，而低出生体重的婴儿在分娩时需要更多的医疗照顾，并且更容易在婴儿期及以后出现相关健康问题。尽管如此，许多女性在怀孕期间仍然吸烟。对于政策制定者来说，主要的问题是烟草控制政策是否能够影响母亲的吸烟行为，从而减少不良出生结果。我们利用2000至2005年的妊娠风险评估监测系统数据来研究这个问题。在这段时间里，各州通过提高消费税和对室内吸烟实施严格限制，显著改变了烟草控制政策。我们建立了出生体重和妊娠周数的模型，重点关注税收和职场限制对吸烟行为的影响。我们还估算了第三孕期吸烟的概率。研究结果表明，烟草控制政策是有效的，但仅对特定年龄段的母亲所生的婴儿有作用。对于由青少年母亲所生的婴儿，较高的香烟税与出生体重和妊娠周数的小幅增加有关。对于由25-34岁母亲所生的婴儿，职场禁烟政策与妊娠周数的小幅增加有关。

abstract.text: Assessing the impact of lead exposure is difficult if individuals select on the basis of their characteristics into environments with different exposure levels. We address this issue with data from when the dangers of lead exposure were still largely unknown, using new evidence on intelligence test scores for male World War Two U.S. Army enlistees linked to the households where they resided in 1930. Higher exposure to water-borne lead (proxied by urban residence and low water pH levels) was associated with lower test scores: going from pH 6 to pH 5.5, scores fell 5 points (1/4 standard deviation). A longer time exposed led to a more severe effect. The ubiquity of lead in urban water systems at this time and uncertainty regarding its impact mean these effects are unlikely to have resulted from selection into locations with different levels of exposure.

10.3386/w17161.abstractZh: 评估铅暴露的影响很困难，因为个体是根据自身特征选择进入不同暴露水平的环境。我们通过1930年数据时的情况来解决这个问题，当时人们对铅暴露的危害还知之甚少。研究发现，男性美国陆军士兵在1930年居住的家庭中，如果长期接触含铅的水（这通常与城市居住环境和低水pH值有关），其智力测试成绩会下降：pH值从6降到5.5时，成绩会下降5分（相当于1/4的标准差）。暴露时间越长，影响越严重。当时城市供水系统中铅的普遍存在以及对其影响的不确定性表明，这些影响不太可能是由于个体选择进入不同暴露水平的环境所导致的。

abstract.text: The extent of pharmaceutical advertising and promotion can be characterized by a balancing act between profitable demand expansions and potentially unfavorable subsequent regulatory actions. However, this balance also depends on the nature of competition (e.g. monopoly versus oligopoly). In this paper we model the firm's behavior under different competitive scenarios and test the model's predictions using a novel combination of sales, promotion, advertising, and adverse event reports data. We focus on the market for erectile dysfunction drugs as the basis for estimation. This market is ideal for analysis as it is characterized by an abrupt shift in structure, all drugs are branded, the drugs are associated with adverse health events, and have extensive advertising and promotion. We find that advertising and promotion expenditures increase own market share but also increase the share of adverse drug reactions. Competitors' spending decreases market share, while also having an influence on adverse drug reactions.

10.3386/w17162.abstractZh: 药品广告和促销的规模可以通过盈利性需求扩张与潜在的负面监管措施之间的平衡来体现。然而，这种平衡也取决于竞争的性质（例如垄断与寡头垄断）。在本文中，我们模拟了企业在不同竞争情境下的行为，并使用销售、促销、广告和不良事件报告数据的新组合来验证模型的预测结果。我们以勃起功能障碍药物市场作为分析对象，因为这个市场非常适合研究：其结构发生突然变化，所有药物均为品牌化，这些药物与不良健康事件相关，并且拥有广泛的广告和促销活动。我们发现，广告和促销支出不仅增加了自身市场份额，还增加了不良药物反应的份额。竞争对手的支出则减少了市场份额，同时也对不良药物反应产生了影响。

abstract.text: Researchers considering levels and trends in the resources available to the middle class traditionally measure the pre-tax cash income of either tax units or households. In this paper, we demonstrate that this choice carries significant implications for assessing income trends. Focusing on tax units rather than households greatly reduces measured growth in middle class income. Furthermore, excluding the effect of taxes and the value of in-kind benefits further reduces observed improvements in the resources of the middle class. Finally, we show how these distinctions change the observed distribution of benefits from the tax exclusion of employer provided health insurance.

10.3386/w17164.abstractZh: 研究人员在评估中产阶级可获得的资源水平和趋势时，通常会以税收单位或家庭为单位来衡量税前现金收入。本文指出，这种选择对评估收入趋势有着重要的影响。将重点放在税收单位而非家庭上，会大大减少对中产阶级收入增长的测量结果。此外，排除税收和实物福利的影响后，中产阶级资源状况的改善幅度还会进一步降低。最后，我们展示了这些差异如何改变雇主提供的健康保险税收减免所带来的利益分配情况。

abstract.text: The Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (ACA) is the most comprehensive reform of the U.S. medical system in at least 45 years. The ACA transforms the non-group insurance market in the United States, mandates that most residents have health insurance, significantly expands public insurance and subsidizes private insurance coverage, raises revenues from a variety of new taxes, and reduces and reorganizes spending under the nation's largest health insurance plan, Medicare. Projecting the impacts of such fundamental reform to the health care system is fraught with difficulty. But such projections were required for the legislative process, and were delivered by the Congressional Budget Office (CBO). This paper discusses the projected impact of the ACA in more detail, and describes the evidence that sheds light upon the accuracy of the projections. It begins by reviewing in broad details the structure of the ACA and then reviews evidence from a key case study that informs our understanding of the ACA's impacts: a comparable health reform that was carried out in Massachusetts four years earlier. The paper discusses the key results from that earlier reform and what they might imply for the impacts of the ACA. The paper ends with a discussion of the projected impact of the ACA and offers some observations on those estimates.

10.3386/w17168.abstractZh: 《患者保护与可负担医疗保健法案》（ACA）是至少45年来对美国医疗体系最全面的改革。该法案改变了美国的非团体保险市场，要求大多数居民拥有健康保险，大幅扩展公共保险范围，补贴私人保险覆盖，通过多种新税收增加收入，并减少和重组国家最大的健康保险计划——Medicare下的支出。对如此根本性改革对医疗体系的影响进行预测存在诸多困难。但立法过程需要这样的预测，而国会预算办公室（CBO）已经提供了这些预测。本文更详细地讨论了ACA的预期影响，并提供了有助于验证这些预测准确性的证据。文章首先概述了ACA的结构，然后回顾了一个关键案例研究的证据，该案例研究为我们理解ACA的影响提供了参考：四年前在马萨诸塞州实施的类似医疗改革。文章还讨论了那次改革的主要成果及其对ACA影响的潜在含义。最后，文章讨论了ACA的预期影响，并对这些估计结果提出了一些观察意见。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes determinants of ex-manufacturer prices for originator and generic drugs across a large sample of countries. We focus on drugs to treat HIV/AIDS, TB and malaria in middle and low income countries (MLICs), with robustness checks to other therapeutic categories and other countries. We examine effects of per capita income, income dispersion, number and type of therapeutic and generic competitors, and whether the drugs are sold to retail pharmacies vs. tendered procurement by NGOs. The cross-national income elasticity of prices is 0.4 across high and low income countries, but is only 0.15 between MLICs, implying that drugs are least affordable relative to income in the lowest income countries. Within-country income inequality contributes to relatively high prices in MLICs. Number of therapeutic and generic competitors only weakly affects prices to retail pharmacies, plausibly because uncertain quality leads to competition on brand rather than price. Tendered procurement attracts multi-national generic suppliers and significantly reduces prices for originators and generics, compared to prices to retail pharmacies.

10.3386/w17174.abstractZh: 本文分析了大量国家中原创药与仿制药出厂价格的决定因素。我们重点关注中低收入国家用于治疗艾滋病、结核病和疟疾的药品，并对其他治疗类别和其他国家的情况进行了稳健性检验。我们研究了人均收入、收入分布、治疗和仿制药竞争者的数量和类型，以及药品是销售给零售药店还是由非政府组织招标采购等因素对价格的影响。在高收入国家与低收入国家之间，价格的跨国收入弹性为0.4，但在中低收入国家这一数值仅为0.15，这表明在最低收入国家，药品相对于收入而言是最难以负担的。国内收入不平等导致中低收入国家的价格相对较高。治疗和仿制药竞争者的数量对零售药店的价格影响较小，这可能是因为质量不确定性导致竞争集中在品牌而非价格上。与零售药店相比，招标采购吸引了多国仿制药供应商，显著降低了原创药和仿制药的价格。

abstract.text: We evaluate the results of a field experiment designed to measure the effect of prompts to form implementation intentions on realized behavioral outcomes. The outcome of interest is influenza vaccination receipt at free on-site clinics offered by a large firm to its employees.
