All employees eligible for study participation received reminder mailings that listed the times and locations of the relevant vaccination clinics. Mailings to employees randomly assigned to the treatment conditions additionally included a prompt to write down either (1) the date the employee planned to be vaccinated or (2) the date and time the employee planned to be vaccinated. Vaccination rates increased when these implementation intentions prompts were included in the mailing. The vaccination rate among control condition employees was 33.1%. Employees who received the prompt to write down just a date had a vaccination rate 1.5 percentage points higher than the control group, a difference that is not statistically significant. Employees who received the more specific prompt to write down both a date and a time had a 4.2 percentage point higher vaccination rate, a difference that is both statistically significant and of meaningful magnitude.

10.3386/w17183.abstractZh: 我们评估了一项实地实验的结果，该实验旨在衡量形成实施意图的提示对实际行为结果的影响。研究关注的是大型公司为其员工提供的免费现场诊所中流感疫苗接种的接受情况。所有符合研究参与条件的员工都收到了提醒邮件，邮件中列出了相关疫苗接种诊所的时间和地点。随机分配到不同处理组的员工还收到了提示，要求他们写下（1）计划接种疫苗的日期，或者（2）计划接种疫苗的日期和时间。当这些实施意图提示包含在邮件中时，疫苗接种率有所提高。对照组员工的疫苗接种率为33.1%。仅收到写下日期提示的员工，其疫苗接种率比对照组高出1.5个百分点，但这一差异并不具有统计学意义。而收到同时写下日期和时间的更具体提示的员工，其疫苗接种率高出4.2个百分点，这一差异不仅具有统计学意义，而且其影响程度也很显著。

abstract.text: In 2008, a group of uninsured low-income adults in Oregon was selected by lottery to be given the chance to apply for Medicaid. This lottery provides a unique opportunity to gauge the effects of expanding access to public health insurance on the health care use, financial strain, and health of low-income adults using a randomized controlled design. In the year after random assignment, the treatment group selected by the lottery was about 25 percentage points more likely to have insurance than the control group that was not selected. We find that in this first year, the treatment group had substantively and statistically significantly higher health care utilization (including primary and preventive care as well as hospitalizations), lower out-of-pocket medical expenditures and medical debt (including fewer bills sent to collection), and better self-reported physical and mental health than the control group.

10.3386/w17190.abstractZh: 2008年，俄勒冈州的一群未投保的低收入成年人通过抽签被选中，有机会申请医疗补助计划。这种抽签方式为通过随机对照设计来评估扩大公共健康保险覆盖对低收入成年人医疗使用、经济压力以及健康状况的影响提供了独特的机会。在随机分配后的第一年，通过抽签被选中的治疗组比未被选中的对照组拥有约25个百分点的更高保险覆盖率。我们发现，在这一年里，治疗组的医疗使用率（包括初级和预防性护理以及住院治疗）明显且统计上显著更高，自付医疗费用和医疗债务也更低（包括更少的账单需要催收），同时他们自我报告的身体和心理健康状况也优于对照组。

abstract.text: We study a general class of models with social interactions that might display multiple equilibria. We propose an estimation procedure for these models and evaluate its efficiency and computational feasibility relative to different approaches taken to the curse of dimensionality implied by the multiplicity. Using data on smoking among teenagers, we implement the proposed estimation procedure to understand how group interactions affect health-related choices. We find that interaction effects are strong both at the school level and at the smaller friends-network level. Multiplicity of equilibria is pervasive at the estimated parameter values, and equilibrium selection accounts for about 15 percent of the observed smoking behavior. Counterfactuals show that student interactions, surprisingly, reduce smoking by approximately 70 percent with respect to the equilibrium smoking that would occur without interactions.

10.3386/w17196.abstractZh: 我们研究了一类具有社会互动的一般模型，这些模型可能表现出多种均衡状态。我们提出了一种针对这些模型的估计方法，并评估了其效率和计算可行性，与处理多重性所引发的维数灾难的不同方法相比。利用青少年吸烟的数据，我们实施了所提出的估计方法，以了解群体互动如何影响健康相关决策。我们发现，无论是在学校层面还是更小的朋友网络层面，互动效应都非常显著。在估计的参数值下，均衡状态的多样性普遍存在，而均衡选择大约占观察到的吸烟行为的15%。反事实分析表明，与没有互动情况下可能出现的均衡吸烟状态相比，学生之间的互动意外地使吸烟行为减少了约70%。

abstract.text: A key issue surrounding employer benefit mandates is the incidence on workers through wages and employment. In this paper, we address this question using a pay-or-play policy implemented in San Francisco in 2008 that requires employers to either provide health benefits or contribute to a public option health plan. We estimate the impact on employment and earnings for the private sector overall, as well as for high impact sectors: retail and accommodation and food services. We develop a novel approach for individual case studies by combining both spatial discontinuity in policies and permutation-type inference using other MSAs. We find that, compared to control counties, employment and earnings patterns in San Francisco did not change appreciably following the policy. This was true for industries most affected by the mandate, as well as for overall private sector employment. The results are generally robust to inclusion of different control groups, county-specific time trends, and varying pre-periods. In contrast to the small effects on the labor market, we do find that about 25% of surveyed restaurants imposed customer surcharges, with the median surcharge being 4% of the bill. These results indicate that while little of the burden of the mandate fell on San Francisco workers, approximately half of the incidence of the mandate fell on consumers.

10.3386/w17198.abstractZh: 关于雇主福利强制规定的关键问题，在于其对工人通过工资和就业的影响。在本文中，我们采用2008年旧金山实施的“支付或放弃政策”来探讨这一问题，该政策要求雇主要么提供健康福利，要么为公共选项健康计划做出贡献。我们估算了私营部门整体以及高影响行业——零售和住宿及食品服务行业——在就业和收入方面的变化。我们采用一种新颖的方法进行个案研究，结合了政策的空间不连续性和使用其他宏观经济变量进行的排列类型推断。研究发现，与对照县相比，旧金山在政策实施后的就业和收入模式并没有显著变化。这一情况适用于受强制规定影响最大的行业，也适用于私营部门的整体就业情况。这些结果在纳入不同的控制组、县级别的时间趋势以及不同的前期情况后仍然具有稳健性。与对劳动力市场的微小影响相比，我们发现约25%的受访餐厅实施了客户附加费，其中平均附加费为账单的4%。这些结果表明，虽然强制规定的负担几乎没有落在旧金山工人的身上，但大约一半的强制规定影响落在了消费者身上。

abstract.text: In US vaccine markets, competing producers with high fixed, sunk costs face relatively concentrated demand. The resulting price and quality competition leads to the exit of all but one or very few producers per vaccine. Our empirical analysis of exits from US vaccine markets supports the hypothesis that high fixed costs and both price and quality competition contribute to vaccine exits. We find no evidence that government purchasing has significant effects, possibly because government purchase tends to increase volume but lower price, with offsetting effects. Evidence from the flu vaccine market confirms that government purchasing is not a necessary condition for exits and the existence of few suppliers per vaccine in the US.

10.3386/w17205.abstractZh: 在美国疫苗市场中，拥有高固定成本和高沉没成本的竞争生产商面临相对集中的需求。由此产生的价格和质量竞争导致每种疫苗只有少数或极少的生产商能够存活。我们对美国疫苗市场退出现象的经验分析支持了以下假设：高固定成本以及价格和质量的竞争都促进了疫苗的退出。我们没有发现政府采购对退出有显著影响的证据，可能是因为政府采购往往会增加销量但降低价格，从而产生相互抵消的效果。来自流感疫苗市场的证据表明，政府采购并不是疫苗退出和每种疫苗只有少数供应商存在的必要条件。

abstract.text: This paper reviews the literature devoted to studying markets for health care services and health insurance. There has been tremendous growth and progress in this field. A tremendous amount of new research has been done in this area over the last 10 years. In addition, there has been increasing development and use of frontier industrial organization methods. We begin by examining research on the determinants of market structure, considering both static and dynamic models. We then model the strategic determination of prices between health insurers and providers where insurers market their products to consumers based, in part, on the quality and breadth of their provider network. We then review the large empirical literature on the strategic determination of hospital prices through the lens of this model. Variation in the quality of health care clearly can have large welfare consequences. We therefore also describe the theoretical and empirical literature on the impact of market structure on quality of health care. The paper then moves on to consider competition in health insurance markets and physician services markets. We conclude by considering vertical restraints and monopsony power.

10.3386/w17208.abstractZh: 本文回顾了关于医疗保健服务和健康保险市场研究的文献。该领域取得了巨大的发展和进步，过去10年中在这一领域进行了大量的新研究。此外，前沿产业组织方法的应用和发展也在不断增加。我们首先探讨了市场结构决定因素的研究，包括静态和动态模型。然后，我们建立了健康保险公司与医疗服务提供者之间价格策略决定的模型，其中保险公司根据医疗服务提供者的网络质量和覆盖范围来向消费者推销产品。接着，我们回顾了通过该模型对医院价格策略决定的大量实证研究。医疗保健质量的变化显然会对福利产生重大影响。因此，我们还描述了关于市场结构对医疗保健质量影响的理论和实证文献。最后，本文进一步探讨了健康保险市场和医生服务市场的竞争情况。最后，我们讨论了垂直限制和垄断力量对市场的影響。

abstract.text: Using the most comprehensive data file ever compiled on air pollution, water pollution, environmental regulations, and infant mortality from a developing country, the paper examines the effectiveness of India's environmental regulations. The air pollution regulations were effective at reducing ambient concentrations of particulate matter, sulfur dioxide, and nitrogen dioxide. The most successful air pollution regulation is associated with a modest and statistically insignificant decline in infant mortality. However, the water pollution regulations had no observable effect. Overall, these results contradict the conventional wisdom that environmental quality is a deterministic function of income and underscore the role of institutions and politics.

10.3386/w17210.abstractZh: 该论文使用了有史以来最全面的关于发展中国家空气污染、水污染、环境法规以及婴儿死亡率的数据文件，来研究印度环境法规的有效性。空气污染法规在降低颗粒物、二氧化硫和二氧化氮的浓度方面取得了成效。在空气污染治理方面，最成功的措施与婴儿死亡率的适度且统计上不显著的下降有关。然而，水污染法规并未产生明显效果。总体而言，这些结果反驳了环境质量仅是收入决定因素的传统观点，并强调了制度与政治因素的作用。

abstract.text: This study uses longitudinal data from the NICHD Study on Early Child Care (SECC) to examine the effects of maternal employment on family well-being, measured by maternal mental and overall health, parenting stress, and parenting quality. First, we estimate the effects of maternal employment on these outcomes measured when children are 6 months old. Next, we use dynamic panel data models to examine the effects of maternal employment on family outcomes during the first 4.5 years of children's lives. Among mothers of six month old infants, maternal work hours are positively associated with depressive symptoms and self-reported parenting stress, and negatively associated with self-rated overall health among mothers. Compared to mothers who are on leave 3 months after childbirth, mothers who are working full-time score 22 percent higher on the CES-D scale of depressive symptoms. However, maternal employment is not associated with the quality of parenting at 6 months, based on trained assessors' observations of maternal sensitivity. Moreover, during the first 4.5 years of life as a whole, we find only weak evidence that maternal work hours are associated with maternal health, and no evidence that maternal employment is associated with parenting stress and quality. We find that unobserved heterogeneity is an important factor in modeling family outcomes.

10.3386/w17212.abstractZh: 本研究利用NICHD早期儿童保育研究中的纵向数据，探讨母亲就业对家庭福祉的影响，具体通过母亲的心理健康、整体健康状况、育儿压力以及育儿质量来衡量。首先，我们估计了在婴儿6个月大时，母亲就业对这些结果的影响。接着，我们使用动态面板数据模型来研究母亲就业在儿童生命前4.5年中对家庭结果的影响。对于6个月大的婴儿的母亲来说，母亲的工作时间与抑郁症状和自我报告的育儿压力呈正相关，而与自我评估的整体健康状况呈负相关。与产后3个月仍在休假的母亲相比，全职工作的母亲在CES-D抑郁症状量表上的得分高出22%。然而，根据训练有素的评估师对母亲敏感性的观察，母亲就业与6个月大的育儿质量并无关联。此外，在儿童生命前4.5年的整体过程中，我们发现母亲工作时间与母亲健康之间存在较弱的关联，而母亲就业与育儿压力及育儿质量之间则没有关联。我们发现，未观察到的异质性是建模家庭结果时的一个重要因素。

abstract.text: Prior research shows grocery stores reduce prices to compete with Walmart Supercenters. This study finds evidence that the competitive effects of two other big box retailers - Costco and Walmart-owned Sam's Club - are quite different. Using city-level panel grocery price data matched with a unique data set on Walmart and warehouse club locations, we find that Costco entry is associated with higher grocery prices at incumbent retailers, and that the effect is strongest in cities with small populations and high grocery store densities. This could be explained by a segmented-market model, or by incumbents competing with Costco along non-price dimensions such as product quality or quality of the shopping experience. We find no evidence that Sam's Club entry affects grocery stores' prices, consistent with Sam's Club's focus on small businesses instead of consumers.

10.3386/w17220.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，杂货店通过降低价格来与沃尔玛超级中心竞争。本研究发现，另外两家大型零售企业——Costco和沃尔玛旗下的Sam's Club——的竞争效应却大不相同。通过城市级别的杂货价格数据，并结合沃尔玛和仓储俱乐部位置的独特数据集，我们发现Costco的进入会导致现有零售商的杂货价格上升，且这种效应在人口较少、杂货店密度较高的城市更为明显。这可能是由于市场分割模型的作用，或者是因为现有零售商在产品质量或购物体验等非价格维度上与Costco竞争。我们没有发现Sam's Club的进入会影响杂货店的价格，这与Sam's Club专注于小型企业而非消费者的定位相符。

abstract.text: Since the Clean Air Act Amendments of 1990 (CAAA), atmospheric concentration of local pollutants has fallen drastically. A natural question is whether further reductions will yield additional health benefits. We further this research by addressing two related research questions: (1) what is the impact of automobile driving (and especially congestion) on ambient air pollution levels, and (2) what is the impact of modern air pollution levels on infant health? Our setting is California (with a focus on the Central Valley and Southern California) in the years 2002-2007. Using an instrumental variables approach that exploits the relationship between traffic, ambient weather conditions, and various pollutants, our findings suggest that ambient pollution levels, specifically particulate matter, still have large impacts on weekly infant mortality rates. Our results also illustrate the importance of weather controls in measuring pollution's impact on infant mortality.

10.3386/w17222.abstractZh: 自1990年《清洁空气法修正案》实施以来，局部污染物的大气浓度已大幅下降。一个自然的问题是，进一步的减排是否还能带来额外的健康效益。我们进一步研究了两个相关的问题：（1）汽车驾驶（尤其是交通拥堵）对大气污染水平有何影响；（2）现代空气污染水平对婴儿健康有何影响？我们的研究样本为2002年至2007年的加利福尼亚州，重点关注中央谷地和南加州地区。通过运用工具变量方法，结合交通、天气条件以及各种污染物之间的关系，我们的研究发现表明，大气污染水平，尤其是颗粒物，仍然对婴儿周死亡率产生较大影响。研究结果还强调了天气因素在衡量污染对婴儿死亡率影响中的重要性。

abstract.text: We study how men's dependence on their own employer for health insurance affects labor supply responses and loss of health insurance coverage when faced with a serious health shock. Men with employment-contingent health insurance (ECHI) are more likely to remain working following some kinds of adverse health shocks, and are more likely to lose insurance. With the passage of health care reform, the tendency of men with ECHI as opposed to other sources of insurance to remain employed following a health shock may be diminished, along with the likelihood of losing health insurance.

10.3386/w17223.abstractZh: 我们研究了男性对自身雇主的医疗保险依赖如何影响他们在面临严重健康冲击时的劳动力供给反应以及医疗保险覆盖率的丧失。拥有基于就业条件的医疗保险的男性在遭遇某些类型的健康冲击后更有可能继续工作，并且更有可能失去保险。随着医疗改革的推进，拥有ECHI的男性在遭遇健康冲击后继续工作的趋势可能会减弱，同时失去医疗保险的可能性也会降低。

abstract.text: This paper examines the role of regulation and competition in generic markets. Generics offer large potential savings to payers and consumers of pharmaceuticals. Whether the potential savings are realized depends on the extent of generic entry and uptake and the level of generic prices. In the U.S., the regulatory, legal and incentive structures encourage prompt entry, aggressive price competition and patient switching to generics. Key features are that pharmacists are authorized and incentivized to switch patients to cheap generics. By contrast, in many other high and middle income countries, generics traditionally competed on brand rather than price because physicians rather than pharmacies are the decision-makers. Physician-driven generic markets tend to have higher generic prices and may have lower generic uptake, depending on regulations and incentives. Using IMS data to analyze generic markets in the U.S., Canada, France, Germany, U.K., Italy, Spain, Japan, Australia, Mexico, Chile, Brazil over the period 1998-2009, we estimate a three-equation model for number of generic entrants, generic prices and generic volume shares. We find little effect of originator defense strategies, significant differences between unbranded and unbranded generics, variation across countries in volume response to prices. Policy changes adopted to stimulate generic uptake and reduce generic prices have been successful in some E.U. countries.

10.3386/w17226.abstractZh: 本文探讨了监管与竞争在仿制药市场中的作用。仿制药为药品支付者和消费者带来了巨大的成本节约潜力。这种节约潜力能否实现，取决于仿制药的进入程度、市场接受度以及仿制药的价格水平。在美国，相关的监管、法律及激励措施促进了仿制药的迅速进入、激烈的价格竞争以及患者转向使用仿制药。关键点是，药剂师被授权并有动力将患者转介到价格更低的仿制药。相比之下，在许多其他高收入和中收入国家，仿制药的竞争主要基于品牌而非价格，因为决策权在医生而非药店手中。以医生为主导的仿制药市场往往存在较高的仿制药价格，且市场接受度可能较低，这取决于相关的监管和激励措施。通过利用IMS数据对1998至2009年间美国、加拿大、法国、德国、英国、意大利、西班牙、日本、澳大利亚、墨西哥、智利和巴西的仿制药市场进行分析，我们建立了一个包含三个方程的模型，用于预测仿制药的进入数量、价格以及市场份额。研究发现，原研药防御策略对仿制药市场的影响较小，无品牌标识的仿制药与有品牌标识的仿制药之间存在显著差异，不同国家对于价格变化的反应也存在差异。一些欧盟国家通过政策调整来刺激仿制药的普及并降低仿制药价格，取得了成功。

abstract.text: We develop an empirical method to assess the generosity of employer-sponsored insurance across groups within the U.S. population. A key feature of this method is its simplicity - it only requires data on out-of-pocket (OOP) health care spending and total health care spending and does not require detailed knowledge of health insurance benefit design. We apply our method to assess whether households with a chronically ill member have more or less generous insurance relative to households with no chronically ill members. We find that the chronically ill have less generous insurance coverage than the non-chronically ill. Additional analyses suggest that the reason for this less generous coverage is not that households with a chronically ill member are in different, less generous plans, on average. Rather, households with a chronically ill member have higher spending on certain types of medical services (e.g., pharmaceutical drugs) that are covered less generously by insurance. Given recent work on value-based insurance design and coinsurance as an obstacle to medication adherence, our findings suggest that the current design of health plans may put the health and financial well-being of the chronically ill at risk.

10.3386/w17232.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种实证方法，用于评估美国人口中雇主赞助保险在各类群体中的慷慨程度。该方法的一个关键特点是其简单性——它只需要关于自付医疗费用和总医疗费用的数据，而不需要详细了解健康保险福利的设计。我们应用该方法来评估有慢性病患者家庭与没有慢性病患者家庭相比，其保险政策是否更为慷慨。研究发现，有慢性病患者家庭的保险覆盖程度低于没有慢性病患者家庭。进一步分析表明，这种较低的保险覆盖程度并非因为有慢性病患者家庭处于不同的、较不慷慨的保险计划之中。相反，有慢性病患者家庭的某些类型医疗服务（如药品）的支出较高，而这些服务在保险中的覆盖程度较低。鉴于最近关于基于价值的保险设计和共付制作为药物依从性障碍的研究，我们的发现表明，当前健康保险计划的设计可能会危及慢性病人的健康和财务福祉。

abstract.text: From 1991 to 2003, the fraction of Medicaid recipients enrolled in HMOs and other forms of Medicaid managed care (MMC) increased from 11 percent to 58 percent. This increase was largely driven by state and local mandates that required most Medicaid recipients to enroll in an MMC plan. Theoretically, it is ambiguous whether the shift from fee-for-service into managed care would lead to an increase or a reduction in Medicaid spending. This paper investigates this effect using a data set on state and local level MMC mandates and detailed data from CMS on state Medicaid expenditures. The findings suggest that shifting Medicaid recipients from fee-for-service into MMC did not reduce Medicaid spending in the typical state. However, the effects of the shift varied significantly across states as a function of the generosity of the state's baseline Medicaid provider reimbursement rates. These results are consistent with recent research on managed care among the privately insured, which finds that HMOs and other forms of managed care achieve their savings largely through reduced prices rather than lower quantities.

10.3386/w17236.abstractZh: 从1991年到2003年，参加HMO和其他形式的医疗管理计划的中介医疗补助受助者比例从11%增加到58%。这一增长主要得益于州和地方的强制要求，这些要求要求大多数医疗补助受助者必须加入医疗管理计划。理论上，从按服务收费模式转向医疗管理模式是否会导致医疗补助支出的增加或减少，这一点并不明确。本文利用关于州和地方层面医疗管理计划强制要求的数据集以及美国卫生与公众服务部提供的州级医疗补助支出详细数据，对这一现象进行了研究。研究结果表明，将医疗补助受助者从按服务收费模式转向医疗管理模式，在典型的州并没有减少医疗补助支出。然而，这种转变在不同州的效果差异显著，这取决于该州基线医疗补助提供方报销率的慷慨程度。这些结果与最近关于私人保险客户群体中的医疗管理研究一致，这些研究发现，HMO和其他形式的医疗管理计划主要通过降低价格而非减少服务量来实现成本节约。

abstract.text: This paper considers the role of survey design and question phrasing in evaluating the subjective health assessment responses using the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe (SHARE) dataset. A unique feature of this dataset is that respondents were twice asked during the survey to evaluate their health on a five-point scale, using two different sets of descriptors to define the five points, with the ordering of which set was first given determined randomly. We find no evidence to refute the assertion that the order was determined by random assignment. Yet we document differences in the response distributions between the two questions, as well as differences in inference in comparing the two populations (those that were asked one question first versus those that were asked the other). We then consider determinants of the degree of concordance between the two questions, as well as the determinants of individuals that provide conflicting responses. There appears to be evidence to suggest that individuals' assessments of their health in response to the second question may be influenced by the battery of health questions that were asked following the first assessment. We find that information in self-assessed health responses is useful in examining health outcomes. Our results suggest that adjusting such responses to take into account framing and sequencing of questions may improve inference. In addition, we show that accounting for survey design may be important in models for predicting outcomes of interest, such as the probability of a major health event.

10.3386/w17244.abstractZh: 本文探讨了调查设计和问题表述在利用欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查数据集评估主观健康评估反应中的作用。该数据集的独特之处在于，受访者在调查过程中被两次要求用五点量表评估自己的健康状况，使用两组不同的描述符来定义这五个等级，而哪一组先被使用是由随机决定的。我们没有发现任何证据可以反驳这种顺序是由随机分配决定的说法。然而，我们发现了两次问题之间的回答分布差异，以及比较两组人群时的推断差异（即先被问到一次问题的人与后被问到一次问题的人）。接着，我们研究了两次问题之间一致性程度的决定因素，以及导致个体给出矛盾回答的因素。有证据表明，个体对第二次问题的健康评估可能会受到第一次评估后所提出的一系列健康问题的影响。我们发现，自我评估的健康反应中的信息对于检查健康结果非常有用。我们的研究结果表明，调整这些反应以考虑问题的框架和顺序可能会改善推断效果。此外，我们还表明，在预测诸如重大健康事件概率等结果时，考虑调查设计的重要性不容忽视。

abstract.text: Using data from a field experiment in Kenya, we document that providing individuals with simple informal savings technologies can substantially increase investment in preventative health and reduce vulnerability to health shocks. Simply providing a safe place to keep money was sufficient to increase health savings, through a mental accounting effect. Adding an earmarking feature was only helpful when funds were put towards emergencies; earmarking for preventative health reduced savings on average, because the liquidity cost of tying up money was too great. Providing social pressure and credit through a ROSCA-based savings scheme had very large effects.

10.3386/w17255.abstractZh: 通过肯尼亚一项实地实验的数据，我们发现为个人提供简单的非正式储蓄技术可以显著增加预防性健康投资，并降低对健康冲击的脆弱性。仅仅提供一个安全的存放资金的地方就足以通过心理账户效应增加健康储蓄。只有当资金被用于紧急情况时，添加专项用途功能才具有帮助作用；因为将资金用于预防性健康投资的流动性成本过高，专项用途功能反而降低了储蓄。通过基于ROSCA的储蓄计划提供社会压力和信贷，效果也非常显著。

abstract.text: Much has been said about the stylized fact that the economically successful are not only wealthier but also healthier than the less affluent. There is little doubt about the existence of this socio-economic gradient in health, but there remains a vivid debate about its source. In this paper, we review the methodological challenges involved in testing the causal relationships between socio-economic status and health. We describe the approach of testing for the absence of causal channels developed by Adams et al. (2003) that seeks identification without the need to isolate exogenous variation in economic variables, and we repeat their analysis using the full range of data that have become available in the Health and Retirement Study since, both in terms of observations years and age ranges covered. This analysis shows that causal inference critically depends on which time periods are used for estimation. Using the information of longer panels has the greatest effect on results. We find that SES causality cannot be ruled out for a larger number of health conditions than in the original study. An approach based on a reduced-form interpretation of causality thus is not very informative, at least as long as the confounding influence of hidden common factors is not fully controlled.

10.3386/w17273.abstractZh: 关于经济成功者不仅更富有，而且更健康这一现象，已有大量研究。这种社会经济地位与健康状况之间的关联毋庸置疑，但关于其成因仍存在争议。本文回顾了测试社会经济地位与健康之间因果关系所涉及的方法学挑战。我们描述了亚当斯等人（2003年）提出的测试是否存在因果渠道的方法，该方法无需分离经济变量的外源变异即可进行识别。我们进一步使用“健康与退休研究”中已获得的所有数据重复了他们的分析，包括观测年份和年龄范围。分析表明，因果推断的关键在于所使用的估计时间段。使用更长的数据面板对结果影响最大。我们发现，与原始研究相比，对于更多的健康状况，无法排除社会经济地位的因果关系。因此，基于因果关系的简化形式解释的方法并不具有太多信息价值，至少在未完全控制隐藏的共同因素导致的混杂影响的情况下是如此。

abstract.text: This paper focuses on the practical importance of a critical but under-explored interpretation of a provision in the Affordable Care Act (ACA): whether "affordable" refers to the cost of single coverage alone, or to family or single coverage as applicable to the worker, in determining the employer's mandated coverage requirement and workers' (and their dependents') access to subsidized exchange coverage. Since the average annual total premium for family coverage is substantially higher than that for single coverage (on average $12,298 vs. $4,386 in 2008) this is a non-trivial distinction. Using data on workers from the Current Population Survey merged with estimates of employer and exchange policy premiums, we investigate the impact of the affordability decision on the fraction of workers who could then access exchange coverage subsidies and on the correspondingly lower employer sponsored insurance (ESI) coverage rates. We do via a series of calculations for each worker that first shows the financial incentives at stake in deciding between ESI and subsidized exchange coverage. We then show how many of those who stand to gain from exchange coverage could do so under the two different affordability rules and different levels of employee contributions. Finally, we show the extent to which a single affordability rule would cause low-income workers with families to fall into a "no-man's land" with no source of affordable family coverage. We estimate that choosing a family affordability rule could initially lead to as many as 1.3 million more workers accessing exchange subsidies for themselves and their families than under a single affordability rule. If employees pay 50 percent of the premiums in the future, this number increases to 6 million. Increased use of exchange subsidies would be accompanied by reductions in ESI coverage and increased costs to taxpayers. Alternatively, choosing a single affordability rule would initially result in close to 4 million dependents of workers with affordable single coverage not having affordable health insurance. This would grow to close to 13 million if employees pay 50 percent of the premium.

10.3386/w17279.abstractZh: 本文重点探讨《平价医疗法案》中一项条款的批判性但未被充分探讨的解释在实际中的重要性：即“平价”是指单人的保险费用，还是指适用于工人的家庭或单人保险费用，这决定了雇主必须提供的保险要求以及工人（及其家属）获得补贴保险的机会。由于家庭保险的年均总保费远高于单人保险（2008年平均为12,298美元，而单人保险为4,386美元），这是一个非常重要的区别。我们利用《当前人口调查》中的工人数据，结合雇主和保险公司的政策保费估算，研究了“平价”决策对能够获得保险补贴的工人比例的影响，以及相应的雇主赞助保险覆盖率下降的情况。我们通过一系列计算，首先展示了在雇主赞助保险和补贴保险之间做出选择时的经济激励因素。接着，我们展示了在两种不同的平价规则以及不同的员工缴费水平下，哪些人能够从保险中受益。最后，我们揭示了单一平价规则会导致低收入有家庭背景的工人处于一种无法获得平价家庭保险的状态。我们估计，采用家庭平价规则可能会使多达130万名工人能够为自己和家人获得保险补贴，而如果员工将来支付50%的保费，这一数字将增加到600万。增加交换补贴的使用将会导致ESI覆盖范围减少，同时增加纳税人的负担。另一方面，如果采用单一负担能力规则，最初大约有400万依赖可负担单一保险覆盖的工人无法获得可负担的医疗保险。如果员工需支付50%的保险费，这一数字将上升到约1300万。

abstract.text: Cross-subsidies are often considered the principal mechanism through which hospitals provide unprofitable care. Yet, hospitals' reliance on and extent of cross-subsidization are difficult to establish. We exploit entry by cardiac specialty hospitals as an exogenous shock to incumbent hospitals' profitability and in turn to their ability to cross-subsidize unprofitable services. Using patient-level data from general short-term hospitals in Arizona and Colorado before and after entry, we find that the hospitals most exposed to entry reduced their provision of services considered to be unprofitable (psychiatric, substance- abuse, and trauma care) and expanded their admissions for neurosurgery, a highly profitable service.

10.3386/w17300.abstractZh: 交叉补贴通常被认为是医院提供无利可图服务的核心机制。然而，医院对交叉补贴的依赖程度却难以确定。我们利用心脏专科医院的进入作为对现有医院盈利能力的外生冲击，进而影响其提供无利可图服务的能力。通过对比亚利桑那州和科罗拉多州普通短期医院在医院进入前后的患者数据，我们发现那些最受医院进入冲击影响的医院减少了被认为无利可图的服务（如精神科、药物滥用和创伤护理），并增加了神经外科的收治量，而神经外科是一项高利润服务。

abstract.text: We investigate the relationship between foreclosures and hospital visits using data on all foreclosures and all hospital and emergency room visits from four states that were among the hardest hit by the foreclosure crisis. We find that living in a neighborhood with a spike in foreclosures is associated with significant increases in urgent unscheduled visits, including increases in visits for preventable conditions. The estimated relationships cannot be accounted for by increasing unemployment, declines in housing prices, migration, or by people switching from out-patient providers to hospitals.

10.3386/w17310.abstractZh: 我们研究了止赎行为与医院就诊之间的关系，使用了四个受止赎危机严重影响州的止赎记录以及医院和急诊室就诊数据。研究发现，居住在止赎事件频发的社区，紧急非计划就诊次数显著增加，其中包括因可预防疾病而进行的就诊次数。这些关系无法用失业率上升、房价下跌、迁移现象，或是人们从门诊医生转向医院来解释。

abstract.text: Health care providers may vertically integrate not only to facilitate coordination of care, but also for strategic reasons that may not be in patients' best interests. Optimal Medicare reimbursement policy depends upon the extent to which each of these explanations is correct. To investigate, we compare the consequences of the 1997 adoption of prospective payment for skilled nursing facilities (SNF PPS) in geographic areas with high versus low levels of hospital/SNF integration. We find that SNF PPS decreased spending more in high integration areas, with no measurable consequences for patient health outcomes. Our findings suggest that subjecting integrated providers to higher-powered reimbursement incentives, i.e., less cost-sharing, may enhance medical productivity. More generally, we conclude that it may be efficient for purchasers of health services (and other services subject to agency problems) to consider the organizational form of their suppliers when choosing a reimbursement mechanism.

10.3386/w17316.abstractZh: 医疗保健提供者进行垂直整合不仅有助于协调护理工作，还可能出于一些未必符合患者最佳利益的战略考虑。最优的医疗保险报销政策取决于上述各种因素中的哪一种解释是正确的。为了研究这一点，我们比较了1997年对技术护理机构采用预期支付制度（SNF PPS）在不同医院/技术护理机构整合程度较高的地区与较低的地区的后果。研究发现，在整合程度较高的地区，SNF PPS减少了支出，但并未对患者的健康结果产生可测量的影响。我们的研究结果表明，对整合的医疗服务提供者给予更高的报销激励，即减少费用分担，可能会提高医疗服务的效率。更普遍地说，我们得出结论：对于医疗服务购买者（以及其他存在代理问题的服务购买者）来说，在选择报销机制时考虑供应商的组织形式可能是有效的。

abstract.text: Organ donations from deceased donors provide the majority of transplanted organs in the United States, and one deceased donor can save numerous lives by providing multiple organs. Nevertheless, most Americans are not registered organ donors despite the relative ease of becoming one. We study in the laboratory an experimental game modeled on the decision to register as an organ donor, and investigate how changes in the management of organ waiting lists might impact donations. We find that an organ allocation policy giving priority on waiting lists to those who previously registered as donors has a significant positive impact on registration.

10.3386/w17324.abstractZh: 在美国，来自已故捐赠者的器官捐赠占移植器官总数的大部分，一位已故捐赠者可以通过提供多个器官来挽救许多生命。然而，尽管成为器官捐赠者相对容易，但大多数美国人并未进行登记。我们在实验室中研究了一个基于捐赠者决策的实验性游戏，并探讨了器官等待名单管理方式的改变对捐赠行为的影响。我们发现，采用优先为之前已登记为捐赠者的人员分配器官的政策，能够显著促进捐赠者的登记率。

abstract.text: We develop a pair of risk measures, health and mortality delta, for the universe of life and health insurance products. A life-cycle model of insurance choice simplifies to replicating the optimal health and mortality delta through a portfolio of insurance products. We estimate the model to explain the observed variation in health and mortality delta implied by the ownership of life insurance, annuities including private pensions, and long-term care insurance in the Health and Retirement Study. For the median household aged 51 to 57, the lifetime welfare cost of market incompleteness and suboptimal choice is 3.2% of total wealth.

10.3386/w17325.abstractZh: 我们开发了一对风险度量指标，即健康和死亡率的“德尔塔”，用于生命和健康保险产品领域。通过简化保险选择的生命周期模型，可以复制通过一系列保险产品实现的最优健康和死亡率“德尔塔”。我们对该模型进行了估计，以解释在“健康与退休研究”中，拥有人寿保险、年金（包括私人养老金）和长期护理保险所暗示的健康和死亡率“德尔塔”的变异情况。对于年龄在51至57岁之间的家庭，市场不完备性和次优选择的终身福利成本占总财富的3.2%。

abstract.text: Prior to July 2009, salaries of the members of the European Parliament were paid by their home country and there were substantial salary differences between parliamentarians representing different EU countries. Starting in July 2009, the salary of each member of the Parliament is pegged to 38.5% of a European Court judge's salary, paid by the EU. This created an exogenous change in salaries, the magnitude and direction of which varied substantially between parliamentarians. Parliamentarians receive per diem compensation for each plenary session they attend, but salaries constitute unearned income as they are independent of attendance to the Parliament. Using detailed information on each parliamentarian of the European Parliament between 2004 and 2011 we show that an increase in salaries reduces attendance to plenary sessions and an increase in per diem compensation increases it. We also show that corruption in home country has a negative effect on attendance for seasoned members of the Parliament.

10.3386/w17329.abstractZh: 在2009年7月之前，欧洲议会议员的薪资由本国支付，不同欧盟国家的议员之间存在显著的薪资差异。从2009年7月开始，每位议员的薪资被设定为相当于欧洲法院法官薪资的38.5%，并由欧盟支付。这一变化属于外部因素导致的薪资调整，其幅度和方向在不同议员之间存在显著差异。议员们每参加一次全体会议都会获得每日津贴，但薪资属于非劳动所得，因为与是否参加议会会议无关。通过详细分析2004年至2011年间欧洲议会议员的薪资情况，我们发现薪资增加会导致议员减少全体会议出席次数，而每日津贴的增加则会增加出席次数。此外，我们还发现，议员所在国家的腐败状况会对资深议员的出席频率产生负面影响。

abstract.text: In this paper we estimate the causal effects on child mortality from moving into less distressed neighborhood environments. We match mortality data to information on every child in public housing that applied for a housing voucher in Chicago in 1997 (N=11,848). Families were randomly assigned to the voucher wait list, and only some families were offered vouchers. The odds ratio for the effects of being offered a housing voucher on overall mortality rates is equal to 1.11 for all children (95% CI 0.54 to 2.10), 1.50 for boys (95% CI 0.72 to 2.89) and 0.00 for girls - that is, the voucher offer is perfectly protective for mortality for girls (95% CI 0 to 0.79). Our paper also addresses a methodological issue that may arise in studies of low-probability outcomes - perfect prediction by key explanatory variables.

10.3386/w17369.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们估计了搬入较不贫困的社区环境对儿童死亡率的因果效应。我们将死亡数据与1997年芝加哥公共住房项目中申请住房券的每名儿童的资料进行了匹配（样本量11,848人）。家庭被随机分配到住房券等待名单上，只有部分家庭获得了住房券。对于获得住房券对儿童总体死亡率的影响，比值比为1.11（95%置信区间0.54至2.10），男孩为1.50（95%置信区间0.72至2.89），女孩为0.00——也就是说，住房券的提供对女孩的死亡率具有完全的保护作用（95%置信区间0至0.79）。我们的论文还探讨了在研究低概率结果时可能出现的方法论问题——即关键解释变量能够实现完美预测。

abstract.text: When a major study finds that a widely used medical treatment is no better than a less expensive alternative, do physicians stop using it? Policymakers hope that comparative effectiveness research will identify less expensive substitutes for widely-used treatments, but physicians may be reluctant to abandon profitable therapies. We examine the impact of the COURAGE trial, which found that medical therapy is as effective as percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) for patients with stable angina, on practice patterns. Using hospital discharge data from US community, Veterans Administration, and English hospitals, we detect a moderate decline in PCI volume post-COURAGE. However, many patients with stable angina continue to receive PCI. We do not find differences in PCI volume trends by reimbursement scheme or hospitals' teaching status, ownership, or degree of vertical integration.

10.3386/w17371.abstractZh: 当一项重要研究指出一种广泛使用的医疗治疗方法并不比价格较低的替代疗法更有效时，医生是否会停止使用这种疗法呢？政策制定者希望比较效果研究能够找到比广泛使用的治疗方法更便宜的替代品，但医生可能不愿意放弃盈利性疗法。我们研究了COURAGE试验的影响，该试验发现对于稳定型心绞痛患者而言，医疗疗法与经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）具有相同的疗效，这一发现对临床实践模式产生了影响。通过美国社区医院、退伍军人管理局医院以及英国医院的出院数据，我们发现COURAGE试验后PCI的接受量有所减少，但许多稳定型心绞痛患者仍然接受了PCI治疗。我们没有发现报销方案、医院的教学水平、所有权或垂直整合程度等因素对PCI接受量趋势的影响。

abstract.text: A large literature shows that religious participation is associated with a wide range of behaviors and outcomes, but what drives this association is unclear. On the one hand, this association may stem from correlations in preferences, where those with tastes for religion coincidentally have particular tastes for other behaviors as well. Alternately, religious participation may directly affect behavior; for example many religious organizations impose rules and proscriptions on their members and these rules may affect members' decisions. Using the canonical economic model of religiosity, I develop an empirical test to investigate the importance of religious proscriptions on behavior. Several empirical applications of this test are conducted; the results indicate a strong role for religious proscriptions in determining behavior. The test developed here does not require an instrumental variable for religion and could be applied to the study of criminal gangs, terrorist organizations, fraternities, communes, political groups, and other "social clubs."

10.3386/w17375.abstractZh: 大量文献表明，宗教参与与多种行为及结果之间存在关联，但这种关联的具体驱动因素尚不清楚。一方面，这种关联可能源于偏好上的相关性，即那些对宗教有偏好的人，也可能对其他行为有特定的偏好。另一方面，宗教参与也可能直接影响行为；例如，许多宗教组织会对其成员制定规则和禁令，这些规则可能会影响成员的决策。利用经典的宗教性经济模型，我开发了一个实证测试，以探究宗教禁令对行为的影响。通过多个实证应用，结果表明宗教禁令在行为决定中起着重要作用。这里开发的测试不需要宗教的工具变量，可以应用于研究犯罪团伙、恐怖组织、兄弟会、公社、政治团体以及其他“社会团体”。

abstract.text: Efforts to reduce greenhouse gas emissions in the US have relied on Corporate Average Fuel Economy (CAFE) Standards and Renewable Fuel Standards (RFS). Economists often argue that these policies are inefficient relative to carbon pricing because they ignore existing vehicles and do not adequately reduce the incentive to drive. This paper presents evidence that the net social costs of carbon pricing are significantly less than previous thought. The bias arises from the fact that the demand elasticity for miles travelled varies systematically with vehicle emissions; dirtier vehicles are more responsive to changes in gasoline prices. This is true for all four emissions for which we have data--nitrogen oxides, carbon monoxide, hydrocarbon, and greenhouse gases--as well as weight. This reduces the net social costs associated with carbon pricing through increasing the co-benefits. Accounting for this heterogeneity implies that the welfare losses from $1.00 gas tax, or a $110 per ton of CO2 tax, are negative over the period of 1998 to 2008 even when we ignore the climate change benefits from the tax. Co-benefits increase by over 60 percent relative to ignoring the heterogeneity that we document. In addition, accounting for this heterogeneity raises the optimal gas tax associated with local pollution, as calculated by Parry and Small (2005), by as much as 57 percent. While our empirical setting is California, we present evidence that the effects may be larger for the rest of the US.

10.3386/w17390.abstractZh: 美国减少温室气体排放的努力依赖于企业平均燃油经济性标准与可再生燃料标准。经济学家通常认为，这些政策相对于碳定价来说效率较低，因为它们忽略了现有车辆，并且未能充分降低驾驶动机。本文提供了证据，表明碳定价的净社会成本实际上比先前认为的要低得多。这种偏差源于对行驶里程的需求弹性与车辆排放之间存在系统性关系；更脏的车辆对汽油价格变化的反应更为敏感。这一点在我们拥有数据的所有四种排放物——氮氧化物、一氧化碳、碳氢化合物和温室气体——以及重量方面都是如此。这通过增加协同效益来降低与碳定价相关的净社会成本。考虑到这种异质性，即使我们忽略税收对气候变化的益处，从1998年到2008年期间，每加仑1.00美元的汽油税或每吨二氧化碳110美元的税收所带来的福利损失也是负面的。与我们记录的异质性相比，协同效益增加了超过60%。此外，考虑到这种异质性，Parry和Small（2005）计算出的与当地污染相关的最佳汽油税增加了多达57%。虽然我们的实证研究是在加利福尼亚州进行的，但我们有证据表明，这些效应在美国其他地区可能更为显著。

abstract.text: As economic recessions reduce employment and wages, associated shifts in time and income constraints would be expected to also impact individuals' health behaviors. Prior work has focused exclusively on recreational exercise, which typically represents only about 4% of total daily physical exertion. The general presumption in these studies is that, because exercise improves health, if unemployment increases exercise it must also improve health. Yet a person may be laid off from a physically demanding job, exercise more, and still be less physically active than when employed. Thus the relevant question is whether unemployment leads persons to become more physically active. We study this question with the American Time Use Survey (2003-2010), exploring the impact of the business cycle (and specifically the Great Recession) on individuals' exercise, other uses of time, and physical activity during the day. We also utilize more precise measures of exercise (and all other physical activities), which reflect information on the duration as well as intensity of each component activity, than has been employed in past studies. Using within-state variation in employment and unemployment, we find that recreational exercise tends to increase as employment decreases. In addition, we also find that individuals substitute into television watching, sleeping, childcare, and housework. However, this increase in exercise as well as other activities does not compensate for the decrease in work-related exertion due to job-loss. Thus total physical exertion, which prior studies have not analyzed, declines. These behavioral effects are strongest among low-educated males, which is validating given that the Great Recession led to some of the largest layoffs within the manufacturing, mining, and construction sectors. Due to the concentration of low-educated workers in boom-and-bust industries, the drop in total physical activity during recessions is especially problematic for vulnerable populations and may play a role in exacerbating the SES-health gradient during recessions. We also find some evidence of intra-household spillover effects, wherein individuals respond to shifts in spousal employment conditional on their own labor supply.

10.3386/w17406.abstractZh: 随着经济衰退导致就业和工资下降，时间和收入限制的相关变化预计也会对个人的健康行为产生影响。先前的研究仅关注于休闲运动，而休闲运动通常仅占总日常体力活动的约4%。这些研究的一般假设是，由于运动有助于健康，因此失业会增加运动量，从而改善健康。然而，一个人可能被解雇从事体力劳动强度较高的工作，但仍然可能比在职时更不活跃。因此，相关的问题是失业是否会导致人们变得更加活跃。我们通过美国时间使用调查（2003-2010年）来研究这个问题，探讨商业周期（特别是大衰退）对个人运动、其他时间利用以及日常体力活动的影响。我们还使用了更精确的测量方法，这些测量方法包含了每项活动的持续时间和强度信息，这比以往的研究更为精确。利用各州就业和失业状况的变化，我们发现休闲运动随着就业减少而增加。此外，我们还发现人们会将时间转移到看电视、睡觉、照顾孩子和家务上。然而，这种增加的运动和其他活动并不能弥补因失业而导致的与工作相关的体力活动减少。因此，之前的研究没有分析的总体力活动量实际上在下降。这些行为效应在受教育程度较低的男性中最为明显，这一点与大衰退导致制造业、矿业和建筑业出现大规模裁员的情况相吻合。由于低教育水平的工作者集中在周期性波动较大的行业中，经济衰退期间整体体力活动的下降对弱势群体来说尤为严重，并可能加剧经济衰退期间的社会经济地位与健康之间的差距。我们还发现了一些家庭内部溢出效应的证据，即个体会根据自身的劳动力供给情况来应对配偶就业状况的变化。

abstract.text: This study uses Monte Carlo simulations to demonstrate that regression-discontinuity designs arrive at biased estimates when attributes related to outcomes predict heaping in the running variable. After showing that our usual diagnostics are poorly suited to identifying this type of problem, we provide alternatives. We also demonstrate how the magnitude and direction of the bias varies with bandwidth choice and the location of the data heaps relative to the treatment threshold. Finally, we discuss approaches to correcting for this type of problem before considering these issues in several non-simulated environments.

10.3386/w17408.abstractZh: 本研究采用蒙特卡洛模拟方法，证明当与结果相关的属性预测处理变量出现堆积现象时，回归不连续设计会得出有偏的估计结果。在表明我们常用的诊断方法难以识别这类问题后，我们提出了替代方案。我们还展示了偏差的大小和方向如何随着带宽选择以及数据堆积位置相对于处理阈值的变化而变化。最后，我们讨论了在几种非模拟环境中纠正这类问题的方法。

abstract.text: Consumers need information to compare alternatives for markets to function efficiently. Recognizing this, public policies often pair competition with easy access to comparative information. The implicit assumption is that comparison friction--the wedge between the availability of comparative information and consumers' use of it--is inconsequential because information is readily available and consumers will access this information and make effective choices. We examine the extent of comparison friction in the market for Medicare Part D prescription drug plans in the United States. In a randomized field experiment, an intervention group received a letter with personalized cost information. That information was readily available for free and widely advertised. However, this additional step--providing the information rather than having consumers actively access it--had an impact. Plan switching was 28 percent in the intervention group, versus 17 percent in the comparison group, and the intervention caused an average decline in predicted consumer cost of about $100 per year among letter recipients--roughly 5 percent of the cost in the comparison group. Our results suggest that comparison friction can be large even when the cost of acquiring information is small, and may be relevant for a wide range of public policies that incorporate consumer choice.

10.3386/w17410.abstractZh: 消费者需要信息来比较不同的选择，以使市场能够高效运作。鉴于此，公共政策通常将竞争与便捷的比较信息获取相结合。隐含的假设是，比较摩擦——即比较信息可用性与消费者使用信息之间的障碍——并不重要，因为信息容易获取，消费者会利用这些信息做出有效的选择。我们研究了美国Medicare Part D处方药计划市场中的比较摩擦程度。在一项随机实地实验中，干预组收到了包含个性化成本信息的信件。这些信息可以免费获取，并且被广泛宣传。然而，这一额外的步骤——提供信息而非让消费者主动获取信息——确实产生了影响。干预组的计划转换率为28%，而对照组为17%，且干预措施使信件接收者的预计年成本平均降低了约100美元——这大约相当于对照组成本的5%。我们的结果表明，即使获取信息的成本较低，比较摩擦仍然可能很大，并且对于涉及消费者选择的广泛公共政策来说可能是重要的。

abstract.text: This study examines racial, ethnic and gender differentials in physical activity. Individuals engage in physical activity during leisure-time and also during in many other activities such as walking to work, home maintenance, shopping and child care. Physical activity also occurs on the job is this is referred to as work physical activity. Prior studies have shown that non-work physical activity has a positive impact on health while work physical activity has a negative impact on health. Many prior studies have relied primarily on leisure-time physical activity, which typically constitutes only about 10% of non-work physical activity and does not capture specific information on the intensity or duration of the activity. This study addresses these limitations by constructing measures of physical activity from the American Time Use Surveys, which are all-inclusive and capture the duration of each activity combined with its intensity based on the Metabolic Equivalent of Task (MET). Non-work physical activity tends to be significantly lower for Blacks, Hispanics, other racial groups than for Whites and lower for males than for females. These adjusted differentials are consistent with racial, ethnic and gender differentials in health. About 25-46% of the differentials in non-work physical activity can be attributed to differences in education, socio-economic status, proxies for time constraints, and locational attributes.

10.3386/w17413.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了种族、民族和性别在体力活动方面的差异。人们不仅在休闲时间进行体力活动，还在许多其他活动中进行体力活动，例如步行上班、家庭维护、购物和照顾孩子。工作期间也会进行体力活动，这被称为工作体力活动。先前的研究表明，非工作体力活动对健康有积极影响，而工作体力活动则对健康有负面影响。许多先前的研究主要依赖于休闲时间体力活动，而休闲时间体力活动通常仅占非工作体力活动的约10%，无法准确反映活动的强度或持续时间。本研究通过美国时间使用调查数据来构建体力活动的衡量指标，这些数据涵盖了所有活动的时间以及基于代谢当量（MET）所确定的活动强度。非工作体力活动在黑人、西班牙裔和其他种族群体中的水平明显低于白人，在男性中则低于女性。这些调整后的差异与种族、民族和性别在健康方面的差异一致。非工作体力活动中的约25-46%的差异可以归因于教育水平、社会经济状况、时间限制因素以及地理位置等因素的差异。

abstract.text: We investigate the effect of therapeutic procedure innovation in general on the longevity of all hospital patients, i.e. patients with a variety of medical conditions. The analysis is based on data on over one million discharges from public and private hospitals in Western Australia (WA) during the period 2000-2007. We can measure survival for a period as long as 8 years after admission, and we know the date each procedure was added to the Medicare Benefits Schedule. Estimates based on patient-level data indicate that therapeutic procedure innovation increased the life expectancy of WA hospital patients by almost 3 months between 2000 and 2007, controlling for the patient's age, sex, Diagnosis Related Group (DRG, over 600 categories), Aboriginal status, marital status, insurance coverage (whether or not the patient had private insurance), postcode (over 400 postcodes), year of hospital admission, and number of procedures performed.. Estimates based on longitudinal DRG-level data also indicate that therapeutic procedure innovation increased the life expectancy of WA hospital patients, but the implied increase may be smaller--about 2 months. In either case, therapeutic procedure innovation in WA hospitals appears to have been remarkably cost-effective, because it increased the cost of medical procedures by a negligible amount.

10.3386/w17414.abstractZh: 我们研究了治疗程序创新对所有医院患者寿命的影响，即患有各种疾病的患者。分析基于2000年至2007年期间西澳大利亚州公立和私立医院超过一百万次出院的数据。我们能够测量患者入院后长达8年的生存情况，并且知道每项治疗程序被添加到Medicare福利清单的日期。基于患者层面的数据估计表明，在控制患者的年龄、性别、诊断相关组（DRG，超过600个类别）、原住民身份、婚姻状况、保险覆盖情况（患者是否有私人保险）、邮政编码（超过400个邮政编码）、入院年份以及执行的手术数量等因素后，治疗程序创新使西澳大利亚州医院患者的预期寿命在2000年至2007年间增加了近3个月。基于纵向DRG级别数据的估计也表明，治疗程序创新确实增加了西澳大利亚州医院患者的预期寿命，但这一增长可能较小，约为2个月。无论哪种情况，西澳大利亚州医院的治疗程序创新似乎具有显著的成本效益，因为它使医疗程序的成本仅增加了微不足道的数量。

abstract.text: We develop a formal model to show how integration solves task allocation problems between organizations and test the predictions of the model, using a large and rich patient-level dataset on hospital discharges to nursing homes and home health care. As predicted by the theory, we find that vertical integration allows hospitals to shift patient recovery tasks downstream to lower cost delivery systems by discharging patients earlier and in poorer health, and integration leads to greater post-hospitalization service intensity. While integration facilitates a shift in the allocation of tasks, health outcomes are no worse when patients receive care from an integrated provider. The evidence suggests that by improving the allocation of tasks, integration solves coordination problems that arise in market exchange.

10.3386/w17419.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个正式模型，以展示整合如何解决组织之间的任务分配问题，并通过一个包含大量患者级数据的医院出院至疗养院和家庭护理数据集来验证模型的预测结果。正如理论所预测的那样，我们发现垂直整合使医院能够将患者康复任务转移给成本较低的系统，通过更早地出院给健康状况较差的患者来实现这一目标；同时，整合还提升了出院后的服务强度。虽然整合促进了任务分配的转移，但患者从整合的医疗服务提供者那里接受护理时，健康结果并未恶化。这些证据表明，通过改善任务分配，整合解决了市场交换中出现的协调问题。

abstract.text: An increasing number of Americans are obese, with a body mass index of 30 or more. In fact, the latest estimates indicate that about 30% of Americans are currently obese, which is roughly a 100% increase from 25 years ago. It is well accepted that weight gain is caused by caloric imbalance, where more calories are consumed than expended. Nevertheless, it is not clear why the prevalence of obesity has increased so dramatically over the last 30 years. We simultaneously estimate the effects of the various socio-economic factors on weight status, considering in our analysis many of the socio-economic factors that have been identified by other researchers as important influences on caloric imbalance: employment, physical activity at work, food prices, the prevalence of restaurants, cigarette smoking, cigarette prices and taxes, food stamp receipt, and urbanization. We use 1979- and 1997-cohort National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY) data, which allows us to compare the prevalence of obesity between cohorts surveyed roughly 25 years apart. Using the traditional Blinder-Oaxaca decomposition technique, we find that cigarette smoking has the largest effect: the decline in cigarette smoking explains about 2% of the increase in the weight measures. The other significant factors explain less.

10.3386/w17423.abstractZh: 越来越多的美国人患有肥胖症，他们的身体质量指数达到30或更高。实际上，最新的估计显示，大约30%的美国人目前患有肥胖症，这一比例比25年前增加了约100%。人们普遍认为，体重增加是由于热量摄入与消耗的不平衡造成的。然而，过去30年里肥胖症的发病率为何会如此急剧上升，目前尚不清楚。我们同时评估了各种社会经济因素对体重状况的影响，分析过程中考虑了其他研究人员认为对热量平衡有重要影响的许多社会经济因素：就业状况、工作期间的体力活动、食品价格、餐馆的普及程度、吸烟行为、香烟的价格和税收、食品救济金的领取情况以及城市化进程。我们使用了1979年和1997年的《全国青年纵向调查》数据，这些数据使我们能够比较大约25年间隔的两个时期肥胖症的发病率。通过传统的Blinder-Oaxaca分解技术，我们发现吸烟行为的影响最大：吸烟人数的减少解释了体重增加的约2%。其他重要因素的影响则较小。

abstract.text: Using annual cross-sectional data on over 100,000 adolescents aged 12-17, we studied academic and behavioral outcomes among those who were and were not likely affected by FDA warnings regarding the safety of antidepressants. Just before the FDA warnings, adolescents with probable depression had grade point averages 0.14 points higher than adolescents with depression just after the warnings. The FDA warnings also coincided with increased delinquency, use of tobacco and illicit drugs. Together, our results stress the importance of mental health and its treatment as an input into cognitive and non-cognitive aspects of human capital.

10.3386/w17426.abstractZh: 我们利用超过100,000名12-17岁青少年的年度横截面数据，研究了那些可能受到美国食品药品监督管理局关于抗抑郁药安全性警告影响的青少年与非受影响青少年的学业和行为表现。在FDA警告发布之前，可能患有抑郁症的青少年的平均绩点比警告发布后患有抑郁症的青少年高出0.14分。FDA的警告还伴随着犯罪率上升、烟草使用以及非法药物使用的情况增加。总的来说，我们的研究结果强调了心理健康及其治疗作为人类资本认知与非认知方面的重要因素的重要性。

abstract.text: Fetal health is an important consideration in the formation of health-based policy. However, a complete census of true fetal deaths is impossible to obtain. We present the gender ratio of live births as an under-exploited metric of fetal health and apply it to examine the effects of air quality on fetal health. Males are more vulnerable to side effects of maternal stress in utero, and thus are more likely to suffer fetal death due to pollution exposure. We demonstrate this metric in the context of the Clean Air Act Amendments of 1970 (CAAA) which provide a source of exogenous variation in county-level ambient total suspended particulate matter (TSPs). We find that a standard deviation increase in annual average TSPs (approximately 35 μg/m³) decreases the percentage of live births that are male by 3.1 percentage points. We then explore the use of observed differences in neonatal and one-year mortality rates across genders in response to pollution exposure as a metric to estimate total fetal losses in utero. These calculations suggest the pollution reductions from the CAAA prevented approximately 21,000-134,000 fetal deaths in 1972.

10.3386/w17434.abstractZh: 胎儿健康是制定健康相关政策时需要考虑的重要因素。然而，要获得真实的胎儿死亡数量是不可能的。我们将活产婴儿的性别比例作为衡量胎儿健康的未充分利用的指标，并运用这一指标来研究空气质量对胎儿健康的影响。男性更容易受到母亲在子宫内压力的影响，因此更可能因污染暴露而导致胎儿死亡。我们在1970年《清洁空气法修正案》的背景下验证了这一指标，该修正案为县级环境总悬浮颗粒物浓度提供了外生变化的来源。我们发现，年均总悬浮颗粒物浓度每增加一个标准差（约35微克/立方米），活产婴儿的男性比例就会减少3.1个百分点。接着，我们探讨了利用不同性别在污染暴露下的新生儿和一年死亡率差异作为指标，来估算子宫内胎儿死亡总数。这些计算表明，1972年《清洁空气法修正案》带来的污染减少大约防止了21,000至134,000例胎儿死亡。

abstract.text: Despite the presence of Medicare, out-of-pocket medical spending is a large expenditure risk facing the elderly. While women live longer than men, elderly women incur higher out-of-pocket medical spending than men at each age. In this paper, we examine whether differences in marital status and living arrangements can explain this difference. We find that out-of-pocket medical spending is approximately 29 percent higher when an individual becomes widowed, a large portion of which is spending on nursing homes. Our results suggest a substantial role of living arrangements in out-of-pocket medical spending; however, our estimates combined with differences in rates of widowhood across gender suggest that marital status can explain only one third of the gender difference in total out-of-pocket medical spending, leaving a large portion unexplained. On the other hand, gender differences in widowhood more than explain the observed gender difference in out-of-pocket spending on nursing homes.

10.3386/w17440.abstractZh: 尽管有医疗保险制度，老年人的自付医疗费用仍然是一个较大的支出风险。虽然女性的寿命比男性长，但老年女性在每个年龄段的自付医疗费用都高于男性。本文探讨了婚姻状况和居住安排是否能够解释这种差异。研究发现，当一个人成为寡妇时，自付医疗费用大约高出29%，其中很大一部分是用于养老院的费用。我们的结果表明，居住安排在自付医疗费用中起着重要作用；然而，结合不同性别的寡妇比例差异来看，婚姻状况只能解释性别差异中三分之一的原因，仍有很大一部分支出无法解释。另一方面，性别差异在寡妇比例上的影响足以解释性别差异在养老院费用上的差异。

abstract.text: Long-term care expenditures constitute one of the largest uninsured financial risks facing the elderly in the United States. This paper provides an overview of the economic and policy issues surrounding insuring long-term care expenditure risk. Through this lens we also discuss the likely impact of recent long-term care public policy initiatives at both the state and federal level.

10.3386/w17451.abstractZh: 长期护理支出是美国老年人面临的最大未保险财务风险之一。本文概述了与长期护理支出风险保险相关的经济和政策问题。在此基础上，我们还讨论了最近在州和联邦层面实施的长期护理公共政策可能产生的影響。

abstract.text: This paper investigates consumer switching costs in the context of health insurance markets, where adverse selection is a potential concern. Though previous work has studied these phenomena in isolation, they interact in a way that directly impacts market outcomes and consumer welfare. Our identification strategy leverages a unique natural experiment that occurred at a large firm where we also observe individual-level panel data on health insurance choices and medical claims. We present descriptive results to show that (i) switching costs are large and (ii) adverse selection is present. To formalize this analysis we develop and estimate a choice model that jointly quantifies switching costs, risk preferences, and ex ante health risk. We use these estimates to study the welfare impact of an information provision policy that nudges consumers toward better decisions by reducing switching costs. This policy increases welfare in a naive setting where insurance plan prices are held fixed. However, when insurance prices change endogenously to reflect updated enrollee risk pools, the same policy substantially exacerbates adverse selection and reduces consumer welfare, doubling the existing welfare loss from adverse selection.

10.3386/w17459.abstractZh: 本文研究了健康保险市场中的消费者转换成本问题，其中逆向选择是一个潜在的担忧因素。尽管以往的研究单独探讨了这些现象，但它们之间存在相互作用，这直接影响了市场结果和消费者福利。我们的识别策略利用了某大型公司发生的一项独特自然实验，同时我们还观察到了关于健康保险选择和医疗索赔的个体层面面板数据。我们通过描述性结果表明：(i) 转换成本很高；(ii) 存在逆向选择现象。为了将这一分析形式化，我们开发并估计了一个选择模型，该模型能够综合量化转换成本、风险偏好和事前健康风险。我们利用这些估计结果来研究一项信息提供政策的福利影响，该政策通过降低转换成本来促使消费者做出更好的决策。在保险计划价格固定的简单设定下，这项政策能够提升福利。然而，当保险价格因更新的参保者风险池而内生变化时，同样的政策会显著加剧逆向选择现象，并降低消费者福利，使因逆向选择造成的福利损失翻倍。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of the spatial accessibility of public human services agencies on the likelihood of receiving a child care subsidy among disadvantaged mothers with young children. In particular, we collect data on the location of virtually every human services agency in the U.S. and use this information to calculate the approximate distance that families must travel from home in order to reach the nearest office that administers the subsidy application process. Using data from the Kindergarten cohort of the Early Childhood Longitudinal Study (ECLS-K), our results indicate that an increase in the distance to a public human services agency reduces the likelihood that a family receives a child care subsidy. Specifically, we estimate an elasticity of subsidy receipt with respect to distance of -0.13. The final section of the paper provides an empirical application in which we use variation in families' travel distance to identify the causal effect of child care subsidies on children's weight outcomes. Our instrumental variables estimates suggest that subsidized child care leads to sizeable increases in the prevalence of overweight and obesity among low-income children.

10.3386/w17471.abstractZh: 本文探讨了公共人类服务机构的空间可达性对贫困母亲及其年幼子女获得儿童保育补贴的可能性所产生的影响。具体而言，我们收集了美国几乎所有人类服务机构的位置数据，并利用这些信息计算出家庭从家中到最近的办理补贴申请手续机构的大致距离。根据《早期儿童纵向研究》的幼儿园队列数据，我们的研究结果表明，与公共人类服务机构的距离增加会降低家庭获得儿童保育补贴的可能性。具体来说，我们估计出补贴获得与距离之间的弹性为-0.13。论文的最后一部分通过实证分析，利用家庭出行距离的变化来识别儿童保育补贴对儿童体重状况的因果效应。我们的工具变量估计表明，享受补贴的儿童保育服务会导致低收入儿童超重和肥胖的患病率显著上升。

abstract.text: This paper contributes to the literature on the relationship between human capital and organizational performance. We use detailed longitudinal monthly data on nursing units in the Veterans Administration hospital system to identify how the human capital (general, hospital-specific and unit or team-specific) of the nursing team on the unit affects patients' outcomes. Since we use monthly, not annual, data, we are able to avoid the omitted variable bias and endogeneity bias that could result when annual data are used. Nurse staffing levels, general human capital, and unit-specific human capital have positive and significant effects on patient outcomes while the use of contract nurses, who have less specific capital than regular staff nurses, negatively impacts patient outcomes. Policies that would increase the specific human capital of the nursing staff are found to be cost-effective.

10.3386/w17474.abstractZh: 本文为关于人力资本与组织绩效之间关系的文献做出了贡献。我们采用了退伍军人管理局医院系统中护理单位的详细月度纵向数据，以研究护理团队的人力资本（包括一般人力资本、医院特定人力资本以及单位或团队特定人力资本）如何影响患者的治疗效果。由于我们使用的是月度数据而非年度数据，因此能够避免使用年度数据可能导致的遗漏变量偏差和内生性偏差问题。护理人员的配置水平、一般人力资本以及单位特定人力资本对患者的治疗效果具有积极且显著的影响；而合同护士由于拥有较少的特定人力资本，其使用会对患者治疗效果产生负面影响。增加护理人员特定人力资本的政策被证明是具有成本效益的。

abstract.text: We analyze the effects of a school-based incentive program on children's exercise habits. The program offers children an opportunity to win prizes if they walk or bike to school during prize periods. We use daily child-level data and individual fixed effects models to measure the impact of the prizes by comparing behavior during prize periods with behavior during non-prize periods. Variation in the timing of prize periods across different schools allows us to estimate models with calendar-date fixed effects to control for day-specific attributes, such as weather and proximity to holidays. On average, we find that being in a prize period increases riding behavior by sixteen percent, a large impact given that the prize value is just six cents per participating student. We also find that winning a prize lottery has a positive impact on ridership over subsequent weeks; consider heterogeneity across prize type, gender, age, and calendar month; and explore differential effects on the intensive versus extensive margins.

10.3386/w17478.abstractZh: 我们分析了基于学校的激励计划对儿童运动习惯的影响。该计划为儿童提供了在奖励期间步行或骑自行车上学可赢得奖励的机会。我们使用每日的儿童数据和个人固定效应模型，通过比较奖励期间与非奖励期间的行为来衡量奖励的影响。通过不同学校奖励期间的时间差异，我们能够建立包含日历日期固定效应的模型，以控制特定日期的属性，如天气和节假日临近情况。平均而言，我们发现处于奖励期间会使骑行行为增加16%，这一影响相当显著，因为每个参与学生的奖励价值仅为6美分。我们还发现，赢得奖励彩票会在随后几周内对骑行行为产生积极影响；需要考虑奖励类型、性别、年龄和日历月的异质性，并探讨对密集型与广泛型骑行行为的不同影响。

abstract.text: Background: Most applications of choice-based conjoint analysis in health use choice tasks with only two profiles, while those in marketing routinely use three or more. This study reports on a randomized trial comparing paired with triplet profile choice formats focused on measuring patient preference for hearing aids. Methods: Respondents with hearing loss were drawn from a nationally representative cohort, completed identical surveys incorporating a conjoint analysis, but were randomized to choice tasks with two or three profiles. Baseline differences between the two groups were explored using ANOVA and chi-square tests. The primary outcomes of differences in estimated preferences were explored using t-tests, likelihood ratio tests, and analysis of individual-level models estimated with ordinary least squares. Results: 500 respondents were recruited. 127 had no hearing loss, 28 had profound loss and 22 declined to participate and were not analyzed. Of the remaining 323 participants, 146 individuals were randomized to the pairs and 177 to triplets. The only significant difference between the groups was time to complete the survey (11.5 and 21 minutes respectively). Pairs and triplets produced identical rankings of attribute importance but homogeneity was rejected (P<0.0001). Pairs led to more variation, and were systematically biased toward the null because a third (32.2%) of respondents focused on only one attribute. This is in contrast to respondents in the triplet design who traded across all attributes. Discussion: The number of profiles in choice tasks affects the results of conjoint analysis studies. Here triplets are preferred to pairs as they avoid non-trading and allow for more accurate estimation of preferences models.

10.3386/w17482.abstractZh:
背景：在健康领域，选择基础联合分析的应用大多采用只有两个属性的选择任务，而在市场营销领域则通常采用三个或更多属性的选择任务。本研究报道了一项随机试验，比较了使用配对和三元组属性的选择格式，旨在评估患者对助听器的偏好。  
方法：来自全国代表性群体的听力受损受访者参与了研究，他们完成了相同的调查问卷，并进行了联合分析，但被随机分配到具有两个或三个属性的选择任务中。使用方差分析和卡方检验探讨了两组之间的基线差异。通过t检验、似然比检验以及使用普通最小二乘法估计的个体水平模型，探讨了偏好估计差异的主要结果。  
结果：共招募了500名受访者。其中127人没有听力损失，28人听力严重受损，22人因不愿参与而未进行分析。在剩余的323名参与者中，146人被分配到配对组，177人被分配到三元组组。两组之间唯一的显著差异是完成调查所需的时间（分别为11.5分钟和21分钟）。配对和三元组在属性重要性的排序上是一致的，但同质性被拒绝（P<0.0001）。配对组表现出更多的差异，并且由于32.2%的受访者只关注一个属性，因此存在系统性偏向零值的情况。这与三元组组中的受访者形成对比，后者在所有属性之间进行了权衡。  
讨论：选择任务中的属性数量会影响联合分析研究的结果。在此研究中，三元组比配对组更受欢迎，因为它们避免了非交易行为，并允许更精确地估计偏好模型。

abstract.text: This paper explores the relationship between time preferences, economic incentives, and body mass index (BMI). Using data from the 1979 cohort of the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth, we first show that greater impatience increases BMI even after controlling for demographic, human capital, and occupational characteristics as well as income and risk preference. Next, we provide evidence of an interaction effect between time preference and food prices, with cheaper food leading to the largest weight gains among those exhibiting the most impatience. The interaction of changing economic incentives with heterogeneous discounting may help explain why increases in BMI have been concentrated amongst the right tail of the distribution, where the health consequences are especially severe. Lastly, we model time-inconsistent preferences by computing individuals'quasi-hyperbolic discounting parameters (β and δ). Both long-run patience (δ) and present-bias (β) predict BMI, suggesting obesity is partly attributable to rational intertemporal tradeoffs but also partly to time inconsistency.

10.3386/w17483.abstractZh: 本文探讨了时间偏好、经济激励与身体质量指数（BMI）之间的关系。利用1979年《全国青年纵向调查》的数据，我们首先发现，即使控制了人口统计、人力资本、职业特征以及收入和风险偏好等因素后，更大的急躁情绪仍会导致BMI的增加。接下来，我们发现了时间偏好与食品价格之间的交互效应：价格较低的食品能够带来更大体重增长，尤其是在那些表现出最急躁情绪的人群中。经济激励的变化与异质性的折现方式之间的相互作用，可能有助于解释为何BMI的增加主要集中在分布的右尾部，而这一区域的健康后果尤为严重。最后，我们通过计算个体的准超bolic折现参数（β和δ）来模拟时间不一致偏好。长期耐心（δ）和当前偏差（β）都预示着BMI的变化，这表明肥胖部分是由于合理的跨时期权衡造成的，但也与时间不一致性有关。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the relationship between having one or more father figures and the likelihood that young people engage in delinquent criminal behavior. We pay particular attention to distinguishing the roles of residential and non-residential, biological fathers as well as stepfathers. Using data from the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent Health, we find that adolescent boys engage in more delinquent behavior if there is no father figure in their lives. However, adolescent girls' behavior is largely independent of the presence (or absence) of their fathers. The strong effect of family structure is not explained by the lack of paternal involvement that generally comes with fathers' absence, even though adolescents, especially boys, who spend time doing things with their fathers usually have better outcomes. There is also a link between adult delinquent behavior and adolescent family structure that cannot be explained by fathers' involvement with their adolescent sons and is only partially explained by fathers' involvement with their adolescent daughters. Finally, the strong link between adolescent family structure and delinquent behavior is not accounted for by the income differentials associated with fathers' absence. Our results suggest that the presence of a father figure during adolescence is likely to have protective effects, particularly for males, in both adolescence and young adulthood.

10.3386/w17507.abstractZh: 本文分析了拥有一个或多个父亲形象与年轻人从事违法行为的可能性之间的关系。我们特别关注区分居住型与非居住型、生物学父亲以及继父的角色。根据《全国青少年健康纵向研究》的数据，我们发现，如果青少年生活中没有父亲形象，他们就会表现出更多的违法行为。然而，青少年的行为在很大程度上并不受父亲存在与否的影响。家庭结构的强烈影响并非由父亲缺席通常带来的父权缺失所解释，尽管那些常与父亲一起活动的青少年，尤其是男孩，往往会有更好的发展结果。此外，成年人的违法行为与青少年家庭结构之间也存在关联，这种关联无法仅通过父亲对青少年儿子的参与来解释，也仅能通过父亲对青少年女儿的参与部分解释。最后，青少年家庭结构与违法行为之间的强烈关联也无法通过父亲缺席所带来的收入差异来解释。我们的研究结果表明，在青少年时期拥有父亲形象可能会起到保护作用，尤其是对男性而言，在青少年时期和年轻成年期都是如此。

abstract.text: We analyze linear models with a single endogenous regressor in the presence of many instrumental variables.We weaken a key assumption typically made in this literature by allowing all the instruments to have direct effects on the outcome.We consider restrictions on these direct effects that allow for point identification of the effect of interest.The setup leads to new insights concerning the properties of conventional estimators, novel identification strategies, and new estimators to exploit those strategies.A key assumption underlying the main identification strategy is that the product of the direct effects of the instruments on the outcome and the effects of the instruments on the endogenous regressor has expectation zero.We argue in the context of two specific examples with a group structure that this assumption has substantive content.

10.3386/w17519.abstractZh: 我们分析了在存在多个工具变量的情况下，包含单个内生回归变量的线性模型。我们通过允许所有工具变量对结果产生直接效应，削弱了该领域通常做出的关键假设。我们考虑了对这些直接效应的限制条件，从而能够精确识别感兴趣效应。这一设定带来了关于传统估计器性质的新见解，以及利用这些策略的新估计方法。主要识别策略的一个关键假设是，工具变量对结果的直接效应与工具变量对内生回归变量的效应相乘的期望值为零。我们在两个具有群体结构的具体案例研究中指出，这一假设具有实质意义。

abstract.text: The Agricultural Adjustment Act (AAA) caused a population shift in the United States in the 1930s. Evaluating the effects of the AAA on the incidence of malaria can therefore offer important lessons regarding the broader consequences of demographic changes. Using a quasi-first difference model and a robust set of controls, we find a negative association between AAA expenditures and malaria death rates at the county level. Further, we find the AAA caused relatively low-income groups to migrate from counties with high-risk malaria ecologies. These results suggest that the AAA-induced migration played an important role in the reduction of malaria.

10.3386/w17526.abstractZh: 《农业调整法案》在20世纪30年代导致了美国人口结构的变动。因此，评估该法案对疟疾发病率的影响，可以为理解人口变化带来的更广泛后果提供重要启示。通过采用准首次差分模型并设定一系列稳健的控制变量，我们发现县级层面上，农业调整法案的支出与疟疾死亡率之间存在负相关关系。此外，我们还发现，农业调整法案促使低收入群体从疟疾高发地区迁移到其他地区。这些结果表明，农业调整法案引发的迁移在减少疟疾方面发挥了重要作用。

abstract.text: The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) expends considerable efforts in regulating medications approved for use. Yet the impact of medication labeling changes on brand pharmaceutical products, and whether and what firms do to respond to increased information regarding the safety and efficacy of a drug, have not be characterized. We propose a behavioral framework for examining the effects of FDA advisories on branded pharmaceutical firms and their products. We empirically assess the impact of recent FDA advisories on the stock market valuations of a sample of branded pharmaceutical manufacturing firms using event study methods. We examine whether and how branded pharmaceutical manufacturers respond to an advisory by assessing changes in promotion compared to non-affected firms. We find firms targeted by an advisory have average stock price declines of 3% in three days and 11% in five days following the advisory release, and in turn appear to decrease total physician-directed promotion spending, journals ads and detailing visits significantly six months following the advisory release; the provision of free samples is unaffected. We find no changes among therapeutic substitutes unaffected by the advisory. Results of sensitivity analyses suggest firms with market dominant positions experience similar decreases in stock market valuations and physician-directed promotion compared to pooled results. The results are also robust to alternative definitions of the timing of advisory release dates and the severity of advisories' wording. Theory and empirical results suggest the public release of FDA advisories negatively impacts firm's short-term market valuations. The results suggest an additional rationale for previously documented declines in prescribing after FDA advisory releases - significant declines in physician-directed promotion following FDA advisory releases; the combined (and likely correlated) effects of the release of the advisory and declines in physician-directed promotion on prescribing behavior are likely larger than the sum of the independent effects.

10.3386/w17528.abstractZh: 美国食品药品监督管理局在监管已获批准的药物方面投入了大量精力。然而，药物标签变更对品牌制药产品的影响，以及企业是否以及如何应对有关药物安全性和有效性信息的增加，尚未得到明确界定。我们提出了一个行为框架，以研究FDA建议对品牌制药企业及其产品的影响。我们通过事件研究方法，实证评估了最近FDA建议对部分品牌制药制造企业股票市场估值的影响。我们通过比较受建议影响的公司与未受影响公司的促销活动变化，来研究品牌制药制造商对建议的反应。研究发现，受建议影响的公司在建议发布后的三天内平均股价下跌3%，五天内下跌11%；同时，在建议发布后的六个月里，这些公司的医生指导型促销活动支出、期刊广告和诊所访问量均显著减少；而免费样品的提供则未受到影响。对于不受建议影响的替代疗法，未发现任何变化。敏感性分析的结果表明，处于市场主导地位的企业，其股票市场估值和医生指导型促销活动的减少程度与整体结果相似。这些结果在调整建议发布时间的定义和建议措辞的严重程度后依然保持稳定。理论和实证结果均表明，FDA建议的公开发布会对企业的短期市场估值产生负面影响。研究结果表明，此前关于FDA建议发布后处方量下降的文献中提到的另一个原因：FDA建议发布后，医生主导的处方推广活动显著减少；建议发布与处方量下降之间的联合效应（可能具有相关性）可能大于单独效应的总和。

abstract.text: Economists seeking to improve the efficiency of health care delivery frequently emphasize two issues: the fragmented structure of physician practices and poorly designed physician incentives. This paper analyzes these issues from the perspective of organizational economics. We begin with a brief overview of the structure of physician practices and observe that the long anticipated triumph of integrated care delivery has largely gone unrealized. We then analyze the special problems that fragmentation poses for the design of physician incentives. Organizational economics suggests some promising incentive strategies for this setting, but implementing these strategies is complicated by norms of autonomy in the medical profession and by other factors that inhibit effective integration between hospitals and physicians. Compounding these problems are patterns of medical specialization that complicate coordination among physicians. We conclude by considering the policy implications of our analysis - paying particular attention to proposed Accountable Care Organizations.

10.3386/w17535.abstractZh: 寻求提高医疗服务效率的经济学家经常强调两个问题：医生执业的碎片化结构以及设计不当的医生激励措施。本文从组织经济学的角度分析这些问题。我们首先简要概述了医生执业的结构，并观察到人们期待已久的整合式医疗服务模式尚未实现。接着，我们分析了碎片化结构对医生激励措施设计带来的特殊挑战。组织经济学为这一情境提出了一些有前景的激励策略，但实施这些策略面临着医学职业中自主性的规范以及其他阻碍医院与医生之间有效整合的因素。此外，医学专业化的模式也增加了医生之间协调的难度。最后，我们探讨了本分析的政策意义，特别关注了提出的责任医疗组织。

abstract.text: This paper examines how estimates of the price elasticity of demand for beer vary with the choice of alcohol price series examined. Our most important finding is that the commonly used ACCRA price data are unlikely to reliably indicate alcohol demand elasticities--estimates obtained from this source vary drastically and unpredictably. As an alternative, researchers often use beer taxes to proxy for alcohol prices. While the estimated beer taxes elasticities are more stable, there are several problems with using taxes, including difficulties in accounting for cross-price effects. We believe that the most useful estimates reported in this paper are obtained using annual Uniform Product Code (UPC) "barcode" scanner data on grocery store alcohol prices. These estimates suggest relatively low demand elasticity, probably around -0.3, with evidence that the elasticities are considerably overstated in models that control for beer but not wine or spirits prices.

10.3386/w17578.abstractZh: 本文探讨了啤酒需求价格弹性估计值如何随着所研究的酒精价格系列的选取而发生变化。我们最重要的发现是，常用的ACCRA价格数据不太可能可靠地反映酒精需求弹性——从这一来源获得的估计值变化幅度巨大且难以预测。作为替代方案，研究人员经常使用啤酒税来代表酒精价格。虽然通过啤酒税估计出的弹性值更为稳定，但使用税收存在几个问题，包括难以考虑交叉价格效应。我们认为，本文报道的最有用的估计值是通过年度统一产品代码（UPC）“条形码”扫描仪数据获得的，这些数据涉及杂货店酒精价格。这些估计表明，啤酒需求弹性相对较低，大约在-0.3左右，并且有证据表明，在控制啤酒价格而不控制葡萄酒或烈酒价格的情况下，这些弹性值被严重高估了。

abstract.text: The threat posed by smoking to health in India is severe. Already 1 in 5 of all adult male deaths and 1 in 20 of all adult female deaths at ages 30-69 are due to smoking and India will soon have 1 million smoking deaths a year. Increasing tobacco prices has been found to be the single most effective method to reduce smoking. Yet, bidis, the most common form of smoked tobacco in India, are largely untaxed, while cigarettes are taxed at about 40% of retail price, well below the 65-80% rate noted by the World Bank in countries with effective tobacco control policies. Moreover, low and stagnant tax rates have occurred in a period in which all tobacco products have become more affordable with income growth. First, we use data from the most recent three consecutive quinquennial National Sample Survey (NSS) rounds (NSS 50, 55 and 61 conducted in 1993/94, 1999/00 and 200/05) and a two-equation system of budget shares and unit values that attempts to correct for quality and measurement error. Second, we pool data from the most recent nine rounds of NSS (NSS 55-57, 59-64, conducted between 1999/00 to 2007/08). Our analyses of single and repeated cross-sections yield own-price elasticity for bidis that are roughly in keeping with existing evidence. We find that a 10% increase in bidi prices would reduce the demand for bidis by about 6 to 9.5%. We find, however, that own-price elasticity for cigarettes in India is substantially larger than previously thought. Our estimates suggest that cigarette users are at least as responsive as bidi users to price changes. On the whole, our analyses suggest that low SES households are likely more responsive to price changes than high SES households. Our analyses also uncovers important and policy-relevant cross-prices effects. Findings from this study provide additional evidence of the effectiveness of tobacco prices at reducing tobacco use.

10.3386/w17580.abstractZh: 在印度，吸烟对健康的威胁非常严重。在30-69岁的成年人中，每5个男性死亡病例中就有1例是由吸烟引起的，而每20个女性死亡病例中就有1例也是由吸烟导致的。印度每年将有100万例与吸烟相关的死亡。提高烟草价格被认为是减少吸烟的最有效方法。然而，印度最常见的吸烟烟草产品——比迪烟，大多免征税收，而香烟的税收约为零售价的40%，远低于世界银行指出在具有有效烟草控制政策的国家中常见的65-80%的税率。此外，在收入增长的情况下，所有烟草产品的价格都变得更加可负担，但税收率却一直较低且停滞不前。首先，我们使用了最近三次连续进行的全国样本调查的数据（NSS 50、55和61，分别于1993/94年、1999/00年和2005年进行），并运用了一个包含预算份额和单位价值的双方程系统来纠正质量和测量误差。其次，我们整合了最近九次NSS调查的数据（NSS 55-57、59-64，时间跨度从1999/00年到2007/08年）。我们对单个和重复横截面的分析表明，比迪烟的自身价格弹性与现有证据大致一致。我们发现，比迪烟价格上涨10%会导致需求减少6%到9.5%。然而，我们发现印度香烟的自身价格弹性比之前认为的要大得多。我们的估计表明，香烟使用者对价格变化的反应至少与比迪烟使用者一样敏感。总体而言，我们的分析表明，低社会经济地位的家庭可能比高社会经济地位的家庭更敏感于价格变化。我们的分析还揭示了一些重要的、与政策相关的交叉价格效应。本研究的结果进一步证明了烟草价格在减少烟草使用方面的有效性。

abstract.text: Estimation of marginal or partial effects of covariates x on various conditional parameters or functionals is often the main target of applied microeconometric analysis. In the specific context of probit models such estimation is straightforward in univariate models, and Greene, 1996, 1998, has extended these results to cover the case of quadrant probability marginal effects in bivariate probit models. The purpose of this paper is to extend these results to the general multivariate probit context for arbitrary orthant probabilities and to demonstrate the applicability of such extensions in contexts of interest in health economics applications. The baseline results are extended to models that condition on subvectors of y, to count data structures that derive from the probability structure of y, to multivariate ordered probit data structures, and to multinomial probit models whose marginal effects turn out to be a special case of those of the multivariate probit model. Simulations reveal that analytical formulae versus fully numerical derivatives result in a reduction in computational time as well as an increase in accuracy.

10.3386/w17588.abstractZh: 估计协变量x对各种条件参数或函数值的边际或部分效应，通常是应用微观计量经济学分析的主要目标。在probit模型的特定背景下，这种估计在单变量模型中较为直接，Greene在1996年和1998年的研究中将这些结果扩展到了双变量probit模型中象限概率边际效应的情形。本文的目的是将这些结果扩展到一般的多变量probit情境，适用于任意象限概率，并证明这些扩展在健康经济学应用中的适用性。基线结果被扩展到了以y的子向量为条件的模型、从y的概率结构派生出的计数数据结构、多变量有序probit数据结构，以及边际效应属于多变量probit模型特例的多项probit模型。模拟结果表明，使用解析公式与完全数值导数相比，可以减少计算时间并提高准确性。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the impact of the macroeconomy on the health insurance coverage of Americans using panel data from the Survey of Income and Program Participation (SIPP) for 2004-2010, a period that includes the Great Recession of 2007-09. We find that a one percentage point increase in the state unemployment rate is associated with a 1.67 percentage point (2.12%) reduction in the probability that men have health insurance; this effect is strongest among college-educated, white, and older (50-64 year old) men. For women and children, health insurance coverage is not significantly correlated with the unemployment rate, which may be the result of public health insurance acting as a social safety net. Compared to the previous recession, the health insurance coverage of men is more sensitive to the unemployment rate, which may be due to the nature of the Great Recession.

10.3386/w17600.abstractZh: 本文利用2004-2010年的《收入与计划参与调查》的面板数据，研究了宏观经济因素对美国人的医疗保险覆盖率的影响。研究期间包括2007-09年的经济衰退。研究发现，州失业率每上升一个百分点，男性拥有医疗保险的概率就会下降1.67个百分点（或2.12个百分点）。这一效应在受过大学教育、白人以及年龄较大（50-64岁）的男性中最为明显。对于女性和儿童而言，医疗保险覆盖率与失业率之间没有显著相关性，这可能是由于公共医疗保险作为社会保障体系的作用所致。与之前的经济衰退相比，男性医疗保险覆盖率对失业率的敏感性更高，这可能是由于经济衰退的性质所导致的。

abstract.text: Technological progress is typically a result of trial-and-error research by competing firms. While some research paths lead to the innovation sought, others result in dead ends. Because firms benefit from their competitors working in the wrong direction, they do not reveal their dead-end findings. Time and resources are wasted on projects that other firms have already found to be dead ends. Consequently, technological progress is slowed down, and the society benefits from innovations with delay, if ever.
