To study this prevalent problem, we build a tractable two-arm bandit model with two competing firms. The risky arm could potentially lead to a dead end and the safe arm introduces further competition to make firms keep their dead-end findings private. We characterize the equilibrium in this decentralized environment and show that the equilibrium necessarily entails significant efficiency losses due to wasteful dead-end replication and a flight to safety - an early abandonment of the risky project. Finally, we design a dynamic mechanism where firms are incentivized to disclose their actions and share their private information in a timely manner. This mechanism restores efficiency and suggests a direction for welfare improvement.

10.3386/w17602.abstractZh: 技术进步通常是竞争企业通过试错研究的结果。虽然某些研究路径能够带来所寻求的创新，但另一些则可能导致死胡同。由于企业从竞争对手的错误方向上获得利益，因此它们不会公开那些导致死胡同的发现。时间和资源被浪费在那些已被其他企业认定为死胡同的项目上。因此，技术进步的速度会放缓，社会也只能在延迟之后才能从创新中受益，甚至根本无法受益。为了研究这一普遍问题，我们构建了一个可行的双臂老虎机模型，其中有两个竞争企业。风险臂可能会通向死胡同，而安全臂则通过进一步的竞争促使企业保持对死胡同发现的保密。我们描述了这种去中心化环境中的均衡状态，并表明这种均衡必然会导致显著的效率损失，因为资源被浪费在重复探索死胡同上，以及企业过早放弃风险项目以寻求安全。最后，我们设计了一种动态机制，通过这种机制，企业有动力公开自己的行动并及时分享私人信息。这一机制恢复了效率，并为福利改善指明了方向。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the impact of unskilled workers' earnings on crime. Following the literature on wage inequality and skill-biased technological change, we employ CPS data to create state-year as well as state-year-and (broad) industry specific measures of skill-biased technological change, which are then used as instruments for unskilled workers' earnings in crime regressions. Regressions that employ state panels reveal that technology-induced variations in unskilled workers' earnings impact property crime with an elasticity of -1, but that wages have no impact on violent crime. The paper also estimates, for the first time in this literature, structural crime equations using micro panel data from NLSY97 and instrumenting real wages of young workers. Using state-year-industry specific technology shocks as instruments yields elasticities that are in the neighborhood of -2 for most types of crime, which is markedly larger than previous estimates. In both data sets there is evidence for asymmetric impact of unskilled workers' earnings on crime. A decline in earnings has a larger effect on crime in comparison to an increase in earnings by the same absolute value.

10.3386/w17605.abstractZh: 本文研究了非技术工人收入对犯罪的影响。基于关于工资不平等和技能偏向性技术变革的文献，我们采用CPS数据来构建以州年份以及州年份与（广泛）行业为维度的技能偏向性技术变革指标，并将其作为非技术工人收入与犯罪关系的回归分析的工具。采用州级面板数据的回归分析表明，技术因素导致的非技术工人收入变化对财产犯罪的影响系数为-1，而工资对暴力犯罪则没有显著影响。本文还首次利用NLSY97的微面板数据，通过工具变量法对实际工资进行估计，得出了结构性犯罪方程。以州年份-行业特定的技术冲击作为工具变量后，发现大多数类型的犯罪影响系数接近-2，这一数值明显高于以往的研究结果。在这两个数据集中，都发现了非技术工人收入对犯罪影响的不对称性：收入下降对犯罪的影响比收入增加的影响更为显著，且两者之间的绝对值差距也更大。

abstract.text: The literature on mergers between private hospitals suggests that such mergers often produce little benefit. Despite this, the UK government has pursued an active policy of hospital merger. These mergers are initiated by a regulator, acting on behalf of the public, and justified on the grounds that merger will improve outcomes. We examine whether this promise is met. We exploit the fact that between 1997 and 2006 in England around half the short term general hospitals were involved in a merger, but that politics means that selection for a merger may be random with respect to future performance. We examine the impact of mergers on a large set of outcomes including financial performance, productivity, waiting times and clinical quality and find little evidence that mergers achieved gains other than a reduction in activity. In addition, mergers reduce the scope for competition between hospitals.

10.3386/w17608.abstractZh: 关于私立医院合并的文献表明，此类合并往往带来的好处有限。尽管如此，英国政府仍积极推行医院合并政策。这些合并是由监管机构代表公众发起的，其理由是合并能够改善医疗效果。我们研究这一承诺是否得以实现。我们发现，在1997年至2006年间，英格兰约有半数的短期综合医院参与了合并，但由于政治因素，合并选择可能对未来的表现具有随机性。我们考察了合并对一系列结果的影响，包括财务绩效、生产力、等待时间以及临床质量，发现合并除了减少医院活动外，并未带来其他显著收益。此外，合并还减少了医院之间的竞争机会。

abstract.text: We use novel data to study the decision to undergo genetic testing by individuals at risk for Huntington disease (HD), a hereditary neurological disorder that reduces healthy life expectancy to about age 50. Although genetic testing is perfectly predictive and carries little financial or time cost, less than 10 percent of at-risk individuals are tested prior to the onset of symptoms. Testing rates are higher for individuals with higher ex ante risk of carrying the genetic expansion for HD. Untested individuals express optimistic beliefs about their probability of having HD and make fertility, savings, labor supply, and other decisions as if they do not have HD, even though individuals with confirmed HD behave quite differently. We show that these facts are qualitatively consistent with a model of optimal expectations (Brunnermeier and Parker, 2005) and can be reconciled quantitatively in this model with reasonable parameter values. This model nests the neoclassical framework and, we argue, provides strong evidence rejecting the assumptions of that framework. Finally, we briefly develop policy implications.

10.3386/w17629.abstractZh: 我们利用新颖的数据来研究有亨廷顿病风险的人群是否进行基因检测的决策。亨廷顿病是一种遗传性神经系统疾病，其导致的健康预期寿命大约在50岁左右。尽管基因检测具有极高的预测性，且成本和时间开销都很低，但在症状出现之前，只有不到10%的有风险人群会接受检测。对于那些有较高风险携带亨廷顿病基因的人群，检测率更高。未接受检测的人群对自身患亨廷顿病的概率持乐观态度，并在生育、储蓄、劳动力供应等方面做出决策，仿佛自己没有患病一样，而确诊患有亨廷顿病的人群则表现出截然不同的行为。我们发现，这些现象与最优期望模型（Brunnermeier和Parker，2005年提出）在定性上是一致的，并且可以通过合理的参数值在定量上与该模型相协调。该模型将新古典框架纳入其中，我们认为，这为否定该框架的假设提供了有力的证据。最后，我们简要讨论了该模型的政策意义。

abstract.text: We present evidence from a natural field experiment involving nearly 100,000 individuals on the effects of offering economic incentives for blood donations. Subjects who were offered economic rewards to donate blood were more likely to donate, and more so the higher the value of the rewards. They were also more likely to attract others to donate, spatially alter the location of their donations towards the drives offering rewards, and modify their temporal donation schedule leading to a short-term reduction in donations immediately after the reward offer was removed. Although offering economic incentives, combining all of these effects, positively and significantly increased donations, ignoring individuals who took additional actions beyond donating to get others to donate would have led to an under-estimate of the total effect, whereas ignoring the spatial effect would have led to an over-estimate of the total effect. We also find that individuals who received a reward by surprise were less likely to donate after the intervention than subjects who received no reward, suggesting that for some individuals a surprise reward adversely affected their intrinsic motivations. We discuss the implications of these findings for understanding pro-social behavior.

10.3386/w17636.abstractZh: 我们展示了来自一项自然实地实验的证据，该实验涉及近10万名个体，研究提供经济激励以鼓励献血的效果。那些被提供经济奖励以献血的受试者更有可能献血，且奖励的价值越高，这种可能性越大。他们也更有可能吸引其他人献血，献血地点会向提供奖励的方向转移，并且献血的时间安排也会发生变化，导致在奖励取消后短期内献血数量减少。尽管提供经济激励能够综合这些效应，使献血数量显著增加，但忽略那些除了献血之外还采取其他行动来鼓励他人献血的个体，会导致对总效果估计不足；而忽略空间效应则会导致对总效果估计过高。我们还发现，那些在干预后收到意外奖励的受试者，比未收到奖励的受试者更不可能献血，这表明对某些个体来说，意外奖励会对其内在动机产生负面影响。我们讨论了这些发现对于理解亲社会行为的重要性。

abstract.text: Regression discontinuity designs (RDDs) are a popular method to estimate treatment effects. However, RDDs may fail to yield consistent estimates if the forcing variable can be manipulated by the agent. In this paper, we examine one interesting set of economic models with such a feature. Specifically, we examine the case where there is a structural relationship between the forcing variable and the outcome variable because they are determined simultaneously. We propose a modi...ed RDD estimator for such models and derive the conditions under which it is consistent. As an application of our method, we study contracts between a large managed care organization and leading hospitals for the provision of organ and tissue transplants. Exploiting "donut holes" in the reimbursement contracts we estimate how the total claims filed by the hospitals depend on the generosity of the reimbursement structure. Our results show that hospitals submit significantly larger bills when the reimbursement rate is higher, indicating informational asymmetries between the payer and hospitals in this market.

10.3386/w17643.abstractZh: 回归不连续设计是一种常用的估计处理效应的方法。然而，如果强迫变量可以被代理人操纵，那么回归不连续设计可能无法得到一致的估计结果。在本文中，我们研究了一组具有此类特征的经济模型。具体来说，我们考察了强迫变量与结果变量之间存在结构性关系的情况，因为它们是同时确定的。我们提出了一种针对此类模型的改进型回归不连续设计估计方法，并推导出了该方法一致性的条件。作为我们方法的应用，我们研究了大型医疗护理组织与顶尖医院之间关于器官和组织移植的协议。通过利用报销协议中的“甜甜圈孔”，我们估计了医院提交的总索赔金额如何取决于报销结构的慷慨程度。我们的结果显示，当报销率较高时，医院提交的账单显著增大，这表明在该市场中，支付方与医院之间存在信息不对称。

abstract.text: A growing literature documents cyclical movements in mortality and health. We examine this pattern more closely and attempt to identify the mechanisms behind it. Specifically, we distinguish between mechanisms that rely on fluctuations in own employment or time use and those involving factors that are external to the individual. Our investigation suggests that changes in individuals' own behavior contribute very little to pro-cyclical mortality. Looking across broad age and gender groups, we find that own-group employment rates are not systematically related to own-group mortality. In addition, we find that most of the additional deaths that occur during times of economic growth are among the elderly, particularly elderly women, who have limited labor force attachment. Focusing on mortality among the elderly, we show that cyclicality is especially strong for deaths occurring in nursing homes, and is stronger in states where a higher fraction of the elderly reside in nursing homes. We also demonstrate that staffing in skilled nursing facilities moves counter-cyclically. Taken together, these findings suggest that cyclical fluctuations in the mortality rate may be largely driven by fluctuations in the quality of health care.

10.3386/w17657.abstractZh: 越来越多的文献记录了死亡率和健康状况的周期性变化。我们更仔细地研究这一模式，并试图找出其背后的机制。具体来说，我们区分了那些依赖于个人就业或时间使用变化的机制，以及那些涉及外部因素的机制。我们的研究表明，个人自身行为的变化对周期性死亡率的影响很小。在广泛的年龄和性别群体中，我们发现个人就业率与个人死亡率之间没有系统性关系。此外，我们发现经济增长期间发生的额外死亡大多发生在老年人中，尤其是那些劳动力参与度较低的老年女性。针对老年人的死亡率，我们发现养老院中发生的死亡具有更强的周期性，而在老年人口比例较高的州，这种周期性更为明显。我们还发现，专业护理设施的人员配置呈现反向周期性变化。综合这些发现，我们认为死亡率的周期性波动可能主要由医疗保健质量的波动所驱动。

abstract.text: We analyze the effects of states' expansions of CHIP eligibility to children in higher income families during 2002-2009 on take-up of public coverage, crowd-out of private coverage, and rates of uninsurance. Our results indicate these expansions were associated with limited uptake of public coverage and only a two percentage point reduction in the uninsurance rate among these children. Because not all of the take-up of public insurance among eligible children is accounted for by children who transfer from being uninsured to having public insurance, our results suggest that there may be some crowd-out of private insurance coverage; the upper bound crowd-out rate we calculate is 46 percent.

10.3386/w17658.abstractZh: 我们分析了2002-2009年间各州扩大CHIP计划对高收入家庭儿童参保资格的影响，包括公共保险覆盖率的提升、私人保险覆盖率的减少以及未参保率的变化。研究结果表明，这些政策扩张仅导致公共保险覆盖率略有提升，未参保率也仅降低了两个百分点。由于符合条件的儿童中，从未参保转变为参保的情况并非全部，因此我们的研究还表明，私人保险覆盖率可能出现了一定的减少；我们计算出的最大减少率为46%。

abstract.text: Over the last several decades, both delay of childbearing and fertility problems have become increasingly common among women in developed countries. At the same time, technological changes have made many more options available to individuals experiencing fertility problems. However, these technologies are expensive, and only 25% of health insurance plans in the United States cover infertility treatment. As a result of these high costs, legislation has been passed in 15 states that mandates insurance coverage of infertility treatment in private insurance plans. In this paper, we examine whether mandated insurance coverage for infertility treatment affects utilization. We allow utilization effects to differ by age and education, since previous research suggests that older, more educated women should be more likely to be directly affected by the mandates than younger women and less educated women, both because they are at higher risk of fertility problems and because they are more likely to have private health insurance which is subject to the mandate. We find robust evidence that the mandates do have a significant effect on utilization for older, more educated women that is larger than the effects found for other groups. These effects are largest for the use of ovulation-inducing drugs and artificial insemination.

10.3386/w17668.abstractZh: 在过去的几十年里，生育延迟和生育问题在发达国家女性中变得越来越普遍。与此同时，技术变革为面临生育问题的个体提供了更多的选择。然而，这些技术成本高昂，美国只有25%的健康保险计划涵盖不孕症治疗。由于高昂的成本，15个州通过了立法，要求私人保险计划必须涵盖不孕症治疗。本文探讨了强制要求保险覆盖不孕症治疗是否会影响治疗的使用情况。我们考虑到年龄和教育水平对使用效果的影响，因为先前的研究表明，年龄较大、受教育程度较高的女性更可能受到这些要求的直接影响，因为她们面临更高的生育问题风险，并且更有可能拥有受该要求约束的私人健康保险。我们发现，强制要求确实对年龄较大、受教育程度较高的女性的治疗使用产生了显著影响，其影响程度大于其他群体的影响。这些影响在排卵诱导药物和人工授精的使用上最为明显。

abstract.text: This paper examines the links between the disease environment around the time of a woman's birth, and her health at the time she delivers her own infant. Our results suggest that exposure to disease in early childhood significantly increases the incidence of diabetes in the population of future mothers. The exposed mothers are less likely to be married, have fewer years of education, are more likely to gain over 60 pounds while pregnant, and are more likely to smoke while pregnant. Not surprisingly then, exposure increases the probability of low birth weight in the next generation, at least among whites. Among whites, this effect remains when we control for maternal behaviors as well as disease exposure. Among blacks, we find that maternal exposure reduces the incidence of low birth weight. The difference between whites and blacks may reflect a "scarring" vs. selection story; whites who go on to have children are negatively impacted, while blacks who go on to have children are positively selected having survived a higher early childhood mortality rate.

10.3386/w17676.abstractZh: 本文探讨了女性出生时的疾病环境与其分娩后健康状况之间的关联。研究结果表明，儿童早期接触疾病会显著增加未来母亲患糖尿病的风险。接触疾病的母亲更可能未婚，受教育年限较少，怀孕时体重增加较多，且更可能吸烟。因此，接触疾病会增加下一代低出生体重的概率，至少在白人人群中如此。在控制母亲的行为和疾病暴露因素后，这一效应在白人中的表现仍然显著。而在黑人群体中，我们发现母亲接触疾病反而降低了低出生体重的发生率。白人与黑人之间的这种差异可能反映了“创伤”与“选择”的两种解释：那些后来生育孩子的白人受到了负面影响，而黑人则因为较高的早期儿童死亡率而得到了正向的选择。

abstract.text: Airports are some of the largest sources of air pollution in the United States. We demonstrate that daily airport runway congestion contributes significantly to local pollution levels and contemporaneous health of residents living nearby and downwind from airports. Our research design exploits the fact that network delays originating from large airports on the East Coast increase runway congestion in California, which in turn increases daily pollution levels around California airports. Using the component of California air pollution driven by airport congestion, we find that carbon monoxide (CO) leads to significant increases in hospitalization rates for asthma, respiratory, and heart related emergency room admissions that are an order of magnitude larger than conventional estimates: A one standard deviation increase in daily pollution levels leads to an additional $1 million in hospitalization costs for respiratory and heart related admissions for the 6 million individuals living within 10km (6.2 miles) of the 12 largest airports in California. While infants and the elderly are more sensitive to air pollution, we also find significant relationships for the adult population. The health impacts are driven by CO, not NO2 or O3, and occur at levels far below existing EPA mandates. Our results suggest there may be sizable morbidity benefits from lowering the existing CO standard.

10.3386/w17684.abstractZh: 机场是美国最大的空气污染来源之一。我们的研究表明，机场跑道上的日常拥堵显著增加了当地污染水平，并影响了居住在机场附近和下风向地区的居民的健康状况。我们的研究设计利用了这样一个事实：东海岸大型机场引起的网络延误会增加加利福尼亚州的跑道拥堵，进而提高加州机场周围的日常污染水平。通过分析由机场拥堵引发的加州空气污染，我们发现一氧化碳（CO）会导致哮喘、呼吸系统及心脏相关急诊住院率的显著上升，其影响程度比传统估计值高出一个数量级：当日常污染水平增加一个标准差时，加州12个最大机场周边60万居民因呼吸系统及心脏相关疾病而增加的住院费用将达到100万美元。虽然婴儿和老年人对空气污染更为敏感，但我们也发现成年人群也存在显著的关系。这些健康影响是由一氧化碳引起的，而非二氧化氮或臭氧，且这些影响发生的污染水平远低于美国环保署现有的标准。我们的研究结果表明，降低当前的一氧化碳标准可能会带来显著的发病率降低效果。

abstract.text: We describe the Medicaid eligibility rules for the elderly. Medicaid is administered jointly by the Federal and state governments, and each state has significant flexibility on the details of the implementation. We document the features common to all states, but we also highlight the most salient state-level differences. There are two main pathways to Medicaid eligibility for people over age 65: either having low assets and income, or being impoverished due to large medical expenses. The first group of recipients (the categorically needy) mostly includes life-long poor individuals, while the second group (the medically needy) includes people who might have earned substantial amounts of money during their lifetime but have become impoverished by large medical expenses. The categorically needy program thus only affects the savings decision of people who have been poor throughout most of their lives. In contrast, the medically needy program provides some insurance even to people who have higher income and assets. Thus, this second pathway is to some extent going to affect the savings of the relatively higher income and assets people.

10.3386/w17689.abstractZh: 我们描述了针对老年人的Medicaid资格规则。Medicaid由联邦政府和州政府共同管理，每个州在实施细节上都有很大的灵活性。我们记录了所有州共有的特征，同时也强调了各州之间最显著的差异。对于65岁以上的人群来说，获得Medicaid资格主要有两条途径：要么资产与收入较低，要么因高额医疗费用而陷入贫困。第一类受益人（明确需要帮助的人）大多包括一生都生活在贫困中的人，而第二类受益人（医疗需求者）则包括那些一生中可能赚取了相当数额收入但因高额医疗费用而陷入贫困的人。因此，明确需要帮助的计划只影响那些一生都生活在贫困中的人的储蓄决策。相比之下，医疗需求者计划甚至为那些拥有较高收入和资产的人提供一定的保障。因此，第二条途径在某种程度上会影响那些拥有较高收入和资产的人的储蓄决策。

abstract.text: There is limited empirical evidence on whether unrestricted cash social assistance to poor pregnant women improves children's birth outcomes. Using program administrative micro-data matched to longitudinal vital statistics on the universe of births in Uruguay, we estimate that participation in a generous cash transfer program led to a sizeable 15% reduction in the incidence of low birthweight. Improvements in mother nutrition and a fall in labor supply, out-of-wedlock births and mother's smoking all appear to contribute to the effect. We conclude that, by improving child health, unrestricted unconditional cash transfers may help break the cycle of intergenerational poverty.

10.3386/w17690.abstractZh: 关于无限制现金社会援助是否有助于改善贫困孕妇的婴儿出生结果，现有的实证证据有限。通过利用乌拉圭出生数据的纵向生命统计资料，并结合项目管理微观数据，我们估计参与一项慷慨的现金转移计划可使低出生体重的发生率降低15%。母亲营养状况的改善、分娩数量的减少、非婚生育的减少以及母亲吸烟率的下降，似乎都对这一效果有所贡献。我们得出结论，通过改善儿童健康，无限制的无条件现金转移可能有助于打破代际贫困的循环。

abstract.text: Two ailments limit the effectiveness and threaten the long-term viability of the U.S. Social Security Disability Insurance program (SSDI). First, the program is ineffective in assisting the vast majority of workers with less severe disabilities to reach their employment potential or earn their own way. Second, the program's expenditures on cash transfers and medical benefits-- exceeding $1,500 per U.S. household--are extremely high and growing unsustainably. There is no compelling evidence, however, that the incidence of disabling conditions among the U.S. working age population is rising. This paper discusses the challenges facing the SSDI program, explains how its design has led to rapid and unsustainable growth, considers why past efforts to slow program growth have met with minimal and fleeting success, and outlines three recent proposals that would modify the program to slow growth while potentially improving the employment prospects of workers with disabilities. Because these proposals depart substantially from a program design that has seen little change in half a century, their efficacy is unproven. Additionally, even well-meaning efforts to place the SSDI program on a sustainable trajectory run the risk of creating additional hurdles for claimants who are truly unable to work. Nevertheless, the imminent exhaustion of the SSDI Trust Fund provides an impetus and an opportunity to explore innovative solutions to the longstanding policy challenges posed by the SSDI program.

10.3386/w17697.abstractZh: 两种问题限制了美国社会保障残疾保险计划（SSDI）的效能，并威胁到其长期可行性。首先，该计划未能有效帮助绝大多数残疾程度较轻的工人实现就业潜力或自食其力。其次，该计划在现金转移和医疗福利方面的支出——每美国家庭超过1,500美元——非常高，且增长趋势难以持续。然而，并没有令人信服的证据表明美国劳动年龄人口中致残状况的发生率在上升。本文讨论了SSDI计划面临的挑战，解释了其设计如何导致快速增长且不可持续的支出，探讨了过去试图减缓计划增长的努力为何收效甚微，并提出了三项近期提案，这些提案旨在调整计划结构，以减缓增长，同时可能改善残疾工人的就业前景。由于这些提案与半个世纪以来几乎没有变化的计划设计存在较大差异，因此其有效性尚未得到验证。此外，即使是出于善意的努力，试图使SSDI计划走上可持续发展的道路，也可能给真正无法工作的申请人带来更多障碍。尽管如此，SSDI信托基金的即将耗尽为探索解决该计划长期存在的政策挑战提供了动力和机会。

abstract.text: On January 1, 1991, the federal excise tax on beer doubled, and the tax rates on wine and liquor increased as well. These changes are larger than the typical state-level changes that have been used to study the effect of price on alcohol abuse and its consequences. In this paper, we develop a method to estimate some important effects of those large 1991 changes, exploiting the interstate differences in alcohol consumption. We demonstrate that the relative importance of drinking in traffic fatalities is closely tied to per capita alcohol consumption across states. As a result, we expect that the proportional effects of the federal tax increase on traffic fatalities would be positively correlated with per capita consumption. We demonstrate that this is indeed the case, and infer estimates of the price elasticity and lives saved in each state. We repeat this exercise for other injury-fatality rates, and for nine categories of crime. For each outcome, the estimated effect of the tax increase is negatively related to average consumption, and that relationship is highly significant for the overall injury death rate, the violent crime rate, and the property crime rate. A conservative estimate is that the federal tax reduced injury deaths by 4.7%, or almost 7,000, in 1991.

10.3386/w17709.abstractZh: 1991年1月1日，联邦对啤酒的消费税翻倍，葡萄酒和烈酒的税率也有所上升。这些变化比通常用于研究价格对酒精滥用及其后果影响的州级变化更为显著。在本文中，我们开发了一种方法，利用各州之间在酒精消费上的差异，来估算1991年这些重大变化的一些重要影响。我们发现，在交通事故死亡中，饮酒的相对重要性与各州的人均酒精消费密切相关。因此，我们预计联邦税收增加对交通事故死亡的影响，会与人均消费呈正相关。我们确实证实了这一点，并估算了各州因税收增加而节省的生命数量。我们对其他伤害与死亡比率以及九类犯罪也进行了类似的估算。对于每一种结果，税收增加的影响与平均消费量呈负相关，且这种关系在整体伤害与死亡比率、暴力犯罪率和财产犯罪率方面尤为显著。保守估计，联邦税收在1991年减少了4.7%的伤害死亡，即近7,000人。

abstract.text: We consider the effects of daytime fasting by pregnant women during the lunar month of Ramadan on their children's test scores at age seven. Using English register data, we find that scores are .05 to .08 standard deviations lower for Pakistani and Bangladeshi students exposed to Ramadan in early pregnancy. These estimates are downward biased to the extent that Ramadan is not universally observed. We conclude that the effects of prenatal investments on test scores are comparable to many conventional educational interventions but are likely to be more cost effective and less subject to "fade out".

10.3386/w17713.abstractZh: 我们研究了孕妇在斋月期间进行日间禁食对其七岁孩子的测试成绩的影响。利用英语登记数据，我们发现，在孕早期经历斋月的巴基斯坦和孟加拉国学生，其测试成绩平均低了0.05到0.08个标准差。这些估计存在向下偏差，因为斋月并非在所有地区都受到普遍遵守。我们得出结论，产前投资对测试成绩的影响与许多传统教育干预措施相当，但可能更具成本效益，且不太容易出现“效果消退”的问题。

abstract.text: This paper uses historical census data from Burkina Faso to characterize local demographic pressures associated with internal migration into river valleys after Onchocerciasis eradication, combined with a new survey of village elders to document change over time and differences across villages in local public goods provision, market institutions and land use rights. We hypothesize that higher local population densities are associated with more public goods and a transition from open-access to regulated land use. Controlling for province or village fixed effects, we find that villages' variance in population associated with proximity to rivers is closely correlated with higher levels of infrastructure, markets and individual land rights, as opposed to familial or communal rights. Responding to population growth with both improved public services and private property rights is consistent with both scale effects in public good provision, and changes in the scarcity of land.

10.3386/w17718.abstractZh: 本文利用布基纳法索的历史人口普查数据，描述了在盘尾丝虫病根除后，当地人口向河谷地区迁移所带来的人口压力。同时，通过一项针对村长的调查，记录了随时间的变化以及不同村庄在公共物品提供、市场制度及土地使用权方面的差异。我们假设，较高的当地人口密度与更多的公共物品以及从开放获取转向受监管的土地使用有关。在控制省份或村庄固定效应后，我们发现，与河流距离相关的村庄人口差异与较高的基础设施水平、市场发展以及个人土地使用权密切相关，而家族或社区权利则相对较弱。通过改善公共服务和私有财产权来应对人口增长，这与公共物品提供的规模效应以及土地稀缺性的变化是一致的。

abstract.text: This paper develops a tractable econometric model of optimal migration, focusing on expected income as the main economic influence on migration. The model improves on previous work in two respects: it covers optimal sequences of location decisions (rather than a single once-for-all choice) and it allows for many alternative location choices. The model is estimated using panel data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth on white males with a high-school education. Our main conclusion is that interstate migration decisions are influenced to a substantial extent by income prospects. The results suggest that the link between income and migration decisions is driven both by geographic differences in mean wages and by a tendency to move in search of a better locational match when the income realization in the current location is unfavorable.

10.3982/ecta4657.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个可行的计量经济模型，用于研究最优迁移问题，重点关注预期收入作为影响迁移的主要经济因素。该模型在两个方面改进了以往的研究：它涵盖了最优的迁移决策序列（而非一次性选择），并且允许存在多种不同的迁移选择。模型采用全国青年纵向调查中的白人男性数据进行了估计。我们的主要结论是，州际迁移决策在很大程度上受到收入前景的影响。研究结果表明，收入与迁移决策之间的联系既受到地区间平均工资的差异影响，也受到当当前所在地收入不佳时，人们倾向于寻找更好的居住环境的动机驱动。

abstract.text: This paper introduces the model confidence set (MCS) and applies it to the selection of models. An MCS is a set of models that is constructed so that it will contain the best model with a given level of confidence. The MCS is in this sense analogous to a confidence interval for a parameter. The MCS acknowledges the limitations of the data; uninformative data yield an MCS with many models whereas informative data yield an MCS with only a few models. The MCS procedure does not assume that a particular model is the true model; in fact, the MCS procedure can be used to compare more general objects, beyond the comparison of models. We apply the MCS procedure to two empirical problems. First, we revisit the inflation forecasting problem posed by Stock and Watson (1999) and compute the MCS for their set of inflation forecasts. Second, we compare a number of Taylor rule regressions and determine the MCS of the best in terms of in-sample likelihood criteria.

10.3982/ecta5771.abstractZh: 本文介绍了模型置信集（MCS）的概念，并将其应用于模型选择。模型置信集是一组模型，其构建方式使得该集合包含具有给定置信度的最佳模型。从这个意义上说，模型置信集类似于参数的置信区间。模型置信集能够考虑到数据的局限性：无信息的数据会导致模型置信集包含许多模型，而信息丰富的数据则只会让模型置信集包含少数模型。模型置信集方法并不假设某个特定模型就是真实模型；实际上，该方法可用于比较更一般的对象，而不仅仅是模型之间的比较。我们将模型置信集方法应用于两个实证问题。首先，我们重新审视了Stock和Watson（1999）提出的通货膨胀预测问题，并计算了他们提供的通货膨胀预测数据的模型置信集。其次，我们比较了多个泰勒规则回归模型，并根据样本内似然准则确定了最佳模型的模型置信集。

abstract.text: Gul and Pesendorfer (2001) model the static behavior of an agent who ranks menus prior to the experience of temptation. This paper models the dynamic behavior of an agent whose ranking of menus itself is subject to temptation. The representation for the agent's dynamically inconsistent choice behavior views him as possessing a dynamically consistent view of what choices he “should” make (a normative preference) and being tempted by menus that contain tempting alternatives. Foundations for the model require a departure from Gul and Pesendorfer's idea that temptation creates a preference for commitment. Instead, it is hypothesized that distancing an agent from the consequences of his choices separates normative preference and temptation.

10.3982/ecta5800.abstractZh: Gul和Pesendorfer在2001年的研究中，模拟了一个在受到诱惑之前对菜单进行排名的静态行为主体。本文则模拟了一个其菜单排名本身会受到诱惑影响的动态行为主体。对于该主体动态不一致的选择行为，其模型假设该主体持有一种动态一致的“应该”选择标准（即规范偏好），同时受到包含诱人选项的菜单的诱惑。该模型的基础假设与Gul和Pesendorfer的观点不同，他们认为诱惑会引发对承诺的偏好。相反，本文假设将主体与其选择后果分离开来，可以区分规范偏好与诱惑。

abstract.text: The focus of the paper is the nonparametric estimation of an instrumental regression function P defined by conditional moment restrictions stemming from a structural econometric model : E[Y-P(Z)|W]=0 and involving endogenous variables Y and Z and instruments W. The function P is the solution of an ill-posed inverse problem and we propose an estimation procedure based on Tikhonov regularization. The paper analyses identification and overidentification of this model and presents asymptotic properties of the estimated nonparametric instrumental regression function.

10.3982/ecta6539.abstractZh: 本文的重点是采用非参数方法估计一种工具回归函数P，该函数由结构计量经济模型中的条件矩限制条件定义：E[Y-P(Z)|W]=0，涉及内生变量Y、Z和工具变量W。函数P是病态逆问题的解，我们提出了一种基于Tikhonov正则化的估计方法。本文还分析了该模型的识别问题及过度识别问题，并探讨了估计得到的非参数工具回归函数的渐近性质。

abstract.text: Golosov and Lucas recently argued that a menu-cost model, when made consistent with salient features of the microdata, predicts approximate monetary neutrality. I argue here that their model misses, in fact, two important features of the data. First, the distribution of the size of price changes in the data is very dispersed. Second, in the data many price changes are temporary. I study an extension of the simple menu-cost model to a multiproduct setting in which firms face economies of scope in adjusting posted and regular prices. The model, because of its ability to replicate this additional set of microeconomic facts, predicts real effects of monetary policy shocks that are much greater than those in Golosov and Lucas and nearly as large as those in the Calvo model. Although episodes of sales account for roughly 40% of all goods sold in retail stores, the model predicts that these episodes do not contribute much to the flexibility of the aggregate price level.

10.3982/ecta6735.abstractZh: Golosov和Lucas最近提出，当菜单成本模型与微观数据的显著特征保持一致时，可以预测出近似的货币中性效果。我在这里认为，他们的模型实际上忽略了数据的两个重要特征。首先，数据中价格变化幅度的分布非常分散。其次，数据中的许多价格变化都是暂时的。我研究了简单菜单成本模型的扩展版本，将其应用于多产品环境，在这种情况下，企业可以在调整公布价格和常规价格方面获得规模经济。由于该模型能够复制这一额外的微观经济事实，因此它能够预测出比Golosov和Lucas的模型更为显著的货币政策冲击的实际效果，其效果几乎与Calvo模型的结果相当。尽管销售事件约占零售商店所有商品销售的40%，但模型预测这些事件对整体价格水平的灵活性贡献不大。

abstract.text: This paper studies the nonparametric identification of a contract model with adverse selection and moral hazard. Specifically, we consider the false moral hazard model developed by Laffont and Tirole (1986). We first extend this model to allow for general random demand and cost functions. We establish the nonparametric identification of the demand, cost, deterministic transfer, and effort disutility functions as well as the joint distribution of the random elements of the model, which are the firm's type and the demand, cost, and transfer shocks. The cost of public funds is identified with the help of an instrument. Testable restrictions of the model are characterized.

10.3982/ecta6954.abstractZh: 本文研究了具有逆向选择和道德风险问题的契约模型的非参数识别问题。具体来说，我们考虑了Laffont和Tirole在1986年提出的虚假道德风险模型。我们首先将该模型扩展为允许一般性的随机需求和成本函数。我们建立了需求函数、成本函数、确定性转移函数以及努力厌恶函数的非参数识别方法，同时确定了模型中随机元素的联合分布，这些随机元素包括企业的类型以及需求和成本、转移冲击等。公共资金的成本通过一种工具得到了识别。本文还描述了模型的可检验限制条件。

abstract.text: We study testable implications for the dynamics of consumption and income of models in which first-best allocations are not achieved because of a moral hazard problem with hidden saving. We show that in this environment, agents typically achieve more insurance than that obtained under self-insurance with a single asset. Consumption allocations exhibit “excess smoothness,” as found and defined by Campbell and Deaton (1989). We argue that excess smoothness, in this context, is equivalent to a violation of the intertemporal budget constraint considered in a Bewley economy (with a single asset). We also show parameterizations of our model in which we can obtain a closed-form solution for the efficient insurance contract and where the excess smoothness parameter has a structural interpretation in terms of the severity of the moral hazard problem. We present tests of excess smoothness, applied to U.K. microdata and constructed using techniques proposed by Hansen, Roberds, and Sargent (1991) to test the intertemporal budget constraint. Our theoretical model leads us to interpret them as tests of the market structure faced by economic agents. We also construct a test based on the dynamics of the cross-sectional variances of consumption and income that is, in a precise sense, complementary to that based on Hansen, Roberds, and Sargent (1991) and that allows us to estimate the same structural parameter. The results we report are consistent with the implications of the model and are internally coherent.

10.3982/ecta7063.abstractZh: 我们研究了由于隐藏储蓄的道德风险问题导致最优分配未能实现的模型中，消费和收入动态的可检验影响。我们发现，在这种环境下，代理人通常获得的保险程度比使用单一资产进行自我保险时更高。消费分配表现出“过度平滑性”，这一点由Campbell和Deaton（1989年）发现并定义。我们认为，在这种背景下，过度平滑性等同于违反了Bewley经济模型中考虑的跨期预算约束（使用单一资产）。我们还展示了我们模型的参数化方案，在这些方案中，我们可以获得有效保险合同的封闭形式解，并且过度平滑性参数在道德风险问题的严重性方面具有结构上的解释。我们提出了对过度平滑性的检验，这些检验基于英国微观数据，并使用了Hansen、Roberds和Sargent（1991年）提出的用于检验跨期预算约束的技术。我们的理论模型使我们将这些检验解释为经济主体所面临的市场结构的检验。我们还构建了一个基于消费和收入横截面方差动态的检验方法，这种方法在精确意义上与Hansen、Roberds和Sargent（1991年）的方法相辅相成，并且允许我们估计相同的结构参数。我们报告的结果与模型的含义一致，并且内部是连贯的。

abstract.text: This paper uses a structural model to understand, predict, and evaluate the impact of an exogenous microcredit intervention program, the Thai Million Baht Village Fund program. We model household decisions in the face of borrowing constraints, income uncertainty, and high-yield indivisible investment opportunities. After estimation of parameters using pre-program data, we evaluate the model's ability to predict and interpret the impact of the village fund intervention. Simulations from the model mirror the data in yielding a greater increase in consumption than credit, which is interpreted as evidence of credit constraints. A cost-benefit analysis using the model indicates that some households value the program much more than its per household cost, but overall the program costs 20 percent more than the sum of these benefits.

10.3982/ecta7079.abstractZh: 本文采用结构模型来理解和评估一项外源性微型信贷干预计划——泰国百万泰铢乡村基金计划的影响。我们模拟了家庭在借贷限制、收入不确定性和高收益不可分割的投资机会面前的决策行为。在使用计划前的数据对参数进行估计后，我们评估了模型预测和解释乡村基金干预效果的能力。模型的模拟结果显示，消费的增加幅度大于信贷带来的增加幅度，这被解释为信贷约束的证据。使用模型进行的成本效益分析表明，一些家庭对该计划的价值远高于其每户成本，但总体而言，该计划的成本比这些收益的总和高出20%。

abstract.text: In this paper, we introduce the extended method of moments (XMM) estimator. This estimator accommodates a more general set of moment restrictions than the standard generalized method of moments (GMM) estimator. More specifically, the XMM differs from the GMM in that it can handle not only uniform conditional moment restrictions (i.e., valid for any value of the conditioning variable), but also local conditional moment restrictions valid for a given fixed value of the conditioning variable. The local conditional moment restrictions are of special relevance in derivative pricing to reconstruct the pricing operator on a given day by using the information in a few cross sections of observed traded derivative prices and a time series of underlying asset returns. The estimated derivative prices are consistent for a large time series dimension, but a fixed number of cross sectionally observed derivative prices. The asymptotic properties of the XMM estimator are nonstandard, since the combination of uniform and local conditional moment restrictions induces different rates of convergence (parametric and nonparametric) for the parameters.

10.3982/ecta7192.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们介绍了扩展的矩估计方法（XMM估计器）。该估计器所采用的矩限制条件比标准的广义矩估计方法更为广泛。具体来说，XMM与GMM的不同之处在于，它不仅能够处理统一的条件矩限制条件（即适用于任何条件变量的取值），还能处理在给定条件变量固定值下适用的局部条件矩限制条件。在衍生品定价中，局部条件矩限制条件尤为重要，它可以通过利用少数几个观测到的衍生品价格截面信息以及基础资产收益的时间序列数据，来重建特定日期的定价算子。对于较大的时间序列维度以及固定数量的截面观测衍生品价格，估计出的衍生品价格是一致的。XMM估计器的渐近性质是非标准的，因为统一条件矩限制条件与局部条件矩限制条件的结合，会导致参数的收敛速率（参数估计与非参数估计）有所不同。

abstract.text: This paper shows that the semiparametric efficiency bound for a parameter identified by an unconditional moment restriction with data missing at random (MAR) coincides with that of a particular augmented moment condition problem. The augmented system consists of the inverse probability weighted (IPW) original moment restriction and an additional conditional moment restriction which exhausts all other implications of the MAR assumption. The paper also investigates the value of additional semiparametric restrictions on the conditional expectation function (CEF) of the original moment function given always observed covariates. In the program evaluation context, for example, such restrictions are implied by semiparametric models for the potential outcome CEFs given baseline covariates. The efficiency bound associated with this model is shown to also coincide with that of a particular moment condition problem. Some implications of these results for estimation are briefly discussed.

10.3982/ecta7379.abstractZh: 本文表明，当数据具有随机缺失特性时，由无条件矩限制条件确定的参数的半参数效率界限与某个特定的增强矩条件问题的界限一致。该增强系统包括逆概率加权原始矩限制条件以及一个额外的条件矩限制条件，后者能够排除MAR假设的所有其他含义。本文还探讨了在始终观测到协变量的情况下，对原始矩函数的条件期望函数施加额外的半参数限制条件所带来的效果。例如，在程序评估的背景下，这样的限制条件是由潜在结果条件期望函数的半参数模型所隐含的。与该模型相关的效率界限也被证明与某个特定的矩条件问题的界限一致。本文简要讨论了这些结果对估计方法的一些启示。

abstract.text: This paper provides an empirical analysis of the effects of employer-provided health insurance, Medicare, and Social Security on retirement behavior. Using data from the Health and Retirement Study, we estimate a dynamic programming model of retirement that accounts for both saving and uncertain medical expenses. Our results suggest that Medicare is important for understanding retirement behavior, and that uncertainty and saving are both important for understanding the labor supply responses to Medicare. Half the value placed by a typical worker on his employer-provided health insurance is the value of reduced medical expense risk. Raising the Medicare eligibility age from 65 to 67 leads individuals to work an additional 0.074 years over ages 60–69. In comparison, eliminating 2 years worth of Social Security benefits increases years of work by 0.076 years.

10.3982/ecta7560.abstractZh: 本文对雇主提供的医疗保险、医疗保险制度以及社会保障对退休行为的影响进行了实证分析。利用“健康与退休研究”的数据，我们建立了一个动态规划模型来模拟退休行为，该模型同时考虑了储蓄和不确定的医疗费用。研究结果表明，医疗保险对于理解退休行为非常重要，而不确定性和储蓄同样对理解劳动力市场对医疗保险的反应至关重要。典型工人对雇主提供的医疗保险所赋予的价值，主要体现在减少医疗费用风险上。将医疗保险的资格年龄从65岁提高到67岁，会使60至69岁的人群额外工作0.074年。相比之下，取消2年的社会保障福利，会使工作年限增加0.076年。

abstract.text: This paper studies whether removing barriers to trade induces efficiency gains for producers. Like almost all empirical work which relies on a production function to recover productivity measures, I do not observe physical output at the firm level. Therefore, it is imperative to control for unobserved prices and demand shocks. I develop an empirical model that combines a demand system with a production function to generate estimates of productivity. I rely on my framework to identify the productivity effects from reduced trade protection in the Belgian textile market. This trade liberalization provides me with observed demand shifters that are used to separate out the associated price, scale, and productivity effects. Using a matched plant–product level data set and detailed quota data, I find that correcting for unobserved prices leads to substantially lower productivity gains. More specifically, abolishing all quota protections increases firm-level productivity by only 2 percent as opposed to 8 percent when relying on standard measures of productivity. My results beg for a serious reevaluation of a long list of empirical studies that document productivity responses to major industry shocks and, in particular, to opening up to trade. My findings imply the need to study the impact of changes in the operating environment on productivity together with market power and prices in one integrated framework. The suggested method and identification strategy are quite general and can be applied whenever it is important to distinguish between revenue productivity and physical productivity.

10.3982/ecta7617.abstractZh: 本文研究消除贸易壁垒是否能带来生产效率的提升。与几乎所有依赖生产函数来衡量生产力的实证研究一样，我并未观察到企业层面的实际产出。因此，控制未观测到的价格和需求冲击至关重要。我开发了一个实证模型，将需求系统与生产函数结合起来，以估算生产力。我利用该框架来识别比利时纺织市场因贸易保护减少而产生的生产力效应。这种贸易自由化为我提供了可观测的需求变化因素，从而能够分离出与价格、规模和生产率相关的效应。通过匹配工厂-产品层面的数据和详细的配额数据，我发现，在控制未观测到的价格因素后，生产力提升的幅度显著降低。更具体地说，废除所有配额保护后，企业层面的生产力仅提升了2%，而依赖标准生产力衡量方法时则提升了8%。我的研究结果促使人们重新评估大量实证研究，这些研究记录了生产力对重大行业冲击的响应，尤其是对贸易开放的反应。我的发现表明，需要在一个综合框架中研究运营环境变化对生产力的影响，以及市场力量和价格的影响。所提出的方法和识别策略具有通用性，可以在需要区分收入生产力和实际生产力的情况下应用。

abstract.text: This paper develops a tractable version of the Lucas and Prescott (1974) search model. Each of a continuum of industries produces a heterogeneous good using a production technology that is continually hit by idiosyncratic shocks. In response to adverse shocks, some workers search for new industries while others are rest unemployed, waiting for their industry's condition to improve. We obtain closed-form expressions for key aggregate variables and use them to evaluate the model's quantitative predictions for unemployment and wages. Both search and rest unemployment are important for understanding the behavior of wages at the industry level.

10.3982/ecta7686.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种可操作的Lucas和Prescott（1974）搜索模型的版本。一系列行业中，每个行业都使用一种不断受到特殊冲击的生产技术来生产异质性的产品。面对不利的冲击，一些工人会寻找新的行业，而另一些则处于闲置状态，等待所在行业的状况改善。我们获得了关键综合变量的封闭形式表达式，并利用这些表达式来评估模型对失业率和工资量的预测结果。无论是寻找新行业还是处于闲置状态，这两种失业形式对于理解行业层面工资的行为都非常重要。

abstract.text: The rollout of Wal-Mart store openings followed a pattern that radiated from the center outward, with Wal-Mart maintaining high store density and a contiguous store network all along the way. This paper estimates the benefits of such a strategy to Wal-Mart, focusing on the savings in distribution costs afforded by a dense network of stores. The paper takes a revealed preference approach, inferring the magnitude of density economies from how much sales cannibalization of closely packed stores Wal-Mart is willing to suffer to achieve density economies. The model is dynamic with rich geographic detail on the locations of stores and distribution centers. Given the enormous number of possible combinations of store-opening sequences, it is difficult to directly solve Wal-Mart's problem, making conventional approaches infeasible. The moment inequality approach is used instead and works well. The estimates show the benefits to Wal-Mart of high store density are substantial and likely extend significantly beyond savings in trucking costs.

10.3982/ecta7699.abstractZh: 沃尔玛门店的开设遵循了一种从中心向外辐射的模式，沃尔玛始终保持着较高的门店密度和连续的门店网络。本文评估了这种策略对沃尔玛的益处，重点在于密集的门店网络所带来的分销成本节约。研究采用了揭示性偏好方法，通过沃尔玛为追求密度经济而愿意承受的紧密布局门店之间的销售侵蚀程度，来推断密度经济的效果。该模型具有动态性，并详细描述了门店和配送中心的位置。鉴于门店开设顺序的极大可能性，直接解决沃尔玛的问题较为困难，因此传统方法难以实施。转而采用时刻不平等方法后，结果表现良好。估计结果显示，沃尔玛通过高门店密度获得的益处相当显著，且可能远远超出运输成本的节约。

abstract.text: This paper studies the design of optimal contracts in dynamic environments where agents have private information that is persistent.In particular, I focus on a continuous time version of a benchmark insurance problem where a risk averse agent would like to borrow from a risk neutral lender to stabilize his income stream.The income stream is private information to the borrower and is persistent.I find that the optimal contract conditions on the agent's reported endowment as well as two additional state variables: the agent's utility and marginal utility under the contract.I show how persistence alters the nature of the contract, and consider an exponential utility example which can be solved in closed form.Unlike the previous discrete time models with i.i.d.private information, the agent's consumption under the contract may grow over time.Furthermore, in my setting the efficiency losses due to private information increase with the persistence of the endowment, and the distortions vanish as I approximate an i.i.d.endowment.

10.3982/ecta7706.abstractZh: 本文研究了在动态环境中最优合约的设计问题，其中代理人拥有具有持久性的私人信息。具体而言，我关注了一个连续时间版本的基准保险问题，其中风险厌恶的代理人希望向风险中性的贷款人借款以稳定其收入流。该收入流是借款人的私人信息，并且具有持久性。我发现，最优合约条件要求代理人报告其资产状况，以及另外两个状态变量：代理人根据合约获得的效用和边际效用。我展示了持久性如何改变合约的性质，并考虑了一个可以用封闭形式求解的指数效用模型。与之前具有独立同分布私人信息的离散时间模型不同，代理人根据合约进行的消费可能会随时间增长。此外，在我的模型中，由于私人信息的存在，效率损失随着资产状况的持久性而增加，而当我近似使用独立同分布资产时，这些扭曲现象会消失。

abstract.text: We adapt the expectation–maximization algorithm to incorporate unobserved heterogeneity into conditional choice probability (CCP) estimators of dynamic discrete choice problems. The unobserved heterogeneity can be time-invariant or follow a Markov chain. By developing a class of problems where the difference in future value terms depends on a few conditional choice probabilities, we extend the class of dynamic optimization problems where CCP estimators provide a computationally cheap alternative to full solution methods. Monte Carlo results confirm that our algorithms perform quite well, both in terms of computational time and in the precision of the parameter estimates.

10.3982/ecta7743.abstractZh: 我们将期望最大化算法应用于动态离散选择问题的条件选择概率估计中，以纳入未观测到的异质性。这种未观测到的异质性可以是时间不变的，也可以遵循马尔可夫链。通过开发一类问题，其中未来价值项的变化取决于少数条件选择概率，我们扩展了动态优化问题的类别，使得条件选择概率估计成为计算上更为经济的替代方法。蒙特卡洛结果证实，我们的算法在计算时间和参数估计精度方面都表现相当良好。

abstract.text: This paper investigates an empirical puzzle in technology adoption for developing countries: the low adoption rates of technologies like hybrid maize that increase average farm profits dramatically. I offer a simple explanation for this: benefits and costs of technologies are heterogeneous, so that farmers with low net returns do not adopt the technology. I examine this hypothesis by estimating a correlated random coefficient model of yields and the corresponding distribution of returns to hybrid maize. This distribution indicates that the group of farmers with the highest estimated gross returns does not use hybrid, but their returns are correlated with high costs of acquiring the technology (due to poor infrastructure). Another group of farmers has lower returns and adopts, while the marginal farmers have zero returns and switch in and out of use over the sample period. Overall, adoption decisions appear to be rational and well explained by (observed and unobserved) variation in heterogeneous net benefits to the technology.

10.3982/ecta7749.abstractZh: 本文探讨了发展中国家在技术采用上的一个实证难题：像杂交玉米这样的技术虽然能显著提高平均农场利润，但采用率却很低。我提出了一种简单的解释：技术的收益与成本存在异质性，因此收益较低的农民不会采用该技术。我通过估计一个相关的随机系数模型来检验这一假设，该模型涉及杂交玉米的产量及其收益分布。该分布表明，收益最高的农民群体并未采用杂交玉米，而他们的收益与获取技术的成本较高有关（主要是由于基础设施落后）。另一组农民的收益较低，因此采用了杂交玉米；而边际农民则几乎没有收益，在样本期间会频繁更换技术使用方式。总体而言，技术采用决策似乎是理性的，并且可以通过技术带来的异质性净收益的变化来解释。

abstract.text: One of the most dramatic economic transformations of the past century has been the entry of women into the labor force. While many theories explain why this change took place, we investigate the process of transition itself. We argue that local information transmission generates changes in participation that are geographically heterogeneous, locally correlated, and smooth in the aggregate, just like those observed in our data. In our model, women learn about the effects of maternal employment on children by observing nearby employed women. When few women participate in the labor force, data are scarce and participation rises slowly. As information accumulates in some regions, the effects of maternal employment become less uncertain and more women in that region participate. Learning accelerates, labor force participation rises faster, and regional participation rates diverge. Eventually, information diffuses throughout the economy, beliefs converge to the truth, participation flattens out, and regions become more similar again. To investigate the empirical relevance of our theory, we use a new county-level data set to compare our calibrated model to the time series and geographic patterns of participation.

10.3982/ecta7767.abstractZh: 过去一个世纪中最引人注目的经济变革之一，就是女性进入劳动力市场的现象。虽然有许多理论解释了这一变化的原因，但我们本研究关注的是这一转变过程本身。我们认为，局部的信息传播导致了参与率的变化，这些变化在地理上呈现出异质性，在局部层面具有相关性，并且在总体上看是平滑的，这与我们数据中观察到的现象一致。在我们的模型中，女性通过观察附近的就业女性来了解母亲就业对孩子的影响。当参与劳动力市场的女性数量较少时，数据稀缺，参与率增长缓慢。随着某些地区信息的积累，母亲就业的影响变得不那么不确定，该地区的参与率就会上升。学习过程加速，劳动力参与率增长更快，地区间的参与率开始分化。最终，信息在整个经济中扩散，人们的观念趋于一致，参与率趋于平稳，各地区之间的差异再次缩小。为了验证我们理论的实证相关性，我们使用了一个新的县级数据集，将我们校准的模型与参与率的时间序列和地理模式进行比较。

abstract.text: The paper studies the asymptotic efficiency and robustness of hypothesis tests when models of interest are defined in terms of a weak convergence property. The null and local alternatives induce different limiting distributions for a random element, and a test is considered robust if it controls asymptotic size for all data generating processes for which the random element has the null limiting distribution. Under weak regularity conditions, asymptotically robust and efficient tests are then simply given by efficient tests of the limiting problem - that is, with the limiting random element assumed observed - evaluated at sample analogues. These tests typically coincide with suitably robustified versions of optimal tests in canonical parametric versions of the model. This paper thus establishes an alternative and broader sense of asymptotic efficiency for many previously derived tests in econometrics, such as tests for unit roots, parameter stability tests and tests about regression coefficients under weak instruments.

10.3982/ecta7793.abstractZh: 本文研究了当感兴趣的模型以弱收敛性质来定义时，假设检验的渐近效率性和稳健性。原假设和局部替代假设会为随机元素引入不同的极限分布，如果一个检验能够控制所有具有原假设极限分布的随机元素的渐近大小，那么该检验被认为是稳健的。在弱正则性条件下，渐近稳健且高效的检验可以简单地通过极限问题的高效检验来给出——即，假设极限随机元素被观测到，并在样本类比情况下进行评估。这些检验通常与模型典型参数版本中的最优检验的适当稳健化版本相一致。因此，本文为许多先前在计量经济学中推导出的检验建立了一种更广义的渐近效率性概念，例如用于单位根检验、参数稳定性检验以及在弱工具变量下的回归系数检验。

abstract.text: A finite number of sellers (n) compete in schedules to supply an elastic demand. The cost of each seller is random, with common and private value components, and the seller receives a private signal about it. A Bayesian supply function equilibrium is characterized: The equilibrium is privately revealing and the incentives to rely on private signals are preserved. Supply functions are steeper with higher correlation among the cost parameters. For high (positive) correlation, supply functions are downward sloping, price is above the Cournot level, and as we approach the common value case, price tends to the collusive level. As correlation becomes maximally negative, we approach the competitive outcome. With positive correlation, private information coupled with strategic behavior induces additional distortionary market power above full information levels. Efficiency can be restored with appropriate subsidy schemes or with a precise enough public signal about the common value component. As the market grows large with the number of sellers, the equilibrium becomes price-taking, bid shading is on the order of 1/n, and the order of magnitude of welfare losses is 1/n2. The results extend to inelastic demand, demand uncertainty, and demand schedule competition. A range of applications in product and financial markets is presented.

10.3982/ecta8126.abstractZh: 有限数量的卖家（n）在供应弹性需求的竞标中竞争。每个卖家的成本是随机的，包含公共价值和私人价值两部分，卖家还会收到关于成本的私人信号。贝叶斯供应函数均衡具有以下特点：均衡具有私人揭示性，依赖私人信号的激励得以保持。成本参数之间的相关性越高，供应函数越陡峭。在高度正相关的情况下，供应函数呈下降趋势，价格高于库尔诺水平；当接近公共价值时，价格趋向于共谋水平。当相关性变为最大负值时，接近竞争结果。在正相关情况下，私人信息与策略性行为共同导致市场力量超出完全信息情况下的水平。通过适当的补贴方案或关于公共价值成分的精确公共信号，可以恢复效率。随着市场规模的扩大和卖家数量的增加，均衡变为价格接受型，出价遮挡程度约为1/n，福利损失的数量级为1/n²。这些结果也适用于非弹性需求、需求不确定性以及需求计划竞争的情况。文中还提出了在产品和金融市场中的一系列应用。

abstract.text: This paper axiomatizes the robust control criterion of multiplier preferences introduced by Hansen and Sargent (2001). The axiomatization relates multiplier preferences to other classes of preferences studied in decision theory, in particular, the variational preferences recently introduced by Maccheroni, Marinacci, and Rustichini (2006a). This paper also establishes a link between the parameters of the multiplier criterion and the observable behavior of the agent. This link enables measurement of the parameters on the basis of observable choice data and provides a useful tool for applications.

10.3982/ecta8155.abstractZh: 本文对Hansen和Sargent（2001）提出的乘数偏好鲁棒控制准则进行了公理化描述。该公理化将乘数偏好与决策理论中研究的其他偏好类别联系起来，特别是Maccheroni、Marinacci和Rustichini（2006a）最近提出的变分偏好。本文还建立了乘数准则参数与代理人可观测行为之间的联系。这种联系使得基于可观测选择数据来测量参数成为可能，并为实际应用提供了有用的工具。

abstract.text: We show that democratic change may be triggered by transitory economic shocks. Our approach uses within-country variation in rainfall as a source of transitory shocks to sub-Saharan African economies. We find that negative rainfall shocks are followed by significant improvement in democratic institutions. This result is consistent with the economic approach to political transitions, where transitory negative shocks can open a window of opportunity for democratic improvement. Instrumental variables estimates indicate that following a transitory negative income shock of 1 percent, democracy scores improve by 0.9 percentage points and the probability of a democratic transition increases by 1.3 percentage points.

10.3982/ecta8183.abstractZh: 我们表明，民主变革可能由短暂的经济冲击引发。我们的研究方法以国内降雨量的差异作为对撒哈拉以南非洲经济体造成短暂冲击的源头。我们发现，负面降雨冲击之后，民主制度会显著改善。这一结果与政治转型的经济学理论一致，即短暂的负面冲击可以为民主制度的改进创造机会。工具变量估计表明，在经历1%的短暂负面收入冲击后，民主指数会提升0.9个百分点，民主转型的概率也会增加1.3个百分点。

abstract.text: We study the evolution of market-oriented policies over time and across countries. We consider a model in which own and neighbors' past experiences influence policy choices through their effect on policymakers' beliefs. We estimate the model using a large panel of countries and find that it fits a large fraction of the policy choices observed in the postwar data, including the slow adoption of liberal policies. Our model also predicts that there would be reversals to state intervention if nowadays the world was hit by a shock of the size of the Great Depression.

10.3982/ecta8299.abstractZh: 我们研究了市场导向政策随时间以及在不同国家间的演变情况。我们考虑了一个模型，在该模型中，个人及其邻国的过往经历通过影响政策制定者的信念来影响政策选择。我们使用大量国家的数据对模型进行了估计，发现该模型能够很好地解释战后数据中观察到的绝大多数政策选择，包括自由化政策的缓慢采纳。我们的模型还预测，如果当今世界遭遇了与大萧条规模相当的冲击，国家干预的政策方向可能会发生逆转。

abstract.text: We examine the sales of French manufacturing firms in 113 destinations, including France itself. Several regularities stand out: (i) the number of French firms selling to a market, relative to French market share, increases systematically with market size; (ii) sales distributions are similar across markets of very different size and extent of French participation; (iii) average sales in France rise systematically with selling to less popular markets and to more markets. We adopt a model of firm heterogeneity and export participation which we estimate to match moments of the French data using the method of simulated moments. The results imply that over half the variation across firms in market entry can be attributed to a single dimension of underlying firm heterogeneity: efficiency. Conditional on entry, underlying efficiency accounts for much less of the variation in sales in any given market. We use our results to simulate the effects of a 10 percent counterfactual decline in bilateral trade barriers on French firms. While total French sales rise by around $16 billion (U.S.), sales by the top decile of firms rise by nearly $23 billion (U.S.). Every lower decile experiences a drop in sales, due to selling less at home or exiting altogether.

10.3982/ecta8318.abstractZh: 我们研究了在113个目的地中，包括法国本土的法国制造企业的销售情况。有几个规律值得注意：(i) 相对于法国市场份额而言，向某个市场销售的法国企业数量随着市场规模的扩大而系统性增加；(ii) 在不同规模和法国参与程度不同的市场中，销售分布相似；(iii) 在法国，向不太受欢迎的市场以及更多市场销售的均值系统性上升。我们采用了一个企业异质性和出口参与度的模型，并使用模拟矩方法估计该模型以匹配法国数据的各阶矩。结果表明，企业进入市场的差异中，超过一半可以归因于企业异质性的单一维度：效率。在进入市场的条件下，基础效率对任何给定市场的销售变化的影响要小得多。我们利用这些结果来模拟双边贸易壁垒下降10%对法国企业的影响。虽然法国企业的总销售额增加了约160亿美元，但排名前10%的企业销售额增加了近230亿美元。而排名较低的所有企业则因在本国销售减少或完全退出市场而导致销售额下降。

abstract.text: The standard gravity model predicts that trade flows increase in proportion to importer and exporter total income, regardless of how income is divided into income per capita and population. Bilateral trade data, however, show that trade grows strongly with income per capita and is largely unresponsive to population. I develop a general equilibrium Ricardian model of trade that allows the elasticity of trade with respect to income per capita and with respect to population to diverge. Goods are of various types, which differ in their income elasticity of demand and in the extent to which there is heterogeneity in their production technologies. I estimate the model using bilateral trade data of 162 countries and compare it to a special case that delivers the gravity equation. The general model improves the restricted model's predictions regarding variations in trade due to size and income. I experiment with counterfactuals. A positive technology shock in China makes poor and rich countries better off and middle-income countries worse off.

10.3982/ecta8346.abstractZh: 标准引力模型预测，贸易流量与进口国和出口国的总收入成正比增长，而无论收入如何分配到人均收入和人口上。然而，双边贸易数据表明，贸易随着人均收入的增加而显著增长，而对人口变化的反应却不大。我构建了一个一般均衡的李嘉图贸易模型，该模型允许贸易对人均收入和人口变化的弹性有所不同。商品分为不同类型，它们在需求收入弹性以及生产技术异质性方面存在差异。我使用162个国家的双边贸易数据对该模型进行了估计，并将其与引力方程的特殊情况进行了比较。该一般模型改进了受限模型对于因规模和收入变化导致的贸易变化的预测能力。我还通过反事实实验进行了验证。在中国出现积极的技术冲击时，贫穷国家和富裕国家的状况会改善，而中等收入国家的状况则会恶化。

abstract.text: We study the dynamics of the distribution of wealth in an overlapping generation economy with finitely lived agents and intergenerational transmission of wealth. Financial markets are incomplete, exposing agents to both labor and capital income risk. We show that the stationary wealth distribution is a Pareto distribution in the right tail and that it is capital income risk, rather than labor income, that drives the properties of the right tail of the wealth distribution. We also study analytically the dependence of the distribution of wealth-of wealth inequality in particular-on various fiscal policy instruments like capital income taxes and estate taxes, and on different degrees of social mobility. We show that capital income and estate taxes can significantly reduce wealth inequality, as do institutions favoring social mobility. Finally, we calibrate the economy to match the Lorenz curve of the wealth distribution of the U.S. economy.

10.3982/ecta8416.abstractZh: 我们研究了在有限寿命的代理人以及代际财富传递的重叠代际经济中，财富分布动态的变化。金融市场是不完整的，这使得代理人面临劳动收入和资本收入的风险。我们证明，稳态财富分布在右尾部是一个帕累托分布，并且是资本收入风险而非劳动收入决定了财富分布右尾的特性。我们还从分析角度研究了财富分布与财富不平等之间的依赖关系，特别是与各种财政政策工具（如资本所得税和遗产税）以及不同的社会流动性程度之间的关系。我们发现，资本所得税和遗产税可以显著减少财富不平等，同样，有利于社会流动性的制度也能起到类似的作用。最后，我们调整了经济模型，使其与美国经济的财富分布洛伦兹曲线相匹配。

abstract.text: Repeated games with imperfect private monitoring have a wide range of applications, but a complete characterization of all equilibria in this class of games has yet to be obtained. The existing literature has identified a relatively tractable subset of equilibria. The present paper introduces the notion of weakly belief-free equilibria for repeated games with imperfect private monitoring. This is a tractable class which subsumes, as a special case, a major part of the existing literature (the belief-free equilibria). It is shown that this class can outperform the equilibria identified by the previous work.

10.3982/ecta8480.abstractZh: 具有不完美私人监控的重复博弈具有广泛的应用前景，但迄今为止尚未能够完全描述这类博弈中的所有均衡。现有文献已经识别出一组相对容易处理的均衡。本文介绍了具有不完美私人监控的重复博弈中弱信念自由均衡的概念。这是一个易于处理的类别，它作为一个特例包含了现有文献中大部分关于信念自由均衡的研究内容。研究表明，这类均衡的性能优于之前研究所确定的均衡。

abstract.text: It is common for a majority of people to rank themselves as better than average on simple tasks and worse than average on difficult tasks. The literature takes for granted that this apparent misconfidence is problematic. We argue, however, that this behavior is consistent with purely rational Bayesian updaters. In fact, better-than-average data alone cannot be used to show overconfidence; we indicate which type of data can be used. Our theory is consistent with empirical patterns found in the literature.

10.3982/ecta8583.abstractZh: 大多数人通常认为自己在简单任务上的表现优于平均水平，而在困难任务上的表现则低于平均水平。相关文献普遍认为这种表面上的低估是有问题的。然而，我们认为这种行为与纯粹的理性贝叶斯更新模型是一致的。事实上，仅凭优于平均水平的数据并不能证明过度自信的存在；我们指出了可以使用哪些类型的数据。我们的理论与文献中发现的实证模式是一致的。

abstract.text: Rational herd behaviour and informationally efficient security prices have long been considered to be mutually exclusive but for exceptional cases. In this paper we describe the conditions on the underlying information structure that are necessary and sufficient for informational herding and contrarianism. In a standard sequential security trading model, subject to sufficient noise trading, people herd if and only if, loosely, their information is sufficiently dispersed so that they consider extreme outcomes more likely than moderate ones. Likewise, people act as contrarians if and only if their information leads them to concentrate on middle values. Both herding and contrarianism generate more volatile prices, and they lower liquidity. They are also resilient phenomena, although by themselves herding trades are self enforcing whereas contrarian trades are self-defeating. We complete the characterization by providing conditions for the absence of herding and contrarianism.

10.3982/ecta8602.abstractZh: 理性群体行为和信息效率高的证券价格长期以来被认为相互排斥，但存在例外情况。在本文中，我们描述了基础信息结构所需满足的条件，这些条件对于信息群体行为与逆向行为来说既是必要的也是充分的。在一个标准的序列证券交易模型中，在足够的噪声交易条件下，人们会形成群体行为，当且仅当他们的信息足够分散，使得他们认为极端结果比中等结果更有可能发生时。同样，人们会表现出逆向行为，当且仅当他们的信息使他们倾向于关注中间值。群体行为与逆向行为都会产生更不稳定的价格，并且会降低流动性。这两种现象都是具有弹性的，尽管群体行为本身是自我维持的，而逆向行为则是自我挫败的。我们通过提供缺乏群体行为与逆向行为的条件来完善这一描述。

abstract.text: Instrumental variables are widely used in applied econometrics to achieve identification and carry out estimation and inference in models that contain endogenous explanatory variables. In most applications, the function of interest (e.g., an Engel curve or demand function) is assumed to be known up to finitely many parameters (e.g., a linear model), and instrumental variables are used identify and estimate these parameters. However, linear and other finite-dimensional parametric models make strong assumptions about the population being modeled that are rarely if ever justified by economic theory or other a priori reasoning and can lead to seriously erroneous conclusions if they are incorrect. This paper explores what can be learned when the function of interest is identified through an instrumental variable but is not assumed to be known up to finitely many parameters. The paper explains the differences between parametric and nonparametric estimators that are important for applied research, describes an easily implemented nonparametric instrumental variables estimator, and presents empirical examples in which nonparametric methods lead to substantive conclusions that are quite different from those obtained using standard, parametric estimators.

10.3982/ecta8662.abstractZh: 在应用计量经济学中，工具变量被广泛用于实现模型识别以及进行包含内生解释变量的模型的估计和推断。在大多数应用中，所关注的函数（例如，恩格尔曲线或需求函数）被假设为已知，至多只有有限多个参数（例如，线性模型），而工具变量则用于识别并估计这些参数。然而，线性模型和其他有限维参数模型对被建模的总体做出了强烈的假设，这些假设很少或根本无法得到经济理论或其他先验推理的支持，如果这些假设不正确，可能会导致严重的错误结论。本文探讨了当所关注的函数通过工具变量被识别出来，但并未假设其已知至多有限多个参数时，可以从中获得哪些信息。文章解释了参数估计量与非参数估计量之间的区别，这些区别对于应用研究非常重要，描述了一种易于实施的非参数工具变量估计方法，并提供了实证例子，说明非参数方法得出的结论与使用标准参数估计量得出的结论有很大不同。

abstract.text: A seller can trade an endowment of a perfectly divisible good, the quality of which she privately knows. Buyers compete by offering menus of nonexclusive contracts, so that the seller can privately trade with several buyers. In this setting, we show that an equilibrium exists under mild conditions and that aggregate equilibrium allocations are generically unique. Although the good for sale is divisible, in equilibrium the seller ends up trading her whole endowment or not trading at all. Trades take place at a price equal to the expected quality of the good, conditional on the seller being ready to trade at that price. Our model thus provides a novel strategic foundation for Akerlof's (1970) results. It also contrasts with competitive screening models in which contracts are assumed to be exclusive, as in Rothschild and Stiglitz (1976). Latent contracts that are issued but not traded in equilibrium play an important role in our analysis.

10.3982/ecta8665.abstractZh: 卖家可以交易一种完全可分割的商品，她私下了解该商品的质量。买家通过提供非独占性合同来竞争，这样卖家就可以与多个买家进行私下交易。在这种情况下，我们证明了在温和条件下存在一个均衡，并且总体均衡分配通常是唯一的。尽管待售商品是可分割的，但在均衡状态下，卖家最终要么交易其全部资产，要么根本不进行交易。交易的价格等于商品预期质量，前提是卖家愿意以该价格进行交易。因此，我们的模型为Akerlof（1970）的研究成果提供了一个新的战略基础。这与竞争筛选模型不同，在竞争筛选模型中，合同被假设为独占性合同，如Rothschild和Stiglitz（1976）所提出的模型。在均衡状态下，虽然合同已经签订但尚未交易的情况在我们的分析中起着重要作用。

abstract.text: We provide a tractable characterization of the sharp identi…cation region of the parameters in a broad class of incomplete econometric models.Models in this class have set valued predictions that yield a convex set of conditional or unconditional moments for the observable model variables.In short, we call these models with convex moment predictions.Examples include static, simultaneous move …nite games of complete and incomplete information in the presence of multiple equilibria; best linear predictors with interval outcome and covariate data; and random utility models of multinomial choice in the presence of interval regressors data.Given a candidate value for ; we establish that the convex set of moments yielded by the model predictions can be represented as the Aumann expectation of a properly de…ned random set.The sharp identi…cation region of ; denoted I ; can then be obtained as the set of minimizers of the distance from a properly speci…ed vector of moments of random variables to this Aumann expectation.Algorithms in convex programming can be exploited to e¢ ciently verify whether a candidate is in I : We use examples analyzed in the literature to illustrate the gains in identi…cation and computational tractability a¤orded by our method.

10.3982/ecta8680.abstractZh: 我们为一系列不完备计量经济模型中的参数提供了一种可行的特征描述方法。这类模型具有设定值的预测结果，这些预测结果会为可观测模型变量产生一个凸集的条件或无条件矩。简而言之，我们将这类模型称为具有凸矩预测的模型。例如，在存在多个均衡情况下的静态、同时移动的多人完全信息不完全信息博弈；具有区间结果和协变量数据的线性最优预测器；以及在存在区间回归数据的多项选择随机效用模型。给定某个候选值，我们可以证明模型预测产生的凸集矩可以表示为一个适当定义的随机集合的Aumann期望。该凸集的精确识别区域，记为I，可以定义为随机变量的一组适当指定的矩向量与这个Aumann期望之间的距离的最小化集合。可以利用凸规划算法来高效地验证某个候选值是否属于I。我们通过文献中分析的例子来说明我们的方法在识别性和计算可行性方面的优势。

abstract.text: This paper proposes that idiosyncratic firm-level shocks can explain an important part of aggregate movements and provide a microfoundation for aggregate shocks. Existing research has focused on using aggregate shocks to explain business cycles, arguing that individual firm shocks average out in the aggregate. I show that this argument breaks down if the distribution of firm sizes is fat-tailed, as documented empirically. The idiosyncratic movements of the largest 100 firms in the United States appear to explain about one-third of variations in output growth. This “granular” hypothesis suggests new directions for macroeconomic research, in particular that macroeconomic questions can be clarified by looking at the behavior of large firms. This paper's ideas and analytical results may also be useful for thinking about the fluctuations of other economic aggregates, such as exports or the trade balance.

10.3982/ecta8769.abstractZh: 本文提出，企业层面的特异性冲击可以解释总体变动的重要部分，并为总体冲击提供微观基础。现有研究倾向于使用总体冲击来解释商业周期，认为个体企业的冲击在总体中会平均化。然而，我指出，如果企业规模的分布具有厚尾特性，那么这一论点就不成立，这一点从实证数据中可以证实。美国前100家最大企业的特异性变动似乎可以解释产出增长变化的三分之一左右。这一“颗粒化”假设为宏观经济研究提供了新的方向，特别是通过研究大型企业的行为来阐明宏观经济问题。本文的观点和分析结果也可能有助于思考其他经济总量的波动，例如出口或贸易平衡。

abstract.text: The increase in female employment and participation rates is one of the most dramatic economic changes to have taken place during the last century. However, while the employment rate of married women more than doubled during the last fifty years, that of unmarried women remained almost constant. In order to empirically analyze these trends we divide the paper into two parts: In the first, we empirically estimate a traditional female dynamic labor supply model using an extended version of Eckstein and Wolpin (1989) in order to compare the various explanations in the literature for the observed trends. The main finding is that the rise in education levels accounts for about one-third of the increase in female employment while about 40 percent remains unexplained by observed household characteristics. We show that this unexplained portion can be empirically attributed to changes in preferences or the costs of childrearing and household maintenance. In the second part, we formulate and estimate a new framework for the couple intra-family game that is then used to analyze the household dynamic labor supply. We find that female labor supply may have increased significantly due to a change in the form of the household game.

10.3982/ecta8803.abstractZh: 女性就业率和参与率的上升是过去一个世纪中最显著的经济变化之一。然而，在过去的五十年里，已婚女性的就业率翻了一番多，而未婚女性的就业率则几乎保持不变。为了对这些趋势进行实证分析，我们将论文分为两部分：第一部分，我们使用Eckstein和Wolpin（1989）的扩展版本，对传统的女性劳动供给模型进行实证估计，以比较文献中对于这些趋势的各种解释。主要发现是，教育水平的提高解释了女性就业增加约三分之一的原因，而约40%的原因仍然无法用观察到的家庭特征来解释。我们表明，这部分无法解释的原因可以归因于偏好变化或抚养孩子和维持家庭生活的成本变化。第二部分，我们构建并估计了一个新的家庭内部博弈框架，然后用该框架来分析家庭劳动供给的动态变化。我们发现，由于家庭博弈形式的变化，女性劳动供给可能显著增加。

abstract.text: The coefficient of relative risk aversion is a key parameter for analyses of behavior toward risk, but good estimates of this parameter do not exist. A promising place for reliable estimation is rare macroeconomic disasters, which have a major influence on the equity premium. The premium depends on the probability and size distribution of disasters, gauged by proportionate declines in per capita consumption or gross domestic product. Long-term national-accounts data for 36 countries provide a large sample of disasters of magnitude 10% or more. A power-law density provides a good fit to the size distribution, and the upper-tail exponent, α, is estimated to be around 4. A higher α signifies a thinner tail and, therefore, a lower equity premium, whereas a higher coefficient of relative risk aversion, γ, implies a higher premium. The premium is finite if α > γ. The observed premium of 5% generates an estimated γ close to 3, with a 95% confidence interval of 2 to 4. The results are robust to uncertainty about the values of the disaster probability and the equity premium, and can accommodate seemingly paradoxical situations in which the equity premium may appear to be infinite.

10.3982/ecta8827.abstractZh: 相对风险厌恶系数是对风险行为分析的关键参数，但目前尚不存在可靠的该参数估计方法。一个值得信赖的估计对象是罕见的宏观经济灾难，因为这些事件对股权溢价有着重大影响。股权溢价取决于灾难发生的概率和规模分布，这可以通过人均消费或国内生产总值的相应下降来衡量。对36个国家的长期国民账户数据进行分析，发现存在大量规模达到10%或以上的灾难事件。幂律密度模型能够很好地描述这些灾难的规模分布，其上尾指数α估计值约为4。较高的α意味着尾部较薄，因此股权溢价较低；而较高的相对风险厌恶系数γ则意味着股权溢价较高。当α大于γ时，股权溢价是有限值的。观察到的5%股权溢价对应的γ值约为3，95%置信区间在2到4之间。这些结果在灾难发生概率和股权溢价存在不确定性时依然具有稳健性，并且能够解释那些看似矛盾的情况，即股权溢价可能看似无限。

abstract.text: We study the e¤ects of deliberation on collective decisions. In a series of experiments, we vary groups’preference distributions (between common and con‡icting interests) and the institutions by which decisions are reached (simple majority, two-thirds majority, and unanimity). Without deliberation, di¤erent institutions generate signi…cantly di¤erent outcomes, tracking the theoretical comparative statics. Deliberation, however, signi…cantly diminishes institutional di¤erences and uniformly improves e ¢ ciency. Furthermore, communication protocols exhibit an array of stable attributes: messages are public, consistently reveal private information, provide a good predictor for ultimate group choices, and follow particular (endogenous) sequencing.

10.3982/ecta8852.abstractZh: 我们研究了审议对集体决策的影响。在一系列实验中，我们改变了群体的偏好分布（在共同利益与冲突利益之间）以及决策达成的方式（简单多数、三分之二多数和一致同意）。在没有审议的情况下，不同的制度会产生显著不同的结果，这与理论上的比较静态分析相符。然而，审议显著减少了制度差异，并统一提高了决策效率。此外，通信协议表现出一系列稳定的特性：消息是公开的，能够一致地揭示私人信息，为最终群体的选择提供了良好的预测指标，并且遵循特定的（内生性）排序规则。

abstract.text: This paper examines repeated implementation of a social choice function (SCF) with infinitely lived agents whose preferences are determined randomly in each period. An SCF is repeatedly implementable in Nash equilibrium if there exists a sequence of (possibly history-dependent) mechanisms such that its Nash equilibrium set is nonempty and every equilibrium outcome path results in the desired social choice at every possible history of past play and realizations of uncertainty. We show, with minor qualifications, that in the complete information environment an SCF is repeatedly implementable in Nash equilibrium if and only if it is efficient. We also discuss several extensions of our analysis.

10.3982/ecta8859.abstractZh: 本文研究了在无限寿命的代理人中反复实施社会选择函数的情况，这些代理人的偏好在每个时期都是随机确定的。如果存在一系列（可能依赖于历史的）机制，使得社会选择函数的纳什均衡集非空，并且每个均衡结果路径都能在可能的历史条件下实现期望的社会选择，那么社会选择函数就可以在纳什均衡中反复实施。我们指出，在完全信息环境下，社会选择函数能够在纳什均衡中反复实施，当且仅当它是有效的。我们还讨论了我们分析结果的几种扩展。

abstract.text: This paper studies dynamic identification of parameters of a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model from the first and second moments of the data. Classical results for dynamic simultaneous equations do not apply because the state space solution of the model does not constitute a standard reduced form. Full rank of the Jacobian matrix of derivatives of the solution parameters with respect to the parameters of interest is necessary but not sufficient for identification. We use restrictions implied by observational equivalence to obtain two sets of rank and order conditions: one for stochastically singular models and another for nonsingular models. Measurement errors, mean, long-run, and a priori restrictions can be accommodated. An example is considered to illustrate the results.

10.3982/ecta8916.abstractZh: 本文研究了从数据的第一和第二时刻动态识别动态随机一般均衡模型的参数问题。由于模型的状态空间解并不构成标准简化形式，因此传统的动态联立方程理论并不适用。对于参数识别而言，解参数对感兴趣参数的导数雅可比矩阵的满秩是必要条件，但不是充分条件。我们利用观测等价性所蕴含的限制，得到了两组秩和顺序条件：一组适用于随机奇异模型，另一组适用于非奇异模型。测量误差、均值、长期效应以及先验限制都可以被纳入考虑范围。文中通过一个例子来说明研究结果。

abstract.text: We generalize Athey's (2001) and McAdams' (2003) results on the existence of monotone pure-strategy equilibria in Bayesian games. We allow action spaces to be compact locally complete metric semilattices and type spaces to be partially ordered probability spaces. Our proof is based on contractibility rather than convexity of best-reply sets. Several examples illustrate the scope of the result, including new applications to multi-unit auctions with risk-averse bidders.

10.3982/ecta8934.abstractZh: 我们将Athey（2001年）和McAdams（2003年）关于贝叶斯博弈中单调纯策略均衡存在性的研究结果进行了推广。我们允许行动空间是局部完备的紧凑度量半格，而类型空间则是部分有序的概率空间。我们的证明基于最佳回应集合的可缩性，而非凸性。通过几个例子说明了该结果的适用范围，包括对具有风险厌恶投标者的多单元拍卖的新应用。

abstract.text: We provide a pure Nash equilibrium existence theorem for games with discontinuous payoffs whose hypotheses are in a number of ways weaker than those of the theorem of Reny (1999). In comparison with Reny's argument, our proof is brief. Our result subsumes a prior existence result of Reny (1999) that is not covered by his theorem. We use the main result to prove the existence of pure Nash equilibrium in a class of finite games in which agents' pure strategies are subsets of a given set, and in turn use this to prove the existence of stable configurations for games, similar to those used by Schelling (1971, 1972) to study residential segregation, in which agents choose locations.

10.3982/ecta8949.abstractZh: 我们为具有不连续收益的博弈提供了一个纯纳什均衡存在性定理，其假设在多个方面都弱于Reny（1999年）的定理。与Reny的论证相比，我们的证明更为简洁。我们的结果包含了Reny（1999年）先前的一个存在性结果，而该结果并未被他的定理所涵盖。我们利用这一主要结果来证明一类有限博弈中纯纳什均衡的存在性，这类博弈中代理人的纯策略是给定集合的子集；进而，我们利用这一结果来证明稳定配置的存在性，类似于Schelling（1971年、1972年）在研究居民隔离问题时所使用的策略，即代理人选择位置的情况。

abstract.text: The majority of labor transactions throughout much of history and a significant fraction of such transactions in many developing countries today are “coercive,” in the sense that force or the threat of force plays a central role in convincing workers to accept employment or its terms. We propose a tractable principal–agent model of coercion, based on the idea that coercive activities by employers, or “guns,” affect the participation constraint of workers. We show that coercion and effort are complements, so that coercion increases effort, but coercion always reduces utilitarian social welfare. Better outside options for workers reduce coercion because of the complementarity between coercion and effort: workers with a better outside option exert lower effort in equilibrium and thus are coerced less. Greater demand for labor increases coercion because it increases equilibrium effort. We investigate the interaction between outside options, market prices, and other economic variables by embedding the (coercive) principal–agent relationship in a general equilibrium setup, and studying when and how labor scarcity encourages coercion. General (market) equilibrium interactions working through the price of output lead to a positive relationship between labor scarcity and coercion along the lines of ideas suggested by Domar, while interactions those working through the outside option lead to a negative relationship similar to ideas advanced in neo-Malthusian historical analyses of the decline of feudalism. In net, a decline in available labor increases coercion in general equilibrium if and only if its direct (partial equilibrium) effect is to increase the price of output by more than it increases outside options. Our model also suggests that markets in slaves make slaves worse off, conditional on enslavement, and that coercion is more viable in industries that do not require relationship-specific investment by workers.

10.3982/ecta8963.abstractZh: 在历史上大部分时期，以及许多发展中国家当前的情况中，绝大多数劳动交易都是“强制性的”，即力量或威胁力量在说服工人接受就业或其条款时起着核心作用。我们提出了一个可行的强制主体-代理人模型，该模型基于这样一个观点：雇主的强制行为，即“武力”，会影响工人的参与约束。我们表明，强制和努力是互补的，因此强制会增加努力，但强制总是会降低功利性社会福利。对于工人来说，更好的外部选择可以减少强制，因为强制和努力之间存在互补性：拥有更好外部选择的工人在均衡状态下付出的努力较少，因此受到的强制也较少。对劳动力的需求增加会加剧强制，因为它会增加均衡努力。我们通过将（强制性的）主体-代理人关系嵌入到一般均衡框架中，研究外部选择、市场价格和其他经济变量之间的相互作用，以及劳动力短缺如何促进强制。通过输出价格进行的一般市场均衡相互作用导致劳动力短缺与强制之间存在正相关关系，这与Domar提出的观点一致；而通过外部选择进行的相互作用则导致负相关关系，这与新马尔萨斯主义历史分析中对封建制度衰落的研究观点相似。总的来说，如果可用劳动力的减少直接（局部均衡）效应使得输出价格的增加幅度超过外部选择带来的增加幅度，那么劳动力短缺通常会增加强制。我们的模型还表明，在奴役的条件下，奴隶市场会使奴隶的处境恶化，而在不需要工人进行特定关系投资行业中，强制手段更为可行。

abstract.text: We present an algorithm to compute the set of perfect public equilibrium payoffs as the discount factor tends to 1 for stochastic games with observable states and public (but not necessarily perfect) monitoring when the limiting set of (long-run players') equilibrium payoffs is independent of the initial state. This is the case, for instance, if the Markov chain induced by any Markov strategy profile is irreducible. We then provide conditions under which a folk theorem obtains: if in each state the joint distribution over the public signal and next period's state satisfies some rank condition, every feasible payoff vector above the minmax payoff is sustained by a perfect public equilibrium with low discounting.

10.3982/ecta9004.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种算法，用于计算在可观测状态且存在公共（但不一定完美）监控的随机博弈中，当长期玩家的均衡支付集合与初始状态无关时，完美公共均衡支付集合的演变情况。这种情况发生在由任意马尔可夫策略组合所诱导的马尔可夫链是不可约的情况下。接着，我们提出了一种条件，在该条件下可以得到一个“民间定理”：如果在每个状态下，公共信号与下一期状态的联合分布满足某种秩条件，那么每一个高于最小最大支付量的可行支付向量都可以通过低折扣率的完美公共均衡得到维持。

abstract.text: Postel-Vinay and Robin's (2002) sequential auction model is extended to allow for aggregate productivity shocks. Workers exhibit permanent differences in ability while firms are identical. Negative aggregate productivity shocks induce job destruction by driving the surplus of matches with low ability workers to negative values. Endogenous job destruction coupled with worker heterogeneity thus provides a mechanism for amplifying productivity shocks that offers an original solution to the unemployment volatility puzzle (Shimer (2005)). Moreover, positive or negative shocks may lead employers and employees to renegotiate low wages up and high wages down when agents' individual surpluses become negative. The model delivers rich business cycle dynamics of wage distributions and explains why both low wages and high wages are more procyclical than wages in the middle of the distribution.

10.3982/ecta9070.abstractZh: Postel-Vinay和Robin在2002年提出的序贯拍卖模型被扩展以考虑总体生产率冲击。工人表现出持久的能力差异，而企业则具有同质性。总体生产率负冲击会导致岗位流失，因为与能力较低的工人匹配的剩余机会成本变为负值。这种内生性岗位流失现象加上工人的异质性，为放大生产率冲击提供了机制，为失业波动之谜提供了原创性解决方案（Shimer, 2005）。此外，无论是正面还是负面的冲击，都可能导致雇主和雇员重新协商低工资或高工资，当个体剩余机会成本变为负值时尤其如此。该模型揭示了工资分布的丰富商业周期动态，并解释了为什么低工资和高工资都比分布中间的工资更具顺周期性。

abstract.text: This paper studies the special case of the triangular system of equations in Vytlacil and Yildiz (2007), where both dependent variables are binary but without imposing the restrictive support condition required by Vytlacil and Yildiz (2007) for identification of the average structural function (ASF) and the average treatment effect (ATE). Under weak regularity conditions, we derive upper and lower bounds on the ASF and the ATE. We show further that the bounds on the ASF and ATE are sharp under some further regularity conditions and an additional restriction on the support of the covariates and the instrument.
